sum: This study investigates the December 2024–March 2025 Fentale-Dofen dike intrusion in the Main Ethiopian Rift, during which 1.4 km3 of magma propagated ~45 km laterally. Combining Sentinel-1 and COSMO-SkyMed InSAR with full-waveform moment tensor inversion (146 events) and single-station machine-learning earthquake detection (9,335 events), the authors image a multi-level magma plumbing system consisting of two stacked sills at ~6 km and ~12 km depth beneath Fentale caldera connected by a vertical conduit. Seismicity splits into shallow dike-induced normal/strike-slip earthquakes with positive CLVD components and deeper (5–15 km) sill-related vertical-slip events with negative CLVD mechanisms, culminating in an Mw 5.8 event at ~11 km depth. Physics-based stress modeling demonstrates that deep underpressure in the lower sill triggered deep-seated failure and massive magma drainage while the vertical conduit remained open, proving that reservoir connectivity and deep underpressure are essential to drive voluminous dike intrusions.
本研究结合Sentinel-1和COSMO-SkyMed的InSAR数据、146个地震的全波形矩张量反演及单台机器学习检测（9335个事件），研究了2024年底至2025年初埃塞俄比亚裂谷Fentale-Dofen段1.4立方公里的巨型岩脉侵入事件。研究揭示了Fentale火山下方6公里和12公里深……

t: Joint nonlinear Monte Carlo and linear least-squares inversions of S1/CSK InSAR and range offsets are combined with probabilistic full-waveform deviatoric moment tensor inversion (Grond), PhaseNet single-station picking, and analytical stress modeling of connected sills.
联合S1/CSK InSAR非线性与线性位错反演、Grond全波形矩张量概率反演、PhaseNet单台拾取及连通岩床解析…

Sentinel-1 C-band and COSMO-SkyMed X-band SAR interferograms and range offsets, broadband seismic waveforms up to 2000 km for 146 moment tensor inversions, and continuous single-station FURI recordings yielding 9,335 ML-detected events.
Sentinel-1与COSMO-SkyMed干涉图及像素偏移量、2000公里内146个地震宽频带波形，以及FURI单台…

The dike intruded 1.4 km3 of magma (90% CI: 1.38–1.45 km3) over ~45 km, while two stacked sills at 5.7 and 11.6 km beneath Fentale deflated by 0.2 km3 and triggered deep negative-CLVD earthquakes up to Mw 5.8.
岩脉侵入体积达1.4立方公里（长45公里），Fentale下方5.7与11.6公里双岩床收缩0.2立方公里并诱发深部负C…
The modeled Fentale reservoir volume contraction accounts for only 16% of the intruded dike volume, requiring magma compressibility from exsolved gases or undetected deeper (>12 km) magma sources.
反演的岩床排空体积仅占侵入体积的16%，需依赖挥发分膨胀或大于12公里的未观测深部岩浆源解释。

First direct geophysical demonstration that massive dike intrusions require established vertical magma storage connectivity and deep reservoir underpressure failure, rather than tectonic tension and melt availability alone.
首次通过地球物理观测证明巨型岩脉侵入需深部储层连通与欠压破裂，而非仅靠构造拉张与岩浆供应。

kc: Documented the 1.4 km3 Fentale-Dofen dike intrusion (Dec 2024–Mar 2025) over 45 km in the Main Ethiopian Rift using high-resolution CSK and S1 InSAR and seismic records.

Resolved a dual-sill magmatic storage system at 5.7 km and 11.6 km depth beneath Fentale caldera and separated dike-induced seismicity (positive CLVD) from sill-drainage seismicity (negative CLVD, including an Mw 5.8 deep failure).

Developed a physics-based mechanical model showing that a vertically elongated conduit stays open while a horizontally elongated deep sill develops underpressure and fails, driving massive magma drainage without caldera collapse.
利用高时空分辨率CSK与S1 InSAR及地震数据，完整记录了主埃塞俄比亚裂谷Fentale-Dofen段长达45公里、体积达1.4立方公里的巨型岩脉侵入过程。
揭示了Fentale破火山口下5.7与11.6公里深处的双层岩床系统，并通过矩张量反演区分了岩脉诱发地震（正CLVD）与岩床排空地震（负CLVD，含Mw 5.8深部破裂事件）。
建立了物理力学模型，阐明垂直延伸通道在深部水平岩床发生欠压破裂时仍能保持开启，从而在不引发破火山口塌陷的情况下抽取巨量深部岩浆。
me: Joint nonlinear Monte Carlo simulated annealing and linear least-squares elastic dislocation inversion of Sentinel-1/COSMO-SkyMed interferograms and pixel range offsets.
Probabilistic full-waveform deviatoric moment tensor inversion (Grond) of 146 earthquakes and focal mechanism clustering (Seiscloud) combined with waveform similarity analysis.
Single-station machine-learning P and S phase picking (PhaseNet) at station FURI using S-P differential times (13–25 s) to track lateral dike seismicity migration.
Analytical elastic cavity and Coulomb stress modeling of two hydraulically connected sills and a vertical conduit under biaxial extensional tectonic stress.
结合非线性蒙特卡洛模拟退火与线性最小二乘弹性位错反演，联合反演Sentinel-1和COSMO-SkyMed干涉图及像素距离向偏移量（RO）。
利用Grond框架对146个地震进行全波形偏矩张量概率反演，并结合Seiscloud震源机制聚类与波形相似性分析。
在FURI台站应用PhaseNet深度学习方法拾取P波和S波到时，利用S-P走时差（13–25秒）重构地震沿岩脉的迁移演化。
基于双轴伸展构造应力场下受内压圆形腔体解析解及库仑应力计算，构建双层连通岩床与垂直通道的物理力学模型。
de: C-band Sentinel-1 (ascending/descending) and X-band COSMO-SkyMed StripMap SAR images and range offset maps spanning December 2024 to March 2025 (plus pre- and post-intrusive periods).
Global earthquake catalogs (GCMT, NEIC, Geofon, ISC; 285 events) and broadband waveforms from open stations within 2000 km for 146 moment tensor inversions.
Continuous broadband waveform data from single station IU.FURI filtered between 0.05 and 1 Hz, yielding 9,335 ML-detected earthquakes.
2024年12月至2025年3月（及侵入前后时期）获取的C波段Sentinel-1和X波段COSMO-SkyMed雷达干涉图及像素偏移量图。
全球地震目录（GCMT、NEIC、Geofon、ISC共285个事件）以及震中距2000公里内开源宽频带台站记录的146个地震的三分量波形。
IU.FURI台站连续宽频带波形数据（0.05–1 Hz带通滤波），通过单台机器学习检测出9335个地震事件。
li: The modeled Fentale sill deflation volume (0.2–0.3 km3) accounts for only ~16% of the 1.4 km3 intruded dike volume, requiring volatile-rich magma compressibility or undetected deeper (>12 km) sources.
Single-station ML earthquake locations along the dike rely on S-P differential times assuming fixed shallow depths near the Fentale-Dofen segment rather than full 3D network relocations.
InSAR deformation modeling assumes simplified shear and tensile dislocations embedded in a homogeneous, isotropic elastic half-space.
反演所得Fentale岩床收缩体积（0.2–0.3立方公里）仅占岩脉侵入总体积（1.4立方公里）的约16%，需依赖富挥发分岩浆的可压缩性或InSAR无法分辨的更深部（>12公里）源来解释。
单台机器学习检测的9335个地震定位依赖于固定浅源假设下的S-P走时差映射，缺乏密集本地台网的三维精确定位。
InSAR形变反演假设震源位于均匀各向同性弹性半空间中，未考虑深部地壳的粘弹性流变效应。

tm.why: The paper investigates a massive 1.4 km3 magma dike intrusion and connected magma reservoir system under the Fentale-Dofen volcanic segment in the Main Ethiopian Rift using InSAR and volcano-tectonic seismicity.
Full waveform deviatoric moment tensor inversion and CLVD component analysis are performed on 146 earthquakes to distinguish dike-induced faulting from deep sill-deflation seismicity.
Single-station machine learning phase picking (PhaseNet) is applied to detect 9,335 earthquakes and track the spatio-temporal migration of seismicity along the propagating dike.

ev.notes: Full 10-page PDF (9 article pages + cover) was provided and analyzed, including main text, figures 1–3, and Materials and Methods.

sum: Modern earthquake catalogs rely on waveform cross-correlation differential travel times, which often suffer from cycle skips and inconsistent links. This paper introduces DDSync, a lightweight graph-based conditioning method that treats differential times for each station-phase group as a weighted event graph and solves a sparse Laplacian synchronization problem for self-consistent relative arrival potentials. DDSync combines weighted least-squares multipath averaging, residual pruning via a median absolute deviation (MAD) threshold, and iteratively reweighted least squares (IRLS) with a Huber loss, alongside optional Hutchinson stochastic uncertainty estimation. Evaluated on a published Ridgecrest synthetic benchmark with ground truth, DDSync removes severe outliers (RMSE ~0.32 s) and reduces retained timing error from 17 ms to ~3.2 ms. The synchronized outputs improve downstream GrowClust precision and HypoDD accuracy. Furthermore, the recovered arrival potentials enable accurate long-baseline (>30 km) differential reconstruction, fast real-data prelocation, and a conceptual path-difference tomography formulation.
针对波形互相关差异走时数据中的周跳与异常值问题，本文提出轻量级图条件化方法DDSync。该方法将每个台站-震相的差异走时视为加权事件图，通过求解稀疏图拉普拉斯同步问题恢复自洽的相对到时势。DDSync结合了加权最小二乘多路径平均、基于中位数绝对偏差（MAD）的残差剪枝、Huber损失迭代重加权最小二……

t: Frames per-station-phase differential travel times as a weighted graph synchronization problem, solving sparse Laplacian normal equations for per-event arrival potentials, followed by MAD-based residual pruning and Huber-loss IRLS reweighting.
将台站-震相差异走时构建为加权图拉普拉斯同步问题，结合MAD残差剪枝与Huber损失IRLS重加权求解相对到时势。

Evaluated on the published Ridgecrest synthetic benchmark dataset (Yu et al., 2025) containing ground-truth hypocenters, clean picks, and noisy dt.cc files, plus real Ridgecrest catalog data from Trugman et al. (2023).
采用Yu等（2025）的Ridgecrest合成基准数据集（含真实震源与约75万条差分数据）及2019年Ridgecre…

On 750,916 retained pairs, DDSync reduces timing RMSE relative to ground truth from 0.017 s to 0.0032 s while pruning 4,640 severe outliers (RMSE ~0.32 s), and reduces GrowClust horizontal precision error from 0.148 km to 0.104–0.125 km.
剔除4640个严重异常值（RMSE 0.32秒），将保留走时RMSE从17毫秒降至3.2毫秒，GrowClust水平精度…

Requires redundant observations in dense graphs and cannot remove internally consistent common-mode station biases; neglecting covariance makes pairwise uncertainty proxies conservative by a factor of ~2.
依赖密集图冗余度，无法消除自洽的台站共模系统偏差，且忽略协方差使配对不确定度估计偏保守约2倍。

Exploits graph Laplacian synchronization on dt.cc pair files as an upstream conditioning tool to recover per-event arrival potentials for denoising, long-baseline reconstruction, prelocation, and path-difference tomography.
首次将dt.cc文件建模为图拉普拉斯同步问题，恢复事件级到时势以实现走时去噪、长基线重构、快速预定位与路径差分层析成像。

kc: Formulates per-station-phase differential travel-time denoising as a sparse weighted graph Laplacian synchronization problem that implicitly averages over redundant paths.
Combines global least-squares synchronization with MAD-based residual pruning and Huber-loss IRLS reweighting, plus optional Hutchinson stochastic uncertainty estimation (thetaStd).
Reduces differential timing RMSE from ~17 ms to ~3.2 ms on a synthetic Ridgecrest benchmark while accurately identifying and pruning gross outliers (RMSE ~0.32 s).

Demonstrates long-baseline (>30 km) differential travel-time reconstruction, fast single-event-style catalog prelocation on real Ridgecrest data, and a conceptual path-difference tomography framework.
将每个台站-震相的差异走时去噪构建为稀疏加权图拉普拉斯同步问题，隐式地对冗余路径进行多路径平均。
结合全局最小二乘同步、基于MAD的残差剪枝和Huber损失IRLS重加权，并提供基于Hutchinson随机估计的事件不确定度代理（thetaStd）。
在Ridgecrest合成基准测试中，成功识别并剔除严重异常值（RMSE约0.32秒），将保留数据的走时RMSE从约17毫秒降低至约3.2毫秒。
展示了超30公里长基线差异走时重构、在实际Ridgecrest数据上的快速目录预定位，以及概念性的路径差分层析成像框架。
me: Weighted graph Laplacian synchronization via pinned sparse linear least squares to estimate scalar per-event relative arrival potentials per station-phase group.
Edge-level inconsistency scoring using loop-closure residuals, followed by outlier pruning with a Median Absolute Deviation (MAD) threshold and connected-component repinning.
Iteratively Reweighted Least Squares (IRLS) with a Huber loss function to smoothly downweight heavy-tailed residuals.
Hutchinson stochastic diagonal estimation on the inverse reduced Laplacian to compute per-event (thetaStd) and conservative per-pair uncertainty proxies.
Two-pass out-of-core streaming implementation in MATLAB and Julia to process massive HypoDD dt.cc files within standard workstation RAM.
通过固定参考事件的稀疏加权图拉普拉斯最小二乘同步，估计每个台站-震相组内各事件的标量相对到时势。
利用闭合环残差计算边级不一致度评分，随后采用中位数绝对偏差（MAD）阈值剪枝异常边并重新固定连通分量。
采用带有Huber损失函数的迭代重加权最小二乘（IRLS）平滑降低重尾残差的权重。
利用Hutchinson随机对角线估计器计算降阶拉普拉斯逆矩阵对角线，提供单事件（thetaStd）及保守的事件对不确定度代理。
在MATLAB和Julia中实现两遍流式核外处理工作流，避免将超大HypoDD dt.cc文件全部载入内存。
de: Synthetic Ridgecrest benchmark dataset from Yu et al. (2025) with known ground-truth hypocenters, clean picks, and noisy dt.cc pair files (~7.51e5 kept pairs, ~4.6e3 dropped pairs).
Long-baseline differential reconstruction evaluation across interevent distance bins (0–10 km up to 50+ km) comparing synchronized potential differences against pick-derived ground truth.
Downstream relative relocation experiments using HypoDD and GrowClust across varying MAD pruning thresholds (K_sigma = 2, 5, 10, 20) and weighting modes (base vs. stdw).
Real-data fast prelocation demonstration on the 2019 Ridgecrest earthquake sequence dataset from Trugman et al. (2023).
使用Yu等（2025）发布的Ridgecrest合成基准数据集，包含已知真实震源位置、纯净震相拾取及含噪dt.cc配对文件（约75.1万保留对，4600个剔除对）。
在不同事件间距分箱（0–10公里至50公里以上）中评估长基线差分走时重构误差，将同步势差值与真实拾取参考值进行对比。
使用HypoDD和GrowClust在不同MAD剪枝阈值（K_sigma = 2, 5, 10, 20）和权重模式（base与stdw）下开展下游相对重定位实验。
基于Trugman等（2023）的2019年Ridgecrest地震序列实际数据集，演示基于同步到时势的快速预定位效果。
li: Requires data redundancy and dense graph connectivity; sparse dt.cc files with few observations per station-phase group will not benefit from synchronization.
Cannot eliminate coherent, systematic common-mode biases at a given station and phase that remain internally consistent across loop closures.

Pairwise uncertainty proxy (stdw) neglects positive off-diagonal Laplacian inverse covariances, making error estimates conservative by roughly a factor of 2 and potentially degrading HypoDD precision if damping is not retuned.
依赖数据冗余度与密集的图连通性；若dt.cc文件稀疏（每个台站-震相组的观测数接近未知势数量），同步算法难以改善结果。
无法消除特定台站和震相上的相干系统性共模偏差，因为此类偏差在图闭合环中仍保持内部自洽。
事件对不确定度代理（stdw）忽略了拉普拉斯逆矩阵的正协方差项，导致不确定度估计保守约2倍，若不重新调整HypoDD阻尼参数可能会降低其相对定位精度。

tm.why: The paper develops a graph-based conditioning tool (DDSync) to denoise differential travel-time observations for double-difference earthquake relocation (HypoDD, GrowClust) and fast catalog prelocation.

The method frames differential travel-time denoising as a weighted graph Laplacian synchronization problem solved via weighted least squares, MAD-based pruning, IRLS with Huber loss, and Hutchinson stochastic diagonal estimation.
The authors formulate a conceptual path-difference body-wave tomography workflow leveraging synchronized long-baseline differential travel times to sharpen velocity structure near seismic clusters.

ev.notes: Full 14-page PDF from Seismological Research Letters (2026) was read and analyzed, including all mathematical derivations, benchmark metrics, and all 8 figures.

sum: This study investigates coseismic geomagnetic field fluctuations recorded at magnetic observatories in Kazakhstan (AAA) and the USA (FRN, TUC, BOU) during three earthquakes (2024 Aykol Mw 7.0, 2024 Cholpon-Ata Mw 4.7, and 2019 Ridgecrest Mw 7.1). By comparing total magnetic field measurements from scalar absolute magnetometers with total fields reconstructed from triaxial fluxgate vector magnetometers, the authors demonstrate that strong coseismic oscillations are primarily 'seismokinetic'—caused by mechanical tilting of the sensor and its support rather than true seismomagnetic fields. Due to 1 Hz sampling aliasing, vector reconstructions lose correlation with scalar measurements during shaking. The authors derive coordinate-rotation equations relating horizontal magnetic component increments to sensor tilt, enabling estimation of the seismic P-wave arrival azimuth from the initial impact within 0.55° to 14.81° of USGS epicenters. They recommend equipping observatories with high-frequency inclinometers (>100 Hz) to correct for tilt.
本研究分析了哈萨克斯坦和美国的地磁台站在三次地震期间记录的震时地磁场波动。通过对比标量绝对磁力仪测量的总磁场与三分量磁通门矢量磁力仪重构的总磁场，证明观测到的强烈震时波动主要源于传感器及支架的机械倾斜（震动效应），而非真实的震磁信号。受低采样率混叠影响，地震期间两类仪器的总场相关性显著下降。作者推导……

t: Models the magnetometer support as a tilting parallelepiped under P-wave horizontal impact, deriving linear small-angle coordinate rotation equations that relate geomagnetic component increments to sensor tilt and wave arrival azimuth.
将磁力仪支架建模为受P波水平冲击倾斜的平行六面体，推导连接磁场分量增量与倾角及波到达方位角的线性小角度坐标旋转方程。

Analyzed 1 Hz vector (LEMI-018) and 0.2 Hz scalar (POS-1) magnetograms from Almaty (AAA) for two 2024 Central Asian earthquakes, plus 1 Hz INTERMAGNET records (FRN, TUC, BOU) for the 2019 Ridgecrest earthquake.
分析了阿拉木图台站对两次2024年中亚地震的矢量和标量磁记录，以及美国三个台站对2019年里奇克莱斯特地震的1 Hz数据…

Scalar-vector total field correlation dropped from 0.9–0.98 to 0–0.57 during seismic shaking due to aliasing of tilt oscillations. Epicenter azimuths estimated from initial magnetic jumps deviated by 0.55° to 14.81° from USGS values.
受倾斜振荡混叠影响，地震期间标量与矢量总场相关性从0.9以上降至0–0.57；由初至磁突变估算的震中方位角偏差为0.55…

Sampling below 100 Hz causes aliasing of seismic vibrations (up to 50 Hz), preventing tilt compensation, while post-onset signals reflect support resonance and multi-axis rotations rather than wave azimuth.
低于100 Hz采样率会导致高达50 Hz地震振动混叠而无法补偿倾斜，且初至波后的信号受支架共振和多轴旋转主导。

Distinguishes mechanical seismokinetic sensor tilts from true seismomagnetic effects via scalar-vector decorrelation and extracts earthquake epicenter bearings directly from the initial jump in 1 Hz vector magnetograms.
利用标量-矢量去相关区分机械震动倾斜与真实震磁效应，并直接从1 Hz矢量磁记录初至突变中提取震中方位角。

kc: Demonstrated that coseismic fluctuations in vector magnetograms are dominated by mechanical sensor tilting (seismokinetic effect) rather than intrinsic geomagnetic variations.
Derived analytical coordinate-transformation equations linking magnetic component increments (ΔBx, ΔBy, ΔBz) to horizontal sensor tilt angles and seismic wave arrival azimuths.
Validated earthquake azimuth estimation across five magnetic observatories for three earthquakes, achieving deviations between 0.55° and 14.81° relative to USGS epicenters.
Proposed sliding-window correlation between scalar and reconstructed vector total fields as a real-time quality control indicator for seismokinetic contamination.
证明矢量磁力仪记录中的震时波动主要由传感器机械倾斜（震动效应）引起，而非真实地磁场变化。
推导了将磁场分量增量与水平传感器倾角及地震波到达方位角联系起来的解析坐标变换方程。
利用5个地磁台站对3次地震进行了震中方位角估算验证，结果与USGS震中方位角的偏差在0.55°至14.81°之间。
提出将标量与矢量重构总场之间的滑动窗口相关性作为实时识别震动干扰和数据质量控制的指标。
me: 3D coordinate rotation modeling assuming small angular tilts of the magnetometer support about a horizontal axis parallel to the P-wavefront.
High-pass filtering (4th-order Butterworth) and sliding-window cross-correlation (10 samples, 5 s per sample) between scalar and vector-derived total magnetic fields.
Time-derivative jump detection to identify the exact onset of seismic P-wave impact on 1 Hz magnetograms for azimuth calculation.
建立三维坐标旋转模型，假设磁力仪支架绕平行于P波波前的水平轴发生小角度倾斜。
对标量总场和矢量重构总场进行四阶巴特沃斯高通滤波及滑动窗口互相关分析（10个样本窗口，采样间隔5秒）。
利用时间导数突变检测识别1 Hz磁记录中地震P波初至时刻，进而计算震中方位角。
de: 1 Hz triaxial fluxgate (LEMI-018) and 0.2 Hz scalar (POS-1) magnetometer records at Almaty (AAA) observatory for the 22 Jan 2024 Aykol (Mw 7.0) and 4 Mar 2024 Cholpon-Ata (Mw 4.7) earthquakes.
Broadband seismogram from the nearby Medeo (MDO) seismic station (~8 km from AAA) for arrival time comparison.
1 Hz vector and scalar magnetograms from INTERMAGNET observatories Fresno (FRN), Tucson (TUC), and Boulder (BOU) during the 6 July 2019 Ridgecrest (Mw 7.1) earthquake.
阿拉木图（AAA）台站记录的2024年1月22日阿合奇Mw 7.0地震和3月4日乔尔蓬阿塔Mw 4.7地震的1 Hz三分量磁通门（LEMI-018）和0.2 Hz标量（POS-1）磁力仪数据。
距离AAA台站约8公里的Medeo（MDO）地震台宽频带地震记录，用于到时对比。
INTERMAGNET数据库中FRN、TUC和BOU台站记录的2019年7月6日里奇克莱斯特Mw 7.1地震的1 Hz矢量和标量磁记录。
li: The 1 Hz magnetometer sampling rate is far below the Nyquist frequency for seismic vibrations (up to 50 Hz), causing severe aliasing that prevents exact waveform matching or tilt compensation.
Only the very first seismic impact yields a reliable azimuth; subsequent oscillations are dominated by structural resonance of the magnetometer support.
The mathematical model only considers simplified rotation about a single horizontal axis, whereas real seismic shaking induces multi-axis rotations.
磁力仪1 Hz的采样率远低于地震振动（高达50 Hz）的奈奎斯特频率，导致严重混叠，无法精确匹配波形或补偿倾斜。
只有最初的地震波冲击能提供可靠的方位角，随后的振荡受磁力仪支架结构共振主导。
数学模型仅考虑了绕单一水平轴的简化旋转，而实际地震摇晃会引起多轴旋转。

tm.why: The paper analyzes mechanical oscillations (seismokinetic effects) of vector magnetometer supports during seismic wave arrivals and recommends adding high-frequency inclinometers to magnetic observatory instrumentation.
The authors derive mathematical equations relating magnetic component variations to sensor tilt angles to determine the arrival azimuth of seismic P-waves toward earthquake epicenters.

ev.notes: Full 22-page PDF analyzed, including equations, 16 figures, and 3 tables.

sum: This study analyzes microseism generation from two consecutive 2018 super typhoons (Trami and Kong-Rey) crossing the Ryukyu arc. Using continuous seismic and pressure data from ocean-bottom seismometers (OBSs) and land stations, integrated with ERA5 reanalysis and WAVEWATCH III wave models, the authors identify short-period (2–6 s) and long-period (6–10 s) double-frequency microseisms. Source tracking reveals two primary excitation mechanisms: coastal reflections of storm-induced waves along the island arc (class II) and single-storm opposing-swell interactions (class IIIa) where a fast-moving storm overtakes its own previous swell. The findings demonstrate the utility of OBS arrays in tracking typhoon-induced microseisms and highlight how subduction bathymetry modulates ocean-to-solid-Earth energy transfer.
本研究分析了2018年穿过琉球岛弧的两个连续超强台风（潭美和康妮）引起的微震特征。利用海底地震仪（OBS）和陆地台站的连续地震与压力记录，结合ERA5再分析和WAVEWATCH III波浪模型，识别出短周期（2-6秒）和长周期（6-10秒）双频微震。源追踪揭示了两种主导激发机制：一是台风引起的波浪在……

t: Spectral analysis of continuous OBS and land seismic/pressure data combined with WAVEWATCH III wave modeling and ERA5 reanalysis.
结合OBS和陆地台站的连续地震与压力数据，进行频谱分析、WAVEWATCH III波浪模拟及ERA5再分析。
Continuous seismic and pressure records from OBSs and land stations during the 2018 super typhoons Trami and Kong-Rey, supplemented by ERA5 and WAVEWATCH III.
2018年超强台风“潭美”和“康妮”期间的OBS与陆地台站连续观测数据，以及ERA5和WAVEWATCH III模拟数据…
Identification of short-period (2–6 s) and long-period (6–10 s) double-frequency microseisms, driven by coastal reflections (class II) and single-storm opposing-swell interactions (class IIIa).
识别出短周期和长周期双频微震，揭示了沿岸反射（Class II）和单风暴相反涌浪相互作用（Class IIIa）两种激发…
The analysis is constrained to the specific bathymetric and tectonic setting of the Ryukyu subduction system.
研究结果和机制解释受限于琉球俯冲带特定的水深和地形环境。
Direct observational tracking of class II and class IIIa microseism generation mechanisms using an in-situ OBS array during consecutive super typhoons.
首次利用原位OBS台阵直接观测并追踪了连续超强台风期间Class II和Class IIIa微震源的激发过程。

kc: Identified and characterized short-period (2–6 s) and long-period (6–10 s) double-frequency microseisms generated by consecutive super typhoons.
Tracked microseism sources across the Ryukyu subduction margin using a combination of OBS arrays, land stations, and numerical wave models.
Demonstrated two distinct microseism excitation mechanisms: coastal reflection (class II) and single-storm opposing-swell interaction (class IIIa).
识别并表征了连续超强台风产生的短周期（2-6秒）和长周期（6-10秒）双频微震特征。
结合OBS台阵、陆地台站和数值波浪模型，对跨琉球俯冲带边缘的微震源进行了追踪。
证实了两种不同的微震激发机制：海岸反射（Class II）和单风暴相反涌浪相互作用（Class IIIa）。
me: Spectral analysis of continuous seismic and pressure records from ocean-bottom seismometers (OBSs) and land stations.
Numerical ocean wave modeling using WAVEWATCH III to simulate significant wave heights and wave-wave interactions.
Integration with ERA5 atmospheric reanalysis data to correlate sea surface pressure with microseism power.
对海底地震仪（OBS）和陆地台站的连续地震与压力记录进行频谱分析。
使用WAVEWATCH III数值波浪模型模拟有效波高和波-波相互作用。
结合ERA5大气再分析数据，将海表面气压与微震能量进行相关性分析。
de: Continuous seismic and pressure data recorded by ocean-bottom seismometers (OBSs) and nearby land stations during the 2018 typhoons Trami and Kong-Rey.
ERA5 atmospheric reanalysis datasets and WAVEWATCH III wave model outputs.
2018年台风“潭美”和“康妮”期间，海底地震仪（OBS）及周边陆地台站记录的连续地震和压力数据。
ERA5大气再分析数据集和WAVEWATCH III波浪模型输出数据。

该研究在地理上集中于琉球俯冲带，所识别的震源机制在不同的水深或海岸背景下可能会有所不同。

tm.why: The paper investigates the generation and source mechanisms of short- and long-period double-frequency microseisms induced by super typhoons.
It focuses on environmental seismology, specifically the interaction between atmospheric storms (typhoons), ocean waves, and solid Earth ground motion.
The study utilizes continuous seismic and pressure records from ocean-bottom seismometers (OBSs) to track microseism sources.

sum: This study investigates the 2025 Sındırgı double earthquake sequence (two Mw 6.1 events on August 10 and October 27) in Western Anatolia, Türkiye. By integrating field geology, seismology, InSAR data, and Coulomb stress transfer modeling, the authors resolve the kinematic ambiguity of the sequence. They demonstrate that the earthquakes nucleated at a fault tip and migrated along newly mapped secondary faults of the Emendere fault zone. The sequence is classified as a 'double earthquake' driven by a hybrid mechanism of tectonic extension and geothermal implosion, distinguishing it from typical dip-slip normal-faulting events in the region.
本研究结合野外地质、地震学、InSAR数据和库仑应力演化模拟，对土耳其安纳托利亚西部2025年Sındırgı双震序列（8月10日和10月27日两次Mw 6.1地震）进行了综合分析。研究表明，该地震序列起震于断层端部，并沿新发现的Emendere断裂带次级断层向东东南方向迁移。库仑应力计算证实了前震……

t: Integration of field-based geology, seismological focal mechanism analysis, InSAR geodesy, and Coulomb stress transfer modeling.
结合野外地质调查、地震震源机制解分析、InSAR大地测量以及库仑应力转移模拟。
Seismic waveforms of the Mw 6.1 mainshocks and aftershocks, InSAR satellite data, and field geological observations of the Simav and Emendere fault zones.
两次Mw 6.1主震及余震的地震波形、InSAR卫星形变观测以及断裂带野外地质数据。
The sequence was triggered by Coulomb stress transfer from the first event, migrating along newly mapped secondary faults, driven by tectonic extension and geothermal implosion.
库仑应力转移触发了第二次主震，余震沿新发现的次级断层迁移，受构造与地热混合驱动。
The complex interplay of tectonic extension and geothermal implosion introduces kinematic ambiguities that require detailed local fluid-fault coupling models.
构造拉张与地热内爆的复杂相互作用导致运动学存在多义性，需更精细的流体-断层耦合模型。
Classification of the Sındırgı sequence as a double earthquake driven by a hybrid mechanism of tectonic extension and geothermal implosion.
首次将该序列定义为由构造拉张与地热内爆混合机制驱动的“双震”事件。

kc: Characterized the kinematic and source parameters of the 2025 Sındırgı double earthquake sequence.
Mapped new secondary faults within the Emendere fault zone using integrated geological and InSAR observations.
Demonstrated that Coulomb stress transfer from the August 10 event directly triggered the October 27 earthquake.
Proposed a hybrid mechanism involving both tectonic extension and geothermal implosion to explain the complex faulting behavior.
确定了2025年Sındırgı双震序列的运动学与震源参数。
结合地质与InSAR观测，在Emendere断裂带内绘制了新的次级断层。
证实了8月10日地震的库仑应力转移直接触发了10月27日的地震。
提出了结合构造拉张与地热内爆的混合机制，以解释复杂的断层破裂行为。
me: InSAR (Interferometric Synthetic Aperture Radar) data analysis for surface deformation mapping.
Seismic focal mechanism inversion for mainshocks and aftershocks.
Field-based geological mapping of fault segments.
Coulomb stress transfer modeling.
利用InSAR（合成孔径雷达干涉测量）数据分析地表形变。
对主震及余震进行地震震源机制解反演。
开展断层段的野外地质调查与填图。
进行库仑应力转移数值模拟。
de: Seismic waveform data for the August 10 (Mw 6.1) and October 27 (Mw 6.1) mainshocks and their aftershock sequence.
InSAR satellite observations capturing co-seismic deformation.
Field geological observations of the Sındırgı segment of the Simav fault zone and the Emendere fault zone.
8月10日（Mw 6.1）和10月27日（Mw 6.1）主震及其余震序列的地震波形数据。
获取同震形变的InSAR卫星观测数据。
Simav断裂带Sındırgı段及Emendere断裂带的野外地质调查数据。
li: The complex hybrid mechanism involving geothermal implosion requires further high-resolution local monitoring to fully quantify the fluid-fault interaction.
涉及地热内爆的复杂混合机制仍需要更高分辨率的本地监测，以定量化流体与断层的相互作用。

tm.why: The paper analyzes the seismic source, focal mechanisms, and rupture dynamics of the 2025 Sındırgı double earthquake sequence.
It investigates the tectonic extension, fault zones, and structural geology of the Western Anatolia Extensional Province.
It models Coulomb stress transfer and examines the kinematic interplay of fault segments and stress loading.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the detailed abstract and metadata available from OpenAlex, Crossref, and Semantic Scholar, as no PDF was available.

sum: This study models the coseismic slip of the 2024 Mw 7.3 Hualien earthquake using onshore and seafloor geodetic data alongside relocated seismicity. The inversion reveals a complex multi-fault rupture involving a deep, 70° east-dipping Longitudinal Valley fault (maximum slip 2.3 m) and a 35° west-dipping offshore fault (maximum slip 1.1 m). Both faults released comparable geodetic moments, each equivalent to an Mw 7.1 event. The findings suggest that offshore structures near Hualien accommodate a significant portion of plate convergence, supported by a sharp decrease in GNSS secular velocities and the seaward propagation of the Central Range fault.
本研究利用陆地与海底大地测量数据及重定位地震，模拟了2024年Mw 7.3花莲地震的同震滑动。反演表明该地震涉及双断层复杂破裂：深部向东倾斜70°的纵谷断层（最大滑动2.3米）和向西倾斜35°的外海断层（最大滑动1.1米），两者释放了相当的矩张量（各相当于Mw 7.1地震）。结果表明花莲外海结构分担……

t: Joint inversion of onshore and seafloor geodetic data combined with relocated seismicity to model coseismic slip on multiple fault planes.
结合陆地与海底大地测量数据及重定位地震，对多断层面的同震滑动进行联合反演。
Onshore GNSS data, seafloor geodetic measurements, and relocated seismicity associated with the 2024 Mw 7.3 Hualien earthquake sequence.
2024年花莲Mw 7.3地震序列的陆地GNSS、海底大地测量观测及重定位地震数据。
The rupture involved a 70° east-dipping Longitudinal Valley fault (max slip 2.3 m) and a 35° west-dipping offshore fault (max slip 1.1 m), each releasing Mw 7.1 equivalent energy.
破裂包含东倾70°纵谷断层（最大滑动2.3米）和西倾35°外海断层（最大滑动1.1米）。
The study is limited by the spatial resolution of seafloor geodetic observations compared to dense onshore networks.
受限于海底大地测量观测空间分辨率相对陆地观测网较低的局限。
First study to integrate seafloor geodesy with onshore data to resolve the complex offshore-onshore dual-fault rupture of the 2024 Hualien event.
首次结合海底与陆地大地测量数据，揭示了2024年花莲地震海陆双断层复杂破裂机制。

kc: Revealed a complex dual-fault rupture mechanism for the 2024 Mw 7.3 Hualien earthquake.
Quantified coseismic slip on both the 70° east-dipping Longitudinal Valley fault and a 35° west-dipping offshore fault.
Demonstrated that offshore structures near Hualien accommodate a substantial portion of plate convergence.
揭示了2024年Mw 7.3花莲地震的双断层复杂破裂机制。
定量计算了向东倾斜70°的纵谷断层与向西倾斜35°的外海断层的同震滑动分布。
证实了花莲外海构造分担了板块汇聚的重要份额。
me: Coseismic slip inversion using joint onshore and seafloor geodetic datasets.
Integration of relocated seismicity to constrain fault geometry.
结合陆地与海底大地测量数据集进行同震滑动反演。
结合重定位地震活动性约束断层几何形状。
de: Onshore GNSS and seafloor geodetic measurements.
Relocated seismicity catalog for the 2024 Hualien earthquake sequence.
陆地GNSS与海底大地测量观测数据。
2024年花莲地震序列的重定位地震目录。
li: Resolution of seafloor geodetic data is typically lower than onshore networks, potentially limiting offshore slip details.
海底大地测量数据的分辨率通常低于陆地网络，可能限制了外海滑动的细节解析。

tm.why: The paper models the coseismic slip and complex rupture process of the 2024 Mw 7.3 Hualien earthquake.
The study discusses the tectonic implications of the rupture, plate convergence, and fault structures in Taiwan.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the peer-reviewed abstract and metadata from Seismological Research Letters, as no PDF was available.

sum: This Nature research highlight discusses how volcanic magma and carbon dioxide bubbling up from underground can solidify seafloor materials, sculpting eerie dome structures on the ocean floor. It highlights the interaction between magmatic degassing and marine geological formations.
这篇《自然》研究亮点文章探讨了火山岩浆及地下涌出的二氧化碳气体如何使海底物质凝固，从而在海底塑造出奇异的穹丘结构。该研究揭示了岩浆脱气与海洋地质构造形成之间的相互作用。

t: Observation and analysis of seafloor volcanic structures and carbon dioxide degassing processes.
对海底火山结构及二氧化碳脱气过程进行原位观测与分析。
In situ observations of seafloor domes and bubbling carbon dioxide from underground volcanic sources.
海底穹丘构造及地下火山源释放二氧化碳气泡的观测数据。
Carbon dioxide bubbling up from underground volcanic magma solidifies seafloor material to form dome structures.
地下火山岩浆涌出的二氧化碳使海底物质凝固，形成了独特的穹丘。
Limited detailed physical and chemical modeling of the solidification rates and exact mineralogy in this brief report.
简报中缺乏对凝固速率及具体矿物成分的详细物理化学模拟。
Linking magmatic carbon dioxide degassing directly to the physical solidification and sculpting of seafloor dome structures.
首次将岩浆二氧化碳脱气与海底穹丘构造的物理凝固与塑造直接联系起来。

Explains the formation mechanism of eerie dome structures on the sea floor

解释了海底奇异穹丘结构的形成机制

海底火山结构的地球物理与地球化学观测
de: Observations of carbon dioxide bubbling and dome formations on the sea floor
海底二氧化碳气泡涌出与穹丘构造的观测数据

作为简短的研究亮点，缺乏对凝固过程的详细定量模拟

ev.notes: Analyzed based on the Nature Research Highlight metadata and Google search snippets describing the role of carbon dioxide in solidifying seafloor material.

sum: This study develops the first locally constrained 1D shallow shear-wave velocity (VS) models at the Mpala Research Centre in Kenya using one year of ambient-noise data from a 15-station broadband array. By jointly inverting Rayleigh-wave dispersion curves (2–9 Hz) from passive seismic interferometry and horizontal-to-vertical spectral ratios (HVSR), the authors image the critical zone down to several hundred meters. They identify three distinct velocity contrasts in the upper 100 m. These models provide crucial hydrogeological constraints for shallow well-siting during droughts and establish a baseline to correct for site-amplification effects in seismic wildlife monitoring.
本研究利用肯尼亚Mpala研究中心15个宽频带地震台站一年的背景噪声数据，构建了该地区首个本地约束的浅表一维剪切波速度（VS）模型。研究联合反演了被动地震干涉法提取的瑞雷波色散曲线（2-9 Hz）与背景噪声水平与垂直谱比（HVSR），探测深度达数百米。结果在浅表100米内发现了三个连续的速度界面。该……

t: Joint inversion of ambient-noise horizontal-to-vertical spectral ratio (HVSR) and Rayleigh-wave dispersion curves from passive seismic interferometry.
联合反演背景噪声水平与垂直谱比（HVSR）和被动地震干涉法提取的瑞雷波色散曲线。
Twelve months of continuous ambient noise recorded by a 15-station broadband seismic array in Mpala, Kenya.
采用肯尼亚Mpala地区15个宽频带地震台站记录的12个月连续背景噪声数据。
Detection of three shallow velocity contrasts in the upper 100 m: at 1-4 m, 5-20 m, and 15-50 m depth.
在浅表100米内检测到三个一致的速度界面，分别位于1-4米、5-20米和15-50米深度。
The 2-9 Hz dispersion curves limit resolution to depths of 70-430 m, requiring HVSR to constrain shallower near-surface structures.
2-9 Hz的色散曲线主要对70-430米深度敏感，极浅层结构需依赖HVSR进行约束。
First locally constrained shear-wave velocity models in Mpala, linking critical zone geophysics to wildlife monitoring and water-well siting.
首次构建了Mpala地区本地约束的剪切波速度模型，将关键带地球物理与野生动物监测及水井选址相结合。

kc: Developed the first locally constrained shallow shear-wave velocity (VS) models for the Mpala Research Centre, Kenya.
Successfully integrated ambient-noise HVSR and passive seismic interferometry dispersion curves in a joint inversion.
Identified three consistent shallow velocity contrasts in the upper 100 m corresponding to critical zone stratigraphy.
Provided a geophysical framework to support shallow water-well siting and correct site effects for seismic wildlife monitoring.
构建了肯尼亚Mpala研究中心首个本地约束的浅部剪切波速度（VS）模型。
成功将背景噪声HVSR与被动地震干涉法色散曲线进行了联合反演。
在浅表100米深度内识别出三个与关键带地层相对应的连续速度界面。
为干旱区浅层水井选址以及野生动物地震监测中的场地效应校正提供了地球物理框架。
me: Ambient-noise horizontal-to-vertical spectral ratio (HVSR) to constrain near-surface impedance contrasts.
Passive seismic interferometry to extract Rayleigh-wave dispersion curves in the 2–9 Hz frequency band.
Joint inversion of HVSR and Rayleigh-wave dispersion measurements to resolve 1D shear-wave velocity profiles.
利用背景噪声水平与垂直谱比（HVSR）约束近地表阻抗对比。
利用被动地震干涉法提取2-9 Hz频段的瑞雷波色散曲线。
联合反演HVSR与瑞雷波色散测量数据，求解一维剪切波速度剖面。
de: Twelve months of continuous seismic data recorded by a 15-station broadband seismic array deployed at the Mpala Research Centre, Kenya.
采用部署在肯尼亚Mpala研究中心的15台站宽频带地震台网所记录的12个月连续地震背景噪声数据。
li: The frequency band of the dispersion curves (2–9 Hz) limits resolution at very shallow depths, requiring HVSR to assist with near-surface constraints.
The current array configuration lacks the multiscale density needed to resolve highly localized, complex 3D geological structures.
色散曲线的频段（2-9 Hz）限制了极浅层的分辨率，需要依赖HVSR辅助约束近地表。
当前的台阵配置缺乏解析高度局部化、复杂的地下三维地质结构所需的多尺度台站密度。

tm.why: The study uses ambient-noise horizontal-to-vertical spectral ratio (HVSR) and passive seismic interferometry to construct shear-wave velocity models.
The paper focuses on the subsurface critical zone, shallow groundwater availability, and seismic wildlife monitoring, which fall under environmental seismology.

sum: This study utilizes a multi-dataset joint inversion framework to image the lithosphere-asthenosphere boundary and interaction beneath the North China Craton (NCC). By integrating multiple geophysical and thermodynamic observables, the authors constrain the thermal and compositional structure of the lithospheric mantle. The resulting models provide key insights into the mechanisms driving Cenozoic intraplate volcanism and anomalous basin subsidence in the region, highlighting the role of lithospheric thinning and asthenospheric upwelling.
本研究采用多数据集联合反演框架，对华北克拉通（NCC）下方的岩石圈-软流圈边界及相互作用进行了成像。通过整合多种地球物理和热力学观测数据，约束了岩石圈地幔的温度和化学成分结构。所得模型为该地区新生代板内火山活动和异常盆地沉降的动力学机制提供了关键见解，强调了岩石圈减薄与软流圈上涌的作用。

t: Multi-dataset joint inversion framework integrating geophysical and thermodynamic observables to constrain lithospheric structure.
整合地球物理与热力学观测的多数据集联合反演框架，用于约束岩石圈结构。
Multiple geophysical observables over the North China Craton used to resolve thermal and compositional variations.
覆盖华北克拉通的多源地球物理观测数据，用于解析温度与成分变化。
Detailed imaging of the lithosphere-asthenosphere interaction, explaining the origins of intraplate volcanism and anomalous basin subsidence.
精细刻画了岩石圈-软流圈相互作用，解释了板内火山与异常盆地沉降的成因。
Trade-offs between temperature and composition in joint inversion schemes.

sum: Conventional full waveform inversion (FWI) suffers from cycle skipping, noise sensitivity, and reliance on accurate initial velocity models, while simultaneous-source FWI (SSFWI) introduces severe crosstalk artifacts. This study proposes a physics-guided Fourier representation neural network (PGFRNN) for unsupervised acoustic FWI and SSFWI. Observed and simulated time-domain shot gathers are transformed into the frequency domain via 1D FFT and embedded into a complex-valued latent space using a shared complex-valued CNN with skip connections. A numerically stable softplus-approximated log-cosh (SALC) loss measures the discrepancy between the real and imaginary latent representations, and two Adam optimizers jointly update the velocity model and network weights via automatic differentiation in Deepwave. Tested on the 2D Overthrust model, PGFRNN substantially outperforms conventional L2 and SALC-based FWI, achieving higher truth-to-error ratios and structural similarity across linear initial models, simultaneous sources, strong noise (-0.61 dB SNR), and missing low-frequency data (<4 Hz).

sum: This study presents a multilevel Bayesian inversion framework to quantify uncertainties and correlations among on- and off-fault dynamic rupture parameters for the 2019 Mw 7.1 Ridgecrest earthquake. Incorporating rate-and-state friction and off-fault plasticity, the inversion is constrained by multidisciplinary geodetic data (satellite offsets, high-rate and static GNSS) and enabled by over four million CPU hours of 3D dynamic rupture simulations. The results reveal a strong correlation between on-fault frictional weakening and off-fault plasticity, showing that inelastic deformation can compensate for velocity-weakening friction. The preferred models indicate a northwest-to-southeast reduction in velocity weakening and favor low off-fault plastic cohesion, yielding a shallow slip deficit (SSD) of 13.1%. This demonstrates the feasibility of integrating physics-based 3D simulations with Bayesian UQ.

sum: This study addresses the controversy over whether the Asian lithosphere beneath Northern Tibet is underthrusting or subducting. The authors compile 846 helium isotopic (Rc/Ra) data points across the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau and develop a Two-Stage Gradient Boosted Tree-Probabilistic Fusion Network (2S-GBTPFN), an attention-based machine learning method. By integrating geological, geophysical, geochemical, and hydrological parameters, they delineate a helium boundary (Rc/Ra > 0.1Ra) representing a 'mantle suture'. This boundary reveals a non-uniform rheological boundary along the Kunlun fault and limited, uneven southward subduction of the Asian lithosphere, supporting a dual-slab subduction and lithospheric delamination model for the plateau's uplift.

sum: This paper presents a multi-step workflow to address the challenges of predicting fracture parameters in multi-layered formations using converted P-to-S (PS) waves. The method integrates Alford rotation and layer stripping to separate fast and slow PS-waves in anisotropic media. It then estimates fracture strike using a weighted circular mean algorithm and quantifies fracture intensity via sliding-window-based Z-score normalization. Tested on numerical simulations and real-world offshore data with limited azimuthal coverage, the workflow successfully enhances both PS-wave imaging quality and the reliability of quantitative fracture characterization, offering a robust solution for reservoir characterization under complex geological conditions.

sum: This didactic, application-oriented textbook introduces digital signal processing principles through seismic data analysis. Developed for graduate students and researchers, it bridges fundamental theory with practical MATLAB implementations. The book covers core concepts like sampling, Fourier analysis, convolution, deconvolution, and digital filtering, leading to advanced seismological applications such as spectral magnitude estimation, source-time function retrieval, ambient-noise cross-correlation, and site-response analysis (HVSR). It provides hands-on learning using synthetic and real seismic data.

sum: Resolving the fine-scale rupture kinematics of moderate-sized (M ~ 6) earthquakes at regional distances is challenging for conventional seismic networks due to sparse station coverage. This study combines P-wave recordings from a ~450 km-long ocean-bottom Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) array offshore Chile (25,972 channels) and 27 onshore broadband stations to image the 2024 Mw 6.0 intermediate-depth (141 km) earthquake in Argentina (~400 km away). Using an empirical Green's function (EGF) cross-correlation approach with an Mw 4.5 aftershock and a second-stage long-wavelength timing alignment, the authors perform shift-and-stack back-projection. The imaging resolves two sub-events separated by ~3 s, indicating northward rupture propagation over 5.9–8.3 km along strike (speeds of 2.0–2.8 km/s). This resolves the nodal plane ambiguity in favor of a north-south striking, west-dipping normal fault within the subducting Nazca slab, demonstrating the transformative potential of seafloor DAS for regional source imaging.
受限于台站密度，利用传统地震台网在区域距离上解析中等强度（M~6）地震的精细破裂过程极具挑战。本研究结合智利近海约450公里长的海底分布式声学传感（DAS）阵列（25,972个通道）与27个陆地宽频带台站的P波数据，对约400公里外阿根廷发生的2024年Mw 6.0中源地震（深度141公里）进行反投……

t: Spatial integration of DAS strain-rate to velocity, cross-correlation with an Mw 4.5 aftershock EGF, second-stage long-wavelength timing alignment on the second subevent, and harmonic-mean merging of normalized DAS and seismic shift-and-stack back-projection images.
将DAS应变率积分为速度，与Mw4.5余震EGF互相关，对齐第二子事件长波长走时，调和平均融合反投影。

P-wave recordings of the 21 September 2024 Mw 6.0 intermediate-depth earthquake (141 km depth) and an Mw 4.5 aftershock from a ~450 km seafloor DAS array (25,972 channels) offshore Chile and 27 onshore broadband stations.
智利近海450公里海底DAS阵列（25972通道）与27个陆地台站记录的Mw6.0中源地震及余震P波。

Back-projection identifies two subevents separated by ~3 s, propagating northward for 5.9–8.3 km along strike (350°) at speeds of 2.0–2.8 km/s, with circular-crack stress drops of 6.6–16.1 MPa, resolving a west-dipping intraslab normal fault.
解析出相隔约3秒的两个子事件，沿走向向北破裂5.9–8.3公里，破裂速度2.0–2.8 km/s。

Long-wavelength (>50 km) unmodeled 3-D velocity heterogeneities dominate back-projection uncertainty (~7 km E-W, 1.5 km N-S), alongside E-W smearing (~15 km) from one-sided array geometry and lack of depth phases.
单侧台阵导致东西向涂抹（15公里），无深度震相，长波长速度异常引起约7公里定位偏差。

First demonstration that integrating a regional 450 km ocean-bottom DAS cable with onshore seismometers resolves kilometer-scale rupture kinematics of a moderate (Mw 6.0) earthquake at ~400 km distance.

kc: Achieved kilometer-scale rupture imaging of a regional Mw 6.0 intermediate-depth earthquake at ~400 km distance by integrating a 450 km seafloor DAS cable with an onshore seismic network.
Developed a two-stage travel-time calibration combining empirical Green's function (EGF) cross-correlation and long-wavelength subevent alignment to suppress path and site effects.
Resolved two distinct subevents separated by ~3 s and 5.9–8.3 km along strike, identifying a north-south striking, west-dipping normal fault plane reactivating a pre-existing slab weakness.
通过融合450公里海底DAS光缆与陆地地震台网数据，实现了约400公里外Mw 6.0中源地震的公里级高分辨率破裂成像。
开发了结合经验格林函数（EGF）互相关与二阶段长波长子事件对齐的走时校正流程，有效抑制了路径和场地效应。
解析出相隔约3秒、沿走向相距5.9–8.3公里的两个子事件，确定发震断层为重新活动的南北走向、西倾板内正断层。
me: Spatial integration of DAS strain-rate recordings to velocity to suppress locally scattered waves and clarify direct P arrivals.

Sensor-by-sensor cross-correlation of mainshock P-waves with an Mw 4.5 aftershock empirical Green's function (EGF), followed by long-wavelength (>50 km) spatial filtering of subevent travel-time residuals.
Shift-and-stack back-projection with a 2-s sliding window and reference-window artifact suppression, merging normalized DAS (1–4 Hz) and seismic (0.5–2 Hz) beam-power maps via the harmonic mean.
对DAS应变率数据进行空间积分以转换为速度波形，从而抑制局部散射波并突显直达P波。
逐通道计算主震与Mw 4.5余震（经验格林函数）P波的互相关，并对第二子事件的走时残差进行长波长（>50 km）空间滤波校正。

Three-component P-wave recordings from 27 regional onshore broadband seismic stations in Chile within 500 km epicentral distance.
Synthetic back-projection tests using 0.5 s Ricker wavelets and measured multi-scale travel-time perturbations (<0.5 km, 0.5–10 km, >50 km) to evaluate spatial smearing and location bias.
智利近海约450公里长的ABYSS海底DAS阵列（25,972个通道，15米间距）记录的2024年9月21日阿根廷Mw 6.0中源地震（深度141公里）及Mw 4.5余震的P波数据。
震中距500公里内智利境内27个区域陆地宽频带地震台站的三分量P波记录。
利用0.5秒主周期Ricker子波及实测多尺度走时扰动（<0.5 km、0.5–10 km、>50 km）开展的合成反投影测试，用于评估空间涂抹与定位偏差。
li: One-sided array geometry and narrow east-west aperture cause significant east-west spatial smearing (~15 km) compared to the north-south direction (~2 km).
Lack of depth phases (pP, sP) at regional distances limits vertical resolution, requiring back-projection on a 2-D horizontal grid fixed at 150 km depth.
Long-wavelength (>50 km) unmodeled 3-D velocity heterogeneities dominate location uncertainties, introducing systematic errors up to ~7 km E-W and 1.5 km N-S.
台阵单侧分布的几何构型及东西向窄孔径导致显著的东西向空间涂抹（约15公里，南北向仅约2公里）。
区域距离缺乏深度震相（如pP、sP），限制了垂向分辨率，只能在固定150公里深度的二维水平网格上进行反投影。

sum: This study investigates the spatiotemporal rupture process of the 2025 Mw 8.8 Kamchatka Peninsula earthquake using teleseismic P-wave backprojection (BP) and P/SH waveform inversion. The BP analysis reveals a ~180 s duration and a 2.2 km/s rupture velocity. Waveform inversion shows a main slip zone 110–290 km southwest of the hypocenter near the trench, with 12.3 m average slip. The northeastern slip zone may recur from the 1841 M~9 event, while the southwestern slip zone overlaps with the 1952 Mw 9.0 rupture. The high slip in the overlap zone exceeds 73 years of strain accumulation, suggesting dynamic overshoot triggered by the northeastern rupture.

Proposed that the southwestern slip overlap with the 1952 rupture zone represents dynamic overshoot rather than simple strain accumulation.
确定了2025年堪察加Mw 8.8级地震的破裂持续时间（约180秒）和平均传播速度（2.2 km/s）。
绘制了空间滑移分布图，确定主滑移区位于震中西南110-290 km处，平均滑移量为12.3米。

sum: This study presents a unified seven-parameter spectral fitting framework to characterize significant marsquakes recorded by NASA's InSight mission over nearly four Earth years. By modeling P- and S-wave vertical displacement spectra using a Brune-like source (long-period amplitude A0, corner frequency fc, P/S offset), viscoelastic attenuation (t*), and local 2.4 Hz resonance, the authors reclassify the marsquake catalog into three physical source families: tectonic quakes (low-frequency and broadband events clustering in Cerberus Fossae), seasonal high-frequency swarm events of non-tectonic origin at 40–55° distance, and meteoritic impacts (very-high-frequency and wideband events). Impact signals reveal extremely weak crustal/lithospheric attenuation (QS > 10^4) and exhibit a near-source damage zone spectral overshoot between 0.5 and 7 Hz. Using updated moment magnitudes and crater scaling laws, the study constrains Martian seismicity to 2–5 times below pre-mission predictions and concludes that the largest marsquake, S1222a (Mw 4.7), was likely impact-generated.
本研究提出了一个包含七个独立参数的统一频谱拟合框架，对NASA“洞察号”任务期间记录的显著火震进行了系统重分析。通过联合建模Brune震源谱（长周期振幅A0、拐角频率fc、P/S比）、粘弹性衰减（t*）及接收端2.4 Hz局部共振，作者将火震目录重新划分为三类物理成因：集中在刻耳柏洛斯槽沟的构造火震……

t: A seven-parameter spectral model fits vertical P- and S-wave displacement spectra using a Brune source (A0, fc, P/S ratio), frequency-independent shear attenuation (t*), and a Lorentzian curve for the 2.4 Hz subsurface resonance.
利用包含Brune震源、频率无关衰减t*和2.4 Hz洛伦兹共振峰的七参数模型拟合P波和S波垂直位移谱。
Manually reviewed vertical displacement spectra of 252 significant marsquakes from the InSight MQS v14 catalog, including 81 LF/BB, 9 WB, 63 VF, 82 HF, and 17 2.4-Hz events.
人工审查了洞察号MQS v14目录中252个高质量火震（含LF/BB、WB、VF、HF和2.4 Hz事件）的垂直分量频谱…

Marsquakes separate in fc–Mw space into tectonic, swarm, and impact classes; impact paths show weak attenuation (QS >= 10^4), global M >= 3.5 rate is ~10 events over 4 years, and S1222a classifies as an impact.
火震在fc-Mw空间分为构造、震群和撞击三类；撞击路径衰减极弱（QS≥10^4），S1222a归类为陨石撞击。
Most marsquake signals exceed background noise across 2 octaves or less, causing parameter trade-offs among the seven free parameters and limiting upper-bound resolution on QS.
多数火震信噪比超背景噪声的频带不足2个倍频程，导致七个自由参数间存在折衷且难以约束QS上限。
Provides the first unified spectral parameterization across the full InSight marsquake dataset, unifying VF and WB events as meteoritic impacts and isolating HF/2.4-Hz quakes as a non-tectonic swarm.
首次对完整洞察号火震数据集进行统一频谱参数化，将VF与WB归为撞击，并将HF定性为非构造震群。

kc: Developed a 7-parameter spectral fitting model separating source amplitude, corner frequency, viscoelastic attenuation, and 2.4 Hz site amplification across 252 marsquakes.
Reclassified the InSight marsquake catalog into three physical families: tectonic quakes, seasonal non-tectonic swarm events, and meteoritic impacts.
Constrained Martian crustal/lithospheric shear-wave quality factor QS to >10^4 and identified a quarter-wavelength near-source damage resonance in impact spectra.
Demonstrated that the largest recorded marsquake (S1222a) aligns spectrally with meteoritic impacts and refined global Martian seismicity rates and crater diameter estimates.
开发了包含7个参数的频谱拟合模型，分离了252个火震的震源振幅、拐角频率、粘弹性衰减和2.4 Hz局部场地放大效应。
将洞察号火震目录重新划分为三个物理成因家族：构造火震、季节性非构造震群事件和陨石撞击事件。
约束火星地壳/岩石圈剪切波品质因子QS > 10^4，并在撞击频谱中识别出近源损伤区的四分之一波长共振峰。
证明最大火震S1222a在频谱特征上属于陨石撞击序列，并更新了火星全球地震活动率及撞击坑直径估计。
me: Welch's power spectral density estimation on 20-second windows (50% overlap) of vertical component P- and S-wave early coda displacement time series.
Manual iterative 7-parameter spectral fitting using a Brune omega-square source model, frequency-independent quality factor (QP = 9/4 QS), and Lorentzian 2.4 Hz peak.
Horizontal-to-vertical (H/V) spectral ratio evaluation across LF, BB, HF, and VF event classes from 0.3 to 9.2 Hz.
Monte Carlo uncertainty propagation (10,000 realizations) for cumulative moment magnitude-frequency distributions and empirical seismic moment-to-crater diameter scaling.
采用Welch方法（20秒窗长，50%重叠）计算垂直分量P波和S波早期尾波位移时间序列的功率谱密度。
基于Brune ω平方震源模型、频率无关品质因子（QP = 9/4 QS）和洛伦兹2.4 Hz共振峰，进行手动迭代七参数频谱拟合。
评估0.3至9.2 Hz频段内LF、BB、HF和VF各类事件的水平与垂直（H/V）频谱比。
利用蒙特卡洛方法（10,000次实现）传播不确定性，计算累积矩震级-频度分布及经验地震矩-撞击坑直径标度关系。
de: Vertical-component displacement waveforms from the InSight SEIS Very Broad Band (VBB, 20 and 100 sps) and Short Period (SP, 100 sps) sensors from the v14 Marsquake Service catalog.
Manually reviewed subset of 252 high- and medium-quality events: 81 LF/BB, 9 WB, 63 VF, 82 HF, and 17 2.4-Hz events.
Orbital crater imaging constraints from Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter Context Camera (CTX) for confirmed meteoritic impacts.
洞察号SEIS甚宽频带（VBB，20和100 sps）和短周期（SP，100 sps）传感器记录的v14火震目录垂直分量位移波形。
人工审查的252个高、中质量事件子集：包括81个LF/BB、9个WB、63个VF、82个HF和17个2.4 Hz事件。
来自火星勘测轨道飞行器背景相机（CTX）对已确认陨石撞击坑的轨道成像约束。
li: Most marsquakes exceed ambient noise over a narrow bandwidth of 2 octaves or less, creating trade-offs among the seven fitted spectral parameters.
Single-station planetary observations leave source and propagation parameters coupled, and simplified Brune models do not capture complex spectral overshoots in several VF impact events.
Because spectra are computed in 60-second coda windows, attenuation estimates cannot be mapped to strict ray-theoretical paths and only constrain lower bounds on QS (>10^4) beyond 40°.
大多数火震信噪比高于背景噪声的频带宽度不超过2个倍频程，导致七个拟合参数之间存在折衷。
单台行星地震观测使震源和传播参数相互耦合，且简化的Brune模型无法拟合部分VF撞击事件的复杂频谱超调。
由于频谱是在60秒尾波窗口内计算的，衰减估计无法直接映射到射线理论路径，且在40°以外仅能约束QS的下限（>10^4）。

sum: This study investigates the spatial, temporal, and depth-dependent variability of earthquake b-values across the Taiwan plate boundary. The b-value, a parameter of the Gutenberg-Richter law, reflects the relative abundance of small to large earthquakes and is sensitive to the stress state and material properties of the seismogenic crust. By analyzing a comprehensive catalog of earthquakes in Taiwan, the research aims to elucidate how tectonic processes, such as subduction and collision, influence the distribution and characteristics of seismic activity. Understanding these variations is crucial for assessing seismic hazard and comprehending the underlying geodynamic mechanisms governing earthquake rupture and recurrence in this highly active region. The novelty lies in the detailed spatio-temporal-depth analysis of b-values in a complex plate boundary setting.
本研究调查了台湾板块边界地震b值的空间、时间和深度依赖性变化。b值是古登堡-里希特定律的参数，反映了小地震与大地震的相对丰度，对孕震地壳的应力状态和物质性质敏感。通过分析台湾地震的综合目录，研究旨在阐明构造过程（如俯冲和碰撞）如何影响地震活动的分布和特征。理解这些变化对于评估地震危险性以及认识该高活……

sum: This study employs geophysical methods, likely including seismic tomography, to identify previously geo-morphologically indistinctive Miocene maar-diatreme volcanoes in Western Bohemia. The research aims to map these subsurface volcanic structures and assess their influence on seismic wave amplification. By integrating geological and geophysical data, the paper seeks to provide a detailed understanding of volcanic evolution in the region and its implications for seismic hazard. The novelty lies in uncovering these hidden volcanic features and quantifying their seismic amplification effects, contributing to both volcanology and seismology.

sum: Traditional earthquake catalog visualizations suffer from symbol occlusion and struggle to couple multiple attributes in massive datasets. This study introduces three novel visual analytics tools: a 3D bar magnitude-frequency (M-f) plot, an RBF-kernel-based M-f plot incorporating empirical rupture scaling, and an improved heat-map-encoded magnitude-time (M-t) plot, alongside ray-casting direct volume rendering. Applying this data-fusion framework to the Sichuan-Yunnan region (1970–2020), the authors integrate 420,190 cataloged earthquakes with over 160 3D active faults, 30-arcsecond topography, community velocity models, Moho depth, and crustal strain rate tensors. Results show that seismicity clusters along major block boundaries and velocity-ratio transition zones, while areas of high strain and strong seismicity do not completely overlap (e.g., Xianshuihe fault). Notably, recent induced seismicity in Weiyuan and Changning exceeds long-term activity in Wenchuan. This framework establishes a new paradigm for multi-source geoscience data fusion and regional seismic hazard assessment.
针对传统地震目录可视化在海量数据下符号遮挡及多维属性耦合困难的问题，本文提出了三维柱状震级-频度（M-f）图、基于RBF核函数与破裂尺度关系的M-f图以及改进的震级-时间（M-t）图，并结合光线投射体绘制技术实现多源数据融合。研究整合了川滇地区1970–2020年间420,190条地震目录、160余……

t: The authors propose three catalog visualizations—a 3D bar M-f plot, a Gaussian RBF-kernel M-f plot scaled by rupture radius, and a dual-encoded M-t plot—integrated with ray-casting 3D volume rendering of geophysical models.
提出三维柱状M-f图、基于破裂半径缩放的高斯RBF核M-f图和双编码改进M-t图，并结合光线投射三维体绘制融合多源地球物…

The study fuses 420,190 earthquake records (1970–2020) in the Sichuan-Yunnan region with >160 3D active faults, 30-arcsecond ETOPO topography, 3D community velocity models, Moho depth, and crustal strain rate models.
整合川滇地区1970–2020年420,190条地震目录、160余条三维活动断层、30弧秒地形、三维公共速度模型、莫霍面…

Seismicity concentrates along velocity-ratio transition zones and major faults, does not fully overlap with high strain rates (e.g., Xianshuihe fault), and exhibits higher activity in Weiyuan and Changning than in Wenchuan.
强震活动集中于高低波速比转换带与主干断裂，与高应变区不完全重合，且威远和长宁页岩气区的地震活动水平超过汶川。

The framework uses uncorrected earthquake catalogs with temporal completeness biases, relies on a circular rupture approximation for M≥6.5 events, and lacks formal uncertainty quantification for kernel parameters.
未对地震目录进行定位误差校正与完备性精化，M≥6.5大震采用圆形破裂近似存在局限，且缺乏核参数的不确定性量化。

First collaborative visual analytics framework integrating RBF-kernel density estimation and dual-encoded time-frequency plots with multi-source 3D geophysical volume rendering in the Sichuan-Yunnan region.

kc: Proposed three novel earthquake catalog visualization techniques (3D M-f plot, RBF-kernel M-f plot, and improved M-t plot) that overcome visual occlusion and decouple magnitude, frequency, time, and location.

Established a multi-source geoscience data fusion framework combining over 420,000 earthquakes with 3D active faults, velocity models, Moho depth, topography, and strain rates in the Sichuan-Yunnan region.

Revealed that strong seismicity clusters at velocity-ratio transition zones, does not strictly overlap with high surface strain rates, and exhibits higher cumulative activity in shale-gas fields (Weiyuan, Changning) than in Wenchuan.
提出了三种新型地震目录可视化方法（三维M-f图、基于RBF核函数的M-f图和改进的M-t图），克服了视觉遮挡并实现了震级、频度、时间和位置的解耦表征。
建立了多源地学数据融合框架，将川滇地区42万余条地震记录与三维活动断层、速度模型、莫霍面深度、地形及应变率张量进行了空间配准与协同分析。
揭示了川滇强震活动主要集中于波速比转换带，发现高表面应变率区与高地震活动区并非完全重叠，且威远和长宁页岩气开发区的累积活动水平超过了汶川地区。
me: 3D bar magnitude-frequency (M-f) plot encoding local earthquake frequency as bar height and local maximum magnitude as color on a 0.01° × 0.01° grid.
RBF-kernel-based M-f plot using a Gaussian kernel with bandwidth scaled to empirical circular rupture radius (σ = 2^M) and amplitude scaled linearly with magnitude (a = c×M).
Improved magnitude-time (M-t) plot utilizing dynamic time-window width and color-mixing heat-map encoding to represent event frequency across time and magnitude.
Ray-casting direct volume rendering to jointly visualize 3D community velocity models (Vp, Vs, Vp/Vs), Moho depth, 3D fault surfaces, strain rates, and hypocenters.
三维柱状震级-频度（M-f）图：在0.01°×0.01°网格上以柱体高度编码局部地震频度，以颜色梯度映射局部最大震级。
基于RBF核函数的M-f图：利用高斯核函数，将带宽设定为基于经验圆形破裂半径的尺度（σ = 2^M），幅值与震级呈线性关系（a = c×M）。
改进的震级-时间（M-t）图：采用动态时间窗口宽度与颜色混合热力图编码机制，在时间-震级域同步展现地震发生频度。
光线投射直接体绘制：将三维公共速度模型（Vp、Vs、Vp/Vs）、莫霍面、三维断层面、应变率与震源点云进行空间配准与三维融合渲染。
de: 1970–2020 Sichuan-Yunnan instrumental earthquake catalog containing 420,190 events within 97.8°E–107°E and 21.8°N–33.4°N.
Over 160 3D active fault models, SWChinaCVM velocity models, and GPS-derived crustal deformation (second invariant of strain rate tensor) from the China Seismic Experimental Site (CSES).
30-arcsecond global relief topography data from NOAA NCEI (ETOPO) and teleseismic receiver-function Moho depth models.
来自中国地震科学实验场（CSES）的160余条三维活动断层模型、高分辨率公共速度模型（CVM）以及基于GPS的地壳形变（应变率张量第二不变量）模型。
来自NOAA NCEI的ETOPO 30弧秒高分辨率全球地形起伏数据以及基于远震接收函数的莫霍面深度模型。
li: Relies on raw observational catalogs without location error corrections or completeness refinements, making low-magnitude (<3.0) temporal fluctuations sensitive to network upgrades.
The circular rupture approximation used in the RBF kernel is intended for small-to-moderate events and serves only as a rough estimate for large, multi-segment ruptures (M ≥ 6.5).
Lacks formal uncertainty quantification for kernel/sampling parameters and does not yet integrate focal mechanisms, continuous InSAR/GPS time series, or industrial injection records.
直接使用现有观测目录而未进行定位误差校正或完备性精化，M<3.0地震的数量波动受台网监测能力变化影响显著。
RBF核函数中的圆形破裂近似主要适用于中小地震，对于M≥6.5的多段复杂不对称大震破裂仅能作为粗略估计。
缺乏对核函数与采样参数的形式化不确定性量化，且尚未整合震源机制解、连续InSAR/GPS时间序列及工业开采记录。

tm.why: The paper introduces three novel visualization methods specifically designed to analyze over 420,000 earthquake catalog records from 1970 to 2020 in the Sichuan-Yunnan region.
The study fuses earthquake catalogs with 3D active faults, community velocity models, Moho depth, and crustal strain rates to analyze how deep and shallow structures control regional seismicity.
An RBF-kernel-based magnitude-frequency plot is formulated using empirical rupture-area scaling to quantify macroseismic intensity and regional seismic hazard levels.
