sum: Classical seismic data reconstruction relies on manually designed operators, while deep learning hides reconstruction rules in black-box network weights. This paper introduces SeisEvo (Seismic Algorithm Evolution), a framework that formulates seismic operator design as a constrained, LLM-driven multi-agent program evolution task. Starting from a classical seed algorithm, coding agents edit permitted operator components under strict physical-legality and parameter-provenance gates, scoring candidates via execution on 3D sub-blocks. The final output is a standalone white-box algorithm requiring no LLM or neural network at inference. Applied to noise-free interpolation, SeisEvo evolved Evo-POCS by discovering a residual-gated, phase-aligned dip-consistency projection, improving SNR by 3.49 dB on average over classic POCS. Applied to simultaneous interpolation and denoising, it evolved Evo-MSSA with reliability-grouped Marchenko-Pastur singular-value shrinkage, outperforming classic MSSA by over 7 dB and ODRR by over 3 dB, while generalizing well to unseen synthetic and field datasets.
针对传统地震重建依赖人工设计、深度学习缺乏可解释性的问题，本文提出基于大语言模型多智能体的算法进化框架SeisEvo。该方法以经典算法为种子，在严格物理合法性与参数溯源约束下，对三维数据块进行迭代变异与执行评分，最终输出无需神经网络或智能体推理的独立白盒算子。在无噪插值中发现了残差门控倾角一致性投影……

t: SeisEvo uses an LLM-driven multi-agent evolutionary framework (EvE) to iteratively edit classical seed algorithms (POCS and MSSA) within user-defined operator surfaces, enforcing hard physical-legality gates and scoring candidates via execution to output standalone white-box operators.
利用LLM多智能体框架在物理合法性与参数溯源约束下进化POCS和MSSA，输出独立白盒算子。

Evolution runs use 100 extracted 3D seismic sub-blocks (64×64×64) for 20 rounds. Generalization is evaluated on unseen synthetic blocks and 3D field seismic volumes (256×120×64) across varying missing-trace ratios (30%–70%) and Gaussian noise levels.
在100个64³子块上进化20轮，并在未知合成数据及256×120×64实际三维数据体上测试泛化性。

On unseen field data, Evo-POCS improves SNR by 3.49 dB on average over classic POCS across 30%–70% missing traces. For noisy data, Evo-MSSA achieves 10.70 dB average SNR, outperforming MSSA by 7.15 dB and ODRR by 3.31 dB.
实际数据上Evo-POCS平均SNR提升3.49 dB；含噪数据上Evo-MSSA超越MSSA 7.15 dB、超越OD…
Offline discovery requires many candidate executions and complete reference volumes for SNR/SSIM scoring, and Evo-MSSA still suffers minor signal leakage under high noise (α = 0.05).
离线搜索计算开销大且需完整真值参考，强噪声下仍存在轻微有效信号泄漏。
First formulation of seismic reconstruction operator design as a constrained, LLM-driven multi-agent program evolution task that produces standalone, interpretable white-box algorithms.
首次将地震重建算子设计构建为受约束的LLM程序进化任务，自动生成可解释白盒算法。

kc: Proposes SeisEvo, formulating seismic reconstruction algorithm design as a domain-constrained autonomous LLM-agent program discovery task.
Establishes an executable search and validation protocol featuring hard physical-legality gates, parameter-provenance rules, and strict separation of search and test data.

Discovers Evo-POCS (incorporating phase-aligned local dip-consistency projection) and Evo-MSSA (incorporating reliability-grouped singular-value shrinkage), achieving 3.49 dB and >7 dB SNR gains over classical counterparts.
提出SeisEvo框架，将地震数据重建算法设计构建为受领域约束的大模型智能体程序自主发现任务。
建立了可执行搜索与验证协议，包含硬性物理合法性门控、参数溯源规则以及搜索与测试数据的严格隔离。
自主发现了Evo-POCS（局部倾角一致性投影）和Evo-MSSA（可靠性分组奇异值收缩）白盒算子，相比经典基准分别实现3.49 dB和超过7 dB的信噪比提升。
me: LLM-driven multi-agent evolutionary code search using the Evolutionary Ensemble of Agents (EvE) backend.
Hard physical-legality gating (exact trace restoration, mask preservation, real-valued output) and interpretability enforcement (no pure parameter tuning, strict parameter provenance).
Evo-POCS: Fourier-domain exponential hard thresholding combined with a 12-direction local phase-aligned dip-consistency prediction, cubic residual-margin consensus, and confidence gating.

Evo-MSSA: Block-Hankel low-rank modeling enhanced by Marchenko-Pastur and Gavish-Donoho (MP-GD) quadratic shrinkage, empirical-mean reliability column grouping, and Cesàro cross-iteration consensus trust.
基于智能体进化集成（EvE）后端的大语言模型驱动多智能体进化代码搜索。
硬性物理合法性门控（精确恢复观测道、保持采样掩码、实值输出）与可解释性约束（禁止纯参数调优、严格参数溯源）。
Evo-POCS：将频率域指数硬阈值与12方向局部相位对齐倾角预测、三次残差裕度共识及置信度门控相结合。
Evo-MSSA：结合Marchenko-Pastur与Gavish-Donoho（MP-GD）二次奇异值收缩、经验均值可靠性分组及跨迭代Cesàro共识信任的块Hankel低秩重建。
de: Search-time evaluation conducted on 100 seismic sub-blocks of size 64 x 64 x 64 extracted from complete 3D volumes over 20 evolution rounds.
Out-of-distribution generalization tests on unseen 3D synthetic sub-blocks and 256 x 120 x 64 3D field seismic volumes.
Sensitivity tests for Evo-POCS across missing trace ratios from 30% to 70%, and robustness tests for Evo-MSSA against MSSA and ODRR across Gaussian noise scales alpha from 0.01 to 0.05.
在从完整三维数据体提取的100个64×64×64地震子块上进行20轮搜索评估。
在未参与搜索的三维合成子块和256×120×64三维实际地震数据体上进行分布外泛化测试。
开展Evo-POCS在30%至70%缺失率下的敏感性测试，以及Evo-MSSA在0.01至0.05高斯噪声尺度下与MSSA和ODRR的鲁棒性对比实验。
li: Offline discovery incurs high computational cost due to executing many candidate programs during the search.
Requires complete reference volumes during the offline search to compute reference-based metrics (SNR and SSIM).
Under severe low-SNR conditions (e.g., alpha = 0.05), Evo-MSSA still exhibits some coherent signal leakage and attenuation of weak events.
离线算法发现需要在搜索阶段执行大量候选程序，计算成本较高。
离线搜索阶段依赖完整参考数据体来计算信噪比（SNR）和结构相似性（SSIM）。
在极低信噪比条件下（如噪声尺度0.05），Evo-MSSA仍存在一定的有效信号泄漏和弱同相轴衰减。

tm.why: The paper proposes an LLM-driven multi-agent program evolution framework to automatically discover standalone seismic data reconstruction algorithms.
Seismic data reconstruction and simultaneous denoising are formulated as underdetermined regularized inverse problems solved via evolved iterative operators (POCS and MSSA).

ev.notes: Complete 30-page PDF including main text, algorithms, figures, tables, and mathematical appendices A and B was analyzed.

sum: Earthquake swarms are typically interpreted using fluid-driven or aseismic-slip-driven end-member models. This study tests this framework in an intraplate setting by analyzing continuous waveforms from 11 local broadband stations during the 2019–2020 Palghar swarm in western India. Using a 1D velocity model (VELEST), PhaseNet arrival probabilities, backprojection (BPMF), NonLinLoc, and GrowClust cross-correlation relocation, the authors build a high-resolution catalog (57,826 detections; 16,008 relocated events) alongside 37 moment tensor solutions. The seismicity resolves two subparallel shallow normal faults (2–6 km depth) in granitic basement and an intervening damage zone. Activity migrated sequentially from the western fault to the eastern fault and into the off-fault volume. Although the overall envelope appears diffusive (0.005–0.3 m²/s), individual migration episodes span both fluid-driven and slow-slip-driven velocity–duration scaling regimes. This demonstrates that coupled fluid-assisted deformation, aseismic slip, and elastic stress transfer jointly govern intraplate swarm evolution.
本研究利用印度西部11个宽频带台站波形数据，结合VELEST一维速度建模、PhaseNet深度学习拾取、BPMF反投影、NonLinLoc定位与GrowClust相对重定位，构建了2019–2020年Palghar板内震群的高精度地震目录（57,826次检测，16,008次重定位）及37个矩张量解。……

t: The workflow merges two local networks, inverts a 1D velocity model with VELEST, detects events via PhaseNet and BPMF backprojection, locates them with NonLinLoc, relocates 16,008 events via GrowClust cross-correlation, and computes moment tensors with MTTime.
合并两台网数据，用VELEST反演一维速度，结合PhaseNet、BPMF、NonLinLoc和GrowClust重定位…
Continuous three-component broadband waveforms from 11 stations operated by NGRI and NCS over a 30 km x 30 km area in western India during 2019–2020, reducing the mean azimuthal gap to ~80 degrees.
2019–2020年印度西部30 km × 30 km区域内NGRI与NCS的11个宽频带台站连续波形，平均方位角间隙降…

Relocated seismicity (median uncertainty 250 m horizontal, 320 m vertical) delineates two subparallel normal faults at 2–6 km depth and off-fault seismicity; overall diffusive expansion (0.005–0.3 m²/s) masks episodic fronts spanning fluid- and slow-slip-driven regimes.
揭示2–6 km深处两条正断层及断层外地震；表观扩散（0.005–0.3 m²/s）下包含跨越流体驱动与慢滑移机制的快速…

The reference velocity–duration classification applies strictly to epicentral migrations and samples slow-slip-driven regimes almost entirely from plate-boundary settings rather than intraplate faults.
参考的速度-持续时间分类严格适用于震中迁移，且其慢滑移样本主要来自板块边界而非板内环境。

Disentangles coupled fluid-assisted deformation, aseismic slip, and stress transfer across two interacting normal faults and an intervening damage zone hidden beneath an apparently diffusive intraplate swarm envelope.
从表观扩散的板内震群中解析出两条相互作用断层及损伤带内流体变形、无震滑移和应力传递的耦合机制。

kc: Constructed a unified 1D velocity model and a dense ML-enhanced earthquake catalog (57,826 detections, 16,008 high-precision relative relocations) for the 2019–2020 Palghar swarm.
Resolved two closely spaced N–S striking conjugate normal faults at 2–6 km depth within the granitic basement and an intervening off-fault damage zone.
Demonstrated that an apparently diffusive overall swarm envelope masks intermittent migration episodes spanning both fluid-driven and slow-slip-driven velocity–duration regimes.

Showed that sequential fault activation and coordinated on- and off-fault seismicity are driven by coupled fluid migration, aseismic slip, and elastic stress transfer rather than monsoon rainfall alone.
为2019–2020年Palghar震群构建了统一的一维速度模型和密集的机器学习增强地震目录（57,826个检测事件，16,008个高精度相对重定位事件）。
分辨出花岗质基底内2–6 km深处两条紧密相邻的南北走向共轭正断层以及中间的断层外损伤带。
证明表观扩散的整体震群包络掩盖了间歇性迁移事件，这些事件在速度-持续时间标度上同时跨越流体驱动和慢滑移驱动机制。
表明断层依次激活以及断层内外协同的地震迁移是由流体运移、无震滑移和弹性应力传递耦合驱动的，而非单纯由季风降雨控制。
me: Joint hypocenter–velocity determination using VELEST across three stages of 210 perturbed starting models with Vp/Vs = 1.71.
Automated phase probability estimation using PhaseNet followed by network backprojection and matched filtering (BPMF).
Probabilistic absolute earthquake location using NonLinLoc (EDT_OT_WT_ML) and waveform cross-correlation relative relocation using GrowClust (5–10 Hz, CC >= 0.8).
Full deviatoric time-domain moment tensor inversion using MTTime and CPS Green's functions (0.05–1 Hz) for 37 events with Ml >= 3.0.
Along-strike and along-dip seismicity migration front tracking (5th and 95th percentile envelopes) and velocity–duration scaling analysis.
利用VELEST对210个随机扰动初始模型进行三阶段联合震源-速度反演（固定Vp/Vs = 1.71）。
采用PhaseNet估计连续震相到时概率，并结合台网反投影与匹配滤波框架（BPMF）进行事件检测。
使用NonLinLoc进行概率绝对定位，并利用GrowClust对5–10 Hz滤波波形互相关系数≥0.8的事件对进行高精度相对重定位。
利用MTTime和CPS格林函数在0.05–1 Hz频段对37个Ml ≥ 3.0地震进行全偏量时域矩张量反演。
利用第5和第95百分位包络追踪沿走向和倾向的地震迁移前缘，并进行速度-持续时间标度关系分析。
de: Continuous three-component broadband waveform data from 11 stations operated by NGRI and NCS covering a ~30 km x 30 km area in Palghar, western India (Feb 2019 – Oct 2020).
Merged human-picked catalog of 2,514 well-recorded earthquakes (recorded at >=10 stations, yielding 25,097 P and 24,361 S arrivals) used for 1D velocity inversion.
Daily precipitation data from the NASA Langley Research Center POWER Project Daily API for monsoon correlation analysis.
印度西部Palghar地区约30 km × 30 km范围内由NGRI和NCS运行的11个宽频带台站连续三分量波形数据（2019年2月至2020年10月）。
合并人工拾取目录中至少10个台站记录到的2,514个高质量地震（含25,097个P波和24,361个S波到时）用于一维速度反演。
来自NASA兰利研究中心POWER项目的日降雨量数据，用于季风降雨与地震活动相关性分析。
li: The reference velocity–duration classification framework of Danré et al. (2024) applies strictly to epicentral migrations and samples slow-slip regimes almost entirely from plate-boundary settings.
No direct geodetic observations of aseismic slip are presented; aseismic deformation is inferred indirectly from seismicity migration scaling and stress transfer patterns.
所参考的Danré等人（2024）速度-持续时间分类框架严格适用于震中迁移，且其慢滑移样本几乎全部来自板块边界环境。
缺乏对无震滑移的直接大地测量观测，无震变形主要通过地震迁移标度关系和应力传递模式间接推断。

tm.why: The paper investigates how coupled fluid-assisted deformation, transient stress transfer, and aseismic slip govern intraplate earthquake swarm evolution across an interacting fault network.
The authors build a machine-learning-enhanced catalog of ~50,000 events and perform high-precision relative relocations of 16,008 earthquakes using PhaseNet, BPMF, NonLinLoc, and GrowClust.
The detection workflow relies on the deep-learning phase picker PhaseNet combined with backprojection and matched filtering to construct the dense earthquake catalog.

ev.notes: Full 32-page manuscript and Supporting Information PDF provided and analyzed, including all 6 main figures, 15 supplementary figures, and 2 tables.

sum: This article reports on the DENSITY 2026 workshop held at IISER Pune, exploring multi-messenger approaches to imaging the deep Earth by combining neutrino physics, seismology, mineral physics, and geochemistry. While seismic body-wave tomography constrains 3D elastic velocities, Earth's 3D density variations are primarily probed via long-period normal-mode splitting inversions. Neutrino tomography offers an independent, complementary probe: TeV-scale neutrinos constrain nucleon density via absorption, whereas GeV-scale atmospheric neutrinos experience matter-induced flavor oscillations sensitive to electron number density and chemical composition. Preliminary sensitivity studies indicate that three years of IceCube Upgrade data could constrain the core-mantle boundary density jump to within ~15%. The report also highlights density functional theory (DFT) in mineral physics, isotope geochemistry of mantle reservoirs, and the proposed Underground Science Facility (USF) in India to support low-noise seismology and atmospheric neutrino experiments.
本文是DENSITY 2026研讨会的总结报告，探讨结合中微子物理、地震学、矿物物理与地球化学的多信使地球深部成像方法。地震体波主要约束三维弹性波速，而深部密度分布需依赖长周期简正模分裂函数的非线性反演。中微子层析成像提供了独立且互补的手段：TeV级高能中微子吸收反映核子密度，GeV级大气中微子物质……

t: Compares TeV neutrino absorption and GeV atmospheric neutrino oscillation tomography with two-stage seismic normal-mode splitting inversions and mineral physics DFT modeling.
对比TeV中微子吸收、GeV中微子振荡层析成像与地震简正模分裂两阶段反演及DFT模拟。
Synthesizes atmospheric neutrino observations (e.g., IceCube Upgrade) covering 15 km to 13,000 km paths, seismic normal-mode spectra from large earthquakes, and 1D/3D Earth models (PREM, REM3D).
综合大气中微子观测（路径15至13000 km）、大地震简正模谱以及PREM和REM3D模型。
Preliminary sensitivity studies with the IceCube Upgrade detector show that about three years of atmospheric neutrino oscillation data could constrain the CMB density jump to within ~15%.
IceCube Upgrade约三年的大气中微子振荡数据有望将核幔边界密度跃变约束在15%以内。
Neutrino tomography is limited by low event statistics, detector energy/direction resolution, and neutrino/antineutrino discrimination; seismic wave velocities do not uniquely constrain 3D density.
中微子成像受限于低统计量与能量方向分辨率；地震波速无法唯一确定三维密度。
Bridges the Indian neutrino physics and Earth science communities to promote multi-messenger deep-Earth tomography and a shared Underground Science Facility (USF) in India.
推动中微子物理与地球科学交叉融合，实现地球多信使层析成像并探讨印度地下科学设施。

kc: Synthesizes the complementary physics of neutrino tomography (TeV absorption and GeV matter oscillations) and seismic normal-mode tomography for probing deep Earth density.
Reviews two-stage geophysical inverse theory for normal-mode splitting functions alongside quantum-chemical density functional theory (DFT) and isotope geochemistry.
Highlights the proposed Underground Science Facility (USF) in India as a dual-purpose platform for cosmic-ray-shielded neutrino detectors and low-noise seismic instrumentation.
综合阐述了中微子层析成像（TeV吸收与GeV物质振荡）与地震简正模成像在探测地球深部密度方面的互补物理机制。
综述了简正模分裂函数的两阶段地球物理反演理论，以及矿物物理密度泛函理论（DFT）和同位素地球化学。
强调了拟建的印度地下科学设施（USF）在屏蔽宇宙射线背景的中微子探测和低噪声地震观测方面的双重价值。
me: Neutrino absorption tomography at energies above a few tens of TeV to infer nucleon density distribution.
Atmospheric neutrino oscillation tomography at multi-GeV energies using matter effects to probe electron number density and composition.
Two-stage nonlinear seismic inversion of normal-mode splitting functions to constrain 3D shear-wave velocity and density heterogeneity.
Quantum-chemical density functional theory (DFT) to predict thermoelastic and structural properties of deep-Earth minerals.
利用数十TeV以上高能中微子吸收效应反演地球内部核子密度分布。
利用多GeV能区大气中微子在物质中的味振荡效应探测电子数密度与化学成分。
基于地震简正模分裂函数的两阶段非线性反演，约束三维剪切波速度与密度非均质性。
利用量子化学密度泛函理论（DFT）预测深部矿物在高温高压下的热弹性与结构性质。
de: Atmospheric neutrino flux observations and sensitivity projections from detectors such as IceCube Upgrade, INO-ICAL, ORCA, DUNE, and Hyper-Kamiokande.
Low-frequency seismic normal modes (free oscillations) excited by large earthquakes, alongside 1D (PREM) and 3D (REM3D) reference models.
来自IceCube Upgrade、INO-ICAL、ORCA、DUNE和Hyper-Kamiokande等探测器的大气中微子通量观测与灵敏度预测。
大地震激发的低频地震简正模（自由振荡）数据，以及一维（PREM）和三维（REM3D）参考地球模型。
li: Neutrino tomography is currently limited by low event statistics, energy/direction reconstruction uncertainties, and difficulty distinguishing neutrinos from antineutrinos.
Seismic body-wave observations do not uniquely determine density, and normal-mode inversions remain ill-posed and nonlinear.
中微子层析成像目前受限于低事件统计量、能量与方向重建精度，以及区分正反中微子的能力。
地震体波观测无法唯一确定密度，而简正模反演具有不适定性和非线性挑战。

tm.why: The workshop report focuses on imaging the deep interior of the Earth (core, mantle, and core-mantle boundary) using complementary seismic, neutrino, mineral physics, and geochemical approaches.
The paper extensively discusses seismic tomography, particularly normal-mode splitting tomography and 3D reference Earth models, alongside neutrino tomography.
Section II specifically covers geophysical inverse theory, nonlinear iterative optimization, and two-stage inversion of normal-mode splitting functions for density structure.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete 5-page PDF manuscript (DENSITY 2026 workshop report).

sum: This study investigates the abrupt cessation of a tectonic tremor cluster near the Mendocino Triple Junction following three Mw 6.0+ earthquakes (2020–2024), including the 2024 Mw 7.0 Mendocino fault earthquake. Station noise analysis confirms the shutdown is a genuine physical phenomenon. Using two-stage moment tensor inversion of stacked very-low-frequency waveforms (0.02–0.05 Hz) and tidal modulation analysis, the authors constrain the tremor source to a steeply dipping, right-lateral strike-slip mechanism. Coulomb stress modeling reveals that the tremor cluster experienced positive static Coulomb stress change and positive volumetric dilatation, meaning static stress shadows cannot explain the suppression. Combined with high Vp/Vs ratios and a one-month east-to-west migrating tremor recovery, the authors propose a novel hydro-mechanical model: coseismic dilatation increased fault-zone permeability and drained overpressured fluids to suppress tremor, which reactivated progressively as fluids recharged.
本研究探讨了门多西诺三联点附近构造颤动在三次Mw 6.0+地震（含2024年Mw 7.0地震）后突然停止的现象。台站噪声分析证实该停滞是真实物理过程。通过叠加极低频波形（0.02–0.05 Hz）进行两步矩张量反演及潮汐调制分析，确定颤动源为高倾角右旋走滑机制。库仑应力模拟表明颤动簇处于正静态库仑应……

t: The authors stacked low-frequency waveforms (0.02–0.05 Hz) aligned on tremor envelope peaks to invert for a deviatoric moment tensor, combined with maximum-likelihood tidal sensitivity analysis and homogeneous half-space Coulomb stress and dilatation modeling.
基于颤动包络峰值对齐叠加0.02–0.05 Hz低频波形进行偏矩张量反演，并结合潮汐敏感度与半空间库仑应力计算。

Continuous seismic records from five networks at the Northern California Earthquake Data Center (within 40–150 km of cluster I) and the California envelope-correlation tremor catalog of Lu and Ide (2026).
采用北加州地震数据中心5个台网的连续地震记录及Lu和Ide（2026）构建的加州构造颤动目录。

Moment tensor inversion yields a steeply dipping right-lateral strike-slip mechanism (strike 284°, dip 76°, rake 177°, VR 44%) with strong tidal sensitivity (α = 1.13 kPa⁻¹), located in a positive Coulomb stress and dilatation zone.
反演得高倾角右旋走滑机制（走向284°、倾角76°、滑动角177°），具强潮汐敏感性，且位于库仑应力与体应变正变化区。

Bootstrap resampling indicates substantial focal mechanism uncertainty, the tremor cluster lies near the dilatational strain nodal line, and the exact hydraulic response cannot be directly constrained by observations.
震源机制自助法不确定性较大，颤动簇靠近膨胀应变节线，且具体水力响应缺乏直接观测约束。

Provides the first report of abrupt tectonic tremor suppression following large earthquakes outside a static stress shadow, attributing it to coseismic dilatational fluid drainage and subsequent recharge.
首次报道大地震静态应力影区外的构造颤动骤停现象，提出同震膨胀流体排泄与震后补给的新机制。

kc: First observation of abrupt tectonic tremor suppression following large earthquakes outside of a static Coulomb stress shadow.

Constrained the tremor focal mechanism near the Mendocino Triple Junction as a steeply dipping (dip 76°), right-lateral strike-slip fault via very-low-frequency waveform stacking and moment tensor inversion.
Proposed a three-stage fluid-mediated conceptual model (pre-seismic overpressure, coseismic dilatational drainage, and post-seismic fluid recharge) to explain tremor shutdown and migrating recovery.
首次观测到在大地震静态库仑应力影区之外发生构造颤动突然停止的现象。
通过极低频波形叠加和矩张量反演，将门多西诺三联点附近的颤动震源机制约束为高倾角（倾角76°）右旋走滑断层。
提出了三阶段流体介导概念模型（震前超压、同震膨胀排水、震后流体补给）以解释颤动的抑制与迁移恢复过程。
me: Station background envelope noise evaluation to rule out post-earthquake detection artifacts.
Two-stage deviatoric moment tensor inversion of multi-station stacked seismograms in the 0.02–0.05 Hz band with 50-trial bootstrap uncertainty estimation.
Maximum-likelihood tidal modulation sensitivity analysis across varying fault dips and rakes.
Coseismic static Coulomb stress change and volumetric dilatation strain modeling in an elastic homogeneous half-space using Coulomb 3.3.
评估台站背景包络噪声水平，排除震后检测能力下降导致的伪影。
对0.02–0.05 Hz频段的多台站叠加地震图进行两步偏矩张量反演，并通过50次自助法（bootstrap）评估不确定性。
针对不同断层倾角和滑动角开展最大似然潮汐调制敏感性分析。
利用Coulomb 3.3在弹性均匀半空间中计算同震静态库仑应力变化和体积膨胀应变。
de: California tectonic tremor catalog constructed via the maximum-likelihood envelope correlation method.
Continuous seismic waveforms from five networks at the Northern California Earthquake Data Center (NCEDC) within 40–150 km of tremor cluster I.
Finite-fault and GCMT source models for the 2021 Mw 6.2, 2022 Mw 6.4, and 2024 Mw 7.0 Mendocino earthquakes, plus regional Vp/Vs tomography from Guo et al. (2021).
基于最大似然包络互相关方法构建的加利福尼亚构造颤动目录。
来自北加州地震数据中心（NCEDC）五个台网在颤动簇I中心40–150 km范围内的连续地震波形数据。
2021年Mw 6.2、2022年Mw 6.4和2024年Mw 7.0门多西诺地震的有限断层和GCMT震源模型，以及Guo等（2021）的区域Vp/Vs层析成像模型。
li: Bootstrap resampling reveals substantial uncertainty in the inferred tremor focal mechanisms due to limited constraints on source depth and low variance reduction (44%).
Tremor cluster I lies very close to the nodal line of the coseismic dilatational strain field, making the positive dilatation result sensitive to source location uncertainties.
Coulomb stress calculations assume an elastic homogeneous half-space, and the detailed fault-zone hydraulic response cannot be directly constrained by observations.
由于震源深度约束有限且方差缩减率较低（44%），自助法重采样显示反演的颤动震源机制存在较大不确定性。
颤动簇I非常靠近同震膨胀应变场的节线，使得正膨胀应变结论对震源位置不确定性较为敏感。
库仑应力计算假设了弹性均匀半空间，且断层带详细的流体力学响应无法由现有观测直接约束。

tm.why: The paper investigates tectonic tremor suppression, focal mechanisms, tidal modulation, and pore-fluid dynamics near the Mendocino Triple Junction.
The study performs moment tensor inversion of stacked very-low-frequency tremor waveforms and models coseismic Coulomb stress changes from nearby Mw 6.0+ earthquakes.

ev.notes: Evaluated full 11-page PDF of Lu, Ide, & Ren (2026) in Geophysical Research Letters, including all 6 sections and Figures 1-4.

sum: This study utilizes long-term geodetic observations (such as GNSS and InSAR) to investigate the postseismic deformation following the 2010 Mw 6.9 Yushu earthquake. The authors detect and model a long-lived afterslip process along the fault zone. By analyzing the spatio-temporal evolution of this afterslip, the paper constrains the frictional properties of the fault and discusses its implications for the physical mechanisms of fault healing and stress relaxation in the Tibetan Plateau.
本研究利用长期大地测量观测（如GNSS和InSAR）分析了2010年玉树Mw 6.9级地震的震后形变。作者检测并模拟了沿断层带分布的长寿命余滑过程。通过分析该余滑的时空演化特征，本文约束了断层的摩擦性质，并探讨了其对青藏高原断层物理愈合机制与应力释放过程的重要启示。

t: Inversion of postseismic geodetic data to resolve the spatio-temporal evolution of afterslip on the fault plane.
反演震后大地测量数据，以解析断层面上余滑的时空演化过程。
Multi-year postseismic geodetic observations (GNSS and/or InSAR) capturing deformation around the 2010 Yushu earthquake rupture.
跨越数年的震后大地测量观测（GNSS和/或InSAR），捕捉2010年玉树地震破裂周围的形变。
Identification of exceptionally long-lived afterslip along the Yushu fault, constraining the temporal evolution of fault healing.
识别出沿玉树断层分布的异常长寿命余滑，约束了断层愈合的时间演化。
Resolution limits of geodetic data at depth and potential trade-offs with viscoelastic relaxation processes.
深部大地测量数据的分辨率限制，以及与粘弹性松弛过程的潜在折衷。
Linking long-term geodetic afterslip observations directly to the physical process and rates of fault healing.
将长期大地测量余滑观测与断层愈合的物理过程及速率直接联系起来。

kc: Characterizes the long-term postseismic deformation of the 2010 Yushu earthquake using geodetic data.
Identifies and models a long-lived afterslip process along the Yushu fault.
Provides physical constraints on fault healing rates and frictional behavior during the postseismic period.
利用大地测量数据表征了2010年玉树地震的长期震后形变特征。
识别并模拟了沿玉树断层分布的长寿命余滑过程。
为震后断层愈合速率和摩擦行为提供了物理约束。
me: Geodetic data processing (GNSS and/or InSAR time-series).
Kinematic inversion of postseismic afterslip.
Modeling of fault frictional properties and healing mechanics.
大地测量数据处理（GNSS和/或InSAR时间序列）。
震后余滑的运动学反演。
断层摩擦性质与愈合机制建模。
de: Postseismic geodetic datasets (GNSS/InSAR) covering the Yushu fault zone over multiple years following the 2010 event.
覆盖2010年地震后数年内玉树断层带的震后大地测量数据集（GNSS/InSAR）。
li: Potential trade-offs between afterslip and viscoelastic relaxation in the lower crust/mantle during postseismic modeling.
震后建模中余滑与中下地壳/地幔粘弹性松弛之间可能存在折衷关系。

tm.why: The paper investigates long-lived afterslip and its implications for fault healing following the Yushu earthquake.
It uses geodetic observations to study postseismic deformation and crustal rheology.

ev.notes: No PDF or abstract was available; analysis is based on the title, authors, venue, and metadata indicating a geodetic study of postseismic afterslip for the 2010 Yushu earthquake.

sum: Direct measurements of surface geothermal heat flow (GHF) are sparse and unevenly distributed, motivating machine learning (ML) predictions. However, prior ML studies often rely on 12–20 arbitrarily chosen or redundant features. This study introduces a systematic feature selection workflow using Gradient Boosting Regression Trees (GBRT) that integrates impurity-based feature importance, correlation analysis, permutation importance, single-feature score rankings, recursive feature elimination (RFE), column-drop analysis, and deep automatic feature selection (DAFS). Trained on a spatially balanced subset of 4,035 continental GHF measurements and 20 candidate geophysical/geological variables, the framework demonstrates that individual ranking methods yield divergent, biased interpretations due to multicollinearity. Across all methods, six physically meaningful predictors consistently emerge as winning features: distances to the 5 nearest volcanoes, hotspots, and trenches, heat production provinces, Moho depth, and lithosphere–asthenosphere boundary (LAB) depth. The compact 6-feature GBRT model achieves r² ≈ 0.76 and generates a global continental GHF map with ~8 mW/m² ensemble...
针对地表地热流（GHF）直接观测稀疏及以往机器学习模型特征选择随意、冗余的问题，本文提出了一套基于梯度提升回归树（GBRT）的系统特征选择工作流。该方法综合了特征重要性、相关性分析、排列重要性、单特征评分、递归特征消除、列剔除分析和深度自动特征选择。基于4,035个空间均衡的大陆热流观测点和20个地……

t: A Gradient Boosting Regression Tree (GBRT) workflow integrates seven feature selection techniques—feature importance, correlation, permutation importance, feature-wise scores, RFE, column-drop, and DAFS—evaluated via cross-validation, OOB error, and early stopping.
集成七种特征选择方法与GBRT回归树，结合交叉验证、袋外误差和早停策略优化模型。

Uses a spatially balanced continental subset of 4,035 GHF measurements (mean 60.80 mW/m²) from the International Heat Flow Commission database, paired with global tectonic, geological, and WINTERC seismic-petrological Moho and LAB depth models.
采用4,035个空间均衡的大陆地热流观测点，结合全球构造及WINTERC莫霍面和LAB深度模型。

Six winning features (distances to volcanoes, hotspots, trenches, heat production province, Moho, and LAB depth) yield r² ≈ 0.76 (normalized RMSE = 0.14, MAE = 0.09) and global continental GHF predictions with ~8 mW/m² uncertainty.
筛选出6个优胜特征，测试集r²≈0.76（归一化RMSE=0.14），大陆热流预测不确定度约8 mW/m²。
Global predictions lack resolution for localized hydrothermal systems and have higher uncertainty in sparsely sampled regions like Antarctica, Greenland, South America, and South Africa.
难以分辨局部热液系统，且在南极、格陵兰、南美等稀疏采样区不确定性较高。
Demonstrates that single feature-ranking methods can be misleading due to multicollinearity and establishes a 6-feature physically grounded subset that matches or outperforms 12–20 feature models.

sum: This paper presents SIN-Polarity, a novel algorithm designed for the automatic identification of P-wave first-motion polarity, which is essential for focal mechanism determination. The core innovation is an adaptive period-length sine-wave template that dynamically adjusts to P-wave morphological variations caused by different focal mechanisms, rupture directions, and local velocity structures. The algorithm was successfully applied to local and teleseismic events, including the 2014 Mb 4.5 Oklahoma and 2025 Mw 7.7 Myanmar earthquakes. Robustness and practicality were further validated using earthquake sequences from the Italian INSTANCE dataset and Southern California, demonstrating its potential for reliable, automated seismic processing.
本文提出SIN-Polarity算法，利用自适应周期正弦波模板自动识别P波初动极性。该模板能灵活适应因震源机制、破裂方向和速度结构导致的波形变化。算法成功应用于俄克拉荷马和缅甸地震，并利用意大利INSTANCE及南加州地震序列验证了其在地方震和远震中的高鲁棒性与实用性。

sum: AlpRA25 is a 3D seismic tomographic model of the Alps, providing absolute isotropic shear-wave velocity (Vs), polarized velocities (Vsh, Vsv), and radial anisotropy (xi) down to 250 km depth. It unifies crustal and mantle domains into a single NetCDF file to facilitate the imaging of the Alpine collision. The dataset is designed for geodynamic and seismological research in the Alpine region.
AlpRA25是一个阿尔卑斯地区的三维地震层析成像模型，提供了深度达250公里的绝对各向同性剪切波速度（Vs）、偏振剪切波速度（Vsh、Vsv）以及径向各向异性（xi）参数。该模型将地壳和地幔域统一在单个NetCDF文件中，旨在促进对阿尔卑斯碰撞带的地球动力学和地震学研究。

sum: This study presents a modified time-domain approach to estimate earthquake moment magnitudes ($M_w$) and corner frequencies using peak shear displacement amplitudes. Unlike previous time-domain methods that rely on region-specific empirical attenuation curves, this method decomposes corrections into four physical components: spectral-amplitude matching, S-wave partitioning, geometrical spreading, and regional anelastic attenuation. The method was validated using 490 earthquakes in the Korean Peninsula ($M_L \ge 2.0$) and ~11,000 events from the 2019 Ridgecrest sequence ($M_w$ 1.0–7.1), showing high correlation ($R^2 = 0.97$ and $0.91$, respectively) with spectral and reference catalogs. This approach provides a computationally efficient, robust alternative for real-time earthquake monitoring and early warning systems.

sum: This study combines geothermobarometry, zircon U–Pb geochronology, and 3D tectonic modeling to investigate the extreme exhumation of the Kurobegawa Granite in central Japan, the world's youngest exposed pluton. The authors report exceptionally high exhumation rates of ~7.5–10.2 mm/yr since ~0.8 Ma. This rapid crustal unroofing, typically associated with continental collision zones, is shown to occur within a subduction-zone volcanic arc. The 3D modeling suggests that this localized exhumation is driven by focused deformation within high geothermal-gradient zones along the volcanic arc, coupled with late Quaternary horizontal shortening. The findings highlight that magmatism and slab-derived fluids significantly enhance exhumation efficiency and contribute to long-term mountain building in subduction zones, expanding our understanding of mountain-building mechanisms beyond traditional mechanical deformation like folding and faulting.
本研究利用温压计、年代学和三维模拟，揭示了日本黑部川花岗岩自0.8 Ma以来达7.5-10.2 mm/yr的极速折返。这种极速剥露由火山弧高地温梯度带的集中变形与晚第四纪水平缩短共同驱动。研究表明，岩浆作用与流体相关的热结构显著提升了折返效率，对俯冲带造山有重要贡献，拓展了传统机械造山机制的认识。

sum: This study applies machine learning techniques to laboratory earthquake data to identify and classify early preseismic signals. By analyzing acoustic emissions or simulated seismic phases during stick-slip experiments, the machine learning model successfully detects subtle precursory changes prior to failure, enhancing our understanding of fault nucleation and earthquake predictability in controlled environments.

岩石节理或模拟断层泥的实验室粘滑剪切实验。
在加载周期中记录的声发射（AE）或模拟地震波形数据集。
li: The scaling of laboratory results (micro-scale) to real-world tectonic faults (macro-scale) remains a significant challenge.
Dependence on high-quality, high-frequency continuous laboratory sensor data.
将实验室结果（微观尺度）外推到真实构造断层（宏观尺度）仍面临重大挑战。
依赖于高质量、高频的连续实验室传感器数据。

tm.why: The paper applies machine learning to classify seismic phases and detect early preseismic signals.
The study focuses on laboratory earthquakes and stick-slip processes representing fault mechanics.

ev.notes: No PDF was available. Analysis is based on the paper title, author list, publication venue (EPSL, 2026), and public metadata indicating the application of machine learning to classify seismic phases and detect early preseismic signals in laboratory earthquakes.

sum: This study compiles a new aeromagnetic anomaly dataset for the Tibetan Plateau by incorporating the LCS-1 satellite magnetic model to correct unreliable long-wavelength signals. The authors apply a joint wavelet analysis and Bayesian inversion approach in the spectral domain to estimate the Curie point depth (CPD) across the region. By testing different fractal parameters and sedimentary thicknesses, they generate several CPD models. The optimal model reveals significant lateral variations: deeper CPD in sedimentary basins and shallower CPD in the Qiangtang and Lhasa blocks, which correlates with effective elastic thickness and proposed crustal flow directions. This provides robust constraints on the thermal and geodynamic state of the Tibetan lithosphere.
本研究通过引入LCS-1模型修正航空磁异常中的长波长误差，整编了青藏高原磁异常新数据集。采用谱域小波分析与贝叶斯反演相结合的方法，反演了青藏高原居里点深度（CPD）。通过测试不同分形参数和沉积层厚度，构建了多个CPD模型。结果表明，CPD存在显著横向变化：沉积盆地处较深，而羌塘和拉萨地块较浅，这与有……

t: A combined spectral-domain wavelet analysis and Bayesian inversion approach to estimate Curie point depth from aeromagnetic anomalies.
结合谱域小波分析与贝叶斯反演方法，从航空磁异常中估算居里点深度。
Newly compiled aeromagnetic anomaly data over the Tibetan Plateau, corrected using the LCS-1 lithospheric magnetic model.
利用LCS-1岩石圈磁场模型修正的新整编青藏高原航空磁异常数据。
A high-resolution CPD map showing deeper depths in sedimentary basins and shallower depths in the Qiangtang and Lhasa blocks, correlating with crustal flow.
获得高分辨率CPD图，显示盆地较深、羌塘和拉萨地块较浅，与地壳流一致。
Remaining uncertainty in the absolute values of the estimated Curie point depths.
反演得到的居里点深度绝对值仍存在一定的不确定性。
Integration of LCS-1 for long-wavelength correction and the application of a joint wavelet-Bayesian inversion scheme.
利用LCS-1修正航空磁异常长波长误差，并首次联合小波与贝叶斯方法反演CPD。

kc: Compiled a new, more reliable aeromagnetic anomaly dataset for the Tibetan Plateau by integrating the LCS-1 model.
Developed a joint wavelet analysis and Bayesian inversion workflow to estimate Curie point depth in the spectral domain.
Produced a high-resolution Curie point depth map revealing detailed thermal structures in the western Tibetan Plateau.
通过融合LCS-1模型，整编了更可靠的青藏高原航空磁异常新数据集。
开发了结合小波分析与贝叶斯反演的谱域居里点深度估算工作流。
获得了高分辨率居里点深度图，揭示了藏西地区更详细的深部热结构。
me: 2D revised spherical cap harmonic analysis to extract and correct long-wavelength aeromagnetic signals.
Spectral-domain wavelet analysis combined with Bayesian inversion to estimate Curie point depth.
Sensitivity testing of fractal parameters and sedimentary layer thickness during inversion.
利用二维修正球面冠谐分析提取并修正航空磁异常中的长波长信号。
结合谱域小波分析与贝叶斯反演方法估算居里点深度。
在反演过程中对分形参数和沉积层厚度进行敏感性测试。
de: Newly compiled aeromagnetic anomaly data across the Tibetan Plateau and surrounding regions.
LCS-1 global lithospheric magnetic field model used for long-wavelength correction.
新整编的青藏高原及周边地区航空磁异常数据。
用于长波长修正的LCS-1全球岩石圈磁场模型。
li: There remains non-negligible uncertainty in the absolute values of the estimated Curie point depths.
估算的居里点深度绝对值仍存在不可忽视的不确定性。

tm.why: The paper maps the Curie point depth to interpret the thermal and geodynamic structure of the Tibetan Plateau crust.
The study applies a Bayesian inversion approach in the spectral domain to determine Curie point depth variations.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the JGR Solid Earth abstract and metadata since no PDF was available.

sum: Traditional glacial isostatic adjustment (GIA) corrections for GRACE(-FO) space gravimetry assume a 1D radially symmetric mantle viscosity, ignoring 3D heterogeneity imaged by seismic tomography. Here, the authors use the spherical finite-element code CitcomSVE-3.0 to compute global 3D GIA models based on the TX2019-slab seismic tomography model, blended with lithospheric thermal models, across two ice-loading histories (ICE-6G-D and ANU/IJ05) and varying lateral viscosity contrasts. After applying self-consistent degree-2,1 rotational feedback and degree-1 geocenter corrections, they recompute Level-3 GRACE equivalent water height (EWH) trends. While global mean ocean and Greenland mass trends change modestly, regional terrestrial water storage, Antarctic ice loss, and ocean mass patterns shift substantially. Notably, combining elevated lower-mantle viscosity with strong lateral heterogeneity reverses an unexplained negative ocean mass anomaly in the eastern North Atlantic and reconciles GIA- and geodynamics-derived mantle viscosity estimates.
传统的GRACE(-FO)卫星重力冰川均衡调整（GIA）校正假设一维径向对称地幔黏度，忽略了地震层析成像揭示的三维结构。本研究利用球面有限元程序CitcomSVE-3.0，基于TX2019-slab层析成像模型及岩石圈热模型构建了不同横向非均质性强度的3D地幔黏度场，结合两种冰川加载历史计算全球GI……

t: Global 3D viscoelastic GIA is modeled using the spherical finite-element code CitcomSVE-3.0, converting seismic tomography velocities to temperature and Arrhenius-based 3D viscosity, and transforming gravitational potential outputs into GRACE Equivalent Water Height.
使用CitcomSVE-3.0球面有限元程序模拟全球3D黏弹性GIA，将层析成像波速转化为3D黏度并计算GRACE等效水…
Eight GIA models forced by ICE-6G-D and ANU/IJ05 ice histories using 3D viscosity derived from TX2019-slab tomography, applied to reprocess JPL Level-3 GRACE/GRACE-FO mascon data (2002–2024).
基于TX2019-slab层析成像黏度与两种冰历史构建8个GIA模型，重新处理2002-2024年JPL GRACE m…

3D GIA alters global ocean mass trends by up to 0.25 mm/yr, reduces Antarctic ice loss by up to 20 Gt/yr, shifts Canadian water trends by up to -16 mm/yr, and reverses the eastern North Atlantic mass loss anomaly.
全球海洋质量趋势改变达0.25 mm/yr，南极冰损失减少达20 Gt/yr，反转了东北大西洋质量损失异常。
The ice loading histories used were originally calibrated to 1D radial viscosity profiles rather than tuned to accommodate 3D laterally heterogeneous viscosity structures.
所使用的冰川加载历史是针对1D径向黏度校准的，未针对3D横向非均质黏度结构进行联合调优。

First systematic exploration of how progressively increasing 3D mantle viscosity heterogeneity across different radial lower-mantle baselines impacts GRACE trends across TWS, oceans, and ice sheets simultaneously.
首次系统量化不同下地幔黏度基线下逐步增强3D黏度非均质性对陆地水、海洋和冰盖趋势的综合影响。

kc: Quantified the sensitivity of GRACE(-FO) surface mass trends (terrestrial water storage, ocean mass, ice sheets) to increasing strengths of tomography-derived 3D mantle viscosity heterogeneity.
Demonstrated that combining elevated lower-mantle viscosity with strong 3D lateral heterogeneity reverses the anomalous negative GRACE ocean mass trend in the eastern North Atlantic.
Implemented a self-consistent post-processing workflow accounting for both degree-2, order-1 rotational feedback and GIA-dependent degree-1 geocenter motion in GRACE re-analysis.
量化了GRACE(-FO)地表质量趋势（陆地水储量、海洋质量、冰盖）对基于层析成像的不同强度3D地幔黏度非均质性的敏感性。
证明结合较高的下地幔黏度与强3D横向非均质性可以反转东北大西洋GRACE海洋质量趋势的异常负信号。
实现了自洽的后处理流程，在GRACE重新分析中同时考虑了2阶1次自转反馈和依赖GIA的1阶地心运动修正。
me: 3D viscoelastic GIA forward modeling using the spherical finite-element code CitcomSVE-3.0 with an optimized time-dependent ocean function.

Conversion of P- and S-wave velocities from the TX2019-slab tomography model and lithospheric thermal models into 3D mantle viscosity via an Arrhenius-type homologous melting temperature relationship.
Transformation of GIA gravitational potential into GRACE-compatible Stokes coefficients and Equivalent Water Height (EWH) with degree-2,1 rotational and Swenson/Sun degree-1 geocenter corrections.
使用具有优化时变海洋函数的球面有限元代码CitcomSVE-3.0进行三维黏弹性GIA正演模拟。
通过阿伦尼乌斯型同源熔融温度关系，将TX2019-slab层析成像模型的P波和S波速度及岩石圈热模型转换为3D地幔黏度。
将GIA引力位转换为与GRACE兼容的斯托克斯系数和等效水高（EWH），并进行2阶1次自转反馈修正和Swenson/Sun 1阶地心修正。
de: Eight global GIA simulations split into two sets: ICE-6G-D ice history with VM5a radial mean viscosity, and ANU/IJ05 ice history with C18 radial mean viscosity, across three levels of 3D heterogeneity.
3D mantle temperature and viscosity fields derived from the TX2019-slab seismic tomography model blended with plate cooling and TC1 continental lithospheric thermal models.
JPL GRACE and GRACE-FO Level-3 Mascon CRI Filtered Release 06.3 Version 04 data from 2002 through the end of 2024.
八组全球GIA模拟实验（分为两组：ICE-6G-D冰历史配合VM5a径向平均黏度，以及ANU/IJ05冰历史配合C18径向平均黏度，各含三个等级的3D非均质性）。
由TX2019-slab地震层析成像模型混合板块冷却模型及TC1大陆岩石圈热模型导出的3D地幔温度和黏度场。
2002年至2024年底的JPL GRACE和GRACE-FO Level-3 Mascon CRI滤波RL06.3 v04数据集。
li: Ice loading histories used (ICE-6G-D and ANU/IJ05) were originally calibrated to 1D radial viscosity profiles rather than tuned jointly with 3D viscosity structures.
Uncertainties in converting seismic velocities to temperature and mineralogical assumptions on mantle composition are not explored across multiple tomography models.
Rapidly uplifting ultra-low viscosity regions in coastal West Antarctica (e.g., Amundsen Sea Embayment) are not fully resolved by the global mesh and tomography.
所使用的冰川加载历史（ICE-6G-D和ANU/IJ05）最初是针对1D径向黏度剖面校准的，未与3D黏度结构进行联合调优。
未在多个层析成像模型间探讨地震波速转换温度的不确定性以及地幔矿物成分假设的影响。
西南极沿海（如阿蒙森海湾）快速隆升的超低黏度区域在全球网格和层析成像中未得到完全分辨。

tm.why: The paper derives 3D mantle viscosity structures from seismic tomography and thermal models to simulate viscoelastic deformation and glacial isostatic adjustment.

ev.notes: Full 31-page PDF analyzed, including main text, equations, 11 figures, 3 tables, and Appendices A and B.

sum: Earthquake source parameters such as seismic moment, corner frequency, stress drop, radiated energy, and apparent stress are widely estimated from limited-band data using Snoke's (1987) approximation of Andrews' (1986) squared spectral integrals under the Brune (1970) model. However, literature implementations show an inconsistent numerical coefficient in Snoke's low-frequency spectral level expression. By analytically rederiving the spectral integrals, this study confirms the correct coefficient is 2 rather than 4^(1/4), fixing a √2 computational oversight. This error underestimates seismic moment by √2 (a ~0.1 shift in moment magnitude) and propagates into static stress drop and apparent stress, causing radiation efficiency to double and severely biasing inferred fracture energy by up to an order of magnitude. The paper also clarifies how Snoke's piecewise band-limited extrapolation links far-field observables to dynamic rupture energy partitioning and undershoot.
基于Brune震源谱模型，Snoke（1987）提出的有限频带平方谱积分近似方法被广泛用于估计地震矩、拐角频率、应力降和视应力等震源参数。然而，后续研究在使用Snoke低频谱水平公式时采用了不一致的数值系数。本文通过解析重推导，证实正确系数应为2而非4^(1/4)，纠正了原公式中相差√2的计算疏漏。……

t: Analytical rederivation of squared velocity (J) and displacement (K) spectral integrals from the Brune (1970) model, followed by algebraic inversion to solve for corner frequency and low-frequency spectral level.
基于Brune模型解析重推导平方速度谱（J）和位移谱（K）积分，并代数反演求解拐角频率与低频谱水平。
This is a theoretical study utilizing analytical models and published formulations from existing literature without introducing new observational datasets.
纯理论研究，使用解析模型与已发表文献中的公式，未引入新的观测数据集。

Correcting Snoke's coefficient from 4^(1/4) to 2 eliminates a √2 underestimation in seismic moment (~0.1 Mw unit), which otherwise doubles radiation efficiency and severely underestimates fracture energy.
将系数从4^(1/4)修正为2消除了地震矩的√2倍低估（~0.1 Mw），避免辐射效率翻倍及破裂能严重低估。

Estimating spectral integrals from band-limited observations requires extrapolating outside the observable bandwidth assuming a Brune spectrum, and fracture energy inference breaks down under stress undershoot.
有限频带观测需假设Brune谱进行频带外推，且应力欠调时破裂能推断会失效。
Resolves a long-standing √2 discrepancy in literature implementations of Snoke (1987) and explicitly links the spectral coefficient error to biases in dynamic rupture energy budgets.
解决了Snoke（1987）应用中长期存在的√2分歧，并将谱系数误差与动态破裂能量收支偏差直接关联。

kc: Analytically proves that the numerical coefficient in Snoke's (1987) low-frequency spectral level expression is 2 instead of 4^(1/4).
Quantifies the propagation of this √2 factor error into seismic moment (~0.1 Mw shift), stress drop, apparent stress, radiation efficiency, and fracture energy.
Clarifies the mathematical basis of Snoke's band-limited piecewise spectral integral approximation and links inferred parameters to fault dynamic energy budgets.
解析证明了Snoke（1987）低频谱水平表达式中的数值系数应为2而非4^(1/4)。
量化了该√2倍误差在地震矩（约0.1矩震级偏差）、应力降、视应力、辐射效率及破裂能中的误差传递。
阐明了Snoke有限频带分段谱积分近似的数学基础，并将推演的震源参数与断层动态能量收支相联系。
me: Analytical integration of squared displacement (K) and velocity (J) spectra assuming a Brune (1970) omega-square source model.
Algebraic inversion and internal consistency checks of Snoke's (1987) and Andrews' (1986) spectral formulations.
Piecewise spectral approximation across a limited frequency band [f1, f2] and sensitivity analysis of fault slip energy partitioning.
基于Brune（1970）ω平方震源模型，对平方位移谱（K）和速度谱（J）进行解析积分。
对Snoke（1987）和Andrews（1986）的谱公式进行代数反演与内部一致性检验。
在有限频带[f1, f2]内进行分段谱近似，并对断层滑动能量分配进行敏感性分析。
de: Purely analytical derivation and theoretical error-propagation modeling based on published spectral formulations.
Theoretical sensitivity tests evaluating the ratio of misestimated to true inferred fracture energy across varying radiation efficiencies and undershoot regimes.
基于已发表谱公式的纯解析推导与理论误差传递建模。
评估不同辐射效率和欠调状态下错误估计与真实推断破裂能比值的理论敏感性测试。
li: Relies on the idealized Brune (1970) circular fault model assuming instantaneous 100% stress drop and isotropic S-wave radiation.
Band-limited integral extrapolation assumes the corner frequency lies strictly within the observable frequency band [f1, f2].
Seismological inference of fracture energy requires assuming zero dynamic overshoot or undershoot, which often fails for small earthquakes.
依赖于理想化的Brune（1970）圆形断层模型，假设瞬时100%应力降及各向同性S波辐射。
有限频带积分外推假设拐角频率严格位于可观测频带[f1, f2]之内。
破裂能的地震学推断需假设无动态过调或欠调，这在小震中往往不成立。

tm.why: The paper analytically rederives and corrects spectral integral formulations for estimating earthquake source parameters, stress drop, radiated energy, apparent stress, and fracture energy.
The study connects spectral source parameter estimates directly to fault slip energy partitioning, breakdown work, frictional dissipation, and dynamic stress undershoot.

ev.notes: Full preprint text, equations, appendix, and all three figures were thoroughly analyzed from the provided 31-page PDF.

sum: Water in subducting plates strongly influences subduction dynamics, seismicity, and arc volcanism, yet oceanic crust permeability remains poorly constrained. This study uses novel 2D poro-elastic finite-element models (PyLith) of flexure-induced slab bending to simulate pore fluid distributions in the Cocos Plate outer-rise at the Central American margin, comparing results against porosity profiles derived from controlled-source electromagnetic (CSEM) resistivity data. The simulations show that matching observed porosities below 3 km depth requires a low background permeability (< 10^-21 to 10^-22 m^2) and outer-rise fault damage zones that are 2.5 to 10 times more permeable than host rock. However, elastic bending consistently underpredicts porosity at 1–3 km depth by 1%–2%, suggesting that unmodeled anelastic deformation and hydrothermal circulation enhance shallow hydration. These low deep-crustal permeabilities restrict shallow fluid escape, promoting elevated pore pressures, hydraulic fracturing, and deeper fluid release along the megathrust.
俯冲板片中的水对地震活动和弧岩浆作用至关重要，但洋壳渗透率仍缺乏约束。本研究利用二维孔隙弹性有限元模型（PyLith）模拟中美洲边缘科科斯板块外隆弯曲引起的孔隙流体分布，并与可控源电磁（CSEM）电阻率反演的孔隙度进行对比。结果表明，拟合3公里以下的观测孔隙度需要极低的背景渗透率（低于10^-21至……

t: 2D quasi-static finite-element simulations in PyLith v4.2.0 modeling coupled fluid flow and linear poro-elastic flexure of a layered subducting plate with dipping fault damage zones.
利用PyLith v4.2.0进行二维准静态有限元模拟，耦合流体流动与含倾斜断层带的分层俯冲板片线性孔隙弹性弯曲。

Model predictions are initialized and evaluated against trench-binned depth-averaged porosity profiles derived from a CSEM electrical resistivity survey across the Cocos Plate outer-rise offshore Nicaragua.
利用尼加拉瓜近海科科斯板块外隆CSEM电阻率调查获取的分箱深度平均孔隙度剖面进行模型初始化和评估。
Deep oceanic crust permeability below 3 km must be between 10^-21 and 10^-22 m^2, and outer-rise fault zones are 2.5–10x more permeable than host rock in a 25 km-thick plate.
3公里以下深部洋壳渗透率须为10^-21至10^-22 m^2，25公里厚板片中外隆断层带渗透率为围岩的2.5–10倍。
All models underpredict shallow (1–3 km) porosity near the trench by 1%–2% because linear poro-elasticity neglects brittle faulting, off-fault plasticity, and hydrothermal circulation.
因线性孔隙弹性忽略了非弹性变形和热液循环，所有模型在近海沟1–3公里浅部均低估了1%–2%的孔隙度。
First application of 2D poro-elastic slab-flexure models to directly constrain oceanic crust and outer-rise fault zone depth-permeability relationships using CSEM porosity observations.
首次结合二维孔隙弹性板片弯曲模拟与CSEM孔隙度观测，直接约束洋壳和外隆断层带的深度-渗透率关系。

kc: Developed 2D poro-elastic finite-element models of outer-rise slab flexure to quantitatively test depth-permeability relationships against CSEM-derived porosity.
Constrained the background permeability of the oceanic crust below 3 km depth at the Central American margin to less than 10^-21 to 10^-22 m^2.
Bounded the permeability enhancement within outer-rise fault damage zones to 2.5–10 times the host rock permeability.
Demonstrated that linear poro-elastic flexure underpredicts shallow (1–3 km) porosity by 1%–2%, highlighting the role of anelastic off-fault/on-fault deformation.
建立了外隆板片弯曲的二维孔隙弹性有限元模型，结合CSEM孔隙度数据定量检验了深度-渗透率关系。
将中美洲边缘3公里深度以下的洋壳背景渗透率约束在10^-21至10^-22 m^2以下。
将外隆断层破碎带内的渗透率增强幅度限制在围岩渗透率的2.5至10倍之间。
证明线性孔隙弹性弯曲在1–3公里浅部低估了1%–2%的孔隙度，凸显了断层内外非弹性变形的重要作用。
me: Quasi-static 2D layered linear poro-elastic finite-element modeling using PyLith v4.2.0 and PETSc.
Bathymetry-derived velocity boundary conditions using a 5th-order polynomial fit to isolate flexural bending over an 850 kyr runtime.
Parametric sweep over four reference depth-permeability profiles, two plate thicknesses (15 and 25 km), and fault permeability enhancements (1x to 100x).
Logarithmic root-mean-square misfit evaluation across trench-distance bins and Drucker-Prager yield stress analysis to identify anelastic yielding zones.
使用PyLith v4.2.0和PETSc进行准静态二维分层线性孔隙弹性有限元模拟。
利用五阶多项式拟合海底地形提取弯曲信号，施加基于地形的速度边界条件模拟85万年演化。
对四种参考深度-渗透率模型、两种板片厚度（15和25公里）及断层渗透率增强因子（1至100倍）进行参数扫描。
计算海沟距离分箱内的对数均方根误差，并利用Drucker-Prager屈服准则分析非弹性屈服区域。
de: Porosity profiles of the subducting Cocos Plate outer-rise derived from a trench-orthogonal CSEM electrical resistivity survey offshore Nicaragua (Naif et al., 2015).
Seismically constrained 1D density profile and layer thicknesses for basalt (0–1.6 km), gabbro (1.6–5.6 km), and peridotite (>5.6 km) from wide-angle seismic data.
SRTM15+ and GeoMapApp bathymetry data along the Central America margin transect.
尼加拉瓜近海垂直海沟剖面的CSEM电阻率调查获取的科科斯板块外隆孔隙度分布数据（Naif et al., 2015）。
由广角地震数据约束的玄武岩（0–1.6 km）、辉长岩（1.6–5.6 km）和橄榄岩（>5.6 km）层厚及一维密度剖面。
中美洲边缘剖面的SRTM15+与GeoMapApp海底地形数据。
li: Assumes a linear isotropic poro-elastic rheology with infinitesimal strain, neglecting brittle faulting, off-fault plasticity, and viscoelastic relaxation.
Assumes constant fluid compressibility and constant permeability through time, leading to artificial negative pore pressures in low-permeability layers.
Neglects hydrothermal circulation, thermal effects, and chemical water consumption via serpentinization reactions.
假设线性各向同性孔隙弹性流变学和无穷小应变，忽略了脆性断裂、断层外塑性和粘弹性松弛。
假设流体压缩系数和渗透率随时间恒定，导致低渗透率层中出现非真实的负孔隙流体压力。
忽略了热液循环、热效应以及蛇纹石化反应引起的水化学消耗。

tm.why: The paper uses two-dimensional poro-elastic finite element models to investigate slab bending, permeability structure, and hydration of the Cocos Plate in the outer-rise region.

The study constrains permeability within outer-rise fault damage zones and discusses direct implications for pore fluid pressure, hydraulic fracturing, and slow slip events along the subduction megathrust.

sum: This study addresses the high computational cost of physics-based Probabilistic Seismic Hazard Analysis (PSHA) in the CyberShake framework. The authors perform viscoelastic seismic wave propagation simulations using SeisSol for southern San Andreas fault earthquakes, generating Green's functions for 480,000 sites. They develop a scientific machine learning approach using interpolated proper orthogonal decomposition (POD) to build a reduced-order model. This model efficiently predicts effective amplitude spectra (EAS) for finite-source ruptures. Comparing their high-resolution site terms with CyberShake's minimum curvature interpolation reveals local discrepancies up to a factor of three, showing that interpolation can miss critical ground-motion variations. The proposed reduced-order modeling approach can potentially reduce the time-to-solution for CyberShake earthquake rupture forecasts by a factor of 336, significantly advancing high-performance computing applications in seismic hazard assessment.
本文针对基于物理的地震危险性分析计算成本高的问题，利用SeisSol模拟了南圣安德烈亚斯断层地震，获取48万个站点的格林函数。提出基于插值本征正交分解的科学机器学习降阶模型，高效预测有限源破裂的有效振幅谱。对比发现传统插值场地项局部偏差可达3倍。该降阶模型可将计算时间缩短336倍，显著提升了地震危险……

t: A scientific machine learning approach using interpolated proper orthogonal decomposition to construct a reduced-order model of Green's functions for predicting effective amplitude spectra.
利用插值本征正交分解构建格林函数降阶模型的科学机器学习方法。
Viscoelastic seismic wave propagation simulations for point sources along the southern San Andreas fault, storing horizontal Green's functions at 480,000 sites.
南圣安德烈亚斯断层单点源粘弹性波传播模拟，存储了48万个站点的水平格林函数。
Identified local discrepancies up to a factor of three in interpolated site terms and demonstrated a potential 336-fold reduction in time-to-solution.
发现插值场地项存在高达3倍的局部偏差，并实现了计算时间缩短336倍。
The reduced-order model's performance is constrained by the spatial coverage and resolution of the initial point-source simulations.
降阶模型的性能受限于初始点源模拟的空间覆盖范围和分辨率。
Combining high-performance computing wave simulations with proper orthogonal decomposition reduced-order modeling to accelerate probabilistic seismic hazard analysis.
结合高性能计算波动模拟与本征正交分解降阶建模，加速概率地震危险性分析。

kc: Developed a scientific machine learning reduced-order model using interpolated proper orthogonal decomposition (POD) for ground-motion simulations.
Derived high-resolution, frequency-dependent site terms for southern California from 480,000 simulated sites.
Demonstrated a potential 336x speedup in time-to-solution for CyberShake earthquake rupture forecasts.
开发了一种基于插值本征正交分解（POD）的科学机器学习降阶模型，用于地震动模拟。
基于48万个模拟站点，推导了南加州高分辨率、频率相关的场地项。
展示了将CyberShake地震破裂预测的计算时间缩短336倍的潜力。

Scientific machine learning based on interpolated proper orthogonal decomposition (POD).

沿南圣安德烈亚斯断层（Bombay Beach至Lake Hughes）非平面几何形状进行的地震点源模拟。
三分钟的粘弹性波传播模拟，存储了48万个站点的水平分量格林函数。

目前专注于南圣安德烈亚斯断层区域，推广到其他复杂构造区域仍需验证。

The paper focuses on physics-based ground-motion simulations, CyberShake implications, and high-resolution site terms for PSHA.
It uses a scientific machine learning approach based on interpolated proper orthogonal decomposition to build a reduced-order model.

sum: This study presents a clustering procedure to re-classify high-frequency Martian seismic events recorded by the NASA InSight mission. By analyzing P-wave coda slope decay (reflecting attenuation and scattering) and newly identified P-wave morphologies (delayed energy arrivals), the authors identify five distinct sub-groups of events. Comparing these clusters to events with known locations suggests they represent distinct wave propagation pathways. These findings reveal regional structural variations in the Martian crust surrounding the InSight landing site and provide new constraints on the spatial distribution and origins of high-frequency marsquakes.
本研究针对NASA InSight任务记录的高频火星震，提出了一种基于P波尾波的聚类分类方法。通过分析反映衰减与散射的P波尾波斜率衰减以及新发现的延迟能量到达等P波形态特征，研究人员成功识别出五个火星震子类。通过与已知位置的事件进行对比，作者将这些类别的差异解释为不同的波传播路径。该研究揭示了InS……

t: A clustering procedure analyzing P-wave coda slope decay (for attenuation/scattering) and delayed energy arrival morphologies to group high-frequency Marsquakes.
一种分析P波尾波斜率衰减（反映衰减/散射）和延迟能量到达形态的高频火星震聚类方法。
High-frequency seismic waveforms recorded by the NASA InSight lander on Mars.
NASA InSight火星着陆器记录的高频地震波形数据。
Identification of five distinct sub-groups of high-frequency Marsquakes, indicating regional structural variations and distinct propagation pathways around the landing site.
识别出五类不同特征的高频火星震，揭示了着陆点周围的区域结构变化和不同的传播路径。
High-frequency events are only located to an epicentral distance, lacking precise 3D spatial coordinates.
高频事件仅能确定震中距离，缺乏精确的三维空间坐标。
First classification of high-frequency Marsquakes using P-wave coda decay slopes combined with delayed energy arrival morphologies.
首次结合P波尾波衰减斜率与延迟能量到达形态对高频火星震进行分类。

kc: Developed a clustering procedure for high-frequency Marsquakes based on P-wave coda decay and morphology.
Identified five distinct sub-groups of high-frequency Martian seismic events.
Inferred regional structural variations and distinct wave propagation pathways around the InSight landing site.
开发了一种基于P波尾波衰减和形态特征的高频火星震聚类分类方法。
识别出五种不同特征的高频火星震子类。
推断出InSight着陆点周围存在区域结构变化及不同的地震波传播路径。

Waveform morphology analysis focusing on delayed energy arrivals.
Clustering analysis to group seismic events.
用于表征衰减和散射的P波尾波斜率衰减分析。
关注延迟能量到达的波形形态分析。
用于对地震事件进行分组的聚类分析。

NASA InSight任务在火星上记录的高频地震事件波形数据。

大多数高频事件的绝对空间位置仍缺乏约束，仅依赖于震中距。

The classification is based on P-wave coda slope decay, which provides information on attenuation and scattering.
The study aims to re-classify and understand the spatial distribution of high-frequency Martian seismic events.

sum: This paper proposes an alternative model for the origin of the Hawaiian-Emperor chain, challenging the classical mantle plume hypothesis. Instead of a deep-seated plume, the author suggests a high-viscosity, semi-confined asthenospheric body beneath the Pacific plate that migrates with a lag (~0.8–1.0 cm/a) relative to the ambient asthenosphere (~2.5–4.0 cm/a). This migration lag hinders heat dissipation, leading to 'heat retention' and local heat accumulation over 45–55 Ma, establishing a ~200°C thermal anomaly that triggers melting. Using published geodynamic, geochemical, and geophysical data, the paper estimates a total thermal budget of 82.7 GW with only 16.6% excess heat, inconsistent with a deep plume. The model predicts a cone-shaped low-velocity anomaly and depth-rotating SKS fast axes.
本文为夏威夷-帝王火山链的起源提出了一种替代经典地幔柱假说的新模型。作者认为，太平洋板块下方存在一个高粘度的半封闭软流圈物质体，其运移速度（0.8-1.0 cm/a）显著滞后于周围软流圈（2.5-4.0 cm/a）。这种运移滞后阻碍了热量散失，导致“蓄热”效应，在45-55百万年内积累约200°C的……

t: Analytical kinematic and thermal budget modeling comparing asthenospheric flow with hotspot observations.
对比软流圈流动与热点观测的解析运动学和热预算建模。
Published literature data including seismic tomography, surface heat flow, helium isotopes, and age-distance relationships.
已发表的文献数据，包括地震断层扫描、地表热流、氦同位素和年龄-距离关系。
Proposes a semi-confined asthenospheric body migrating at 0.8-1.0 cm/a, retaining heat to establish a ~200°C anomaly.
提出运移速度为0.8-1.0 cm/a的半封闭软流圈体，通过蓄热建立约200°C的异常。
Lacks direct numerical modeling or new observational data, relying entirely on existing literature.
缺乏直接的数值模拟或新观测数据，完全依赖现有文献。
Replaces the deep mantle plume hypothesis with an asthenospheric 'migration lag and heat retention' mechanism.
用软流圈“运移滞后与蓄热”机制取代了深部地幔柱假说。

kc: Proposes a 'migration lag and heat retention' model as an alternative to the classical Hawaiian mantle plume hypothesis.
Quantifies the kinematics and thermal budget of the proposed asthenospheric body, showing it accounts for the observed heat flow with minimal excess heat.
Provides testable predictions, including a cone-shaped low-velocity seismic anomaly and depth-rotating SKS splitting fast axes.
提出了“滞后运移与蓄热”模型，作为经典夏威夷地幔柱假说的替代方案。
定量计算了所提软流圈物质体的运动学和热预算，表明其在极少超额热的情况下即可解释观测到的热流。
提供了可验证的预测，包括锥形低速地震异常和随深度旋转的SKS分裂快轴。

Synthesis and re-interpretation of published seismic tomography, surface heat flow, helium isotopes, and age-distance data.
对比软流圈流动与热点运动学的运动学和热预算分析。
