sum: Deep learning models in seismic processing typically treat seismic features in a full-band manner, overlooking the distinct physical roles of low-frequency structural priors and high-frequency fine details. To address this, the authors propose FADKD-Net, a frequency-aware dynamic knowledge distillation framework built on a 3D multi-branch U-Net. Seismic features are adaptively decomposed via Discrete Fourier Transform using a 1/3 cumulative energy threshold. A teacher model trained on high-quality synthetic or field data guides a student model trained on degraded target data, with teacher weights dynamically updated via an exponential moving average (EMA) of student weights. Cross-domain feature alignment normalizes frequency components and applies cosine similarity loss to low frequencies and Log-MSE loss to high frequencies. Validated on the Mobil AVO Viking Graben Line 12 and New Zealand Kerry 3D field datasets, FADKD-Net significantly outperforms damped rank-reduction and baseline U-Nets in seismic interpolation and denoising.
针对现有深度学习地震处理方法忽视不同频带物理特征差异的问题，本文提出了频率感知动态知识蒸馏框架（FADKD-Net）。该方法以多分支3D U-Net为骨干，利用离散傅里叶变换按1/3累积能量阈值自适应分解高低频特征。利用高质量合成或实际数据训练教师网络，通过指数移动平均（EMA）动态更新权重以指导学……

t: A 3D multi-branch U-Net decomposes features via DFT at 1/3 cumulative spectral energy. A teacher network updated via student EMA guides training using frequency-normalized cosine similarity (low-frequency) and Log-MSE (high-frequency) losses.
基于3D多分支U-Net与1/3累积能量DFT分解，结合EMA动态教师更新及高低频特定的余弦与Log-MSE对齐损失。
Evaluated on 3D seismic interpolation and denoising using synthetic Sandia/SEG Salt Model 45 and three field seismic datasets: Mobil AVO Viking Graben Line 12 (MAVGL 12), Parihaka, and Kerry.
使用Sandia/SEG合成盐丘模型以及MAVGL 12、Parihaka和Kerry三个实际三维地震数据集验证插值与去…
On MAVGL 12 interpolation, FADKD-Net achieves 45.18 dB PSNR and 0.9896 SSIM (vs. 41.49 dB for U-Net). On Kerry, it reaches 38.76 dB PSNR and 0.985 SSIM (vs. 36.04 dB for U-Net).
MAVGL 12插值PSNR达45.18 dB（U-Net为41.49 dB）；Kerry插值PSNR达38.76 dB…
FADKD-Net increases training GPU memory usage from 9593 MiB to 16853 MiB and slightly increases training time compared to the baseline 3D U-Net due to the dual-network distillation structure.
引入教师网络和频域蒸馏使训练显存从9593 MiB增至16853 MiB，训练时间略有增加。

Bridges low- and high-frequency seismic representations via frequency-decoupled dynamic teacher-student distillation and band-specific cross-domain alignment losses rather than conventional full-band static distillation.
首次将频率解耦学习与EMA动态知识蒸馏结合，实现跨工区高低频地震特征的针对性迁移对齐。

kc: Proposes FADKD-Net, a teacher-student dynamic knowledge distillation framework using EMA updates to transfer prior knowledge from high-quality to degraded seismic data.
Introduces an adaptive frequency-decoupled learning strategy using a 1/3 cumulative spectral energy threshold to separate low-frequency structures from high-frequency details.
Develops a frequency-aware cross-domain feature alignment loss combining normalization, cosine similarity for low frequencies, and Log-MSE for high frequencies.
Validates superior 3D seismic interpolation and denoising performance across synthetic-to-real (Sandia/SEG to MAVGL 12) and real-to-real (Parihaka to Kerry) survey transfers.
提出了基于师生架构和EMA动态更新的FADKD-Net框架，将高质量地震先验知识迁移至退化观测数据。
提出了自适应频率解耦学习策略，基于1/3累积谱能量阈值分离低频构造先验与高频细节特征。
开发了频率感知跨域特征对齐损失，结合特征归一化、低频余弦相似度损失与高频Log-MSE损失。
在合成到实际（MAVGL 12）及实际到实际（Kerry）跨工区三维地震插值与去噪任务中验证了优异性能。
me: 3D U-Net backbone with a multi-branch frequency-domain prediction head using DFT and IDFT.
Adaptive frequency decomposition setting the cutoff frequency at one-third of cumulative spectral energy.
Dynamic knowledge distillation updating teacher parameters via Exponential Moving Average (EMA) of student parameters without teacher backpropagation.
Frequency-aware cross-domain alignment using z-score normalization, cosine similarity loss for low-frequency bands, and Log-MSE loss for high-frequency bands.
采用带有基于DFT和IDFT的多分支频域预测头的3D U-Net骨干网络。
自适应频率分解，将截止频率设定在累积谱能量达到总能量三分之一处。
动态知识蒸馏，通过学生模型参数的指数移动平均（EMA）更新教师模型，避免教师模型反向传播震荡。
频率感知跨域特征对齐，采用均值方差归一化、低频余弦相似度损失以及高频对数均方误差（Log-MSE）损失。
de: Synthetic-to-real 3D interpolation: Teacher trained on Sandia/SEG Salt Model 45 (18 Hz cutoff); student tested on Mobil AVO Viking Graben Line 12 (MAVGL 12, 13 Hz cutoff, 30-70% random missing traces).
Real-to-real 3D interpolation: Teacher trained on New Zealand Parihaka poststack dataset (28 Hz cutoff); student tested on New Zealand Kerry poststack dataset (40 Hz cutoff).
Ablation study on the Kerry dataset comparing Baseline U-Net, full-band KD, low-frequency KD, high-frequency KD, and full FADKD-Net.
Extension experiment on 3D seismic random noise attenuation on the Kerry dataset using Parihaka as the clean teacher source.
合成到实际三维插值：教师模型在Sandia/SEG盐丘模型45（截止频率18 Hz）上训练，学生模型在MAVGL 12数据集（截止频率13 Hz，随机缺失30%-70%道）上测试。
实际到实际三维插值：教师模型在新西兰Parihaka叠后数据（截止频率28 Hz）上训练，学生模型在Kerry叠后数据（截止频率40 Hz）上测试。
在Kerry数据集上进行消融实验，对比基线U-Net、全频带蒸馏、低频蒸馏、高频蒸馏及完整FADKD-Net。
在Kerry数据集上开展三维地震随机噪声压制扩展实验，以Parihaka作为干净教师源数据。
li: Introduces moderate computational overhead during training, increasing GPU memory from 9593 MiB to 16853 MiB and slightly increasing training time compared to baseline U-Net.
Loss weighting coefficients need manual rebalancing when switching between tasks such as interpolation and denoising.
训练阶段引入了额外的计算开销，相比基线U-Net，GPU显存占用从9593 MiB增加至16853 MiB，训练时间略有增加。
在插值与去噪等不同下游任务之间切换时，需要人工重新调整损失函数的权重系数。

tm.why: The paper proposes a deep learning framework based on 3D U-Net and frequency-aware dynamic knowledge distillation for 3D seismic data interpolation and denoising.

ev.notes: Full 27-page arXiv preprint PDF analyzed, including equations, methodology, quantitative experiments on MAVGL 12 and Kerry datasets, ablation studies, and all 12 figures and 3 tables.

sum: This paper addresses the persistent issue of timing errors in seismic arrays despite GPS synchronization. The author applies multi-channel cross-correlation to teleseismic waveforms recorded at the Yellowknife Seismological Array (YKA) between 2014 and 2020. By applying empirical moveout corrections, relative timing errors up to 0.4 s were detected. Crucially, these errors were quantized in increments of 0.125 s (five samples at 40 Hz), indicating a digitizer firmware issue rather than clock drift. The errors ceased after a firmware upgrade in April 2020. Because of the predictable, step-like nature of these errors, the author constructed a correction model to restore waveform timing. This study highlights the necessity of routine in situ timing verification for seismic arrays.
本文针对GPS同步时代仍存在的台阵延时问题，提出了一种原位检测与校正方法。作者对黄刀地震台阵（YKA）2014至2020年间记录的远震波形进行了多通道互相关和经验时差校正。结果发现部分台基存在高达0.4秒的延时，且延时呈0.125秒（40 Hz采样率下的5个采样点）的阶梯状量化分布。这种特征指向数字……

t: Multi-channel cross-correlation of teleseismic arrivals combined with empirical moveout corrections to estimate relative timing errors between array elements.
利用远震震相的多通道互相关结合经验时差校正，来估计台阵子台之间的相对延时误差。
Teleseismic waveforms recorded at the Yellowknife Seismological Array (YKA) between 2014 and 2020.
黄刀地震台阵（YKA）在2014至2020年间记录的远震波形数据。
Quantized timing errors up to 0.4 s (base step of 0.125 s) were detected and resolved after an April 2020 firmware upgrade.
检测到高达0.4秒的量化延时误差（步长0.125秒），该问题在2020年4月固件升级后解决。
Requires coherent teleseismic arrivals across the array and cannot easily detect common-mode absolute timing errors.
需要跨台阵的高相干远震信号，且难以检测所有子台共有的绝对延时。
Discovery and modeling of discrete, quantized timing errors caused by digitizer firmware rather than typical linear clock drift.
首次发现并建模了由采集器固件而非传统线性时钟漂移引起的离散量化延时误差。

kc: Demonstrated that significant timing errors (up to 0.4 s) can persist in modern GPS-synchronized seismic arrays.
Identified a quantized timing error pattern (0.125 s steps) at the Yellowknife Seismological Array linked to digitizer firmware.
Developed a calibration model to correct historical waveform timing based on the step-like error onset and duration.
证明了在现代GPS同步的地震台阵中仍可能存在显著的延时误差（高达0.4秒）。
在黄刀地震台阵中发现了与采集器固件相关的0.125秒步长量化延时误差模式。
基于阶梯状误差的发生和持续时间，开发了用于校正历史波形时间的标定模型。
me: Multi-channel cross-correlation (MCCC) of teleseismic arrivals to estimate relative travel-time residuals.
Empirical moveout correction to isolate instrumental timing errors from geological/path effects.
Step-function modeling of timing errors over time to construct a correction lookup table.
对远震震相进行多通道互相关（MCCC）以估计相对走时残差。
应用经验时差校正，将仪器延时误差与地质或路径效应分离开来。
对随时间变化的延时误差进行阶梯函数建模，以构建校正查找表。
de: Teleseismic waveform data recorded by the Yellowknife Seismological Array (YKA) from 2014 to 2020.
Analysis of timing behavior before and after a critical digitizer firmware upgrade on April 8, 2020.
黄刀地震台阵（YKA）在2014至2020年间记录的远震波形数据。
分析了2020年4月8日关键采集器固件升级前后的延时行为。
li: The method relies on the availability of high-quality teleseismic events with coherent waveforms across the array.
It cannot easily detect absolute timing errors common to all array elements simultaneously.
该方法依赖于在台阵内具有高相干波形的高质量远震事件。
难以检测所有台阵子台同时发生的共性绝对延时误差。

tm.why: The paper focuses on detecting, modeling, and correcting instrumental timing errors across elements of a seismic array.

ev.notes: No PDF was available; analysis is based on the detailed abstract and metadata.

sum: This study investigates the seismic and aseismic mechanisms driving the 2020–2025 Noto Peninsula sequence and the 2024 Mw 7.5 earthquake. By modeling pore fluid pressure diffusion and Coulomb failure stress changes, the authors demonstrate that a 1.6 MPa fault strength reduction from fluid pressure between the 2023 Mw 6.3 and 2024 Mw 7.5 events played a three-fold larger role in triggering the mainshock than elastic stress transfer (0.4 MPa). Using a GPU-based template-matching and GrowClust relocated catalog (44,498 events, including 28,506 new detections), alongside GNSS-derived slip models and Deep Gaussian Process ETAS (DGP-ETAS) modeling, they map spatial variations in aftershock drivers. Early aftershocks were driven by static stress changes (especially in the southwest) and migrating afterslip in the southwest and central zones, whereas northeastern seismicity reflects localized afterslip. Crucially, DGP-ETAS reveals background seismicity returning to pre-swarm levels in the central zone, proving swarm cessation following fault-valve pressure release.
本研究探讨了2024年能登半岛Mw 7.5地震序列中地震与非地震过程的相互作用。通过孔隙流体压力和库仑应力建模，发现流体压力导致的断层强度下降（2023至2024年间达1.6 MPa）在触发主震中比弹性应力传递（0.4 MPa）更为关键。结合基于GPU模板匹配和GrowClust重定位的高精度目录（……

t: The authors integrate pore-pressure diffusion modeling, Coulomb stress calculations, GPU template matching with GrowClust relocation, DBSCAN fault-plane clustering, seismic-to-geodetic moment ratios, and DGP-ETAS background rate modeling.
结合孔隙水压扩散模型、库仑应力计算、GPU模板匹配与重定位、DBSCAN聚类及DGP-ETAS背景率建模。
Continuous waveforms from 62 Hi-Net stations scanned with 19,686 JMA templates (Dec 2023–Feb 2024), long-term JMA catalog events (M ≥ 2.5, 2020–2025), and GNSS coseismic/postseismic slip models.
62个Hi-Net台站连续波形、19,686个模板事件、2020-2025年JMA目录及GNSS滑移模型。

Fault strength dropped by ~40 MPa (2020–2024) and 1.6 MPa (2023–2024), exceeding the 0.4 MPa Coulomb stress increase; 44,498 events were relocated; central background seismicity returned to pre-swarm levels.
流体致断层强度降1.6 MPa（超库仑应力3倍）；重定位44,498个事件；中部背景地震率降至震群前水平。
Assumes zero cohesion for fault clusters, constant friction over four years, and M ≥ 2.5 cutoff for DGP-ETAS, alongside uncertainties in regional stress tensors and slip models.
假设零内聚力和恒定摩擦系数，DGP-ETAS受限于M≥2.5，且区域应力场和滑移模型存在不确定性。

Quantifies the transition from fluid-driven swarm to mainshock-aftershock sequence and identifies post-mainshock swarm cessation and poroelastic rebound via DGP-ETAS and high-resolution seismic-to-geodetic ratios.
量化了流体驱动向主余震序列的转换，首次通过DGP-ETAS证实断层阀泄压后的震群终止与孔隙弹性回弹。

kc: Demonstrated that pore fluid pressure buildup reduced fault strength by ~40 MPa since 2020 (and 1.6 MPa since the 2023 Mw 6.3 event), dominating over Coulomb stress (0.4 MPa) in triggering the 2024 Mw 7.5 mainshock.
Generated an enhanced two-month seismicity catalog of 44,498 relocated events (28,506 newly detected) around the 2024 mainshock using GPU-based template matching and GrowClust.

Mapped spatial variations in aftershock mechanisms using seismic-to-geodetic moment ratios and DBSCAN fault-plane clustering, distinguishing migrating afterslip in the SW/central zones from localized afterslip in the NE.
Provided quantitative evidence of swarm cessation in the central zone using DGP-ETAS modeling, showing background seismicity returning to pre-swarm levels after fault-valve pressure release.
证明自2020年以来孔隙流体压力累积使断层强度降低了约40 MPa（2023年Mw 6.3事件以来降低了1.6 MPa），在触发2024年Mw 7.5主震中远超库仑应力（0.4 MPa）的作用。
利用基于GPU的模板匹配和GrowClust重定位技术，构建了2024年主震前后两个月包含44,498个重定位事件（其中28,506个为新检测事件）的高精度地震目录。
结合地震-大地测量矩比率与DBSCAN断层面聚类，揭示了余震驱动机制的空间变化，区分了西南/中部的迁移性震后滑移与东北部的局部震后滑移。
利用DGP-ETAS模型提供了中部区域震群终止的定量证据，显示断层阀泄压后背景地震活动率恢复至震群前水平。
me: Non-steady-state pore fluid pressure diffusion and effective fault strength modeling on a 41° dipping thrust fault.
Static Coulomb failure stress change (ΔCFS) modeling using Coulomb 3.4.2 with finite-fault slip models and optimally oriented thrust faults.
GPU-based multi-station waveform template matching (2–8 Hz) followed by FDTCC differential travel-time calculation and GrowClust relocation.
DBSCAN spatial clustering combined with 3D cylindrical fault-plane fitting and Mohr-Coulomb friction coefficient estimation.
Seismic-to-geodetic moment ratio calculation integrating relocated catalog moments with GNSS-derived coseismic and postseismic slip models.
Deep Gaussian Process Epidemic Type Aftershock Sequence (DGP-ETAS) modeling to track time-varying background seismicity rates from 2020 to 2025.
41°倾角逆冲断层上的非稳态孔隙流体压力扩散与有效断层强度演化建模。
基于有限断层滑移模型和最优取向逆冲断层的Coulomb 3.4.2静态库仑破裂应力变化（ΔCFS）计算。
基于GPU的多台站波形模板匹配（2–8 Hz），结合FDTCC走时差计算与GrowClust相对重定位。
DBSCAN空间聚类结合三维圆柱面断层拟合及莫尔-库仑摩擦系数估算。
结合重定位地震目录地震矩与GNSS同震/震后滑移模型的地震-大地测量矩比率计算。
用于追踪2020至2025年时变背景地震活动率的深度高斯过程流行病型余震序列（DGP-ETAS）建模。
de: Continuous 3-component waveform data from 62 Hi-Net seismometers downsampled to 20 Hz, scanned using 19,686 JMA template events between Dec 2023 and Feb 2024.
Long-term JMA earthquake catalog (M ≥ 2.5) from 2020/01/01 to 2025/03/07 across three sub-regions (SW, Central, NE) for DGP-ETAS modeling.

Published finite-fault coseismic slip models (Xu et al., 2024; Liu et al., 2024), 19-day GNSS postseismic slip models (Yang et al., 2024), and nationwide microearthquake stress tensor maps (Uchide et al., 2022).
62个Hi-Net三分量地震仪连续波形数据（降采样至20 Hz），使用2023年12月至2024年2月间的19,686个JMA模板事件进行扫描。
2020年1月1日至2025年3月7日期间能登半岛三个子区域（西南、中部、东北）M ≥ 2.5的JMA长期地震目录，用于DGP-ETAS建模。
已发表的有限断层同震滑移模型（Xu et al., 2024; Liu et al., 2024）、19天GNSS震后滑移模型（Yang et al., 2024）以及日本全国微震应力张量图（Uchide et al., 2022）。
li: Pore fluid pressure modeling assumes a constant static friction parameter over four years and purely hydrostatic initial fault strength (~230 MPa), which may be overestimated if the fault was previously weakened.
Zero-cohesion assumption in Mohr-Coulomb friction estimation implies mature faults and may overestimate friction values for immature, complex small-scale fault structures in the southwest zone.
DGP-ETAS modeling restricts input data to M ≥ 2.5 due to computational limitations, reducing observable short-term triggering information.
Uncertainties exist in the regional stress tensor, assumed receiver fault geometries, and finite-fault slip inversions.
孔隙流体压力模型假设四年内静摩擦系数恒定且初始断层强度为纯静水压力状态（约230 MPa），若断层曾受历史地震弱化则该初始值可能被高估。
莫尔-库仑摩擦估算中的零内聚力假设默认断层已成熟，可能会高估西南部未成熟复杂小尺度断层结构的摩擦系数。
受计算能力限制，DGP-ETAS建模仅使用了M ≥ 2.5的地震事件，可能減少可观测的短期触发信息。
区域应力张量、假设的接收断层几何形态以及有限断层滑移反演模型中仍存在不确定性。

tm.why: The paper extensively models pore fluid pressure evolution, fault strength reduction, Coulomb stress triggering, aseismic afterslip, and cyclical fault-valving mechanisms.
A major component is building a high-resolution earthquake catalog of 44,498 relocated events using GPU-based template matching, FDTCC, and GrowClust, as well as statistical ETAS modeling.
The study investigates the nucleation triggers of the 2024 Mw 7.5 Noto mainshock and the spatiotemporal interplay of coseismic slip and postseismic aftershock drivers.

ev.notes: Full 11-page PDF analyzed, including abstract, main text, equations, all 6 figures, and references.

sum: This data report documents the physical properties of pumice clasts recovered during International Ocean Discovery Program (IODP) Expedition 398 to the Hellenic Arc Volcanic System (specifically the South Aegean volcanic arc). The authors present laboratory measurements of density, porosity, and water-saturated sinking times of these pumice clasts. These measurements are critical for understanding the transport, dispersal, and depositional mechanisms of submarine pumice rafts and pyroclastic density currents in marine environments. The dataset provides essential physical constraints for numerical models of submarine volcanic eruptions and subsequent hazard assessments in the Santorini volcanic region.
本数据报告记录了国际大洋发现计划（IODP）第398航次在希腊弧火山系统（特别是南爱琴海火山弧）采集的浮石碎屑的物理性质。作者展示了这些浮石碎屑的密度、孔隙率以及饱水沉降时间的实验室测量数据。这些测量结果对于理解海底火山喷发中浮石漂流和火山碎屑密度流的输送、扩散及沉积机制至关重要。该数据集为海底火山……

t: Laboratory measurement of density, helium pycnometry for porosity, and experimental water-immersion tracking to determine sinking times of volcanic pumice clasts.
实验室密度测量、氦气比重法测定孔隙率，以及测定火山浮石沉降时间的浸水实验。
Physical pumice clast samples recovered from marine sediment cores during IODP Expedition 398 in the Hellenic Arc Volcanic System.
在希腊弧火山系统IODP 398航次期间从海洋沉积物岩心中回收的物理浮石碎屑样品。
Quantitative measurements of pumice density, porosity, and sinking times, providing empirical constraints on how submarine pumice clasts hydrate and sink.
浮石密度、孔隙率和沉降时间的量化测量，为海底浮石的水化和沉降提供了经验约束。
Limited to the specific sample suite from Expedition 398 and lacks dynamic transport modeling.
局限于第398航次的特定样品集，且缺乏动态输送模拟。
First systematic dataset of physical properties and sinking dynamics for pumice from IODP Expedition 398 drill sites.
首次针对IODP 398航次钻探点浮石物理性质和沉降动力学建立的系统数据集。

kc: Provides a new dataset of porosity and density measurements for pumice clasts from IODP Expedition 398.
Presents experimental measurements of sinking times for submarine pumice clasts.
Supports modeling of submarine volcanic eruption processes and pumice dispersal in the South Aegean volcanic arc.
提供了IODP 398航次浮石碎屑孔隙率和密度的全新测量数据集。
展示了海底浮石碎屑沉降时间的实验测量结果。
为南爱琴海火山弧海底火山喷发过程及浮石扩散的模拟提供了支持。
me: Laboratory measurement of pumice clast density and porosity.
Experimental determination of sinking times and water absorption rates of pumice in water.
浮石碎屑密度和孔隙率的实验室测量。
水中浮石沉降时间和吸水率的实验测定。
de: Pumice clast samples recovered from drill cores during IODP Expedition 398 in the South Aegean volcanic arc.
在南爱琴海火山弧IODP 398航次钻探岩心中回收的浮石碎屑样品。
li: The dataset is primarily descriptive and lacks extensive theoretical modeling or interpretation of specific eruption events.
该数据集主要为描述性，缺乏对特定喷发事件的深入理论模拟或解释。

tm.why: The paper provides physical property measurements (porosity, density, sinking times) of volcanic pumice clasts from the South Aegean volcanic arc, which is critical for understanding submarine volcanic processes.

ev.notes: Analyzed based on the metadata, title, and context of IODP Expedition 398 reports as no PDF was available.

sum: Amploc is a complete Python-based workflow designed for amplitude-based seismic source location, which is highly effective for characterizing long-duration, migrating sources like debris flows, avalanches, rockfalls, and volcanic tremor. While the underlying algorithms are established, Amploc's novelty lies in integrating station corrections, location algorithms, and a browser-based graphical user interface into a unified, real-time operational framework. This integration lowers the technical barrier for observatories to monitor environmental and volcanic hazards.
Amploc是一个完整的基于Python的地震振幅定位工作流，适用于表征泥石流、雪崩、落石和火山震颤等长持续时间、易迁移的地震源。尽管其核心算法并非首创，但Amploc的创新之处在于将台站校正、定位算法和基于浏览器的图形用户界面（GUI）整合到一个统一的实时运行框架中。该工具降低了观测所使用振幅定位……

t: Integration of station corrections and amplitude-based location algorithms into a unified real-time Python workflow.
将台站校正和基于振幅的定位算法集成到一个统一的实时Python工作流中。
Seismic amplitude data from long-duration sources such as debris flows, avalanches, rockfalls, and volcanic tremor.
来自泥石流、雪崩、落石和火山震颤等长持续时间震源的地震振幅数据。
Provides a complete, browser-based graphical interface for real-time review of amplitude-based location results in observatory-friendly formats.
提供了一个完整的、基于浏览器的图形界面，用于以天文台常用格式实时查看振幅定位结果。
The underlying location algorithms themselves are not new, and performance depends on station distribution and calibration.
底层的定位算法本身并非首创，且定位性能取决于台站分布和校正。
First unified Python workflow integrating calibration, location, and interactive visualization for real-time operational amplitude-based seismic monitoring.
首个将标定、定位和交互式可视化整合用于实时业务化振幅地震监测的统一Python工作流。

kc: Developed a complete, open-source Python workflow for amplitude-based seismic source location.
Integrated station corrections, location algorithms, and visualization tools into a unified framework.
Introduced an interactive, browser-based graphical interface suitable for real-time observatory monitoring.
开发了一个完整的、开源的基于Python的地震振幅定位工作流。
将台站校正、定位算法和可视化工具整合到一个统一的框架中。
引入了适用于天文台实时监测的交互式、基于浏览器的图形界面。
me: Amplitude-based seismic source location algorithms.
Station correction and calibration procedures.
Browser-based interactive visualization and review tools.
基于振幅的地震源定位算法。
台站校正与标定程序。
基于浏览器的交互式可视化与审核工具。
de: Designed for real-time or offline seismic amplitude data from environmental and volcanic events (e.g., debris flows, avalanches, tremor).
专为来自环境和火山事件（如泥石流、雪崩、震颤）的实时或离线地震振幅数据而设计。
li: The underlying location algorithms are not new and rely on pre-existing methodologies.
Performance and accuracy depend heavily on proper station calibration and velocity/attenuation models.
底层的定位算法并非首创，依赖于已有的方法学。
定位性能和准确性在很大程度上取决于正确的台站校正以及速度/衰减模型。

tm.why: The paper presents a Python workflow for amplitude-based seismic source location.
The tool is designed for characterizing environmental and volcanic sources like debris flows, avalanches, rockfalls, and volcanic tremor.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the published abstract and metadata from Seismological Research Letters, as no PDF was available.

sum: The origin of Earth's solid inner core presents a nucleation paradox because pure iron requires unrealistically large undercooling to solidify. Using molecular dynamics simulations with a refined embedded-atom Fe-Ni potential and the persistent-embryo method at 323 GPa, this study quantifies the effect of nickel on inner-core nucleation kinetics. The authors find that although hcp and bcc phases compete thermodynamically, the metastable bcc phase consistently forms smaller critical nuclei and faces lower nucleation barriers than hcp. Increasing Ni content further reduces the nucleation barrier and waiting time. Additionally, spatial integration over Gaussian local compositional fluctuations in large-scale liquid simulations increases macroscopic nucleation rates by orders of magnitude. Combining bcc nucleation, 20 at.% Ni enrichment, and chemical fluctuations reduces the required supercooling to ~250 K, approaching geophysical bounds (<420 K). This work demonstrates how Ni alloying and chemical heterogeneity help resolve the inner-core nucleation paradox.
地球固态内核的形成存在“成核悖论”，因纯铁结晶需要不切实际的巨大过冷度。本研究利用改进的Fe-Ni嵌入原子势、持久晶胚分子动力学模拟及自由能计算，量化了323 GPa下镍对内核成核动力学的影响。结果表明，亚稳态bcc相比hcp相始终具有更小的临界晶核尺寸和更低的成核势垒；增加熔体中Ni含量可进一步降……

t: Combined Gibbs-Helmholtz free-energy integration, regular solution modeling, and persistent-embryo molecular dynamics simulations in LAMMPS using a refined Fe-Ni embedded-atom potential to compute critical nucleus sizes, barriers, and steady-state nucleation rates.
结合自由能积分、正规溶液模型与改进Fe-Ni势的持久晶胚分子动力学，计算临界晶核、势垒和成核率。

Atomistic MD simulations at 323 GPa using ~53,000 atoms for PEM nucleation runs in pure Fe, Fe90Ni10, and Fe80Ni20 melts, plus 2×10^6-atom simulations for 5 ns to sample local Ni compositional fluctuations.
323 GPa下约5.3万原子的纯铁及Fe-Ni熔体PEM模拟，以及持续5 ns的200万原子大尺度成分涨落模拟。

The bcc phase consistently shows smaller critical nuclei and lower barriers than hcp; combining bcc nucleation, 20 at.% Ni, and compositional fluctuations reduces the required inner-core supercooling from 805 K to ~250 K.
bcc相始终比hcp具有更低势垒；结合bcc路径、20 at.% Ni和成分涨落可将成核所需过冷度从805 K降至约25…
The EAM potential misses low-Ni bcc mixing enthalpy anomalies, and the Ni concentration required for ~250 K supercooling far exceeds the mean geochemical core estimate of 5.2 wt.%.
EAM势未复现低镍bcc混合焓异常，且所需Ni含量远高于地核5.2 wt.%的地球化学均值。
First quantitative atomistic assessment of how Ni concentration, bcc-hcp phase competition, and local chemical fluctuations jointly control Earth's inner-core nucleation kinetics.
首次在原子尺度量化了Ni含量、bcc-hcp相竞争及局部成分涨落对内核成核动力学的协同调控。

kc: Quantified the nucleation barriers, critical nucleus sizes, and nucleation rates of hcp and bcc phases in Fe-Ni alloys at 323 GPa using persistent-embryo molecular dynamics.
Demonstrated that the metastable bcc phase consistently exhibits lower nucleation barriers than hcp in Fe-Ni melts, acting as a kinetic gateway.
Formulated a macroscopic nucleation rate model incorporating local Gaussian compositional fluctuations, showing it reduces required supercooling to ~250 K in Fe80Ni20.
利用持久晶胚分子动力学量化了323 GPa下Fe-Ni合金中hcp和bcc相的成核势垒、临界晶核尺寸及成核率。
证明了在Fe-Ni熔体中亚稳态bcc相的成核势垒始终低于hcp相，充当了成核动力学通道。
建立了结合局部高斯成分涨落的宏观成核率模型，表明在Fe80Ni20中所需过冷度可降至约250 K。
me: Molecular dynamics (MD) in LAMMPS using a refined embedded-atom method (EAM) Fe-Ni potential calibrated against ab initio free energies and mixing enthalpies.
Gibbs-Helmholtz integration and regular solution modeling to compute alloy phase diagrams and chemical potential driving forces.
Persistent-embryo method (PEM) with ~53,000 atoms and iso-configurational ensembles to determine critical nucleus sizes, barriers, and steady-state nucleation rates.
Spatial averaging over local compositional fluctuations derived from 2,000,000-atom MD simulations.
基于第一性原理自由能和混合焓校准的改进嵌入原子势（EAM），在LAMMPS中进行分子动力学（MD）模拟。
利用Gibbs-Helmholtz积分和正规溶液模型计算合金相图及化学势成核驱动力。
采用约53,000原子的持久晶胚法（PEM）和等构型系综测定临界晶核尺寸、势垒及稳态成核率。
基于200万原子大尺度MD模拟统计局部成分分布，对局部成分涨落进行空间积分求取宏观成核率。
de: Thermodynamic free-energy and phase diagram calculations for Fe-Ni alloys up to 15–20 at.% Ni at 323 GPa.
PEM nucleation simulations for pure Fe, Fe90Ni10, and Fe80Ni20 liquids across temperatures from 5000 K to 5500 K.
Large-scale MD simulations of 2×10^6 atoms over 5 ns divided into 10×10×10 subdomains to quantify equilibrium Ni concentration fluctuations.
323 GPa下含镍量达15–20 at.%的Fe-Ni合金热力学自由能与相图计算。
5000 K至5500 K温度范围内纯Fe、Fe90Ni10和Fe80Ni20液体的PEM成核模拟。
持续5 ns的2×10^6原子大尺度MD模拟（划分为10×10×10子域），用于量化平衡态Ni浓度涨落。
li: The EAM potential does not reproduce the negative mixing enthalpy anomaly of the bcc phase at ~5 at.% Ni, inflating the bcc stability field and liquidus by ~100 K.
The ~20 at.% Ni concentration needed to reach ~250 K undercooling exceeds the bulk core geochemical estimate of ~5.2 wt.% Ni.
Even at ~250 K, the required supercooling remains higher than the strictest <100 K paleomagnetic and inner-core growth constraints.
所用EAM势未能复现~5 at.% Ni处bcc相的负混合焓异常，导致bcc稳定区扩大且液相线偏高约100 K。
实现~250 K过冷度所需的~20 at.% Ni浓度高于地球化学估计的地核平均Ni含量（~5.2 wt.%）。
~250 K的过冷度仍高于古地磁和内核生长模型给出的最严格约束（<100 K）。

tm.why: The paper investigates the thermodynamic and kinetic mechanisms of Earth's inner-core solidification and deep-Earth thermal-chemical evolution.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete 9-page manuscript PDF including text, equations, and all four figures.

sum: This study investigates fluidized fault gouge injections into host cataclasites within clay-rich fault zones of the Altyn Tagh fault (Tibet) and Carboneras fault (Spain). Both strike-slip systems exhibit similar injection geometries, microstructures, and high fractal dimensions (>3) of clast size distributions, indicating extreme comminution. The authors interpret these injections as products of transient fluid overpressure during coseismic slip, which contributes to dynamic fault weakening. These findings suggest that fluidized gouge injections can serve as reliable geological indicators of past earthquakes and provide critical constraints on rupture dynamics in rheologically complex fault zones where frictional melts (pseudotachylytes) are rarely preserved.
本文研究了阿尔金断裂带（青藏高原北部）和卡沃内拉斯断裂带（西班牙东南部）富黏土断裂带中，流体化断层泥向宿主碎裂岩的侵入现象。这两个走滑断裂系统具有相似的侵入几何形状和微观结构，且碎屑粒径分布的碎形维度超过3，表明存在与同震滑动一致的极端粉碎作用。研究表明，断层泥的流体化和侵入是由同震滑动期间的瞬态流……

Field observations and rock samples from the Altyn Tagh fault (Tibet) and Carboneras fault (Spain).

sum: This Zenodo repository provides slidequake catalog data (cluster_pub.pkl) along with deformation and environmental datasets (inp_data_pub.pkl) collected at the Slumgullion landslide, Colorado, from September 13 to October 8, 2023. These data support the analysis of slidequake activity, landslide deformation dynamics, and their response to environmental forcing. The dataset serves as a valuable resource for studying landslide mechanics, environmental seismology, and the relationship between slip behavior and microseismicity in a highly active clay-rich landslide.

sum: This paper presents a novel 2D seismo-thermo-mechanical model with adaptive time-stepping and invariant rate- and state-dependent friction (STM-RSF). The model bridges the gap between million-year tectonic timescales and millisecond seismic rupture timescales. It simulates sequences of fully dynamic ruptures in a self-consistently evolved subduction zone with visco-elasto-plastic rheology. The authors demonstrate that faults form and evolve spontaneously based on heterogeneous, temperature-dependent material parameters and local stress fields. Key findings show that splay faults in the outer wedge must be sufficiently weak to be dynamically activated during megathrust earthquakes, as velocity-strengthening afterslip otherwise relaxes their stresses. This model successfully links long-term geodynamics with short-term dynamic rupture processes, showing how reflected seismic waves alter slip distributions.
本文提出了一种新型二维地震-热-力学模型（STM-RSF），采用自适应时间步长和率状态摩擦定律，首次实现了百万年尺度长期俯冲构造演化与毫秒级短期动态破裂序列的自洽耦合。模型采用粘-弹-塑性流变学，断层根据温度相关材料参数和局部应力场自发形成与演化。研究表明，外楔分支断层必须足够脆弱才能在巨型逆冲断层……

t: A 2D seismo-thermo-mechanical model (STM-RSF) with adaptive time-stepping and invariant rate- and state-dependent friction.
具有自适应时间步长和率状态摩擦定律的二维地震-热-力学模型（STM-RSF）。
Synthetic numerical simulations of a self-consistently evolved subduction zone over 3.5 million years.
经历350万年演化的自洽俯冲带合成数值模拟。
Splay faults must be weak to activate during megathrust events, and dynamic triggering transfers slip, altering long-term deformation.
分支断层需足够脆弱才能在巨震中激活，动态触发会转移滑动并改变长期变形。
The model is limited to 2D geometry and simplified fluid/pore pressure physics.
模型受限于二维几何结构，且流体与孔隙压物理机制较为简化。
First model to self-consistently simulate fully dynamic rupture sequences within a long-term evolved geodynamic subduction zone.
首次在长期演化的地球动力学俯冲带中自洽模拟完全动态的破裂序列。

kc: Developed the first 2D seismo-thermo-mechanical model (STM-RSF) that self-consistently couples million-year subduction geodynamics with millisecond-scale dynamic earthquake ruptures.
Demonstrated the conditions required for splay fault activation in the outer wedge during megathrust earthquakes.
Showed how dynamic triggering and reflected seismic waves alter slip distribution and long-term deformation.
开发了首个二维地震-热-力学模型（STM-RSF），自洽地耦合了百万年尺度的俯冲带地球动力学与毫秒级的动态地震破裂。
揭示了巨型逆冲断层地震期间激活外楔分支断层（splay fault）所需的物理条件。
展示了动态触发和反射地震波如何改变滑动分布以及长期构造变形。

sum: Smoothness-constrained geophysical inversions often blur sharp structural boundaries like geological faults. This study presents an uncertainty-aware joint inversion workflow for collocated electrical resistivity tomography (ERT) and seismic refraction tomography (SRT) data using a layer-based model parameterization (LBMP) explicitly incorporating a fault discontinuity. A Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) algorithm updates fault nodes, layer depths, resistivities, and P-wave velocities on unstructured meshes with adaptive refinement. Repeating the inversion from randomly initialized fault geometries produces an ensemble of plausible subsurface models with comparable data misfits. Tested on a 3-layer synthetic normal-fault model and field data from the Bazoches fault system in central France, the method constrains shallow fault locations to within a few meters. Incorporating simulated borehole constraints progressively reduces non-uniqueness, though competing normal and reverse fault geometries can still fit data equally well. A subsequent geometry-preserving smooth inversion refines intralayer heterogeneity while maintaining sharp boundaries.
常规平滑约束地球物理反演往往会模糊断层等尖锐边界。本研究提出一种针对共址电阻率层析成像（ERT）和地震折射层析成像（SRT）数据的联合反演工作流，采用显式包含断层不连续面的层状模型参数化（LBMP），结合自适应非结构化网格与粒子群优化（PSO）反演断层几何与物性参数。通过随机初始断层几何的多次反演生……

t: Jointly inverts 2-D ERT and SRT data using a layer-based model parameterization (LBMP) explicitly representing a fault and horizontal layers, optimized globally via Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) with adaptive unstructured meshing.
采用显式表征断层和水平地层的层状参数化（LBMP），结合自适应网格与粒子群优化（PSO）联合反演二维ERT和SRT数据。
Evaluated on synthetic data (96 sensors, 2 m spacing across an 8 m offset normal fault) and field ERT/SRT profiles overlapping across a granite-sediment fault contact in central France.
采用8米落差正断层合成数据（96传感器）及法国中部花岗岩-沉积物断层接触带的实测共址ERT/SRT剖面。

Joint inversion narrows shallow fault location to within a few meters; adding borehole constraints on both sides increases models resolving fault geometry within tolerance from 11% to 23%, while geometry-preserving smooth inversion lowers misfits to ~2%.
浅层断层定位精度达数米；双侧钻孔约束使断层几何达标率从11%升至23%；保几何平滑反演将拟合差降至约2%。
High computational cost (~20 hours per field run on a single CPU core) and persistent non-uniqueness in fault dip direction (normal vs. reverse) without prior geological constraints.
单核计算耗时约20小时，且缺乏地质先验时断层倾向（正/逆断层）仍存在显著多解性。
Explicitly parameterizes fault discontinuities within a global PSO joint inversion of ERT and SRT data to generate uncertainty-aware structural ensembles rather than a single smoothed tomogram.
在ERT与SRT全局PSO联合反演中显式参数化断层不连续面，生成量化结构不确定性的模型集合。

kc: Extended layer-based model parameterization (LBMP) with Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) to explicitly include fault discontinuities and jointly invert collocated 2-D ERT and SRT datasets.

Demonstrated an ensemble-based strategy using randomized initial fault geometries and varying objective function weights to map structural uncertainty and competing fault scenarios (e.g., normal vs. reverse faults).

Proposed a two-step hybrid approach combining LBMP with shallow smoothness-constrained priors and subsequent geometry-preserving smooth inversions to handle intra-layer heterogeneity and non-coincident sensor layouts.
将基于层状模型参数化（LBMP）与粒子群优化（PSO）的框架扩展至显式包含断层不连续面，并实现二维ERT与SRT数据的联合反演。
展示了利用随机初始断层几何和不同目标函数权重生成模型集合的策略，以刻画结构不确定性及竞争性断层情景（如正断层与逆断层）。
提出了一种两步混合策略，将LBMP与浅层平滑约束先验及随后的保几何平滑反演相结合，有效处理层内非均质性和非重合观测系统。
me: Layer-Based Model Parameterization (LBMP) defining a fault via top and bottom horizontal node coordinates and horizontal layer interfaces on both sides.
Forward modeling using pyGIMLi on 2-D unstructured triangular meshes (Triangle library) with adaptive refinement along faults and interfaces, using Dijkstra ray-tracing for SRT.
Global optimization via Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) minimizing a weighted sum of relative SRT traveltime misfit and logarithmic ERT apparent resistivity misfit.
Second-stage smoothness-constrained geometry-preserving deterministic inversion where regularization coupling across LBMP fault and layer boundaries is set to zero.
层状模型参数化（LBMP），通过顶底边界水平节点坐标定义断层，并在断层两侧设置水平地层界面。
基于pyGIMLi和Triangle库生成沿断层和界面自适应加密的二维非结构化三角网格进行正演，SRT采用Dijkstra射线追踪。
利用粒子群优化（PSO）进行全局寻优，最小化SRT走时相对误差与ERT视电阻率对数误差的加权联合目标函数。
第二阶段保几何平滑约束确定性反演，将跨LBMP断层和层界面的正则化耦合权重设为零以保持尖锐界面。
de: Synthetic 2-D profile (96 collocated sensors at 2 m spacing) across a 3-layer model offset by an 8 m normal fault, tested across 3 prior-knowledge scenarios (0, 1, or 2 boreholes) with 100 PSO runs each.

Field collocated ERT (96 electrodes, 5 m spacing, 475 m line) and SRT (120 geophones, 1 m spacing, 240 m line, 2 m shot spacing) across the Bazoches normal fault at Les Fontaines Salées, central France.
Sensitivity analysis of SRT-to-ERT objective function weighting ratios (1:1, 2:1, and 3:1; 20 runs each) on convergence rates and depth-dependent fault position uncertainty.
跨越被8米落差正断层错断的三层模型的二维合成剖面（96个共址传感器，间距2米），在3种钻孔先验信息情景下各进行100次PSO反演。
法国中部Les Fontaines Salées遗址跨越Bazoches正断层的实测共址ERT（96电极，5米间距）与SRT（120检波器，1米间距，2米炮距）数据。
针对SRT与ERT目标函数权重比（1:1、2:1和3:1，各20次运行）对收敛速度及随深度变化的断层位置不确定性的敏感性分析。
li: High computational cost: a single PSO joint inversion run of the field dataset takes approximately 20 hours on a single desktop CPU core.
Simplified geometry assumes a single linear fault line and horizontal homogeneous layers, requiring fixed shallow parameters from smooth inversions when near-surface heterogeneity is strong.
Substantial non-uniqueness persists at depth, where opposite fault dip directions (normal vs. reverse) can yield comparable data misfits without independent geological constraints.
计算成本高昂：实测数据集的单次PSO联合反演在台式机单核CPU上耗时约20小时。
简化几何假设单一线性断层和水平均匀层，当浅表非均质性较强时需固定来自平滑反演的浅部参数。
深部仍存在显著的多解性，若无独立地质约束，相反倾向的断层（正断层与逆断层）可能产生相近的数据拟合差。

tm.why: The paper develops a joint inversion workflow combining electrical resistivity tomography (ERT) and seismic refraction tomography (SRT) using layer-based parameterization and particle swarm optimization.
Seismic refraction tomography (SRT) based on P-wave first-arrival traveltimes is one of the two primary imaging modalities inverted to resolve faulted subsurface velocity structure.
The workflow generates ensembles of plausible models from randomized fault geometries using stochastic global optimization to evaluate structural ambiguity and parameter trade-offs.

ev.notes: Full 41-page preprint PDF (submitted to GJI) was analyzed, including methodology, equations, synthetic scenarios (Table 1, Figs. 3-6), field application at Les Fontaines Salées (Figs. 7-10), and discussion.

sum: This paper introduces a reinforcement learning-based task-aware denoising (RL-TAD) model to address complex multitype noise (ambient, instrument, and optical artifacts) in Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) seismic data. The model utilizes an Asynchronous Advantage Actor-Critic (A3C) agent to dynamically formulate region-aware filtering policies. These policies select optimal filtering actions from an action space composed of multiple lightweight, task-specific denoising networks. By decomposing global denoising into adaptive, region-specific dominant-noise suppression, RL-TAD enhances interpretability and computational efficiency. Applications to synthetic and field DAS datasets demonstrate that the proposed method effectively recovers weak seismic signals, preserves fine details, and easily adapts to novel noise characteristics through simple fine-tuning of its action space.
本文提出一种基于强化学习的任务感知去噪（RL-TAD）模型，用于解决分布式声学传感（DAS）地震数据中复杂的混合多类型噪声问题。该方法利用异步优势累积评论员（A3C）智能体，自适应地制定区域感知滤波策略，从由多个轻量级特定任务去噪网络组成的动作空间中选择最佳滤波动作。通过将全局去噪分解为区域自适应的……

t: An Asynchronous Advantage Actor-Critic (A3C) reinforcement learning agent dynamically selects optimal filtering actions from an action space of lightweight, task-specific denoising networks to suppress region-specific dominant noise.
利用A3C智能体从轻量级去噪网络动作空间中动态选择滤波动作，抑制区域主导噪声。
Synthetic DAS seismic datasets with simulated multitype noise and real-world field DAS seismic data containing complex ambient and instrument noise.
包含模拟多类型噪声的合成DAS数据集，以及含有复杂环境和仪器噪声的野外实际数据。
The RL-TAD model successfully suppressed complex multitype noise, accurately recovered weak seismic signal details, and demonstrated high adaptability to new noise types via fine-tuning.
成功抑制了复杂混合噪声，准确恢复了微弱信号细节，并通过微调展现出对新噪声的高适应性。
The denoising performance is bounded by the pre-defined action space of task-specific networks and requires offline training of the RL agent.
去噪性能受限于预定义动作空间，且需离线训练智能体。
Formulating DAS denoising as a reinforcement learning task where an agent adaptively selects region-specific, interpretable filtering actions from a flexible action space.
将DAS去噪建模为强化学习，自适应选择区域特异的滤波动作。

kc: Proposed a novel reinforcement learning-based task-aware denoising (RL-TAD) framework for DAS data.
Introduced an A3C agent to dynamically select region-specific filtering actions, improving interpretability and efficiency.
Demonstrated superior performance in suppressing heterogeneous multitype noise while preserving weak seismic signal details.
提出了一种针对DAS数据的基于强化学习的任务感知去噪（RL-TAD）新框架。
引入了A3C智能体来动态选择区域特异性滤波动作，提高了可解释性和计算效率。

me: Asynchronous Advantage Actor-Critic (A3C) reinforcement learning agent.

sum: The 24 June 2026 Venezuela earthquake doublet (Mw 7.2 and Mw 7.5, 32 s apart) ruptured a complex transform fault system along the South American–Caribbean plate boundary. Using time-adaptive potency density tensor inversion (PDTI) across seven 1-D velocity models and hybrid back-projection (HBP) of 47 teleseismic P-wave records, alongside Rayleigh-wave Mach-cone analysis, the authors simultaneously resolve slip evolution and fault geometry without prescribing fixed fault planes. Results show predominantly eastward rupture over ~220 km with total moment Mw 7.7 and multiple stages of supershear propagation (5–6 km/s). Three apparent rupture stalls at ~50, 100, and 150 km east of the epicenter coincide with fault bends and intersections along the Boconó, San Sebastián, and Tacagua faults. Notably, a high-slip-rate subevent occurred ~37 s after origin, 90 km behind the leading front, after which eastward supershear rupture initiated or resumed, potentially causing repeated strong shaking.
本研究结合时间自适应地震矩密度张量反演（PDTI）、混合反投影（HBP）及面波马赫锥分析，利用47个远震P波台站数据和7个一维速度模型，联合反演了2026年6月24日委内瑞拉Mw 7.2与7.5走滑双震的破裂过程与断层几何。结果表明破裂主要向东传播约220 km（总矩震级Mw 7.7），多阶段达5–……

t: Time-adaptive potency density tensor inversion (PDTI) of teleseismic P waves across seven 1-D velocity models, complemented by multi-band hybrid back-projection (HBP) and Rayleigh-wave Mach-cone analysis.
利用7个一维速度模型对远震P波进行时间自适应PDTI反演，结合双频段HBP和面波马赫锥分析。
Vertical-component teleseismic P-wave records from 47 stations (30°–90° epicentral distance) over an 80 s source duration on a 246 km × 24 km nonplanar model fault surface.
47个台站（震中距30°–90°）80秒窗口的远震P波垂直分量记录，投影于246×24 km曲面断层。
Total moment was 3.8–4.1×10^20 N m (Mw 7.7) with max slip 2.9–4.0 m over ~220 km east, supershear speeds of 5–6 km/s, three stalls (50, 100, 150 km), and a 37 s subevent 90 km behind the front.
总地震矩3.8–4.1×10^20 N m（Mw 7.7），向东超剪切破裂约220 km（5–6 km/s），伴3次停滞…
Neither PDTI nor HBP clearly resolves continuous westward migration, leaving ambiguity between back-propagating rupture and an independent rupture episode at 37 s.
PDTI和HBP均未清晰解析出连续向西迁移，无法唯一区分反向传播破裂与独立子事件。
First source model of the 2026 Venezuela doublet revealing compound multi-stage supershear rupture, geometry-controlled rupture stalls, and potential repeated supershear traversal.
首次揭示2026年委内瑞拉双震受断层几何控制的复合多阶段超剪切破裂及重复强震动潜力。

Identified multiple episodes of eastward supershear rupture (5–6 km/s) over ~220 km, corroborated by hybrid back-projection and Rayleigh-wave Mach-cone analysis.
Demonstrated that three apparent rupture stalls at 50, 100, and 150 km east of the epicenter correspond to fault bends and segment intersections.
Discovered a high-slip-rate subevent at 37 s located 90 km behind the leading rupture front, followed by renewed eastward supershear propagation.

结合混合反投影和瑞利波马赫锥分析，识别出长达约220 km的多阶段向东超剪切破裂（5–6 km/s）。
证实震中以东50、100和150 km处的三次明显破裂停滞与断层弯曲及断层段交汇相对应。

Sensitivity testing using seven 1-D velocity models (six from CRUST1.0 and ak135-F), planar vs. nonplanar model surfaces, and varying model-space front velocities.
Hybrid back-projection (HBP) in high-frequency (0.3–1.0 Hz) and low-frequency (0.1–0.3 Hz) bands using cross-correlations with Green's functions.
Far-field Rayleigh-wave Mach-cone waveform similarity analysis (10–25 s period) using a nearby 2009 Mw 6.4 earthquake as an empirical Green's function.

Broadband vertical-component Rayleigh-wave displacement records (10–25 s) from the 2026 doublet and the 2009-09-12 Mw 6.4 EGF event.

2026年双震与2009年9月12日Mw 6.4经验格林函数事件的宽频带垂直分量瑞利波位移记录（10–25 s）。
USGS ComCat和FUNVISIS的余震目录，以及GEM数据库中的活动断层迹线数据。

Offshore fault geometry in the northern half of the source region is poorly constrained by InSAR, and the offshore connection between the Tacagua and San Sebastián faults remains uncertain.

sum: This paper introduces FaultNet, a deep-learning framework designed to reconstruct complex three-dimensional fault structures from earthquake hypocenter distributions. FaultNet employs two PointNet++-based models: a denoising model that filters out background seismicity from fault-related earthquakes, and a feature learning model that maps earthquakes into an embedding space where events on the same fault have similar representations. These embeddings are clustered using agglomerative clustering, and the resulting clusters are reconstructed into continuous 3D fault surfaces using radial basis function (RBF) interpolation. The framework provides an automated, objective workflow to map complex fault networks from seismicity catalogs, overcoming manual interpretation biases.
本文介绍了FaultNet，这是一个旨在从地震震源分布中重建复杂三维断层结构的深度学习框架。FaultNet采用两个基于PointNet++的模型：一个去噪模型，用于从与断层相关的地震中过滤背景地震活动；以及一个特征学习模型，将地震映射到嵌入空间中，使同一断层上的事件具有相似的表征。这些嵌入通过凝聚……

sum: This study investigates how fluid pre-conditioning (FP) modifies the shear reactivation and rupture nucleation of a critically stressed saw-cut Rotondo granite fault confined at 20 MPa. Performing six triaxial reactivation experiments (three with FP, three without), the authors combine fiber-optic distributed strain sensing (DSS) with a 16-transducer piezoelectric array for active ultrasonic P-wave velocity surveying and passive acoustic emission (AE) detection. Ultrasonic mapping reveals preferential fluid pathways along the fault, causing asymmetric deformation. Results show that FP enables pore pressure to redistribute before rapid pressurization, creating a relatively drained state with smoother effective normal stress gradients and coherent aseismic preslip (Model A). Conversely, non-pre-conditioned tests exhibit a locally undrained response, preserving strong stress gradients and strength heterogeneities that trigger foreshocks and complex nucleation (Model B). The joint DSS-ultrasonic approach provides novel spatiotemporal constraints on hydro-mechanical rupture nucleation.
本研究探讨了流体预处理（FP）对20 MPa围压下临界应力花岗岩锯切断层剪切再激活及破裂成核的影响。作者进行了六次三轴实验，创新性地结合光纤分布式应变传感（DSS）与16个压电换能器阵列，同步监测应变、声发射（AE）及反映流体迁移的超声波P波速度变化。超声测量揭示了断层面上存在优势流体通道。结果表明……

t: Combined fiber-optic distributed strain sensing (40 Hz, 2.6 mm resolution) and a 16-PZT ultrasonic/AE array during triaxial fluid-injection reactivation tests on a saw-cut granite fault.
在花岗岩锯切断层三轴注水再激活实验中，结合光纤分布式应变传感与16通道超声/声发射阵列。
Six fluid reactivation tests on a saw-cut Rotondo granite cylinder (144.5 mm height, 74.6 mm diameter, 35° fault angle) confined at 20 MPa and loaded to 80% shear strength.
20 MPa围压和80%抗剪强度下，对Rotondo花岗岩锯切圆柱样（35°倾角）进行的六次流体再激活实验。

Ultrasonic surveys detected up to +10% P-wave velocity increases along preferential left-side fluid pathways, matching asymmetric premonitory DSS strain acceleration in FP tests and foreshock occurrence in non-FP tests.
超声探测到沿优势流体通道P波速度增加达+10%，与FP测试的非对称预滑应变及无FP测试的前震一致。
Sample fault dimensions are too small to observe full rupture dynamics, and quantitative mapping from DSS strain to shear stress requires dedicated numerical modeling.
样品尺寸过小限制了完整破裂动力学观测，且从应变到剪切应力的定量映射需专门的数值模拟。

首次联合应用断层平行光纤应变传感与16换能器超声阵列，同步成像变形时空演化与流体迁移通道。

kc: Demonstrated that fluid pre-conditioning (FP) shifts fault reactivation toward a relatively drained regime with smoother effective-stress profiles and coherent aseismic preslip.
Showed that rapid injection without FP maintains locally undrained conditions with sharp effective-stress gradients, promoting foreshocks and complex cascade-like nucleation.
Identified preferential fluid migration pathways along the fault plane via ultrasonic P-wave velocity variations (+10% dV/V) and linked them to asymmetric fault-parallel strain localization.
证明流体预处理（FP）使断层再激活向相对排水状态转变，具有更平滑的有效应力分布和连贯的无震预滑移。
表明无FP的快速注水维持局部不排水条件和陡峭的有效应力梯度，促进前震发生和复杂的级联式成核。
通过超声波P波速度变化（最大+10%）识别出断层面上的优势流体迁移通道，并将其与非对称断层平行应变局部化联系起来。

Distributed strain sensing (DSS) using polyimide-coated optical fibers mounted on footwall and hanging wall at 40 Hz sampling and 2.6 mm spatial resolution.
Active ultrasonic travel-time surveying and passive acoustic emission (AE) monitoring using 16 conical piezoelectric transducers (PZTs) sampled at 20 MHz.
在20 MPa围压下对处于临界应力状态（80%抗剪强度）的Rotondo花岗岩锯切断层进行三轴剪切再激活实验。
利用粘贴于上下盘的聚酰亚胺涂覆光纤进行分布式应变传感（DSS），采样率40 Hz，空间分辨率2.6 mm。
使用16个圆锥形压电换能器（PZT，20 MHz采样）进行主动超声波走时测量和被动声发射（AE）监测。

sum: This paper investigates the historical consequences of two small-to-moderate earthquakes in the Fennoscandian Shield: the 23 June 1882 (Mw ~4.2) and 23 October 1904 (Ms 5.4) events. By analyzing contemporary newspaper accounts and official administrative archives in Sweden and Finland, the authors document widespread minor damage, particularly to unreinforced masonry chimneys and tiled stoves up to 300–400 km from the epicenters. The shaking posed significant fire hazards, damaged vulnerable structures like medieval churches and a quay wall, and caused panic-related injuries. The study highlights that even moderate intraplate earthquakes can result in substantial cumulative economic losses and secondary hazards like post-earthquake fires, emphasizing the value of archival research in refining historical seismic risk assessments.
本文研究了芬诺斯堪底亚盾地两次中小地震（1882年Mw ~4.2和1904年Ms 5.4）的历史影响。作者通过检索瑞典和芬兰的当代报纸及国家档案馆资料，发现未加固的砖石烟囱和瓷砖炉灶在距离震中达300-400公里处仍受到影响，构成了火灾隐患。此外，地震还损坏了在建码头挡土墙和中世纪教堂，并因恐慌和次……

Historical newspaper reports, national archives, administrative correspondence, and accident investigation reports for the 1882 (Mw ~4.2) and 1904 (Ms 5.4) earthquakes.
1882年（Mw ~4.2）和1904年（Ms 5.4）地震的历史报纸、国家档案、行政信函及事故报告。
Unreinforced masonry chimneys and stoves were damaged up to 300-400 km away, causing fire hazards, while medieval churches and a quay wall suffered structural damage.
未加固砖石烟囱和炉灶在300-400公里外受损并引发火灾隐患，中世纪教堂和码头受损。
Relies on qualitative historical records and archives, which may contain gaps, biases, or lack precise physical measurements of ground shaking.
依赖定性的历史记录和档案，可能存在缺失、偏差，且缺乏精确的地面运动物理测量。
First detailed exploration of the hitherto unknown societal and structural consequences of these two historical Fennoscandian Shield earthquakes using archival records.
首次利用档案记录详细探讨了芬诺斯堪底亚盾地这两次历史地震此前未知的社会和结构影响。

Analysis of official administrative correspondence, accident investigation reports, and insurance records from the National Archives of Sweden and Finland.

sum: This paper addresses the long-standing discrepancy between low geodynamic lithosphere-asthenosphere effective friction (0.01–0.03) and high laboratory rock friction (0.6–0.85). The author proposes the 'Interface Selection Principle,' where the system selects the minimum friction interface as the sliding plane, rendering macroscopic friction a thickness-dependent emergent property. A core creep friction relation is derived, showing that distributed creep shear dominates friction reduction (80–90%), while trace-melt weakening accounts for the remaining 10–20%. This dual framework suggests asthenospheric friction is lower than previously thought (0.0067), whereas trench megathrust friction is underestimated due to the absence of creep layers. This work redefines Byerlee's law as a melt-free baseline within a thickness-controlled model.
本文解决了地球动力学反演中岩石圈-软流圈超低等效摩擦（0.01-0.03）与实验室拜尔里定律（0.6-0.85）之间的长期矛盾。作者提出了“界面选择原理”，认为系统选择最小摩擦界面作为滑动面，使宏观摩擦成为依赖于厚度的涌现特征。推导出了核心蠕变摩擦关系式，表明分布式蠕变剪切主导了80-90%的摩擦降……

t: Derivation of a core creep friction relation and a secondary trace-melt weakening formula based on melt-film contact replacement.
基于熔体膜接触替代，推导了核心蠕变摩擦关系式和辅助微量熔体弱化公式。
Standard mantle geodynamic parameters and laboratory rock friction values (Byerlee's law) used for model calibration and validation.
使用标准地幔地球动力学参数和实验室岩石摩擦值（拜尔里定律）进行模型校准。
Distributed creep shear dominates friction reduction (80-90%), yielding effective friction of ~0.0067 at 366 m thickness, while trace-melt weakening accounts for 10-20%.
分布式蠕变剪切主导了80-90%的摩擦降低（在366米厚度下等效摩擦约为0.0067）。
The analytical formulations are simplified and assume idealized shear zones, neglecting complex 3D structural and rheological heterogeneities.
解析公式较为简化，假设了理想化的剪切带，忽略了复杂的三维结构非均匀性。
Proposes the Interface Selection Principle, transforming friction from a fixed material constant into a thickness-dependent emergent variable.
提出界面选择原理，将摩擦从固定的材料常数转变为依赖于厚度的涌现变量。

kc: Introduced the Interface Selection Principle, defining macroscopic friction as a thickness-dependent emergent property rather than a material constant.
Derived a novel analytical creep-friction relation showing that effective friction scales inversely with creep zone thickness.
Formulated a dual-weakening framework combining distributed creep shear (80-90% reduction) and trace-melt weakening (10-20% reduction).
引入了界面选择原理，将宏观摩擦定义为依赖于厚度的涌现属性，而非固定的材料常数。
推导了新型解析蠕变摩擦关系式，表明等效摩擦与蠕变带厚度成反比。
构建了结合分布式蠕变剪切（减弱80-90%）和微量熔体弱化（减弱10-20%）的双重弱化框架。
me: Theoretical derivation of the core creep friction relation incorporating temperature, grain size, and velocity.
Analytical formulation of trace-melt weakening via melt-film contact replacement.
结合温度、粒径和速度，对核心蠕变摩擦关系进行理论推导。
通过熔体膜接触替代，对微量熔体弱化进行解析公式化。

使用标准地幔地球动力学参数和实验室岩石摩擦值（拜尔里定律）来验证理论模型。

sum: This Zenodo repository provides the simulated data and analyzed swarm sequences associated with the study 'Frictional Heterogeneities can induce Earthquake Swarms with Diffusive Migration Patterns'. The dataset includes numerical simulation outputs of earthquake swarms generated under heterogeneous frictional conditions, alongside an Excel spreadsheet detailing the analyzed swarm sequences. These data support the finding that spatial variations in fault friction can naturally produce diffusive migration patterns in earthquake swarms without requiring external fluid diffusion.

模拟的地震群目录及所分析地震群序列的Excel表格。

The dataset is entirely synthetic and based on idealized numerical friction models.

Provides open-access simulated data showing fluid-free diffusive migration in earthquake swarms.
提供了开放获取的模拟数据，展示了无流体参与的地震群扩散迁移。

Includes a curated Excel sheet of analyzed swarm sequences for reproducibility and further analysis.
提供了在非均匀摩擦条件下模拟地震群的完整数据集。

在具有非均匀性质的速率-状态摩擦力学框架下，对地震破裂和地震群生成进行数值模拟。

模拟的地震目录数据以及所分析地震群序列的Excel电子表格。

sum: This study presents a high-resolution catalog of induced seismicity at the Lacq gas field and wastewater disposal site (southwestern France) from 2021 to 2026. Using a dense temporary and semi-permanent network of 24 new stations (including GFZ short-period sensors and low-cost RaspberryShakes) alongside permanent stations and industrial picks, the authors independently apply an automated deep-learning workflow (PhaseNet + PyOcto) and a manual envelope-stacking and picking workflow, locating events in a local 3-D velocity model via NonLinLoc. Merging both approaches yields 1,619 located events (Mc ~ 0.45, b ~ 1.06), with 767 having hypocentral uncertainties <0.5 km. Nearly 80% of well-constrained events occur within 1 km below the deep reservoir (~3.2–6 km depth), and ~19% occur inside it. Methodological comparisons reveal that 3-D vs. 1-D velocity model errors (0.6 ± 0.5 km depth bias) dominate over picking-method differences (0.1 ± 0.2 km), providing key lessons for reservoir monitoring.
本研究构建了法国西南部Lacq气田及废水回注区2021至2026年的高分辨率诱发地震目录。研究结合永久台站、GFZ短周期台阵、低成本RaspberryShake及工业台站数据，独立采用深度学习自动流程（PhaseNet+PyOcto）与人工包络叠加拾取流程，并利用NonLinLoc在局部三维速度模型……

t: The authors independently apply an automated deep-learning workflow (PhaseNet with 0.5 threshold and PyOcto association) and a manual envelope-stacking/picking workflow, relocating merged phase picks with NonLinLoc in a local 3-D velocity model.
独立应用深度学习自动流程（PhaseNet+PyOcto）与人工包络叠加拾取流程，结合三维速度模型与NonLinLoc重…

Five years (2021–2026) of continuous recordings from 24 temporary/semi-permanent stations (10 GFZ short-period sensors, 12 RaspberryShakes, 2 local stations), permanent Epos-France stations, and picks from 6 TOTAL stations.
2021–2026年24个新布设临时/半永久台站、法国永久台网连续波形及6个TOTAL工业台站震相数据。
The final catalog contains 1,619 located events (Mc = 0.45, b = 1.06), including 767 with uncertainties <0.5 km, of which 79% occur below the reservoir (67% within 1 km) and 19% inside.
最终目录含1619个事件（Mc=0.45，b=1.06），767个误差<0.5 km事件中79%位于储层下方、19%位于…
Velocity model uncertainties (0.6 ± 0.5 km between 1-D and 3-D models) exceed formal NonLinLoc uncertainties, and the 3-D model lacks independent 3-D S-wave velocity variations.
一维与三维速度模型深度偏差（0.6±0.5 km）超出NLL形式误差，且缺乏独立的三维S波速度模型。

Provides the first high-resolution 5-year seismicity catalog for Lacq using a dense local network and dual manual/AI workflows capable of resolving event depths relative to the 0.4-km-thick reservoir.
首次利用密集局部台网与人工/AI双流程构建Lacq高分辨率五年地震目录，实现储层尺度（0.4 km）深度分辨。

kc: Released the most comprehensive 5-year (2021–2026) high-resolution seismic catalog and phase bulletin (1,619 events, Mc ~ 0.45) for the Lacq induced seismicity cluster.
Demonstrated that most well-located seismicity (uncertainties < 0.5 km) occurs within (19%) or less than 1 km below (67%) the 0.4-km-thick deep carbonate reservoir.
Quantified that epistemic uncertainties from 1-D vs. 3-D velocity models (0.6 ± 0.5 km in depth) dominate over automatic vs. manual phase-picking differences (0.1 ± 0.2 km).
Established practical network design guidelines showing that 15–20 local stations (20–30 phases) and high AI probability thresholds (0.5) are needed to resolve reservoir-scale depths.
发布了Lacq诱发地震区最全面的5年（2021–2026）高分辨率地震目录和震相数据（1619个事件，完备震级0.45）。
证实大多数高精度定位地震（误差<0.5 km）发生在厚0.4 km的深部碳酸盐岩储层内部（19%）或其下方1 km以内（67%）。
量化证实了一维与三维速度模型带来的深度系统偏差（0.6±0.5 km）远大于自动与人工震相拾取差异（0.1±0.2 km）。
提出了实用的台网设计指南，表明需要15–20个局部台站（20–30个震相）及较高的AI概率阈值（0.5）才能分辨储层尺度的震源深度。
me: Automated phase picking using PhaseNet (with a strict probability threshold of 0.5 to minimize outliers) and phase association using PyOcto within SeisBench.
Manual workflow combining 3-D grid envelope back-projection/stacking (modified Gharti et al. 2010 with 120-s spectral whitening) and manual P/S picking (>20,000 picks).
Probabilistic earthquake relocation using NonLinLoc in a local 3-D P-wave velocity model (with Vp/Vs = 1.9 and iterative station delay corrections).
Homogeneous local and moment magnitude (ML, Mw) and Peak Ground Velocity (PGV) estimation following French national SiHex and BCSF-RéNaSS protocols.
在SeisBench框架下使用PhaseNet（采用0.5的高概率阈值以减少异常值）进行自动震相拾取，并利用PyOcto进行震相关联。
结合三维网格包络反投影叠加（改进Gharti et al. 2010方法，加入120秒谱白化）与人工P/S波拾取（超20000个震相）的人工处理流程。
利用NonLinLoc在局部三维P波速度模型（Vp/Vs=1.9，并迭代校正台站走时残差）中进行概率地震重定位。
遵循法国国家SiHex和BCSF-RéNaSS规范计算均一化的地方震级（ML）、矩震级（Mw）及峰值地面速度（PGV）。
de: Continuous waveform recordings from 2021 to February 2026 across 24 newly deployed temporary/semi-permanent stations (10 GFZ L4C velocimeters, 12 RaspberryShakes, 1 broadband, 1 accelerometer) plus permanent Epos-France stations.
Integration of manual P and S arrival-time picks from 6 industrial stations operated by TOTAL for 169 events during 2022–2023.
Systematic relocation experiments comparing 3-D vs. 1-D velocity models and automatic (0.3 vs. 0.5 threshold) vs. manual vs. fused phase catalogs.
2021年至2026年2月期间24个新布设临时/半永久台站（10个GFZ短周期地震计、12个RaspberryShake、1个宽频带、1个加速度计）及法国永久台网的连续波形记录。
整合了TOTAL公司在2022–2023年间运营的6个工业台站对169个事件的人工P波和S波走时拾取数据。
对比三维与一维速度模型、以及自动（0.3与0.5阈值）、人工与融合震相目录的系统重定位实验。

Formal NonLinLoc uncertainties underestimate true depth errors because epistemic uncertainties from the 3-D velocity model are not propagated.
Low-cost RaspberryShake stations suffer from recording gaps, unverified internet-based timing reliability, and unoriented horizontal components.
三维速度模型仅包含P波三维变化并假设固定Vp/Vs=1.9，缺乏独立的三维S波速度约束。
NonLinLoc的形式不确定度低估了真实深度误差，因为未能传递来自三维速度模型的认知不确定度。
低成本RaspberryShake台站存在数据缺失、基于互联网的授时可靠性未量化以及水平分量方位未校准等问题。

tm.why: The paper builds and analyzes a five-year high-resolution earthquake catalog for induced seismicity at the Lacq gas field and wastewater injection site.
The core objective is constructing a 2021–2026 earthquake catalog using manual envelope-stacking/picking and automatic deep-learning detection and NonLinLoc 3-D relocation.
The authors implement and systematically benchmark an automated PhaseNet and PyOcto deep-learning workflow against manual analyst picks.

sum: Exhumed subduction complexes are volumetrically dominated by thick mélange zones, leading to debates on whether interseismic pressure solution creep or localized seismic faulting accommodates most plate convergence. This study applies anisotropy of magnetic susceptibility (AMS), electron probe microanalysis (EPMA), and bulk rock geochemical mass-balance calculations to the Lakes of the Gods (LOTG) shear zone, an exhumed mid-seismogenic paleomegathrust (~250–280 °C) in the Olympic Subduction Complex, Cascadia. Results show that while total volume loss via pressure solution is highest in the mélange (~17%), the resulting strain rates (~2.7 × 10^-15 s^-1) are three orders of magnitude slower than required by plate motion (~10^-12 s^-1). Flow laws and lack of interconnected phyllosilicates confirm that viscous creep and distributed sliding accommodate only ~0.1% of plate displacement. This reconciles geological observations with geodetic locking models, demonstrating that plate convergence in the seismogenic zone is predominantly accommodated on discrete faults.
针对俯冲带震源区混杂岩非地震蠕变与离散断层地震滑移的应变分配争议，本研究对卡斯卡迪亚奥林匹克俯冲杂岩中出露的古俯冲大断层（LOTG剪切带）开展了磁化率各向异性（AMS）、电子探针（EPMA）及全岩地球化学质量平衡分析。结果显示，尽管混杂岩的压溶体积损失最高（~17%），但其对应的应变率（~2.7×1……

t: Combined field fabric analysis, anisotropy of magnetic susceptibility (AMS), EPMA microscale elemental mapping, bulk rock chemistry mass-balance calculations, and pressure solution constitutive flow laws along a transect across the paleomegathrust.
沿横穿古大断层的剖面，结合野外组构、磁化率各向异性、电子探针面扫描、全岩化学质量平衡与流变律计算。

Samples from three structural domains (coherent wall rock, ~450 m wide mélange zone, and 10 major anastomosing brittle fault strands) of the Lakes of the Gods shear zone in the Olympic Subduction Complex, Cascadia.
采自卡斯卡迪亚奥林匹克俯冲杂岩LOTG剪切带完整围岩、450米宽混杂岩及10条交织脆性断层的岩石样品。

Total pressure solution volume loss is ~17% in mélange, ~11% in faults, and ~2% in coherent rocks, yielding strain rates (~10^-15 s^-1) three orders of magnitude slower than required for plate convergence (~10^-12 s^-1).
混杂岩、断层和围岩的总压溶体积损失分别为17%、11%和2%，对应应变率比板块汇聚速率低三个数量级。
AMS and chemical methods do not record localized brittle slip on discrete surfaces, and strain rate estimates depend on simplifying assumptions of shear zone thickness and subduction duration.
AMS和化学方法无法记录离散面上的脆性滑移，且应变率估算依赖于剪切带宽度与俯冲历时假设。

First quantitative demonstration using coupled chemical and magnetic fabrics in Cascadia that volumetrically dominant mélange accommodates only ~0.1% of plate motion, reconciling field geology with geodetic locking models.
首次通过磁组构与地球化学定量证明占体积主导的混杂岩仅调节约0.1%的板块运动，弥合了地质与大地测量观测矛盾。

kc: Quantified spatial and structural strain partitioning across coherent wall rock, mélange, and discrete fault strands in an exhumed Cascadia paleomegathrust.
Demonstrated via Ti-conserved chemical mass balance that total pressure solution volume loss is ~17% in mélange, ~11% in fault rocks, and ~2% in coherent rocks.
Showed that pressure solution strain rates (~10^-15 s^-1) are three orders of magnitude lower than plate convergence strain rates (~10^-12 s^-1), accounting for only ~0.1% of total plate motion.
Provided geological validation for geodetic locking model assumptions that off-fault permanent deformation is negligible during the seismic cycle in the seismogenic zone.
量化了卡斯卡迪亚出露古俯冲大断层中完整围岩、混杂岩和离散断层带之间的空间与构造应变分配。
通过基于Ti守恒的化学质量平衡计算，证明混杂岩的总压溶体积损失约为17%，断层岩约为11%，完整围岩约为2%。
表明压溶应变率（~10^-15 s^-1）比板块汇聚应变率（~10^-12 s^-1）低三个数量级，仅占总板块运动的约0.1%。
为大地测量闭锁模型中“震源区地震周期内断层外永久变形可忽略不计”的假设提供了地质学证据。
me: Anisotropy of magnetic susceptibility (AMS) to quantify 3D mineral alignment, ellipsoid shapes (Flinn diagram), and corrected anisotropy degree (Pj).
Electron probe microanalysis (EPMA) elemental mapping (Si, Ti, Fe) and quantitative spot analysis combined with bulk rock geochemistry for mass-balance volume strain calculations.
Rheological modeling using the Fisher & Hirth (2024) pressure solution flow law and Fagereng & den Hartog (2017) phyllosilicate frictional sliding criteria.
利用磁化率各向异性（AMS）量化三维矿物定向、椭球体形态（Flinn图解）和校正各向异性度（Pj）。
结合电子探针（EPMA）元素面扫描（Si、Ti、Fe）、定量点分析及全岩地球化学进行质量平衡体积应变计算。

de: Rock samples collected along a fault-strike perpendicular transect across the ~450 m wide Lakes of the Gods (LOTG) shear zone in the Olympic Subduction Complex, Washington, USA.
Field structural measurements of bedding, tectonic foliations, and phacoid long-axis lineations compared against AMS principal axes.
SEM backscattered electron (BSE) microstructural imaging and EPMA chemical maps across coherent, mélange, and cataclastic fault rock domains.
沿垂直断层走向剖面采集的美国华盛顿州奥林匹克俯冲杂岩中约450米宽的诸神之湖（LOTG）剪切带岩石样品。
层理、构造面理及透镜体长轴线理的野外构造测量数据，并与AMS主轴方向进行对比。
完整围岩、混杂岩和碎裂断层岩结构域的扫描电镜背散射电子（SEM BSE）显微结构成像及EPMA化学元素分布图。

Strain rate calculations rely on simplifying assumptions of a constant 2 m.y. subduction transit time and assumed active shear zone widths (250–1000 m).
AMS和化学质量平衡方法无法捕捉离散断层面上的局部脆性滑移，因此只能间接推断同震滑移的主导地位。

tm.why: The paper quantifies strain partitioning between distributed interseismic viscous creep (pressure solution in mélange) and localized coseismic brittle slip along an exhumed subduction megathrust.
It investigates the structural architecture, rheology, and deformation mechanisms of an exhumed paleomegathrust in the Cascadia accretionary complex.

sum: This study investigates the mantle transition zone (MTZ) structure beneath Sumatra using receiver functions accounting for non-planar wavefronts, analyzing 34,255 records from 197 stations. The results show widespread MTZ thickening with significant along-strike heterogeneity. In central Sumatra, a depressed 660-km discontinuity in the middle segment contrasts with an uplifted 410-km discontinuity in adjacent segments, indicating a laterally discontinuous slab. This, along with a gap in slab-related velocity anomalies and localized MTZ thinning, suggests a slab window beneath central Sumatra. The authors propose this window represents a fossil slab breakoff event initiated during the late Early to Middle Miocene (~20–15 Ma). Geodynamic numerical modeling demonstrates that along-trench slab age variations can trigger such non-collisional breakoff, explaining the mantle material exchange between the Indian Ocean and the South China Sea.
本研究利用考虑非平面波前的接收函数方法，分析了197个台站的34,255条地震记录，成像了苏门答腊下方的地幔过渡带（MTZ）结构。结果显示MTZ普遍增厚且具有显著的走向异质性。在苏门答腊中部，中段660千米不连续面下沉，而相邻段410千米不连续面抬升，表明存在横向不连续的板片。结合板片速度异常缺失和……

t: Receiver function stacking accounting for non-planar wavefronts to image the 410-km, 520-km, and 660-km mantle transition zone discontinuities beneath Sumatra.
利用考虑非平面波前的接收函数叠加技术，成像苏门答腊下方410、520和660千米地幔过渡带不连续面。
Seismic dataset consisting of 34,255 receiver function records from 197 stations across Sumatra, combined with geodynamic numerical modeling.
包含苏门答腊197个台站的34,255条接收函数记录的地震数据集，以及地球动力学数值模拟。
Discovery of a slab window beneath central Sumatra, characterized by a depressed d660 in the middle segment and uplifted d410 in adjacent segments, indicating a discontinuous slab.
发现苏门答腊中部下方的板片窗口，表现为中段d660下沉而相邻段d410抬升，指示板片不连续。
Potential resolution limits from station distribution and simplified assumptions in the geodynamic numerical models.
台站分布带来的潜在分辨率限制以及地球动力学数值模型中的简化假设。
First seismic evidence of a fossil non-collisional slab breakoff beneath Sumatra, explaining Indian-Pacific mantle exchange via along-trench slab age variations.
首次提供苏门答腊下方化石非碰撞板片断裂的地震学证据，解释了沿海沟年龄变化导致的印太地幔交换。

kc: Imaged the mantle transition zone (MTZ) structure beneath Sumatra using receiver functions with non-planar wavefront corrections.
Discovered a slab window beneath central Sumatra characterized by contrasting 410-km and 660-km discontinuity behaviors and weak 520-km phases.
Linked the slab window to a fossil non-collisional slab breakoff event during the Miocene (~20–15 Ma).
Used geodynamic numerical modeling to show that along-trench slab age variations can trigger non-collisional slab breakoff, facilitating Indian-Pacific mantle exchange.
利用考虑非平面波前修正的接收函数方法，成像了苏门答腊下方的地幔过渡带（MTZ）结构。
发现了苏门答腊中部下方的板片窗口，其特征为410和660千米不连续面的显著对比行为以及微弱的520千米相位。
将该板片窗口与中新世（约20-15 Ma）期间的化石非碰撞板片断裂事件联系起来。
结合地球动力学数值模拟，表明沿海沟的板片年龄变化可触发非碰撞板片断裂，从而促进印-太地幔物质交换。
me: Receiver function stacking accounting for non-planar wavefronts.
Discontinuity imaging of the 410-km, 520-km, and 660-km upper mantle discontinuities.
Geodynamic numerical modeling of subduction and slab breakoff.
考虑非平面波前的接收函数叠加技术。
410千米、520千米和660千米上地幔不连续面的成像。
俯冲和板片断裂的地球动力学数值模拟。

2D/3D geodynamic numerical simulations of subduction with along-trench age variations.

Numerical models simplify complex 3D mantle flow and rheological parameters.
接收函数的解析度受台站分布和噪声限制，可能平滑了细微尺度的板片结构。
数值模型简化了复杂的三维地幔流和流变学参数。

The paper investigates the slab window structure and geodynamics of the subducting slab beneath Sumatra.
