sum: Lunar pits expose mare volcanic stratigraphy and provide potential access to subsurface lava tubes. This paper reviews the formation, stability, and orbital detection of lunar pits and lava tubes, and evaluates in situ geophysical and remote-sensing methods to characterize them. Using 2D FDTD electromagnetic simulations (GPRMax), potential-field forward modeling, terrestrial analogue joint inversions from Lanzarote, and laboratory FTIR spectroscopy of lunar mineral mixtures, the authors quantify instrument requirements for void detection and wall characterization. They present LunarLeaper, a ~30 kg legged robot mission concept targeting the Marius Hills Pit during a single lunar day. Equipped with a leveling-free 3D gravimeter (GRASS), a ~100 MHz GPR (RIMFAX heritage), an RGB camera, and a MEMS Fabry-Perot infrared spectrometer, LunarLeaper can traverse steep pit funnels (up to 30°) to map subsurface cave geometry, pit-wall basalt layering, and local regolith geomechanics without requiring complex cave entry.
月球坑洞暴露了月海火山地层并可能连通地下熔岩管。本文综述了月球坑洞与熔岩管的形成、稳定性及轨道探测现状，评估了原位地球物理与遥感探测方法的可行性。结合二维FDTD探地雷达模拟、引力正演、兰萨罗特岛地球类比联合反演及矿物红外光谱实验，量化了探测指标。在此基础上提出了靶向马里乌斯山坑的约30 kg四足机……

t: Evaluates surface gravity forward modeling, 2D FDTD GPR wavefield simulations (GPRMax) with Kirchhoff migration, and FTIR spectral mixing to design a payload for a legged robot traversing a lunar pit rim.
结合表面重力正演、100 MHz探地雷达二维FDTD模拟与偏移及FTIR光谱混合，设计四足机器人月球坑缘探测载荷。

Combines LRO orbital DEMs/imagery of Marius Hills Pit, terrestrial analogue gravity/magnetic/LiDAR data from Lanzarote, 2D synthetic GPR traces, and vacuum FTIR laboratory spectra of granular mineral mixtures (63–125 µm).
融合LRO马里乌斯山坑DEM与影像、兰萨罗特岛地球类比重磁与激光雷达数据、GPR合成记录及真空矿物红外光谱。

A 50–500 m wide tube at 50 m depth produces a 0.4–1 mGal gravity anomaly; 100 MHz GPR clearly images the cave roof at 30 m and floor with a polarity flip; increasing olivine shifts the Christiansen feature from 8 to 8.1 µm.
50 m深、50–500 m宽熔岩管产生0.4–1 mGal重力异常；100 MHz雷达清晰成像30 m深洞顶及反相洞底…

Gravity interpretations are non-unique without radar constraints, while constant-velocity GPR migration in basalt underestimates vacuum cave thickness by a factor of 3 (locating the 60 m floor at 40 m).
单一重力反演存在多解性；玄武岩恒速雷达偏移会将真空洞穴厚度低估为1/3（60 m洞底误定位于40 m）。

Introduces LunarLeaper, a ~30 kg legged robot concept integrating a leveling-free 3D gravimeter, 100 MHz GPR, camera, and MEMS spectrometer to perform the first in situ reconnaissance of a lunar mare pit.
提出约30 kg四足机器人概念LunarLeaper，集成免调平重力仪、雷达、相机和MEMS光谱仪开展月海坑洞原位侦察。

kc: Comprehensive review of lunar mare pits, lava tube formation mechanisms, mechanical stability, and open science questions in lunar volcanism and regolith evolution.
Quantitative feasibility assessment of surface gravity (~0.4–1 mGal anomalies) and 100 MHz GPR (FDTD simulations) for detecting and sizing buried lunar lava tubes.
Laboratory FTIR emissivity measurements of lunar mineral mixtures demonstrating that a compact MEMS Fabry-Perot LWIR spectrometer can resolve olivine layering and ISRU materials on pit walls.
Presentation of the LunarLeaper mission architecture, concept of operations, and payload suite for a 1-lunar-day legged reconnaissance of the Marius Hills Pit.
全面综述了月海坑洞、熔岩管形成机制、力学稳定性以及月球火山演化和月壤研究中的关键科学问题。
定量评估了表面重力（约0.4–1 mGal异常）和100 MHz探地雷达（FDTD数值模拟）探测和约束地下月球熔岩管尺度的可行性。
开展了月球矿物混合物实验室FTIR发射率测量，证明紧凑型MEMS法布里-珀罗长波红外光谱仪可分辨坑壁橄榄石分带及原位资源利用（ISRU）矿物。
提出了针对马里乌斯山坑开展为期一个昼夜原位侦察的四足机器人LunarLeaper任务架构、运行概念及科学载荷配置。
me: Potential-field forward modeling of gravity anomalies across subsurface cylindrical/tabular voids and Hamiltonian Monte Carlo 2D joint gravity-magnetic inversion on a terrestrial analogue.
2D Finite-Difference Time-Domain (FDTD) electromagnetic wavefield simulation (GPRMax) at 100 MHz with Kirchhoff migration to evaluate GPR cave detection and antenna height effects.
Vacuum laboratory bidirectional reflectance and emissivity spectroscopy (0.4–20 µm) with linear spectral mixing for augite, anorthite, forsterite, ilmenite, and albite.

Evaluation of alternative geophysical methods including active seismic reflection, passive ambient noise H/V spectral ratio inversion, Rayleigh wave dispersion from thermal moonquakes, and magnetometry.
地下空腔重力异常势场正演模拟，以及基于哈密顿蒙特卡洛方法的地球类比剖面重磁二维联合反演。
利用GPRMax开展100 MHz二维时域有限差分（FDTD）电磁波场数值模拟与基尔霍夫偏移，评估探地雷达对洞穴的探测能力及天线高度影响。
真空环境下0.4–20 µm波段实验室双向反射率与发射率光谱测量，并对普通辉石、钙长石、镁橄榄石、钛铁矿和钠长石开展线性光谱混合模拟。
评估主动源地震反射、被动源热月震背景噪声H/V谱比反演、瑞利波频散反演及磁法勘探等替代地球物理方案。
de: Orbital imagery and DEMs from LRO NAC/WAC and KAGUYA/Selene covering global lunar pits and the Marius Hills Pit and rille.
Field gravity, magnetic, seismic, and LiDAR laser-scanner datasets from the Cueva de Los Naturalistas lava tube in Lanzarote, Spain.
2D synthetic GPR radargrams generated with GPRMax using Clementine-derived TiO2 (4.9%) and FeO (21.4%) loss-tangent properties for Marius Hills.
Granular mineral spectra (63–125 µm) measured under vacuum with a Bruker Vertex 90V FTIR spectrometer at the DLR Planetary Emissivity Laboratory.
覆盖全球月球坑洞及马里乌斯山坑与月溪的LRO NAC/WAC和KAGUYA/Selene轨道影像与数字高程模型（DEM）。
西班牙兰萨罗特岛Cueva de Los Naturalistas熔岩管的野外重力、磁法、地震及三维激光扫描数据集。
基于Clementine反演的马里乌斯山TiO2（4.9%）和FeO（21.4%）损耗角正切属性生成的GPRMax二维合成探地雷达剖面。
在德国宇航中心（DLR）行星发射率实验室真空条件下使用Bruker Vertex 90V FTIR光谱仪测量的63–125 µm颗粒矿物光谱。
li: Gravity modeling alone suffers from mathematical non-uniqueness regarding exact depth and geometry, and requires DEM elevation accuracy better than 0.25 m to keep free-air errors below 0.05 mGal.
2D GPR simulations omit 3D geometrical spreading (overestimating signal amplitude), and constant-velocity migration in basalt compresses the apparent cave height by a factor of 3.

Active seismic imaging is hindered by strong lunar regolith scattering, while passive seismic H/V and dispersion methods require poorly constrained thermal moonquake rates and longer mission durations.
The baseline LunarLeaper mission is limited to one lunar day (~14 Earth days) and explores only the pit rim and funnel rather than entering the cave interior.
单一重力建模在精确深度和几何形态上存在多解性，且需优于0.25 m的高程精度才能将自由空气校正误差控制在0.05 mGal以内。
二维GPR模拟忽略了三维几何扩散（高估了信号振幅），且采用玄武岩恒速偏移会导致真空洞穴底界反射深度被压缩为实际高度的1/3。
主动源地震成像受制于月壤强散射，而被动源H/V和面波频散方法受限于尚不明确的热月震发生率及单月昼任务时长。
LunarLeaper基线任务时长仅为一个月昼（约14个地球日），仅在坑缘和漏斗斜坡开展侦察而不直接进入熔岩管内部。

tm.why: The paper reviews lunar lava tubes and presents the LunarLeaper robotic mission concept using geophysical (gravity, GPR, and discussed seismic/magnetic) and remote-sensing surveys to investigate lunar volcanic pits.

The paper details compact planetary geophysical payloads including the GRASS rotating-cantilever gravimeter, a 100 MHz RIMFAX-derived GPR, and a MEMS Fabry-Perot spectrometer mounted on a legged robot.

ev.notes: Full 49-page PDF analyzed, including text, equations, 12 figures, 1 appendix table, and references.

sum: Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) generates massive datasets that benefit from deep learning processing, yet a lack of standardization hinders model interoperability and practitioner adoption. This paper introduces SeisBench DAS, an extension to the SeisBench Python library tailored for machine learning on DAS data. Building on PyTorch and the xdas framework, SeisBench DAS defines a standard benchmark dataset format (using Apache Parquet for metadata and HDF5 for 2D records and 1D channel annotations), unified model APIs, and flexible training pipelines. Crucially, its processing engine supports larger-than-memory datasets via virtual arrays, asynchronous chunking, GPU-accelerated F-K filtering, and memory-efficient callbacks, plus a wrapper to apply classical 3-component seismic models (e.g., PhaseNet, EQTransformer) to DAS data. Performance evaluations on a 3.1 GB record (36,718 channels) show annotation throughputs from 0.8 to 74 MB/s, highlighting the value of GPU acceleration and efficient model design.
针对分布式声学传感（DAS）海量数据深度学习处理缺乏标准化的问题，本文推出了SeisBench DAS开源框架。该框架结合xdas与PyTorch，定义了基于Parquet和HDF5的DAS基准数据集格式、统一模型接口及训练流水线。其核心创新在于专为超内存数据设计的处理引擎，支持虚拟数组按块异步读取……

t: SeisBench DAS extends SeisBench by integrating xdas virtual arrays with PyTorch, processing larger-than-memory DAS datasets in overlapping chunks with asynchronous prefetching, GPU-accelerated F-K filtering, memory-evicting callbacks, and a wrapper for classical 3-component models.
结合xdas虚拟数组与PyTorch，通过异步分块预取、GPU F-K滤波、内存释放回调及三分量模型封装实现超内存处理。

Introduces a Parquet/HDF5 benchmark format exemplified by the MLSubDAS dataset, and evaluates annotation throughput on a 3.1 GB continuous DAS record (36,718 channels, 225 s duration, 100 Hz sampling rate).
定义了Parquet/HDF5基准格式并集成MLSubDAS数据集，使用3.1 GB（36,718通道，225秒，100…
Annotation throughputs range between 0.8 MB/s and 74 MB/s across CPU and GPU setups; GPU accelerates DeepSubDAS by ~13x (up to 27 MB/s) and wrapped classical models by ~2x.
标注吞吐量在0.8至74 MB/s之间；GPU使DeepSubDAS提速约13倍（达27 MB/s），传统封装模型提速约…
The initial collection of DAS models and datasets is limited, the index-based data format lacks general-purpose coordinate awareness, and 2D DAS-native models remain computationally heavy.
初始集成的模型和数据集较少，索引格式缺乏通用坐标感知，且二维DAS原生模型计算开销较大。
First unified open-source framework standardizing DAS machine learning datasets, training pipelines, and larger-than-memory model inference across diverse interrogator formats via xdas and PyTorch.
首个统一DAS深度学习数据集、训练流水线及跨解调仪格式超内存推理的开源标准化框架。

kc: Introduces SeisBench DAS, an open-source extension to SeisBench providing unified APIs for DAS deep learning models, benchmark datasets, and training pipelines.
Defines a standardized DAS benchmark dataset format using Parquet for metadata and HDF5 for 2D waveform records and 1D channel-specific annotations, with optional dataset chunking.
Develops a larger-than-memory annotation engine integrating xdas virtual arrays, asynchronous data prefetching, GPU-accelerated F-K filtering, and memory-controlling callbacks.
Provides a wrapper to seamlessly apply over 80 pretrained classical 3-component sequence-to-sequence models (e.g., PhaseNet, EQTransformer) to single-channel DAS records.
推出SeisBench DAS开源扩展框架，为DAS深度学习模型、基准数据集和训练流水线提供统一API。
定义了标准化的DAS基准数据集格式，使用Parquet存储元数据，HDF5存储二维波形记录和一维通道标注，并支持数据集分块。
开发了超内存标注引擎，集成xdas虚拟数组、异步数据预取、GPU加速F-K滤波以及控制内存占用的回调机制。
提供模型封装器，可将SeisBench中80多个预训练的传统三分量地震模型（如PhaseNet、EQTransformer）无缝应用于单通道DAS数据。
me: Integration of xdas virtual arrays and HDF5 memory mapping to enable larger-than-memory data ingestion across diverse interrogator formats.
Asynchronous chunked processing pipeline with overlap weighting, on-the-fly zero-phase FIR resampling, stateful causal IIR filtering, and batched PyTorch GPU F-K filtering.
Callback architecture (in-memory collection, disk writer, and phase picking) that evicts processed chunk annotations from RAM to maintain near-constant memory usage.
Training generation pipelines in seisbench.generate operating on virtual arrays for random window selection and probabilistic phase labelling, moving normalization into the model forward pass.
集成xdas虚拟数组与HDF5内存映射，支持跨多种解调仪格式的超内存数据读取。
采用带重叠平滑插值的异步分块处理流水线，支持即时零相位FIR重采样、跨块状态保持的因果IIR滤波及PyTorch批处理GPU F-K滤波。
引入回调架构（内存收集、磁盘写入和震相拾取），在处理后立即从内存释放块标注，保持总内存占用近似恒定。
在seisbench.generate中构建基于虚拟数组的训练生成流水线，支持随机窗口选择和概率标签生成，并将数据归一化移至模型前向传播中。
de: Integration and demonstration of the MLSubDAS submarine DAS benchmark dataset and the DAS-native DeepSubDAS phase picking model.
Annotation throughput benchmark on a 3.1 GB continuous DAS record (36,718 channels, 225 s duration, 100 Hz sampling rate, 32-bit float).

Comparative performance evaluation across three models (DeepSubDAS, wrapped PhaseNet, wrapped EQTransformer), two overlap settings (10% and 50%), CPU (16-core Intel Xeon) vs. GPU (Nvidia A40), and local SSD vs. RAM preloading.
集成了MLSubDAS海底DAS基准数据集与DAS原生震相拾取模型DeepSubDAS并展示了应用与训练工作流。
在3.1 GB连续DAS记录（36,718个通道，时长225秒，采样率100 Hz，32位浮点数）上进行了标注吞吐量基准测试。
对比评估了三种模型（DeepSubDAS、封装的PhaseNet和EQTransformer）、两种重叠率（10%和50%）、CPU（16核Intel Xeon）与GPU（Nvidia A40）以及本地SSD与内存预加载的性能差异。
li: The initial collection of DAS-native models and benchmark datasets integrated into SeisBench DAS is not yet comprehensive and covers only specific use cases.
The benchmark dataset format uses an index-based view without full coordinate awareness and is tailored specifically for machine learning rather than general-purpose DAS archiving.
The DAS-native model (DeepSubDAS) has high computational cost, achieving only 0.75 s to 2.0 s of annotated data per second of GPU compute time on a 36,718-channel cable.
目前集成的DAS原生模型和基准数据集尚不够全面，仅涵盖特定应用场景。
所提出的基准数据集格式采用基于索引的视图，缺乏完整的坐标感知能力，仅针对机器学习设计而非通用DAS数据归档标准。
DAS原生模型（DeepSubDAS）计算开销大，在36,718通道光缆数据上单GPU每秒仅能处理0.75至2.0秒的数据。

tm.why: The paper presents a dedicated software framework and benchmark data format specifically for Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) datasets and models.
It extends the SeisBench library to standardize deep learning models, training pipelines, and benchmark datasets for seismic phase picking and processing on DAS data.
The primary demonstrated use cases and benchmark evaluations focus on deep learning-based seismic phase picking (DeepSubDAS, PhaseNet, EQTransformer) on continuous DAS records.

ev.notes: Full 17-page PDF software report analyzed, including architecture diagrams, code listings (Listings 1 and 2), and benchmark performance evaluations.

sum: This study integrates detailed morphostructural mapping with twenty high-resolution electrical resistivity tomography (ERT) profiles to characterize the 3D geometry and kinematic evolution of the Serrote fault system in the central Paraná Basin, Brazil. The surface structural data document repeated brittle reactivation under dextral transtension. ERT imaging resolves vertically persistent low-resistivity corridors that widen and bifurcate at depth, delineating negative flower structures and a wide shear corridor. This contrasts with previous interpretations of a simple normal-fault-bounded graben. The results demonstrate that deformation is accommodated across a distributed network of interconnected strands and rotated blocks, highlighting the role of Precambrian basement anisotropies in focusing strain and controlling fault linkage.
本研究结合地貌制图与20条高分辨率ERT剖面，表征了巴西Serrote断裂系统的三维几何。地表数据记录了右旋张扭重激活。ERT成像解析出深部变宽分叉的低电阻率带，描绘出负花状结构，否定了此前简单地堑的解释。结果表明，变形由分布式网络分担，强调了前寒武纪基底各向异性对应变集中和断裂连接的主导作用。

t: Integration of detailed morphostructural mapping with twenty high-resolution 2D electrical resistivity tomography (ERT) profiles to characterize fault-zone geometry.
结合地貌制图与20条高分辨率二维电阻率断层成像（ERT）剖面表征断裂带几何。
Surface structural measurements (fault orientations, veins, breccias) and twenty high-resolution 2D ERT profiles across the Serrote fault system, Brazil.
巴西Serrote断裂系统的地表结构测量数据与20条高分辨率2D ERT剖面。
ERT resolved vertically persistent low-resistivity corridors forming negative flower structures, revealing a multi-stranded shear corridor instead of a simple graben.
ERT解析出构成负花状结构的低电阻率通道，揭示了多分支剪切带而非简单地堑。
Depth penetration and resolution of ERT are limited, preventing direct imaging of the deep crustal roots of the shear zone.
ERT的探测深度和分辨率有限，无法直接成像剪切带的深部地壳根部。
First 3D characterization of the Serrote fault system using integrated ERT and morphostructural mapping, revealing a complex multi-stranded transtensional architecture.
首次结合ERT和地貌制图三维表征该断裂系统，揭示了复杂的分布式张扭剪切架构。

kc: Demonstrated that the Serrote fault system is a wide, multi-stranded transtensional shear zone rather than a simple normal-fault-bounded graben.
Successfully imaged vertically persistent, low-resistivity corridors and negative flower structures at depth using high-resolution ERT.
Highlighted the first-order control of Precambrian basement anisotropies on strain focusing, fault linkage, and hydraulic compartmentalization.
证明了Serrote断裂系统是一个宽阔的多分支张扭剪切带，而非此前认为的简单正断层控制的地堑。
利用高分辨率ERT成功成像了深部垂直延伸的低电阻率通道和负花状结构。
突出了前寒武纪基底各向异性对应变集中、断裂连接和水文分块的主导控制作用。
me: Detailed morphostructural and surface structural mapping to identify fault trends, shear types, and kinematic indicators.
Acquisition and inversion of twenty high-resolution electrical resistivity tomography (ERT) profiles to image subsurface resistivity structures.
详细的地貌和地表结构制图，以识别断层走向、剪切类型和运动学指示标志。
采集并反演了20条高分辨率电阻率断层成像（ERT）剖面，以对地下电阻率结构进行成像。
de: Surface structural data including fault orientations, calcite-filled veins, breccias, and shale smear.
Twenty high-resolution 2D electrical resistivity tomography (ERT) profiles crossing the Serrote fault system in southeastern Brazil.

ERT的分辨率随深度增加而降低，可能会模糊较深区域的微细断层分支。

sum: This study investigates the provenance evolution of the Red River drainage system to constrain the kinematics of the Ailao Shan-Red River Fault Zone (ARRFZ). By integrating petrographic thin-section analysis, heavy mineral assemblages, and zircon U-Pb geochronology, the authors characterize three potential source areas (Simao, ARRFZ, and Sichuan-Yunnan blocks). Reconstructing the source-to-sink system from the southeastern Tibetan Plateau to the Yinggehai Basin reveals a major provenance shift at 10.5 Ma, where detrital contributions from the Sichuan-Yunnan Block increased significantly. This shift marks the eastward propagation of tectono-geomorphic uplift and constrains the ARRFZ's left-to-right strike-slip inversion to no later than 10.5 Ma.
本研究通过红河水系物源演化探讨哀牢山-红河断裂带（ARRFZ）的运动学特征。结合岩相薄片、重矿物组合及锆石U-Pb年代学，对比了思茅地块、断裂带和川滇地块三大源区。重建源-汇系统表明，10.5 Ma前红河泥沙主要源自思茅地块，此后川滇地块贡献显著增加。这一物源转变记录了构造地貌抬升的向东扩展，并将断……

t: Integration of petrographic thin-section analysis, heavy mineral assemblage characterization, and detrital zircon U-Pb geochronology to fingerprint potential sediment source areas.
结合岩相薄片分析、重矿物组合特征及碎屑锆石U-Pb年代学进行源区示踪。
Provenance datasets compiled from Vietnam, Hainan Island, and the Yinggehai Basin, alongside new petrographic and geochronological data from the Simao, ARRFZ, and Sichuan-Yunnan blocks.
整合越南、海南岛、莺歌海盆地及川滇、思茅、断裂带等区域的物源数据集。
A marked increase in detrital contribution from the Sichuan-Yunnan Block at 10.5 Ma constrains the ARRFZ strike-slip reversal to no later than 10.5 Ma.
10.5 Ma时川滇地块物源贡献显著增加，限制断裂带反转不晚于10.5 Ma。
Potential ambiguity in distinguishing tectonic uplift signals from climate-driven drainage reorganization or river capture events.
构造抬升信号与气候驱动的河流袭夺或水系重组信号可能存在多解性。
Provides a precise temporal constraint (10.5 Ma) on the ARRFZ strike-slip inversion by reconstructing a comprehensive source-to-sink system.
通过重建完整的源-汇系统，为哀牢山-红河断裂带走滑反转提供了精确的时间约束。

kc: Characterized the petrological, mineralogical, and geochronological fingerprints of three potential source areas in the southeastern Tibetan Plateau.
Reconstructed the Cenozoic source-to-sink system linking the southeastern Tibetan Plateau to the Yinggehai Basin.
Constrained the timing of the Ailao Shan-Red River Fault Zone strike-slip reversal (left-lateral to right-lateral) to no later than 10.5 Ma.
系统刻画了青藏高原东南缘三大潜在源区的岩石学、矿物学和年代学特征。
重建了连接青藏高原东南缘与莺歌海盆地的晚新生代源-汇系统。
将哀牢山-红河断裂带走滑性质反转（左旋至右旋）的时间限制在不晚于10.5 Ma。
me: Petrographic thin-section analysis of sandstones.
Heavy mineral assemblage characterization (including ZTR index).
Detrital zircon U-Pb geochronology.
砂岩岩相薄片分析。
重矿物组合特征分析（包括ZTR指数）。
碎屑锆石U-Pb年代学。

收集并新获取了思茅地块、哀牢山-红河断裂带、川滇地块、越南、海南岛及莺歌海盆地的物源数据集（锆石年龄谱、重矿物）。

sum: Microseismic monitoring of highway slopes for rockfall early warning faces severe environmental noise and extreme class imbalance. This paper proposes the Denoising Attention Loss Network (DALNet) for robust microseismic event classification. DALNet integrates three core innovations: (1) a CNN-Transformer autoencoder guided by a joint time-frequency domain reconstruction loss to suppress noise while preserving spectral fidelity; (2) a cascaded channel-temporal hybrid attention module to extract discriminative multi-scale features; and (3) a Momentum Adaptive Weighted Class Balance Loss (MAWCBL) that dynamically adjusts weights using prior class distributions, instance hardness, and exponential moving average feedback of F1 and G-mean scores. Validated on a 1,900-sample field dataset from quarry slope rockfall and rock fracture experiments across SNRs of -5 to -1 dB and imbalance ratios up to 1:100, DALNet achieves up to 97.88% accuracy and 91.44% macro-accuracy at -5 dB, significantly outperforming CNN, GRU, Transformer, and ResNet18 baselines.
针对公路边坡微震监测中强噪声干扰和样本极度不平衡的问题，本文提出了去噪注意力损失网络（DALNet）。该方法构建了基于CNN-Transformer和联合时频重构损失的去噪模块，结合级联通道-时间混合注意力机制提取多尺度特征，并提出动量自适应加权类平衡损失（MAWCBL）动态调整类别权重。基于采石场……

t: DALNet integrates a CNN-Transformer autoencoder with joint time-frequency MSE loss for denoising, multi-scale convolutions with cascaded channel-temporal hybrid attention for feature extraction, and Momentum Adaptive Weighted Class Balance Loss for imbalanced classification.
集成CNN-Transformer联合时频损失去噪、多尺度卷积与通道-时间混合注意力及动量自适应类平衡损失。

1,900 labeled 2048-point microseismic waveforms across four classes (large rolling stone, gravel group, dangerous rock, no microseismic) collected from quarry highway slope rockfall and static rock fracture experiments using 28 Hz sensors.
利用28 Hz传感器在采石场边坡落石和静态岩石破裂实验中采集的4类共1900个2048点微震波形样本。

DALNet achieves up to 97.88% overall accuracy at -1 dB SNR and maintains 92.82% accuracy, 91.44% macro-average accuracy, and 74.01% Macro-F1 under extreme noise (-5 dB) and severe class imbalance (20:20:1:100).
在-1 dB下最高准确率达97.88%，在-5 dB及极端不平衡下仍保持92.82%准确率和91.44%宏平均准确率。
High equipment deployment costs and difficulty in annotating field data restricted validation to a single geological site rather than diverse slope environments.
监测设备部署成本高且数据标注困难，目前仅在单一地质场地验证了算法可行性。

Jointly optimizes a dual-domain time-frequency reconstruction loss, a cascaded channel-temporal attention mechanism, and an online EMA-guided momentum-adaptive class-balanced loss in a single end-to-end network.
在端到端网络中协同优化双域时频重构损失、级联通道-时间注意力与基于EMA动态反馈的类平衡损失。

kc: Designed a CNN-Transformer autoencoder with a joint time-frequency domain MSE reconstruction loss for adaptive microseismic signal denoising.
Developed a cascaded Channel-Temporal Attention (CTA) module to simultaneously filter redundant frequency channels and capture long-range temporal dependencies.
Formulated a Momentum Adaptive Weighted Class Balance Loss (MAWCBL) combining class priors, focal instance hardness, and EMA-based online F1/G-mean feedback.
Validated the framework on field rockfall simulation and static expansive rock fracture datasets under extreme noise (-5 dB) and severe class imbalance (20:20:1:100).
设计了结合联合时频域均方误差重构损失的CNN-Transformer自编码器，实现自适应微震信号去噪。
开发了级联通道-时间混合注意力（CTA）模块，同时过滤冗余频率通道并捕捉长程时间依赖。
提出了结合类别先验、样本难度和基于指数移动平均的在线F1/G-mean反馈的动量自适应加权类平衡损失（MAWCBL）。
在极端噪声（-5 dB）和严重类别不平衡（20:20:1:100）条件下，利用现场落石模拟和静态膨胀岩石破裂数据集验证了模型有效性。
me: 1D CNN encoder-decoder with a multi-head self-attention Transformer bottleneck trained with joint time-domain and FFT amplitude MSE loss.
Multi-scale 1D convolution (kernels 15, 7, 3) followed by cascaded channel squeeze-and-excitation and temporal self-attention with feedforward layers.
Momentum Adaptive Weighted Class Balance Loss (MAWCBL) dynamically updating class weights via an exponential moving average of batch confusion matrices.
采用一维CNN编码器-解码器与多头自注意力Transformer瓶颈结构，使用时间域与FFT幅值联合均方误差损失进行训练。
利用多尺度一维卷积（卷积核15、7、3）提取特征，并接入级联通道挤压激励与时间自注意力前馈网络。
采用动量自适应加权类平衡损失（MAWCBL），通过批次混淆矩阵的指数移动平均动态更新类别权重。
de: Field data acquired at a quarry highway slope using a KJ1640 monitoring system (YZD12-C monitor, 28 Hz single-component sensors, 141 V/m/s sensitivity).
Two field experimental phases: rockfall simulation (releasing rock blocks from slope top) and rock fracture monitoring (static expansive cracking over ~5 hours).

1,900 labeled waveforms (2048 points each, 7:3 train/test split) across four classes: large rolling stone, gravel group, dangerous rock, and no microseismic, tested under injected Gaussian noise (-5, -3, -1 dB SNR).
使用KJ1640监测系统（YZD12-C监测仪，28 Hz单分量传感器，灵敏度141 V/m/s）在采石场公路边坡采集现场数据。
开展两阶段现场实验：落石模拟实验（从坡顶释放岩块）和岩石破裂监测实验（约5小时的静态膨胀致裂监测）。
包含4类共1900个标注波形样本（每段2048点，7:3划分训练/测试集）：大滚石、碎石群、危岩和无微震，在注入高斯白噪声（-5、-3、-1 dB）下进行测试。

Extreme difficulty in acquiring and accurately annotating high-quality microseismic data, limiting validation to a single specific geological site.
复杂真实公路边坡环境下微震监测设备的部署成本较高。
获取和准确标注高质量微震数据极其困难，目前仅在单一特定地质条件下进行了算法验证。

tm.why: The paper proposes a deep learning architecture (DALNet) combining CNNs, Transformers, hybrid attention, and adaptive class-balanced loss for microseismic signal denoising and classification.
The study focuses on environmental/engineering seismology, specifically microseismic monitoring of highway slopes for rockfall and rock fracture hazard early warning.
The primary task is the automated detection and four-class classification of microseismic events under low SNR and high class imbalance.

sum: Current distributed fiber-optic vibration sensors face a trade-off between spatial resolution, temporal bandwidth, and interrogator cost. This study introduces a dual-modality fiber sensing architecture combining multimode fiber (MMF) speckle dynamic analysis with single-mode fiber (SMF) state-of-polarization (SoP) interrogation. Both fibers are co-routed through four piezoelectric actuators along a 4-m path. Operating under a single-active-source assumption, a 4000 FPS CMOS camera tracks MMF speckle pattern shifts via a linearized Jacobian pseudo-inverse to localize active perturbations among pre-calibrated zones (down to 3 cm spacing) with near 100% accuracy across 1000 events. Simultaneously, a high-speed polarimeter samples SMF Stokes vectors at 200 kHz to reconstruct broadband vibration waveforms from 100 Hz to 40 kHz with a 35 dB SNR. The novelty lies in decoupling spatial discrimination and broadband temporal reconstruction across complementary optical observables, bypassing single-modality hardware constraints.
现有分布式光纤传感面临空间分辨率、带宽与成本的权衡。本文提出一种结合多模光纤（MMF）散斑动态分析与单模光纤（SMF）偏振态（SoP）解调的双模态传感架构。在4米光纤路径的4个压电致动器实验中，假设单一活动震源，利用4000帧/秒相机记录散斑并通过雅可比伪逆实现近100%精度的位置识别（间距小至3厘……

t: A two-stage sensor fusion framework linearizes multimode speckle intensity and single-mode Stokes vector perturbations via empirical Jacobian matrices, using Moore-Penrose pseudo-inversion and spectrogram power to localize events and reconstruct broadband waveforms.
通过经验雅可比矩阵线性化多模散斑强度和单模斯托克斯矢量微扰，利用伪逆和谱图功率实现事件定位与宽频波形重构。

Co-located 4-m multimode (532 nm, 4000 FPS CMOS camera) and single-mode (1550 nm, 200 kHz polarimeter) fibers excited by four piezoelectric actuators (spaced 3 cm to 1.2 m) with chirps (100 Hz–40 kHz) and 1000 music excerpts.
共路径4米多模（4000帧/秒相机）和单模（200 kHz偏振计）光纤，经4个压电致动器施加100 Hz–40 kHz扫…

The system reconstructs vibration waveforms linearly from 100 Hz to 40 kHz with 35 dB SNR via polarization interrogation, while speckle imaging localizes perturbations across four zones (down to 3 cm apart) with 97–100% accuracy.
偏振臂在100 Hz至40 kHz内实现线性波形重构（信噪比35 dB），散斑臂在4个标定区（最小间距3厘米）实现97%…
Restricted to a single active vibration source at a time, lacks absolute amplitude calibration, only localizes within pre-calibrated discrete zones, and suffers from environmental speckle drift.
受限于单一活动震源假设，无法获取绝对振幅，仅支持预标定离散点定位，且易受环境散斑漂移影响。

First dual-modality fiber sensor integrating camera-based multimode speckle localization with high-speed single-mode polarimetric interrogation to decouple spatial discrimination from temporal bandwidth constraints.
首创结合多模散斑定位与单模高速偏振解调的双模态光纤传感架构，将空间分辨与时间带宽解耦。

kc: Proposed a dual-modality fiber-optic vibration sensor combining multimode speckle imaging for spatial localization and single-mode polarization interrogation for broadband waveform recovery.
Formulated a unified first-order linear perturbation framework using Moore-Penrose pseudo-inverses of empirically calibrated Jacobian sensitivity matrices for both speckle and Stokes vectors.
Demonstrated high-fidelity waveform reconstruction across 100 Hz to 40 kHz with 35 dB SNR alongside near-100% localization accuracy across 1000 test events in four pre-calibrated zones.
提出结合多模散斑空间定位与单模偏振宽频波形恢复的双模态光纤振动传感架构。
建立了统一的一阶线性微扰数学框架，利用经验标定的雅可比灵敏度矩阵伪逆反演散斑和斯托克斯矢量变化。
实验验证了100 Hz至40 kHz范围内35 dB信噪比的波形重构，并在1000次测试事件中实现近100%的四区域定位准确率。
me: Small-signal linear perturbation expansion of the multimode transmission matrix and single-mode Stokes vector on the Poincaré sphere.
Empirical two-step finite-difference calibration using 500 Hz sinusoidal excitations to construct Jacobian sensitivity matrices for speckle macropixels and Stokes parameters.
Deformation reconstruction via Moore-Penrose pseudo-inversion and active zone localization by maximizing integrated short-time Fourier transform (STFT) spectrogram power.
多模传输矩阵与单模庞加莱球斯托克斯矢量的小信号一阶线性微扰展开。
利用500 Hz正弦激励进行两步有限差分经验标定，构建散斑宏像素和斯托克斯参数的雅可比灵敏度矩阵。
通过Moore-Penrose伪逆重构形变信号，并利用短时傅里叶变换（STFT）谱图积分功率最大化定位活动区域。
de: Laboratory setup with co-routed 4-m step-index MMF (532 nm laser, CMOS camera at 4000 FPS, 64x64 ROI) and 4-m SMF (1550 nm laser, polarimeter up to 100 MHz, operated at 200 kHz).
Frequency response testing using a 20-s linear frequency chirp from 100 Hz to 40 kHz applied via piezoelectric membrane speakers.
Localization accuracy benchmark using 1000 one-second perturbation events from six music clips across four actuators separated by 3 cm to 1.2 m.
实验室4米并行多模光纤（532 nm激光，4000 FPS相机，64x64像素区域）与单模光纤（1550 nm激光，200 kHz采样偏振计）测试平台。
利用压电薄膜扬声器施加20秒、100 Hz至40 kHz线性扫频信号进行频率响应表征。
在间距3厘米至1.2米的4个致动器上，利用6段音乐剪辑生成的1000个1秒扰动事件测试定位准确率。
li: Operates strictly under a single-active-source assumption because the SoP arm aggregates all perturbations along the fiber into a single global measurement.
Provides localization only within predefined, pre-calibrated discrete zones rather than continuous distributed sensing along the entire fiber.
Does not recover calibrated absolute vibration magnitudes and is susceptible to environmental thermal or mechanical drift affecting the reference speckle pattern.
严格依赖单一活动震源假设，因为偏振通道将整条光纤的扰动聚合为单一全局测量，无法分离同时发生的多重事件。
仅能在预先标定的离散区域内进行定位，无法实现沿光纤全长的连续分布式传感。
无法恢复标定的绝对振动幅值，且散斑基准图案易受环境温度或机械漂移影响，需定期重新标定。

tm.why: The paper develops a novel dual-modality optical fiber vibration sensing architecture combining multimode speckle dynamics and single-mode state-of-polarization interrogation as a low-complexity alternative to conventional distributed acoustic sensing (DAS).
The study focuses on hardware design, calibration, and experimental validation of a new fiber-optic vibration sensor instrument.

sum: This paper investigates the critical role of three-dimensional fault geometry in controlling earthquake nucleation and dynamic rupture propagation. Using advanced numerical simulations of dynamic ruptures on complex 3D fault surfaces, the authors demonstrate how geometric variations, such as bends, steps, and roughness, influence stress accumulation, nucleation location, and rupture velocity. The findings provide key insights into the physical mechanisms governing earthquake behavior and have important implications for seismic hazard assessment and the predictability of large earthquakes.
本文研究了三维断层几何结构在控制地震成核和动力学破裂传播中的关键作用。作者通过对复杂三维断层表面动力学破裂的数值模拟，展示了断层弯曲、阶区和粗糙度等几何变化如何影响应力积累、成核位置及破裂传播速度。研究结果揭示了控制地震行为的物理机制，对地震灾害评估和强震预测具有重要意义。

t: 3D dynamic rupture modeling on geometrically complex fault surfaces to simulate earthquake nucleation and propagation.
在几何复杂的断层表面上进行三维动力学破裂模拟，以研究地震成核与传播。
Synthetic numerical models of 3D faults with varying geometric complexities and stress states.
具有不同几何复杂度和应力状态的三维断层合成数值模型。
3D fault geometry significantly controls the location of earthquake nucleation and the spatial variation of rupture velocity.
三维断层几何显著控制了地震成核的位置以及破裂速度的空间变化。
The models rely on simplified friction laws and homogeneous crustal structures.
模型依赖于简化的摩擦定律和均匀的地壳介质结构。
Systematic quantification of the coupling between 3D geometric fault variations and dynamic rupture parameters.
系统定量化了三维几何断层变化与动力学破裂参数之间的耦合关系。

kc: Demonstrated the quantitative impact of 3D fault geometry on earthquake nucleation and rupture propagation.
Provided a physical framework linking fault roughness and geometric complexity to rupture arrest and acceleration.
定量展示了三维断层几何结构对地震成核和破裂传播的影响。
建立了一个将断层粗糙度和几何复杂性与破裂终止及加速联系起来的物理框架。
me: 3D dynamic rupture simulation on geometrically complex fault models.
Numerical modeling of stress field evolution during nucleation.
在几何复杂的断层模型上进行三维动力学破裂模拟。
成核过程中应力场演化的数值模拟。

具有不同三维断层几何形状的动力学地震破裂合成模拟。

sum: This study investigates how the Malta Graben in the Sicily Channel accommodates regional Africa-Europe convergence. Integrating depth-converted vintage multichannel seismic reflection profiles (MS-120 and CROP M24), high-resolution EMODnet bathymetry, earthquake catalogs (1981–2025), and continuous GNSS strain-rate fields, the authors reconstruct the graben's Plio-Quaternary tectono-stratigraphic evolution. Results demonstrate that the Malta Graben originated as a Lower Pliocene dextral transtensional basin featuring negative flower structures and fault-aligned magmatic intrusions. In the Upper Pliocene to Holocene, localized contraction developed in the northern graben, forming an elliptical seabed bulge (~102 sq. km, ~200 m uplift) via positive inversion of pre-existing normal faults. This coexistence of transtension and contraction is driven by stress partitioning between the Capo Granitola-Sciacca and Scicli-Ragusa strike-slip fault zones, promoting eastward lateral crustal escape toward the low-confinement Ionian slab rollback domain.
本研究结合深度转换的多道地震反射剖面（MS-120和CROP M24）、高分辨率EMODnet水深地形、1981–2025年地震目录与震源机制解以及GNSS大地测量应变场，重建了西西里海峡马耳他地堑的上新世-第四纪构造地层演化。结果表明，该地堑自早更新世起作为右旋张扭盆地发育，具负花状构造与沿断层侵……

sum: This paper presents a deep-learning framework to detect and localize submarine earthquakes using Co-seismic Ionospheric Disturbances (CSIDs) recorded in Total Electron Content (TEC) time series. To overcome the limitations of sparse offshore seismic networks, the authors train a deep-learning model to predict CSID arrival-time probabilities, achieving high precision/recall (>0.9) and low arrival-time errors (<20 s). These deep-learning-derived picks are then combined with acoustic ray tracing in a grid-search inversion to estimate the earthquake's source location, origin time, and detection altitude. Testing demonstrates that localization is highly feasible, achieving errors below 20 km from the maximum-displacement region when dense observations are available within 300 km of the epicenter. This work highlights the power of combining machine learning with physics-based wave propagation for rapid hazard assessment.

sum: This paper introduces DispSAC, an iterative surface-wave dispersion inversion method based on the off-policy soft actor-critic (SAC) reinforcement learning algorithm. The agent is trained on 50,000 synthetic Rayleigh-wave phase-velocity curves (1–100 s) computed from 1D shear-wave velocity models parameterized by B-splines (four crust coefficients, five mantle coefficients, and Moho depth). During inference, the fixed neural policy interacts with an integrated Computer Programs in Seismology (CPS) forward solver over 20-step rollouts from multiple random initializations to generate ensembles of velocity profiles. Evaluated on held-out synthetic data, a western US reference model, and 393 ambient-noise dispersion curves from Yunnan, China, DispSAC achieves comparable or narrower velocity-error distributions than a single-chain Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) baseline while reducing full-dataset inference wall-clock time (e.g., 2.53 h vs. 4.79 h in Yunnan). Its main novelty is coupling off-policy RL policy reuse with iterative physical forward evaluations.

sum: This Zenodo archive presents processed distributed acoustic sensing (DAS) observations off-shore Chile, synthetic waveforms, and conversion inputs alongside Python code for tsunami reconstruction. The code supports DAS preprocessing, DAS-to-water-elevation conversion, and preparation of inputs (such as station weights and time-reversal waveforms) for the PCOMCOT tsunami simulation tool. It also includes post-processing scripts for observation-driven reconstruction results. This dataset and software package enable the reconstruction of tsunami events, specifically targeting inputs for the 2025 Kamchatka tsunami, demonstrating the utility of offshore fiber-optic cables in tsunami early warning and hazard assessment.

sum: This study investigates how absolute static and dynamic friction coefficients influence rupture and slip on shallow dip-slip faults, where the free surface breaks geometrical symmetry. Using 2D finite-element dynamic rupture modeling of thrust and normal faults, the authors demonstrate that dynamic friction, through its coupling with time-dependent normal stress, significantly impacts shear stress, stress drop, and fault slip. Specifically, absolute friction values alter surface slip by 8% to 20%. This effect decreases with fault burial depth and vanishes for deeply buried, symmetric faults. The findings highlight that absolute friction values have physical consequences in asymmetric fault models, a factor often overlooked in existing dynamic rupture simulations.
本研究探讨了绝对摩擦系数对浅层倾滑断层破裂及滑动的物理影响。通过二维有限元动力学模拟，发现动摩擦与随时间变化的法向应力耦合，显著影响剪切应力、应力降和断层滑动，对地表滑动的物理影响达8%至20%。该效应随断层埋深增加而减弱，在深埋对称断层中消失。这表明在非对称断层模型中绝对摩擦值具有重要物理效应。

定量评估了绝对摩擦值对浅层倾滑断层破裂动力学的影响。
证明了自由表面引起的对称性破裂导致绝对摩擦对地表滑动产生8%至20%的影响。
表明绝对摩擦的影响具有深度依赖性，并在深埋的对称断层中完全消失。
me: 2D finite-element modeling of dynamic earthquake rupture.
Parameterization of thrust and normal faults with homogeneous and heterogeneous initial stresses.
Analysis of the coupling between dynamic friction and time-dependent normal stress.
地震动力学破裂的二维有限元模拟。
具有均匀和非均匀初始应力的逆断层和正断层参数化建模。
分析动摩擦与随时间变化的法向应力之间的耦合关系。
de: Synthetic dynamic rupture simulations of shallow thrust and normal faults under various stress states and burial depths.
在不同应力状态 and 埋藏深度下，浅层逆断层和正断层的合成动力学破裂模拟。
li: The study is limited to 2D modeling, which may omit 3D geometric and rupture propagation effects.
Simplified friction laws (e.g., slip-weakening) and idealized fault geometries were used.
研究局限于二维模拟，可能忽略了三维几何和破裂传播效应。
采用了简化的摩擦定律（如滑移弱化）和理想化的断层几何形状。

tm.why: The paper models the spatiotemporal evolution of rupture and slip along shallow dip-slip faults using 2D finite-element methods.
It investigates the physical effects of absolute friction values and geometrical symmetry on fault slip and stress drop.

ev.notes: Analysis is based on the BSSA abstract and metadata as no PDF was available.

sum: The July 29, 2025 Mw 8.8 Kamchatka megathrust earthquake generated ~18–19 m local tsunami runup—comparable to the larger 1952 Mw 8.8–9.0 event—yet produced much smaller far-field Pacific waves than both the 1952 tsunami and initial real-time warning forecasts. To explain this discrepancy, the authors perform a joint finite-fault slip inversion combining 7 DART bottom-pressure records, open-ocean SWOT satellite sea surface height anomalies, Sentinel-1 InSAR, and GNSS offsets, using dispersive JAGURS tsunami Green's functions and a Heat-Bath global optimization algorithm. The resulting unilateral southwestward rupture features three asperities mainly confined to mid-depths, with one central asperity (~17–18 m peak slip) extending to the shallow trench. The mid-depth concentration yields 5–10 times lower tsunami potential energy than 1952, explaining moderate far-field impact, while shallow trench slip generated steep short-wavelength waves that amplified local runup.
2025年7月29日堪察加8.8级逆冲大地震产生了约18-19米的近场海啸爬高（与1952年8.8-9.0级地震相当），但其远场太平洋海啸振幅远小于1952年事件及实时海啸预警预测。本研究利用考虑频散效应的JAGURS海啸模拟代码与热浴全局优化算法，联合反演了7个DART海底压力记录、SWOT卫星海……

t: Joint finite-fault slip inversion using the Heat-Bath (Simulated Annealing) global optimization algorithm, combining analytical triangular dislocation geodetic Green's functions with dispersive JAGURS tsunami simulations incorporating Boussinesq dispersion, earth elasticity, and water stratification.
采用热浴全局优化算法，结合三角形位错格林函数与包含频散、弹性和层化效应的JAGURS海啸模拟进行联合有限断层反演。

Joint inversion of 7 de-tided NOAA DART bottom-pressure waveforms, two tracks of SWOT satellite KaRIn L2 sea-surface height anomalies, ascending and descending Sentinel-1 InSAR displacement maps, and horizontal coseismic offsets from 14 GNSS stations.
联合反演7个DART海啸波形、两条SWOT卫星海面高度异常轨迹、Sentinel-1升降轨InSAR形变及14个GNSS…

The rupture propagated southwestward unilaterally with three asperities mostly at mid-depths and ~17–18 m peak slip reaching the shallow trench near 51.5°N, yielding 5–10 times smaller tsunami potential energy than the 1952 event.
破裂向西南单侧扩展并形成三个中深部为主的凹凸体，51.5°N处峰值滑动17-18米达海沟，海啸势能比1952年小5-10…
Large uncertainties in the 1952 source models prevent determining whether the 2025 rupture overlapped or was spatially complementary to the 1952 rupture zone.
1952年震源模型不确定性较大，无法确定2025年破裂与1952年破裂区是空间重叠还是倾向互补。
Jointly inverts open-ocean SWOT satellite swath altimetry with DART, InSAR, and GNSS using dispersive kinematics to reconcile high near-field runup with moderate far-field tsunami amplitudes.
首次联合SWOT宽刈幅测高、DART、InSAR和GNSS及频散运动学模型，解释高近场爬高与温和远场海啸并存的机制。

kc: Jointly inverts SWOT satellite KaRIn sea-surface height anomalies, 7 DART buoys, Sentinel-1 InSAR, and 14 GNSS stations for the 2025 Mw 8.8 Kamchatka earthquake slip model.
Demonstrates that dispersive tsunami modeling (JAGURS with Boussinesq, elasticity, and stratification terms) and finite rupture kinematics (2 km/s) are essential to fit SWOT and DART waveforms.
Explains why far-field tsunami amplitudes were moderate (5–10 times lower potential energy due to mid-depth slip) while near-field runups reached 18–19 m (localized trench-reaching slip).
Benchmarks real-time tsunami forecasts (PTWC, NWS-NTWC, JMA) and compares tsunami energetics with the 1952 Kamchatka, 2010 Maule, and 2005 Nias megathrust events.
联合反演SWOT卫星海面高度异常、7个DART浮标、Sentinel-1 InSAR和14个GNSS台站数据，构建2025年堪察加8.8级地震滑动模型。
证明包含Boussinesq频散、地球弹性和海水层化的JAGURS海啸模拟及2 km/s破裂运动学对拟合SWOT和DART波形至关重要。
阐明远场海啸温和（中深部滑动导致海啸势能比1952年低5-10倍）而近场爬高高达18-19米（局部延伸至海沟的浅部滑动）的物理机制。
评估了PTWC、NWS-NTWC和JMA的实时海啸预警结果，并与1952年堪察加、2010年智利Maule和2005年印尼Nias地震海啸进行了对比。
me: Tessellation of SLAB2.0 subduction interface into 192 quadrilateral subfaults (~25 x 25 km) using Cubit.
Computation of static elastic Green's functions using analytical triangular dislocations in a homogeneous half-space, including horizontal slope displacement and Kajiura water-column filtering.

Dispersive tsunami Green's function modeling via JAGURS solving nonlinear shallow-water equations with Boussinesq dispersion, seawater density stratification, elastic loading, and gravitational potential changes.

Global optimization inversion using the Heat-Bath (Simulated Annealing) algorithm with waveform period/amplitude misfit and L2 geodetic norm, outputting an inverse-misfit weighted ensemble average model.
基于SLAB2.0模型，利用Cubit软件将俯冲界面剖分为192个约25×25 km的四边形子断层。
采用均匀半空间解析三角形位错计算静态同震形变格林函数，并计入海底斜坡水平位移贡献及水体滤波效应。
利用JAGURS求解包含Boussinesq频散、海水密度层化、弹性负载和重力位变化的非线性浅水方程，计算海啸格林函数。
采用热浴（模拟退火）全局优化算法进行反演，结合波形周期/振幅失配函数与大地测量L2范数，输出按失配倒数加权的系综平均模型。
de: 7 de-tided NOAA DART bottom-pressure tsunami waveforms in the Pacific Ocean (1-min sampling).
NASA/CNES SWOT satellite Level 2 KaRIn Low-Rate Sea Surface Height Anomaly (SSHA) swath data (Cycle 36, Pass 267, ~70 min post-origin).
Sentinel-1 ascending (July 19–31, 2025) and descending (July 23–August 4, 2025) DInSAR displacement maps sampled on a 3000 m grid.
Horizontal coseismic offsets at 14 GNSS stations on the Kamchatka Peninsula and Paramushiri Island, plus coastal runup observations and Pacific tide gauge records.
太平洋7个去潮汐处理的NOAA DART海底压力海啸时间序列（采样率1分钟）。
发震后约70分钟过境的SWOT卫星Level 2 KaRIn低速率海面高度异常（SSHA）条带数据（Cycle 36，Pass 267）。
按3000米网格采样的Sentinel-1升轨（2025年7月19-31日）和降轨（2025年7月23日-8月4日）InSAR同震形变图。
堪察加半岛和幌筵岛14个GNSS台站的水平同震位移，以及近场海岸爬高观测和太平洋验潮站记录。
li: High uncertainty in 1952 Kamchatka earthquake source models prevents definitively resolving whether the 2025 event is an updip complementary rupture or a partial re-rupture.
Near-field runup validation relies on a 1D Green's law coastal amplification approximation from 50 m to 1 m depth rather than full high-resolution 2D coastal inundation modeling.
Rupture kinematics are simplified as a circular front with a fixed constant rupture velocity of 2.0 km/s.
1952年堪察加地震震源模型的不确定性较大，无法最终确定2025年地震是沿倾向向浅部的互补破裂还是部分重复破裂。
近场爬高验证依赖于从50米到1米水深的格林定律放大近似，而非高分辨率二维海岸淹没数值模拟。
破裂运动学被简化为以2.0 km/s恒定破裂速度扩展的圆形破裂前锋。

tm.why: The paper jointly inverts tsunami (DART, SWOT) and geodetic (InSAR, GNSS) data to resolve the complex three-asperity slip distribution and unilateral rupture kinematics of the 2025 Mw 8.8 Kamchatka megathrust earthquake.
The study evaluates near-field tsunami runup (~18-19 m) and far-field tsunami amplitudes against real-time warning forecasts from PTWC, NWS-NTWC, and JMA.
The authors use a global optimization Heat-Bath (Simulated Annealing) algorithm to explore an ensemble of slip models and derive an inverse-misfit weighted mean model with uncertainty envelopes.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete 10-page article PDF including Online Methods, all 5 main figures, and references.

sum: Quantifying deep magmatic flux from the mantle is vital for understanding crustal formation and volcanic hazards, yet direct present-day constraints are lacking. This study establishes a physical framework linking the cumulative seismic moment of deep long-period (DLP) seismicity and volcanic tremors near the Moho to the volume of ascending magma. Adopting a model where seismic waves are generated by rapid gas bubble growth in decompressing, oversaturated magma batches, the authors relate scalar seismic moment to magma volume via rock bulk modulus and an expansion coefficient (γ ≈ 650). Applying this to 11 months of continuous data from the 2015–2016 KISS dense seismic array at the Klyuchevskoy Volcanic Group in Kamchatka, they show that deep tremor moment release (2.2×10¹⁷ N·m) exceeds DLP earthquakes by two orders of magnitude. The resulting deep magma supply rate is ~1.5 km³/year, occurring in intermittent surges and matching long-term geological output expectations.
量化地幔深部岩浆通量对理解地壳形成和火山灾害至关重要。本研究建立了莫霍面附近深源长周期（DLP）地震及火山颤动的累积地震矩与上涌岩浆体积之间的物理联系。基于减压过饱和岩浆中气泡快速生长产生地震波的模型，作者利用岩石体积模量和膨胀系数（γ≈650）将标量地震矩转化为岩浆体积。将该框架应用于勘察加克柳切……

t: Establishes a physical scaling relation between cumulative scalar seismic moment of deep volcanic tremors and ascending magma volume using a rapid gas bubble growth model in decompressing oversaturated magma sills (expansion factor γ ≈ 650).
基于减压过饱和岩浆床中气泡快速生长模型（膨胀系数γ≈650），建立深部火山颤动累积地震矩与上涌岩浆体积的物理标度关系。

Uses 11 months of continuous waveforms from 101 temporary and permanent seismic stations during the 2015–2016 KISS experiment in Kamchatka, analyzing catalogs of DLP earthquakes and 2,494 deep tremor episodes (25–48.5 km depth).
使用勘察加2015–2016年KISS实验中101个台站11个月的连续波形，分析DLP地震和2494个深部颤动事件（25…

Deep tremor cumulative seismic moment (2.2×10¹⁷ N·m) exceeds DLP earthquakes (4.8×10¹⁴ N·m) by over two orders of magnitude, yielding an intermittent mantle magma supply rate of ~1.4 km³ over 11 months (~1.5 km³/year).
深部颤动累积地震矩（2.2×10¹⁷ N·m）比DLP地震高两个数量级以上，推算11个月内岩浆补给量为1.4 km³（约…

Estimates have an order-of-magnitude uncertainty due to poorly constrained source parameters, possible multi-episode bubble nucleation during magma ascent across 25–48.5 km, and potential top-down depressurization triggers.
受震源参数约束、25–48.5 km深度内气泡多次成核重复计数及自上而下减压触发影响，结果存在一个数量级不确定性。
Provides the first physics-based quantitative proxy for present-day time-dependent deep mantle magma flux using continuous deep seismo-volcanic tremors rather than long-term geological averages.
首次利用连续深部火山颤动而非长期地质平均值，提供了现代时变地幔深部岩浆通量的物理定量代理指标。

kc: Establishes a physical scaling relationship between cumulative seismic moment of deep volcanic seismicity and ascending magma volume based on rapid gas bubble growth.
Demonstrates that deep seismic tremors dominate total deep seismic moment release over DLP earthquakes by more than two orders of magnitude beneath Klyuchevskoy.
Provides the first quantitative estimate of present-day mantle magma influx (~1.5 km³/year) beneath the Klyuchevskoy Volcanic Group, revealing highly intermittent transport episodes.
基于气泡快速生长模型，建立了深部火山地震活动累积地震矩与上涌岩浆体积之间的物理标度关系。
证明了克柳切夫火山下方深部地震颤动的总地震矩释放比DLP地震高出两个数量级以上。
首次定量估算了克柳切夫火山群现代地幔岩浆输入率（约1.5 km³/年），揭示了高度间歇性的深部岩浆运移过程。
me: Physical source modeling relating tensile crack isotropic/deviatoric moment to magma batch volume via rapid degassing overpressure and expansion factor γ ≈ 650.
Spectral displacement plateau (1–5 Hz) analysis in 5-s sub-windows across 101 stations to quantify scalar seismic moments of non-impulsive continuous tremor episodes.
Empirical estimation of S-wave inelastic attenuation (Q ≈ 95) from hypocentral distance decay of normalized station-event seismic moment residuals.
物理震源建模：通过快速脱气超压和膨胀系数（γ≈650），将张裂隙各向同性/偏量地震矩与岩浆团体积关联。
利用101个台站的5秒子窗口位移谱平台（1–5 Hz）分析，量化非脉冲连续颤动事件的标量地震矩。
基于归一化台站-事件地震矩残差随震源距的衰减，经验估算S波非弹性衰减品质因子（Q≈95）。
de: 11 months of continuous 3-component seismic records (Aug 2015–Jul 2016) from 101 temporary (KISS network X9) and permanent (KBGS network D0) stations.
Machine-learning-derived DLP earthquake catalog and network-covariance-matrix-derived deep tremor catalog (2,494 distinct tremor events at 25–48.5 km depth).
来自101个临时（KISS台网X9）和固定（KBGS台网D0）台站的11个月（2015年8月至2016年7月）连续三分量地震记录。
基于机器学习构建的DLP地震目录与基于台网协方差矩阵提取的深部颤动目录（25–48.5 km深度范围内共2494个独立颤动事件）。
li: Estimates carry roughly one order of magnitude uncertainty due to poorly constrained parameters (e.g., over-saturation pressure, non-degassing seismic contributions, crack geometry).
Potential multiple counting of magma batches if a single ascending batch undergoes repeated episodes of bubble nucleation across the 25–48.5 km depth interval.
Cannot unambiguously distinguish whether intermittent tremor surges reflect true mantle influx pulses or top-down depressurization transients of the transcrustal system.
由于过饱和压力、非脱气震源贡献和裂隙几何形态等参数约束较差，体积估算存在约一个数量级的不确定性。
若同一上涌岩浆团在25–48.5 km深度区间内发生多次气泡成核，可能导致岩浆体积被重复计算。
无法完全区分间歇性颤动增强是反映真实的地幔补给脉冲，还是穿地壳岩浆系统自上而下的快速减压瞬变。

tm.why: The paper develops a physical model linking deep seismo-volcanic tremors and deep long-period (DLP) earthquakes to magma supply from the mantle beneath the Klyuchevskoy Volcanic Group.
It establishes a physical source relationship between cumulative scalar seismic moment of tensile cracks/rapid gas bubble growth and magma batch volume.
It quantifies deep magma flux across the crust-mantle boundary (Moho) and relates it to crustal emplacement and intrusive-to-extrusive ratios.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete 32-page EarthArXiv preprint PDF, including the main text (pp. 1–13) and Supplementary Materials (pp. 14–32).

sum: Existing integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) fiber-optic systems merely coexist with separate transceivers or reserved spectrum, limiting scalability. This paper proposes a holistically co-designed sensing and communication (CSAC) framework spanning signal, system, and network levels. It introduces a dual-function fractional Fourier transform (FrFT) pilot signal inserted into spectral dips between digital subcarriers. A single transmitter simultaneously generates multi-tone pilots and 100 G 16QAM 4-subcarrier signals over a 10-km point-to-multipoint (P2MP) network. Forward pilots enable multi-user frequency synchronization with 1.56 MHz accuracy, while Rayleigh backscattered pilots are demodulated via matched filtering and rotated-vector-sum synthesis for distributed acoustic sensing (DAS). With three pilots, the system achieves 22 pε/√Hz strain sensitivity, 5 m spatial resolution, and 12 kHz sensing bandwidth. Using an on-chip thin-film lithium niobate (TFLN) electro-optic comb to synthesize seven pilots further expands the vibration response bandwidth to 28 kHz, setting a record for ISAC systems.
针对现有通感一体化光纤系统资源共享不足的问题，本文提出一种从信号、系统到网络多层协同设计的分布式声学传感（DAS）与相干通信框架（CSAC）。该方法基于分数阶傅里叶变换（FrFT）设计双功能导频，插入数字子载波的频谱间隙中，利用单一发射机在10公里点对多点（P2MP）网络中同时实现100G 16QA……

t: Dual-function Fractional Fourier Transform (FrFT) pilots are placed in spectral dips between digital subcarriers from a single transmitter, enabling in-advance multipoint frequency synchronization and matched-filter Rayleigh backscattering phase demodulation with chronological multi-pilot synthesis.
在数字子载波频谱凹陷处插入双功能FrFT导频，单发射机同时实现多点频偏估计与匹配滤波瑞利散射多导频合成传感。

Laboratory experiments over a 10-km standard single-mode fiber (plus 500-m and 1-km P2MP branches) transmitting 25.6 Gbaud 16QAM DSCM signals while recording PZT-induced vibrations from 1 kHz to 28 kHz.
在10公里单模光纤及500米/1公里分支上开展25.6 Gbaud 16QAM传输与1-28 kHz PZT振动实验。

Achieved 100 G 16QAM transmission with 1.56 MHz frequency offset estimation accuracy, 22 pε/√Hz strain sensitivity at 5 m spatial resolution, and vibration bandwidth expanded to 12 kHz (3 pilots) and 28 kHz (7 pilots).
实现100G传输、1.56 MHz频偏估计精度、5米分辨率、22 pε/√Hz灵敏度及最高28 kHz响应带宽。
The communication rate (100 Gb/s) is not the highest compared to existing WDM systems due to experimental constraints, and higher launched power (>6 dBm) induces nonlinear phase noise.
受实验条件限制单波速率（100G）非最高，且高入纤功率（>6 dBm）会引入非线性噪声。

Holistic co-design of DAS and P2MP coherent communication across signal, system, and network levels using dual-function FrFT pilots and chip-based optical combs, reaching a record 28 kHz vibration bandwidth.
提出信号-系统-网络多层协同设计的通感框架，结合片上光频梳创下28 kHz振动探测带宽纪录。

kc: Proposed a holistic co-designed sensing and communication (CSAC) framework sharing time, spectrum, and hardware resources across signal, system, and P2MP network levels.
Designed a dual-function FrFT pilot placed in spectral dips between digital subcarriers for simultaneous forward frequency synchronization (1.56 MHz accuracy) and backward DAS.
Demonstrated 100 Gbps 16QAM 4-subcarrier P2MP transmission over 10-km SSMF alongside DAS with 5 m spatial resolution and 22 pε/√Hz sensitivity.
Expanded DAS acoustic frequency response up to 12 kHz using 3 chronological pilots and up to 28 kHz (ultrasonic regime) using 7 pilots with an on-chip TFLN optical comb LO.
提出了涵盖信号、系统和P2MP网络层面的光纤分布式声学传感与相干通信协同设计（CSAC）框架，实现时频与硬件资源深度共享。
设计了置于数字子载波频谱凹陷处的双功能FrFT导频信号，同时实现前向多点频率同步（精度1.56 MHz）和后向DAS传感。
在10公里标准单模光纤上验证了100 Gbps 16QAM四子载波P2MP传输，同时实现5米空间分辨率和22 pε/√Hz灵敏度的声学传感。
利用3个时序导频合成将声学响应频率提升至12 kHz，并结合片上TFLN电光频梳本振合成7个导频，将探测带宽进一步拓展至28 kHz超声频段。
me: Dual-function pilot generation using opposite-order Fractional Fourier Transform (FrFT) linear frequency modulation signals placed in spectral dips between root-raised-cosine filtered digital subcarriers.
Point-to-multipoint (P2MP) coherent communication using digital subcarrier multiplexing (DSCM) and in-advance FrFT-based frequency offset estimation (FOE).
Rayleigh backscattering (RBS) phase demodulation using matched filtering, rotated-vector-sum (RVS), and moving rotated-vector-average (MRVA) to suppress interference fading.
Chronological multi-pilot synthesis using an optical frequency comb local oscillator (including an on-chip TFLN modulator comb) to multiply the effective acoustic sampling rate.
利用相反阶数的分数阶傅里叶变换（FrFT）生成线性调频双功能导频信号，并将其置于根升余弦滤波数字子载波之间的频谱凹陷处。
采用数字子载波复用（DSCM）构建点对多点（P2MP）相干通信架构，并利用FrFT导频在解复用前进行高精度频偏估计（FOE）。
采用匹配滤波算法解调瑞利后向散射（RBS）信号相位，并结合旋转矢量求和（RVS）与移动旋转矢量平均（MRVA）抑制干涉衰落。
利用光频梳本振（包括片上TFLN调制器光频梳）按时序合成多个导频的解调波形，成倍提升分布式声学传感的有效采样率与响应带宽。
de: Laboratory transmission and vibration experiment over a 10-km standard single-mode fiber (SSMF) with a piezoelectric transducer (PZT) at the fiber end.
Launched optical power (LOP) sweep (0 to 16 dBm) and received optical power (ROP) sweep (-34 to -28 dBm) evaluating BER, sensing SNR, and phase STD.
P2MP optical splitting experiment with a 1x2 coupler routing after 10-km SSMF to 500-m and 1-km fiber branches with PZT excitations at 4, 8, and 12 kHz.
Ultrasonic vibration detection experiment (10, 20, and 28 kHz) using eight 3.2-Gbaud subcarriers, seven FrFT pilots, and a packaged TFLN chip electro-optic comb generator.
在末端带有压电陶瓷换能器（PZT）的10公里标准单模光纤（SSMF）上进行室内通信传输与振动传感实验。

Single-polarization modulation was used in the experiment, making receiver performance slightly sensitive to minor polarization controller variances.
High launched optical power (>6 dBm) degrades both communication BER and backward sensing phase STD due to fiber nonlinearities.

实验采用单偏振调制，通信接收性能对偏振控制器的微小变化较为敏感。

It introduces novel optical hardware and signal processing schemes (FrFT pilots, on-chip TFLN optical comb generators) to enhance DAS sensing bandwidth and sensitivity.

sum: Simulating large-scale rock fracture with the Combined Finite-Discrete Element Method (FDEM) and cohesive crack models requires elements smaller than the fracture process zone (FPZ), which is computationally prohibitive at engineering scales. Using coarser meshes without parameter adjustment causes severe inaccuracies. This paper establishes a theoretical size effect law for FPZ length by combining the Dugdale-Barenblatt (D-B) model and Bazant's size effect law. Closed-loop three-point bending tests on geometrically similar granite specimens (heights 40–160 mm) monitored with Digital Image Correlation (DIC) and fine-mesh FDEM models verify the FPZ size effect. Sensitivity analysis shows traction force in the FPZ is primarily governed by tensile strength. Consequently, the authors propose a tensile strength reduction law that scales cohesive strength by the ratio of element size to the infinite-size FPZ length. Applied to large-scale bending tests and a compressed air energy storage cavern, the law cuts peak-load errors from up to 192% to under...
针对大尺度岩石断裂FDEM模拟中内聚力单元尺寸大于断裂过程区（FPZ）长度导致计算失真的问题，本文结合D-B模型与Bazant尺寸效应律推导了FPZ长度的尺寸效应公式，并提出了内聚力单元抗拉强度折减律。通过对不同尺寸花岗岩试样开展三点弯曲DIC实验及细网格FDEM模拟，验证了FPZ演化规律。算例表明……

t: Combines the Dugdale-Barenblatt model and Bazant's size effect law to derive FPZ length scaling, then formulates a cohesive tensile strength reduction law based on the ratio of element length to asymptotic FPZ length.
结合D-B模型和Bazant尺寸效应律推导FPZ长度公式，并基于单元尺寸与渐近FPZ长度之比建立内聚力抗拉强度折减律。

Closed-loop three-point bending tests with DIC on four geometrically scaled granite beams (heights 40–160 mm), plus ABAQUS FDEM simulations of beams up to 2000 mm height and a 40 m × 40 m CAES cavern.

Experimental FPZ lengths grow from 25.74 to 69.28 mm (asymptotic length 159.28 mm, R²=0.98). The strength reduction law reduces coarse-mesh peak-load errors from 12.91–192% down to 0.01–14.71% and cuts cavern simulation time from 57.78 to 2.31 hours.
实验FPZ长度随尺寸从25.74增至69.28 mm；强度折减律将粗网格峰值荷载误差从最高192%降至15%内，洞室计算…

Limited to Mode-I tensile fracture and requires a pre-existing crack or notch; cannot directly resolve shear-dominated failures like landslides or shear earthquakes, and requires partial mesh refinement for unnotched structures.
仅适用于含初始裂纹的I型张拉断裂，无法解决滑坡或剪切地震等剪切破坏问题。

Replaces empirical parameter tuning in coarse-mesh FDEM with a theoretically grounded tensile-strength reduction law that links cohesive element size directly to the asymptotic FPZ characteristic length.
建立了关联内聚力单元尺寸与渐近FPZ长度的理论抗拉强度折减律，取代了粗网格模拟中的经验调参。

kc: Derived an analytical size effect law for the fracture process zone (FPZ) length in quasi-brittle rocks by combining the D-B model and Bazant's size effect law.
Measured FPZ lengths (25.74 to 69.28 mm) across geometrically scaled granite beams (H = 40 to 160 mm) using closed-loop three-point bending tests and DIC.
Proved via partial derivative sensitivity analysis that total traction force in the FPZ is overwhelmingly more sensitive to tensile strength than to penalty stiffness or fracture energy.
Formulated and validated a practical tensile strength reduction law for coarse cohesive elements that preserves load-displacement accuracy and slashes CPU time by over 95% in cavern simulations.
结合D-B模型与Bazant尺寸效应律，推导了准脆性岩石断裂过程区（FPZ）长度的尺寸效应理论公式。
利用闭环三点弯曲实验和数字图像相关（DIC）技术，测定了几何相似花岗岩试样（高40–160 mm）的FPZ长度（25.74–69.28 mm）。
通过偏导数敏感性分析证明，FPZ内的总牵引力对抗拉强度的敏感性远高于罚刚度和断裂能。
提出了适用于粗网格内聚力单元的抗拉强度折减律，在保证荷载-位移精度前提下将洞室模拟CPU时间缩短95%以上。
me: Theoretical derivation of FPZ length scaling using the Dugdale-Barenblatt (D-B) cohesive model and Bazant's nominal strength size effect law.
Experimental FPZ tracking via Digital Image Correlation (DIC) and Crack Mouth Opening Displacement (CMOD) feedback control on granite three-point bending beams.
Combined Finite-Discrete Element Method (FDEM) modeling in ABAQUS using zero-thickness cohesive elements with bilinear traction-separation laws.
Analytical sensitivity analysis of integrated FPZ traction force and formulation of a similarity-based tensile strength reduction law for coarse cohesive elements.
结合Dugdale-Barenblatt（D-B）模型和Bazant名义强度尺寸效应律，理论推导FPZ长度缩放规律。
采用CMOD闭环控制花岗岩三点弯曲实验和DIC技术进行实验FPZ识别与追踪。
在ABAQUS中使用插入零厚度双线性内聚力单元的有限-离散元法（FDEM）进行数值模拟。
对积分FPZ牵引力进行解析敏感性分析，并基于相似性原理建立大尺寸内聚力单元抗拉强度折减公式。

FDEM numerical parametric simulations of three-point bending beams with heights ranging from 40 to 2000 mm and cohesive element sizes from 1 mm to 637.5 mm.
Literature benchmark verification against two granite Mode-I fracture cases (l_fpz = 73.5 mm and 144.8 mm).

2D plane-strain FDEM simulation of a 6 m diameter compressed air energy storage (CAES) rock cavern in a 40 m × 40 m domain under in-situ stresses (8 MPa horizontal, 4 MPa vertical) comparing 70 mm fine and 400 mm coarse meshes.
对4组几何相似花岗岩试样（高度40、80、120和160 mm，厚度25 mm）开展闭环三点弯曲实验及DIC应变与位移监测。
对高度40–2000 mm、内聚力单元尺寸1–637.5 mm的三点弯曲梁进行FDEM数值参数化模拟。
基于文献中两个花岗岩I型断裂算例（l_fpz = 73.5 mm和144.8 mm）进行基准验证。
在8 MPa水平和4 MPa垂直地应力下，对40 m × 40 m区域内直径6 m的压缩空气储能（CAES）岩石洞室进行二维平面应变FDEM模拟（对比70 mm细网格与400 mm粗网格）。

Requires an existing crack or notch to satisfy the underlying D-B model and Bazant size effect law assumptions; intact structures require partial mesh refinement at crack initiation zones.
Rock heterogeneity causes winding crack paths and millimeter-level errors in theoretical FPZ length calculations.
仅适用于I型（张拉）断裂，未考虑剪切型断裂的FPZ及滑坡、剪切型地震等剪切主导破坏。
D-B模型和Bazant尺寸效应律要求存在初始裂纹或切口，无初始裂纹结构需在起裂区进行局部网格加密。

tm.why: The paper develops a constitutive tensile-strength reduction law for cohesive crack models in quasi-brittle rock fracture mechanics, directly relevant to rock damage and fracture process zone scaling.

sum: Estimating the northern extent of Greater India is essential for reconstructing the India-Asia collision, yet prior paleomagnetic methods (fill-the-gap and fixed great circle) yield conflicting estimates from ~200 to ~3,000 km due to age uncertainties and India's complex kinematics. This study introduces a refined apparent polar wander path (APWP)-constrained framework that treats the Tethyan Himalaya (TH) paleomagnetic record as an integrated temporal sequence. Assuming rigid attachment to the Indian craton, the method iteratively translates TH sampling sites and poles northward, quantifying angular distance discrepancies against the updated Indian APWP while propagating pole and age uncertainties via Monte Carlo simulations. Applied to 18 quality-screened Jurassic–Paleocene poles with updated GTS2020 ages, the discrepancy minimizes at a 7.9 ± 1.2° northward shift, corresponding to ~880 ± 130 km of crustal shortening. This supports a two-stage collision beginning with a ~60 Ma equatorial India-arc collision and ~32% crustal recycling.
重建印度-亚洲碰撞需要确定大印度的北部范围，但以往古地磁方法受年代误差和印度板块复杂运动学影响，估算结果在200至3000公里间差异巨大。本文提出一种改进的视极移路径（APWP）约束方法，将特提斯喜马拉雅（TH）的古地磁记录作为整体时间序列，假设其与印度克拉通刚性连接，通过向北迭代平移并结合蒙特卡洛……

t: Iteratively translates Tethyan Himalaya sites and paleomagnetic poles northward in 0.1° steps, using Monte Carlo simulations to propagate age and pole uncertainties and minimize angular distance discrepancies against the Indian APWP.

Compiled Jurassic–Paleocene paleomagnetic poles from the Tethyan Himalaya, screened via R1–R7 quality criteria into 18 reliable poles with ages updated to the GTS2020 and GPTS2020 timescales.

The discrepancy between Tethyan Himalaya poles and the Indian APWP reaches a global minimum at a northward shift of 7.9 ± 1.2°, corresponding to ~880 ± 130 km of N-S crustal shortening.

假设特提斯喜马拉雅与印度克拉通刚性连接；若碰撞前存在显著裂解或相对运动，则需重新评估。

Determined an optimal northward shift of 7.9 ± 1.2° (~880 ± 130 km crustal shortening) for Greater India, indicating ~32% crustal volume recycling into the mantle and supporting an initial ~60 Ma India-arc collision.
开发了基于APWP约束的运动学平移与蒙特卡洛模拟框架，将特提斯喜马拉雅古地磁极作为统一时间序列进行整体评估。
汇编并筛选了特提斯喜马拉雅18个可靠的侏罗纪-古新世古地磁极，并将其年代约束统一更新至GTS2020/GPTS2020标准。
确定大印度最佳向北平移量为7.9 ± 1.2°（地壳缩短约880 ± 130 km），表明约32%的地壳体积再循环进入地幔，支持约60 Ma的初始弧-陆碰撞模型。

Monte Carlo uncertainty propagation resampling candidate rock ages (uniformly and normally distributed within stratigraphic ranges) and 100 Fisher-distributed virtual geomagnetic poles (VGPs) per pole.

Minimization of great-circle angular distance discrepancies (via the Haversine formula) between relocated sites and restored TH poles versus coeval reference poles interpolated at 0.1 Myr from the Vaes et al. (2023) Indian APWP.
围绕特定赤道欧拉极进行刚体旋转，将特提斯喜马拉雅采样点及对应古地磁极按0.1°步长严格向北迭代平移（最大至50°）。

sum: This study investigates retrogressed garnet amphibolites from the Xuerongzangbu area in the Central Lhasa Terrane, Tibet, using petrography, geochemistry, Sr-Nd isotopes, zircon U-Pb geochronology, and phase-equilibrium modeling. The rocks record high-pressure metamorphism (15.4–16.0 kbar, 600–660°C) and subsequent retrogression. Geochemical signatures (OIB-type trace elements, εNd(t) of -1.59 to +0.16) indicate derivation from an enriched intraplate mantle source (seamount/ocean-island basalts) with minimal crustal contamination. Zircon U-Pb dating yields a protolith age of 271.0 ± 3.0 Ma, while Ar-Ar cooling ages of 232.9–216.9 Ma record Late Triassic exhumation. These findings suggest that the protoliths formed on the Songduo oceanic lithosphere, linking Permian mantle plume-like activity beneath North Gondwana to the geodynamic evolution and closure of the Songduo Paleo-Tethys Ocean.
本文对西藏拉萨地块雪绒藏布石榴角闪岩进行地球化学、定年与相平衡模拟。结果显示其经历了高压变质（15.4–16.0 kbar），原岩为271 Ma的富集地幔源洋岛玄武岩（OIB），并在232.9–216.9 Ma折返。该成果证实其原岩形成于松多洋盆海山，揭示了北冈瓦纳边缘二叠纪地幔活动与古特提斯洋演化……

结合岩相学、全岩地球化学、Sr-Nd同位素、锆石U-Pb、Ar-Ar定年及相平衡模拟。
Retrogressed garnet amphibolites from the Xuerongzangbu area of the Central Lhasa Terrane, Tibet.
