sum: This paper addresses the cycle-skipping problem in Full Waveform Inversion (FWI) when initial velocity models are inaccurate and low-frequency data are missing. Inspired by machine learning optimization, the authors propose using gradient-based optimizers with relatively large step lengths to induce a quasi-global search behavior. This strategy leverages the more linear and convex nature of the shallow subsurface, allowing the inversion to converge there first. As the shallow model improves, it guides the convergence of deeper structures, which initially undergo a more global-like search. Synthetic and field data experiments demonstrate that this approach successfully reconstructs accurate velocity models even under severe cycle-skipping conditions, highlighting a key information propagation property in FWI loss topology.
针对全波形反演（FWI）在缺乏低频和初始模型不准时易陷入周期跳跃（局部极小值）的问题，本文提出了一种受机器学习启发的优化策略。作者通过在梯度类优化器中采用相对较大的步长，激发了“准全局搜索”行为。该策略利用浅部地层更具线性和凸性的特征，使反演首先在浅部收敛；随着浅部模型的改善，逐步引导深部结构的收敛……

t: Gradient-based optimization using relatively large step lengths, inspired by machine learning, to promote quasi-global search behavior in FWI.
受机器学习启发，在梯度类FWI优化中采用相对较大的步长以促进准全局搜索行为。
Synthetic and field seismic datasets used to test the inversion under severe cycle-skipping conditions.
用于在严重周期跳跃条件下测试反演效果的合成与实际地震数据集。
Successful reconstruction of accurate velocity models from shallow to deep, even in the presence of significant cycle skipping.
在存在严重周期跳跃的情况下，成功重建了自浅入深的精确速度模型。
Potential risk of numerical instability or divergence if the step length is excessively large.
若步长过大，可能存在数值不稳定或发散的风险。
Exploiting large-step gradient optimization to induce quasi-global search, leveraging the shallow-to-deep information propagation in FWI.
利用大步长梯度优化诱导准全局搜索，发挥FWI中信息自浅向深传播的特性。

kc: Proposes a large-step gradient-based optimization strategy for FWI to achieve quasi-global search behavior.
Demonstrates how resolving shallow structures first can guide deeper convergence and mitigate cycle skipping.
提出了一种用于FWI的大步长梯度优化策略，以实现准全局搜索行为。
阐明了先解决浅部结构如何引导深部收敛并缓解周期跳跃。
me: Gradient-based optimization with large step lengths inspired by machine learning.
Full waveform inversion (FWI) workflow.
受机器学习启发的大步长梯度优化算法。
全波形反演（FWI）工作流。
de: Synthetic velocity model tests under severe cycle-skipping conditions.
Field data application to validate the practical feasibility of the large-step optimization.
严重周期跳跃条件下的合成速度模型测试。
实际野外数据应用，验证大步长优化的实际可行性。
li: The exact criteria for choosing the optimal 'large' step length without causing divergence remain to be fully generalized.
在不引起发散的情况下选择最佳“大”步长的具体标准仍需进一步推广。

tm.why: The paper focuses on mitigating cycle skipping in full waveform inversion using a novel optimization strategy.
It addresses gradient-based optimization and global search behavior in geophysical inverse problems.

ev.notes: No PDF was available; analysis is based on the metadata and abstract.

sum: Understanding the Cenozoic deformation timing in the East Kunlun Mountains is vital for testing Tibetan Plateau growth models. This study presents the first high-density-sampling magnetostratigraphic record integrated with structural analysis and ostracod biostratigraphy from an 850-m-thick succession of the Miocene Wudaoliang Formation at the Xiaohongshan section. Correlation with the geomagnetic polarity timescale dates the section to 25.7–17.5 Ma. The systematic upward decrease in bedding dip from ~50° to 10° defines classic syntectonic growth strata, placing the onset of major thrust faulting at ca. 23 Ma. This timing aligns with regional low-temperature thermochronological exhumation records across the range. Combining these findings with prior seismic and magnetotelluric imaging, the authors propose that early Miocene thrusting was triggered not by far-field upper-crustal shortening, but by northward-flowing weakened lower crust from the Hoh Xil Basin being obstructed by and injected into the rigid Qaidam lithosphere.
本研究对东昆仑山小红山剖面850米厚的中新世五道梁组进行了高密度磁性地层学采样、构造几何学分析及介形虫生物地层学研究。通过与标准极性年表对比，确定剖面沉积年代为25.7–17.5 Ma。地层倾角由底部~50°向上系统减小至10°，构成典型的同构造生长地层，直接限定大规模逆冲断层起始于约23 Ma。该……

t: Thermal demagnetization and principal component analysis isolated primary characteristic remanent magnetization directions from 439 screened samples, which were correlated to the GTS 2020 polarity timescale using ostracod biostratigraphy and regional isotopic age bounds.
通过热退磁和主成分分析从439块样品分离特征剩磁，结合介形虫生物地层与区域同位素年龄对比至GTS 2020。

An 850-m-thick fluvial-lacustrine succession of the Miocene Wudaoliang Formation at the Xiaohongshan section (35.4°N, 96.0°E), yielding 609 paleomagnetic samples, 14 ostracod samples, and structural dip measurements across growth strata.
小红山剖面850米厚中新世五道梁组河湖相地层，包含609块古地磁样、14块介形虫样及生长地层倾角测量。

The Xiaohongshan section spans 25.7–17.5 Ma; growth strata characterized by bedding dips decreasing upward from ~50° to 10° initiate with basal conglomerates at ca. 23 Ma, dating the onset of major thrust faulting.
剖面沉积年代为25.7–17.5 Ma，倾角由50°向上减至10°的生长地层及底部砾岩始于约23 Ma，直接限定逆冲启动…

The syntectonic growth strata record comes from a single stratigraphic section, requiring compilation of independent regional thermochronological and structural datasets to verify its regional significance across the East Kunlun Mountains.
同构造生长地层记录仅来自单一剖面，需结合区域低温热年代学与构造数据验证其区域普遍性。

Provides the first high-density-sampling magnetostratigraphic chronology integrated with syntectonic growth strata in the northern East Kunlun Mountains, directly dating early Miocene thrust initiation to ca. 23 Ma.
首次在东昆仑山建立结合同构造生长地层的高密度早中新世磁性地层年代学，直接测定逆冲断层始于约23 Ma。

kc: Presents the first high-density-sampling early Miocene magnetostratigraphy (25.7–17.5 Ma) from the Wudaoliang Formation in the East Kunlun Mountains.
Directly constrains the onset of syntectonic growth strata and major thrust faulting to ca. 23 Ma (with tilting possibly starting at ca. 24.5 Ma).
Proposes a geodynamic model linking ca. 23 Ma upper-crustal thrusting to the obstruction and injection of northward-flowing weak Hoh Xil lower crust against the rigid Qaidam lithospheric keel.
建立了东昆仑山中新世五道梁组首个高密度早中新世磁性地层年代学框架（25.7–17.5 Ma）。
利用同构造生长地层直接限定东昆仑山主逆冲断层活动的起始时间约为23 Ma（倾斜可能始于约24.5 Ma）。
提出深部动力学模型，将约23 Ma的上地壳逆冲归因于可可西里软弱下地壳向北流动受到柴达木刚性岩石圈阻挡及挤入。
me: High-density paleomagnetic sampling, thermal demagnetization, and principal component analysis to isolate characteristic remanent magnetization (ChRM).
Rock magnetic experiments including temperature-dependent susceptibility heating curves, isothermal remanent magnetization (IRM) acquisition, and hysteresis loops.
Ostracod taxonomic identification and biostratigraphic correlation alongside regional radiometric age anchoring to the Geologic Time Scale 2020.
Structural cross-section logging of bedding dip variations to identify syntectonic growth strata geometry.
高密度古地磁采样、系统热退磁及主成分分析以分离特征剩磁（ChRM）。
岩石磁学实验，包括热磁曲线、等温剩磁（IRM）获得曲线和磁滞回线分析。
介形虫化石分类鉴定与生物地层对比，并结合区域同位素年代学锚点对比至2020地质年代表（GTS 2020）。
测量剖面地层产状倾角变化并进行构造横剖面分析，以识别同构造生长地层几何特征。
de: 609 oriented paleomagnetic samples collected from the ~850-m-thick Xiaohongshan (XHS) section (439 samples passed screening criteria for magnetostratigraphy).
14 ostracod fossil samples examined microscopically, yielding 11 species across 7 genera in three key specimens.
Compilation of regional low-temperature thermochronology, radiometric ages, and published seismic/magnetotelluric profiles across the Kunlun-Qaidam boundary.
采集自约850米厚小红山（XHS）剖面的609块定向古地磁样品（其中439块通过筛选用于建立磁性地层序列）。
14件介形虫微体化石样品显微镜检，在3个关键层位中鉴定出7属11种。
汇编了跨越昆仑-柴达木边界的区域低温热年代学、同位素年龄以及已发表的地震和大地电磁剖面数据。
li: Sedimentary growth strata observations are derived from a single localized stratigraphic section (Xiaohongshan), requiring regional thermochronological datasets to confirm broader spatial significance.
A long normal-polarity interval between 390 and 725 m depth introduces correlation complexity that requires external age anchors and biostratigraphy to resolve.
生长地层的沉积学观测来自单一局部剖面（小红山），需依赖区域热年代学数据集来验证其广泛的区域构造代表性。
剖面390至725米深度之间存在一段长正极性带，增加了极性对比的复杂性，需要外部同位素年龄锚点和生物地层学辅助约束。

tm.why: The study constrains the timing of upper crustal thrusting in northern Tibet and links it to deep lithospheric geodynamics, specifically northward lower-crustal flow obstructed by the rigid Qaidam lithosphere.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete 11-page PDF including text, figures, and references.

sum: This study reconciles advanced earthquake detection techniques across multiple monitoring scales at the Irpinia Near-Fault Observatory (INFO) in Southern Italy. The authors apply machine learning phase pickers (EQTransformer, PhaseNet), CNN polarity classifiers, and similarity-based template matching (EQCorrscan) to three datasets: the permanent 31-station INFO network (~10 km spacing), the 1-year DETECT deployment of 200 stations in 20 dense arrays (~100 m spacing), and two continuous DAS systems (~80 km total length, ~10 m channel spacing). For seismic sequences, combining EQTransformer with template matching yields 7x more events than manual catalogs and 21x more than automatic ones. For 1-year background seismicity with dense arrays, ML detection identifies ~3,600 earthquakes (~9x increase), lowering completeness magnitude by over one unit and resolving depth-dependent clustering, fault planes, and regional stress. Finally, single-station PhaseNet models are directly exported to native DAS strain-rate records, successfully detecting microseismicity despite higher noise thresholds.
本研究在意大利南部伊尔皮尼亚近断层观测站（INFO）跨越不同监测尺度融合了先进的地震检测技术。作者将机器学习震相拾取器（EQTransformer、PhaseNet）、CNN初动极性分类器及模板匹配（EQCorrscan）应用于三类数据：31个台站的永久台网（台间距~10 km）、为期1年包含200……

t: Integrates deep learning phase pickers (EQTransformer, PhaseNet) with template matching (EQCorrscan), phase associators (REAL, GAMMA), double-difference relocation, and CNN polarity-based focal mechanism stress inversion across network, array, and DAS scales.
跨台网、密集台阵与DAS尺度，融合深度学习震相拾取、模板匹配、双差重定位及CNN极性震源机制应力反演。

Multi-scale monitoring at the Irpinia Near-Fault Observatory: 31 permanent stations (~10 km spacing), 200 temporary stations in 20 dense arrays for 1 year (~100 m spacing), and 2 DAS cables (~80 km total, ~10 m spacing).
伊尔皮尼亚近断层观测站多尺度数据：31个永久台站、200个密集台阵临时台站（1年）及80 km双DAS系统。

EQT+TM yields 1,715 sequence events (7x manual). With 1-year dense arrays, ML identifies ~3.6k events (~9x increase), relocates ~2.3k (<150 m uncertainty), lowers Mc by >1 unit, and resolves 289 fault planes (R = 0.68 ± 0.07).
序列目录扩充至人工7倍；密集台阵1年识别约3600次地震（增9倍），完备震级降逾1级，反演289个断层面。
DAS records of microseismic events suffer from low signal-to-noise ratio and a higher detection threshold than seismic networks; the automatic network workflow also yields 23% false detections.
DAS微震记录信噪比低、检测阈值高于传统台网；台网自动关联流程仍存在约23%的虚假检测。

Reconciles and benchmarks ML detection, template matching, and automated source/stress characterization seamlessly across kilometric permanent networks, hectometric dense arrays, and decametric DAS cables in an active fault zone.
首次在活动断层带将机器学习检测与模板匹配从千米级台网、百米级密集台阵无缝拓展并验证至十米级DAS尺度。

kc: Demonstrated that combining EQTransformer and template matching (EQCorrscan) increases seismic sequence catalogs by 7x over manual and 21x over automatic catalogs.
Identified ~3,600 background earthquakes in 1 year (~9x increase) by integrating ML pickers with 200 temporary stations in 20 dense arrays (DETECT), reducing completeness magnitude by >1 unit.

Resolved depth-dependent seismicity behavior (sparse shallow hydrological events vs. clustered deeper stress-release sequences) and inverted 289 focal mechanisms to constrain the anti-Apenninic extensional stress field.
Exported single-station PhaseNet pickers and GAMMA association directly to native DAS strain-rate records across ~80 km of fiber in Irpinia.
证明结合EQTransformer与模板匹配（EQCorrscan）可将地震序列目录扩充至人工目录的7倍、自动目录的21倍。
通过将机器学习拾取器与20个密集台阵（200个临时台站，DETECT实验）结合，1年内识别出约3600次背景地震（增长约9倍），完备震级降低超过1个震级单位。
揭示了随深度变化的地震活动特征（浅部受水文调制呈稀疏分布，深部呈丛集应力释放序列），并利用289个震源机制解反演约束了反亚平宁方向的张性应力场。
将单台PhaseNet震相拾取器与GAMMA关联算法直接迁移应用于伊尔皮尼亚约80 km的原生DAS应变率记录。
me: Machine learning earthquake detection and P/S phase picking using EQTransformer and PhaseNet.
Template matching (EQCorrscan) initialized from conservative ML catalogs and subspace/similarity detection (FAST).
Phase association (REAL, GAMMA), absolute location (NLLoc, HYPO71), and double-difference relocation (uncertainties < 150 m).
Source characterization: seismic moment (M0) and corner frequency (fc via EGFs), CNN P-wave polarity estimation, FPFIT fault plane determination, and focal mechanism stress inversion.
利用EQTransformer和PhaseNet进行机器学习地震检测与P/S波震相拾取。
基于保守机器学习目录初始化的模板匹配（EQCorrscan）以及相似性检测（FAST）。
震相关联（REAL、GAMMA）、绝对定位（NLLoc、HYPO71）与双差重定位（定位不确定度 < 150 m）。
震源参数与机制表征：地震矩（M0）与拐角频率（基于经验格林函数EGF估算fc）、CNN初动极性估计、FPFIT断层面求解及震源机制应力场反演。
de: Permanent seismic network (INFO / ISNet) of 31 stations with ~10 km interstation distance monitoring deep crustal microseismicity (max Ml 4.1).
Temporary DETECT experiment: 200 stations deployed in 20 dense arrays (~100 m interstation distance) for 1 year.
Continuous monitoring with 2 DAS systems totaling ~80 km (20 km and 60 km fibers) with ~10 m interchannel spacing.
由31个台站组成的永久地震台网（INFO / ISNet，台间距~10 km），监测深部地壳微震活动（最大震级 Ml 4.1）。
临时DETECT实验：在20个密集台阵中布设200个台站（台间距~100 m），持续监测1年。
两套DAS系统（分别为20 km和60 km光缆，总长~80 km，道间距~10 m）的连续监测记录。
li: Microseismic events recorded on DAS exhibit a low signal-to-noise ratio, leading to a higher detection threshold compared to conventional seismic networks.
Automated PhaseNet + REAL workflows at INFO still produce ~23% false detections (480 out of 2,060 detections) and require locally trained or DAS-specific models.
DAS记录到的微震事件信噪比较低，导致其检测阈值高于传统地震台网。
INFO台网的PhaseNet + REAL自动工作流仍存在约23%的误检率（2060次检测中有480次虚假检测），亟需针对本地数据及DAS特性训练专用模型。

tm.why: The presentation focuses on enhancing seismic catalogs for background seismicity and sequences using ML phase pickers, template matching, and double-difference relocation.
The authors systematically evaluate and export deep learning models (EQTransformer, PhaseNet, CNN polarity pickers) across permanent networks, dense arrays, and DAS.
The work investigates exporting single-station ML pickers (PhaseNet) and association (GAMMA) directly to ~80 km of native DAS records in Irpinia.

ev.notes: Evaluated from the 22-page conference presentation PDF (44th GNGTS National Conference, Udine, Feb 2026) and the accompanying Zenodo abstract.

sum: This study develops high-resolution seismic site amplification maps for Sion, Switzerland, by combining 306 ambient-noise Horizontal-to-Vertical Spectral Ratio (HVSR) measurements with empirical amplification functions (SSR and ESM). Two statistical frameworks—Pearson correlation-based HVSR clustering and Canonical Correlation (CC) analysis—are interpolated via kriging and compared against independent hybrid standard spectral ratio (SSRh) estimates. Novel improvements to the CC method include expanded frequency binning (0.2–12 Hz for HVSR) and incorporating the valley depth-to-width shape ratio as a morphometric proxy to account for 2D/3D Alpine basin resonance. Results show all methods consistently identify strong low-frequency amplification in the central Rhone valley controlled by deep basin geometry. CC outperforms clustering in spatial pattern agreement and statistical error (lower NRMSE), though CC and clustering systematically underestimate peak amplification relative to SSRh by factors of ~2.5 and ~1.5, respectively, highlighting regression smoothing limits in deep basins.
本研究结合306个环境噪声水平与垂直谱比（HVSR）测量和经验放大函数（SSR和ESM），为瑞士锡永开发了高分辨率地震场地放大图。研究采用皮尔逊相关聚类和典型相关分析（CC）两种统计方法，结合克里金插值，并与混合标准谱比（SSRh）进行对比。创新点在于改进了CC方法，扩展了HVSR频率分箱，并引入山……

t: Combines ambient-noise HVSR clustering (Pearson correlation plus goodness-of-fit) and multivariate Canonical Correlation (CC) with kriging interpolation to predict frequency-dependent site amplification functions across an Alpine valley.
将环境噪声HVSR聚类与多元典型相关分析（CC）及克里金插值相结合，预测高山河谷中随频率变化的场地放大函数。
Uses 306 ambient vibration HVSR measurements in Sion, local SSR and SSRh functions from 9 seismic stations, and a Swiss national training dataset of 211 stations with ESM and HVSR.
使用锡永306个环境振动HVSR测量、9个台站的SSR/SSRh数据，以及包含211个台站ESM和HVSR的瑞士全国训练…

All methods map highest low-frequency amplification in the central valley. CC best matches SSRh spatial patterns (NRMSE 0.5276–0.5953) but underestimates peak amplitudes by ~2.5x; Pearson clustering underestimates by ~1.5x.
各方法均显示河谷中心低频放大最强。CC与SSRh空间分布最吻合，但峰值低估约2.5倍；皮尔逊聚类法低估约1.5倍。
National-scale CC regression suffers from regression-to-the-mean bias in deep 2D/3D basins, and azimuthally averaged HVSRs neglect directional wavefield effects and basin-edge diffractions.
全国尺度CC回归在深部二维/三维盆地存在均值回归偏差，且方位角平均HVSR忽略了方向性波场效应。

Improves Canonical Correlation site-response prediction by incorporating the valley depth-to-width shape ratio as a morphometric proxy for 2D/3D basin effects and expanding complementary HVSR frequency bins.
通过引入表征二维/三维盆地效应的山谷深宽形状比代理指标并扩展HVSR频率分箱，改进了典型相关场地响应预测。

kc: Developed high-resolution site amplification maps (at 0.5, 1.0, 2.0, and 5.0 Hz) for the Alpine basin of Sion, Switzerland, combining 306 ambient noise HVSRs with earthquake-derived empirical amplification functions.

Enhanced the Canonical Correlation (CC) method for Switzerland by expanding the training dataset to 211 stations, extending HVSR frequency bins (0.2–12.0 Hz), and introducing valley shape ratio (depth-to-half-width) as a proxy for 2D/3D basin resonance.

Systematically compared Pearson correlation clustering, CC, and hybrid standard spectral ratios (SSRh), demonstrating that CC best captures spatial trends among statistical approaches despite underestimating extreme basin-center amplitudes by a factor of ~2.5.
结合306个环境噪声HVSR与地震经验放大函数，为瑞士锡永高山盆地开发了0.5、1.0、2.0和5.0 Hz的高分辨率场地放大图。
通过将训练集扩展至211个台站、拓宽HVSR频率范围（0.2–12.0 Hz）以及引入山谷形状比（深宽比）作为二维/三维盆地共振代理指标，改进了瑞士典型相关分析（CC）模型。
系统对比了皮尔逊相关聚类、CC和混合标准谱比（SSRh），证明CC在统计方法中对空间趋势的捕捉最佳，但对盆地中心极端放大低估约2.5倍。
me: Horizontal-to-Vertical Spectral Ratio (HVSR) analysis on 30-min ambient vibration recordings using Geopsy (0.2–20 Hz, Konno-Ohmachi smoothing b=40).
Pearson correlation and goodness-of-fit clustering of f0-normalized HVSR curves around 8 reference seismic station centroids, mapped via Voronoi cells and exponential kriging.

Canonical Correlation (CC) multivariate regression relating binned HVSR (0.2–12 Hz) and site proxies (VS30, Last Glacial Maximum thickness, valley shape ratio h/l) to Empirical Spectral Modelling (ESM) amplification (0.5–10 Hz), mapped via spherical kriging.
Cross-comparison and consistency evaluation against hybrid Standard Spectral Ratio (SSRh) maps using Nugget-to-Sill Ratio (NSR) and Normalized Root Mean Squared Error (NRMSE).
使用Geopsy对30分钟环境振动记录进行水平与垂直谱比（HVSR）分析（0.2–20 Hz，Konno-Ohmachi平滑参数b=40）。
以8个参考地震台站为质心，对f0归一化的HVSR曲线进行皮尔逊相关与拟合优度聚类，并利用Voronoi单元和指数克里金法制图。
利用典型相关分析（CC）多元回归，将分箱HVSR（0.2–12 Hz）及场地代理指标（VS30、末次盛冰期厚度、山谷形状比h/l）与经验谱模拟（ESM）放大函数（0.5–10 Hz）关联，并采用球面克里金法制图。
利用块金基台比（NSR）和归一化均方根误差（NRMSE），与混合标准谱比（SSRh）图进行交叉对比与一致性评估。
de: 306 single-station ambient vibration measurements in the Sion (Rhone valley) area collected during SHAKE-VAL, SSMNet, and Risk Model Switzerland campaigns.

SSR and SSRh datasets from 4 permanent SSMNet and 5 temporary broadband stations operating between 2018 and 2022 in Sion (referenced to rock station SIOV and adjusted to Swiss reference rock VS30 = 1100 m/s).
National calibration dataset of 211 Swiss seismic stations with paired ESM amplification functions, HVSR curves, VS30, LGM thickness, and morphometric shape ratios across 6365 basin transects.
在SHAKE-VAL、SSMNet和瑞士风险模型项目中收集的锡永（罗纳河谷）地区306个单台环境振动测量数据。
2018至2022年间锡永地区4个永久SSMNet台站和5个临时宽频带台站的SSR和SSRh数据集（以基岩台SIOV为参考并校正至瑞士参考基岩VS30 = 1100 m/s）。
包含211个瑞士地震台站的全国校准数据集，配有成对的ESM放大函数、HVSR曲线、VS30、LGM厚度以及横跨6365条盆地剖面的形态学形状比。
li: Both CC and Pearson clustering systematically underestimate maximum amplification compared to SSRh (by factors of ~2.5 and ~1.5, respectively) due to regression-to-the-mean bias and smoothing of extreme 2D/3D Alpine basin effects.
Pearson correlation clustering normalizes HVSR by fundamental frequency (f0), which can force shallow and deep sediment sites into the same cluster and increase heterogeneity near basin edges.
All applied methods use azimuthally averaged spectral ratios, ignoring directional amplification and azimuthal variability caused by complex 2D/3D wave propagation and basin-edge diffraction.
由于向均值回归偏差以及对极端二维/三维高山盆地效应的平滑，CC和皮尔逊聚类相对于SSRh系统性地低估了最大放大倍数（分别低估约2.5倍和1.5倍）。
皮尔逊相关聚类对HVSR进行了基频（f0）归一化，这可能会将浅层和深层沉积物场地强行归入同一簇，并增加盆地边缘附近的异质性。
所有采用的方法均使用方位角平均谱比，忽略了由复杂二维/三维波传播和盆地边缘衍射引起的方向性放大和方位角变化。

tm.why: The study focuses on developing high-resolution seismic site amplification maps for seismic hazard assessment and microzonation in Sion, Switzerland.
The core data consists of 306 single-station ambient vibration measurements processed using the Horizontal-to-Vertical Spectral Ratio (HVSR) technique.

ev.notes: Full 14-page PDF article from Engineering Geology (ETH Library repository version) was read and analyzed, including all equations, methodology sections, and 10 figures.

sum: Visibility graph analysis (VGA) links the connectivity degree-magnitude slope (k-M_slope) of earthquake catalogues to the Gutenberg-Richter (G-R) b-value, but results are biased by temporal event ordering and catalogue size (N). This paper generalizes the k-M_slope-b relationship using 8,400 synthetic G-R catalogues across 42 combinations of N (100 to 5,000) and b-value (0.6 to 1.8), each randomly shuffled 200 times in the natural time domain. The authors show that shuffled k-M_slope distributions are Gaussian, become size-independent for N >= 2,000, and yield a robust multi-parameter regression (R^2_adj = 0.980) for predicting b-values even in smaller catalogues. Applied to ten diverse real earthquake catalogues (tectonic, volcanic, and induced), the framework validates classical b-value estimates and uses Z-score deviations from shuffled and expected baselines to diagnose peculiar temporal clustering of large events or departures from the exponential G-R law.
可视图分析（VGA）将地震目录的连通度-震级斜率（k-M_slope）与G-R定律的b值相关联，但受发震顺序和目录大小（N）影响。本文利用42组不同N（100–5,000）和b值（0.6–1.8）的模拟目录，在自然时间域对每个目录进行200次随机重排（共8,400个目录），推广了三者间的定量关系。结……

t: Applies undirected natural-time visibility graph analysis to 200 randomly shuffled permutations of earthquake catalogues, using multi-parameter regression of mean and standard deviation of k-M_slope and catalogue size N to estimate b-values.
在自然时间域对200次随机重排的地震目录进行可视图分析，通过k-M_slope均值、标准差和目录大小N多元回归估计b值。

8,400 synthetic Gutenberg-Richter catalogues covering 42 combinations of size N (100 to 5,000) and b-value (0.6 to 1.8), plus ten real earthquake catalogues spanning geothermal, induced, volcanic, and tectonic settings.
包含42种大小（100至5,000）和b值（0.6至1.8）组合的8,400个合成目录，以及涵盖地热、诱发、火山和构造背…

Shuffled k-M_slope correlates linearly with b-value and converges for N >= 2,000 (coefficient of variation < 2%); multi-variable regression predicts b-value with R^2_adj = 0.980 and identifies anomalous sequences or G-R departures in five of ten real catalogues.
重排k-M_slope与b值呈线性相关并在N>=2,000时收敛（变异系数<2%）；多元回归预测b值的R^2_adj达0…

VGA has quadratic time complexity, and the Z-score p-values comparing observed and expected k-M_slope are only a complementary diagnostic tool rather than a formal quantitative test of G-R compliance.
可视图转换具有二次时间复杂度，且Z分数p值仅能作为检验G-R定律适用性的补充诊断工具而非严格定量检验。

Generalizes the k-M_slope–b-value relationship across varying catalogue sizes while removing sequential-order bias via random shuffling, turning sequence-order deviations into a diagnostic metric for anomalous clustering and G-R departures.
通过随机重排消除了发震顺序偏差并推广了跨目录尺度的k-M_slope-b关系，同时将序列偏差转化为异常丛集和G-R偏离的…

kc: Quantified the joint dependence of visibility graph k-M_slope and its dispersion on Gutenberg-Richter b-value and catalogue size N using 8,400 shuffled synthetic catalogues.
Established that 200 random shufflings remove sequence-order bias and achieve a normal distribution, and that catalogue size effects become negligible above N >= 2,000 events.
Derived a multi-variable regression model linking b-value to mean k-M_slope, its standard deviation, and log10(N) with R^2_adj = 0.980.

Demonstrated on ten real catalogues that Z-score deviations between original, shuffled, and expected k-M_slope values diagnose low-probability magnitude ordering and non-G-R frequency-magnitude distributions.
利用8,400个随机打乱的合成地震目录，量化了可视图k-M_slope及其离散度对G-R定律b值和目录大小N的联合依赖关系。
证明了200次随机重排可消除序列顺序偏差并保证正态分布，且当事件数N>=2,000时目录大小的影响可忽略不计。
建立了将b值与k-M_slope均值、标准差及log10(N)相关联的多元回归模型（调整后R^2达0.980）。
在10个真实地震目录中证明了原始值、打乱均值和期望值之间的Z分数偏差可用于诊断低概率震级排序及偏离G-R分布的特征。
me: Natural-time undirected Visibility Graph Analysis (VGA) transforming event magnitudes into network connectivity degrees k.
Monte Carlo random permutation (200 shufflings per catalogue) to decouple frequency-magnitude distribution from sequential order bias.
Multiple linear regression and leave-one-out cross-validation (LOOCV) relating b-value, log10(N), mean k-M_slope, and standard deviation of k-M_slope.
Statistical hypothesis testing using Shapiro-Wilk normality tests and Z-score p-values to detect anomalous sequences and G-R deviations.
采用自然时间域无向可视图分析（VGA），将地震震级序列转换为网络节点连通度k。
利用蒙特卡洛随机置换（每个目录打乱200次）将震级-频度分布与发震顺序偏差解耦。
采用多元线性回归与留一法交叉验证（LOOCV），建立b值、log10(N)、k-M_slope均值及标准差之间的预测模型。
结合Shapiro-Wilk正态性检验和Z分数p值进行统计假设检验，以检测异常发震序列和G-R定律偏离。
de: 42 synthetic Gutenberg-Richter earthquake catalogues (N = 100, 200, 500, 1,000, 2,000, 5,000; b = 0.6 to 1.8 in steps of 0.2; 0.1 magnitude binning) shuffled 200 times each (8,400 catalogues total).
Synthetic sensitivity experiments repositioning the top <=1% largest magnitude events into clustered or boundary arrangements in a 5,000-event (b = 1.0) catalogue.

Ten real earthquake catalogues spanning geothermal, gas-field, reservoir-induced, volcanic, and tectonic settings (Lavey-les-bains, Basel, Saint Gallen, Etna, Groningen, El Hierro, Adriatic offshore, Pertusillo lake, Campi Flegrei, La Palma).
在N=5,000、b=1.0的合成目录中，通过人工调整前1%最大震级事件的位置（丛集或置于首尾）进行敏感性实验。
涵盖地热、气田、水库诱发、火山及构造地震背景的10个真实地震目录（Lavey-les-bains、Basel、Saint Gallen、Etna、Groningen、El Hierro、Adriatic offshore、Pertusillo lake、Campi Flegrei、La Palma）。
li: VGA transformation has quadratic time complexity, making repeated permutations computationally expensive for very large catalogues.
The Z-score p-values comparing observed and expected k-M_slope serve only as a qualitative diagnostic indicator of G-R departure rather than a formal quantitative compliance test.
Real catalogues remain susceptible to short-term aftershock incompleteness and spatial mixing of seismic zones, which can confound G-R departure interpretations.
可视图转换具有二次时间复杂度，对于超大规模地震目录进行多次随机置换计算成本较高。
对比观测与期望k-M_slope的Z分数p值目前仅能作为偏离G-R定律的补充诊断工具，尚不能替代严格的定量统计检验。
真实地震目录易受短期余震不完备性及不同地震区混合的影响，可能干扰对偏离G-R趋势原因的解释。

tm.why: The paper develops and tests a generalized visibility graph analysis method for characterizing the statistical properties of synthetic and real earthquake catalogues.
The study provides an independent method to estimate and validate the Gutenberg-Richter b-value, which is a key input for probabilistic seismic hazard assessment.
Several of the ten real case-study catalogues analyzed are induced and anthropogenic seismicity sequences from geothermal basins, gas fields, and water reservoirs.

ev.notes: Full 37-page manuscript PDF analyzed, including abstract, main text (§1–§6), Equations 1–6, Figures 1–9, and Tables 1–5.

sum: Understanding shallow magmatic-hydrothermal systems is vital for interpreting volcanic unrest. Using a dense deployment of 196 three-component nodal geophones over one month during the 2021 unrest at Vulcano Island (Italy), the authors detected 13,527 events via QuakeMigrate, refined 7,744 with HYPOELLIPSE, and isolated 1,749 volcano-tectonic earthquakes using a frequency-index filter. Applying the LOTOS iterative bending ray-tracing tomography algorithm to 91,716 P and S travel times, they produced the first high-resolution 3D Vp, Vs, and Vp/Vs models of the island, improving spatial resolution fivefold horizontally and threefold vertically over prior regional studies. Results reveal high Vp/Vs (>1.8) domains (H1–H3) representing liquid-rich hydrothermal pathways, alongside two vertically segmented low Vp/Vs (<1.6–1.72) anomalies (L1, L2) beneath La Fossa representing gas/vapor-dominated reservoirs. The deeper L2 anomaly coincides with very-long-period (VLP) seismicity hypocenters, linking volatile accumulation and pressurization to long-period seismic generation.
本研究利用2021年意大利武尔卡诺岛火山动荡期间布设的196个密集三分量节点地震仪1个月的数据，通过QuakeMigrate检测、HYPOELLIPSE重定位及频率指数筛选出1749个火山构造地震（共91,716条P、S波走时）。应用LOTOS弯曲射线追踪算法，构建了该岛首个高分辨率三维Vp、Vs和……

t: Seismicity is detected via QuakeMigrate, relocated with HYPOELLIPSE, filtered by Frequency Index (FI > -0.12) to isolate VT events, and inverted for 3D Vp, Vs, and Vp/Vs using LOTOS iterative bending ray-tracing across four rotated grids.
经QuakeMigrate检测、HYPOELLIPSE重定位和频率指数筛选VT事件后，用LOTOS弯曲射线追踪反演三维速…

One month of continuous 250 Hz waveforms from 196 three-component SmartSolo nodal geophones across Vulcano and Lipari during October–November 2021, yielding 1,708 retained VT events and 91,716 P and S ray paths.
2021年10-11月武尔卡诺和利帕里岛196个三分量节点检波器数据，含1708个VT事件和91716条走时射线。

Tomography resolves fluid-rich high Vp/Vs (>1.8) domains (H1–H3) above -1 km a.s.l. and two gas-dominated low Vp/Vs (<1.6) anomalies (L1 at 0 to -1 km, L2 at -1 to -2.5 km) beneath La Fossa, with daily VT and LP-VLP counts correlated at r = 0.86.
解析出高Vp/Vs(>1.8)富液区H1-H3及La Fossa下方低Vp/Vs(<1.6)富气区L1和L2，VT与LP…
Spatial resolution degrades rapidly below -1 km a.s.l. where ray coverage is sparse, and independent Vp and Vs inversions amplify Vp/Vs uncertainty in poorly constrained zones.
-1 km以下射线稀疏区分辨率迅速下降，且Vp与Vs独立反演放大了约束较差区域的Vp/Vs不确定性。

First nodal 3D local earthquake travel-time tomography of a volcano during unrest, improving spatial resolution 5x horizontally and 3x vertically at Vulcano and linking segmented gas conduits to VLP seismicity.
首次对动荡期火山开展节点三维地方震走时成像，水平和垂直分辨率分别提升5倍和3倍。

kc: First high-resolution 3D Vp, Vs, and Vp/Vs models of Vulcano Island derived from a dense 196-station nodal seismic network during the 2021 volcanic unrest.
Identification of high Vp/Vs (>1.8) anomalies corresponding to fluid-rich, mechanically weak hydrothermal domains beneath Lipari, Vulcanello, La Fossa, and Il Piano.
Discovery of a segmented subvertical low Vp/Vs (<1.6) conduit system (anomalies L1 and L2) beneath La Fossa interpreted as gas- or vapor-dominated reservoirs.
Demonstration of a spatial and temporal link between the deeper gas-rich reservoir (L2), transient pressurization, volcano-tectonic seismicity, and very-long-period (VLP) events.
利用2021年火山动荡期间196个密集节点地震台网数据，构建了武尔卡诺岛首个高分辨率三维Vp、Vs和Vp/Vs模型。
识别出Lipari、Vulcanello、La Fossa和Il Piano下方对应于富流体、力学薄弱热液区的高Vp/Vs（>1.8）异常。
发现La Fossa下方分段的近垂直低Vp/Vs（<1.6）通道系统（L1和L2异常），解释为富气或富蒸汽储层。
证实了较深富气储层（L2）、瞬态增压、火山构造地震与超长周期（VLP）事件之间的时空联系。
me: Automated waveform migration and coalescence earthquake detection/location using QuakeMigrate with recursive STA/LTA onset functions.
Hypocentral relocation and quality filtering using HYPOELLIPSE followed by Frequency Index (FI) classification to separate VT from LP/VLP events.
Iterative 3D local earthquake travel-time tomography using the LOTOS bending ray-tracing algorithm across four rotated grids (0°, 22°, 45°, 67°).
Synthetic checkerboard resolution testing (1.7 km × 1.7 km × 2.79 km anomalies) with Gaussian travel-time noise.
使用基于递归STA/LTA特征函数的QuakeMigrate进行自动波形偏移与凝聚地震检测及定位。
使用HYPOELLIPSE进行震源重定位与质量过滤，并结合频率指数（FI）分类以分离VT和LP/VLP事件。
使用LOTOS弯曲射线追踪算法在四个旋转网格（0°、22°、45°、67°）上进行迭代三维地方震走时层析成像。
添加高斯走时噪声进行合成棋盘分辨率测试（异常体尺寸1.7 km × 1.7 km × 2.79 km）。
de: Continuous seismic waveforms from 196 three-component short-period SmartSolo nodal geophones (172 on Vulcano, 24 on Lipari) sampled at 250 Hz from 16 October to 16 November 2021.
Catalog of 13,527 initially detected events, refined to 7,744 relocated events, and filtered to 1,749 high-frequency VT events (FI > -0.12).
91,716 retained travel-time ray paths (44,355 P and 47,361 S picks) from 1,708 final VT earthquakes.
2021年10月16日至11月16日期间布设的196个三分量短周期SmartSolo节点检波器（武尔卡诺岛172个，利帕里岛24个）250 Hz连续波形数据。
初步检测出13,527个事件，重定位精炼至7,744个事件，并通过频率指数（FI > -0.12）筛选出1,749个高频VT事件。
来自1,708个最终VT地震的91,716条保留走时射线路径（44,355个P波和47,361个S波拾取）。
li: Rapid degradation of spatial resolution below -1 km a.s.l. outside the high-seismicity La Fossa cone, especially between Lipari and Vulcano where ray crossing is sparse.
Amplified uncertainty in the Vp/Vs ratio wherever either Vp or Vs is poorly constrained because the two velocity fields are inverted independently.
Inability to directly use LP and VLP events in travel-time tomography due to emergent, lower-frequency phase arrivals.
在地震密集的La Fossa火山锥以外区域（特别是射线稀疏的Lipari和Vulcano之间），海拔-1 km以下的空间分辨率迅速退化。
由于Vp和Vs独立反演，在任一速度场约束较差的地方，Vp/Vs比值的不确定性会被放大。
由于LP和VLP事件震相初动缓慢且频率较低，无法直接用于走时层析成像。

tm.why: The paper constructs 3D Vp, Vs, and Vp/Vs models of Vulcano Island using local earthquake travel-time tomography with the LOTOS algorithm.
The study images the shallow magmatic-hydrothermal plumbing system of Vulcano Island during the 2021 volcanic unrest and links velocity anomalies to VLP seismicity and degassing.
The authors detect, relocate, and classify thousands of volcano-tectonic and long-period seismic events using QuakeMigrate, HYPOELLIPSE, and frequency-index filtering.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete 10-page GRL PDF including text, equations, figures, references, and erratum.

sum: This presentation outlines the mid-term achievements and strategic goals of the TRANSFORM2 Horizon Europe project, which aims to advance eight (plus one candidate) European Near-Fault Observatories (NFOs) within EPOS. The project rests on four pillars: (1) innovative multidisciplinary instrumentation, including high-rate multi-constellation GNSS, EMFIT ferroelectric acoustic emission sensors, quadrupole mass spectrometers for trace gases, unpowered optical ocean-bottom seismometers (OBS) with buoy telemetry, and low-cost single-PCB seismic nodes; (2) automated open-source workflows using deep learning and Bayesian methods for waveform denoising (EQS-Denoiser), unsupervised detection (RECOVAR), phase picking with calibrated uncertainties, GaMMA association, DAS processing (PhaseNet-DAS, ResNet-18, SPAR), and source characterization (DiTingMotion, SKHASH, Bayesian focal mechanisms, Gisola CMT); (3) next-generation Earthquake Early Warning (EEW) integrating DAS, GNSS, and unified decision modules; and (4) real-world test-bed demonstrations across European NFOs alongside a sustainability 'White Book'.
本文介绍了欧盟“地平线欧洲”TRANSFORM2项目的中期成果与战略目标，旨在升级欧洲板块观测系统（EPOS）下的近断层观测站（NFOs）。项目涵盖四大支柱：（1）研发高频GNSS、铁电薄膜声发射传感器、地球化学质谱仪、无源光纤海底地震仪（OBS）及低成本单PCB地震仪等新型多学科仪器；（2）开发基……

t: The project develops multidisciplinary NFO sensors (GNSS, acoustic emission, geochemical, optical OBS, low-cost nodes), open-source ML workflows for seismic/DAS detection and source characterization, and multi-algorithm Earthquake Early Warning decision modules.
研发多学科NFO传感器、用于地震与DAS检测及震源表征的开源机器学习工作流，以及多算法融合的地震预警决策模块。

Experiments utilize data from eight European EPOS Near-Fault Observatories (e.g., CRL Corinth Rift, Irpinia 80 km DAS cable, Marmara, Valais, Vrancea, TABOO), STEAD/INSTANCE benchmarks, and a 1-50 Hz GNSS shake-table in Timisoara.
使用欧洲8个EPOS近断层观测站（如科林斯裂谷、Irpinia 80公里DAS、马尔马拉等）、STEAD基准库及蒂米什瓦…

EQS-Denoiser extends catalogs by 2.8x; calibrated PhaseNet achieves P: 0.029s and S: 0.042s MAD; GaMMA matches 3,566 CRL events (~1 km shift); ResNet-18 DAS classifier hits 100% accuracy; Gisola CMT matches 531 events.
去噪器将目录扩展2.8倍；拾取MAD达P波0.029秒；关联匹配3566个事件；DAS分类准确率100%；CMT匹配53…
Some NFOs currently lack the dense infrastructure required for operational EEW, and low-cost seismic PCB prototypes require ongoing field validation from Q2 2026 onwards.
部分NFO尚缺乏预警基础设施，且低成本地震仪PCB原型仍需在2026年第二季度后完成野外长期验证。

Combines novel unpowered optical OBS, ferroelectric acoustic sensors, and geochemical spectrometers with DAS/seismic deep learning workflows and unified EEW decision modules across European NFO test-beds.
在欧洲NFO测试平台中首次将无源光学OBS、声发射与地球化学传感器、DAS深度学习工作流及统一预警模块深度集成。

kc: Design and validation of five novel NFO sensor systems: high-rate GNSS, EMFIT acoustic emission sensors, Hiden HPR-20 geochemical mass spectrometers, optical OBS with moored buoy, and ETHZ low-cost seismic prototypes.
Development of open-source ML workflows (EQS-Denoiser, RECOVAR, calibrated PhaseNet, GaMMA) that extend seismic catalogs by 2.8x and match 3,566 events during the Corinth Rift crisis.
Adaptation of deep learning and probabilistic spectral inversion to DAS cables (PhaseNet-DAS, ResNet-18 spectrogram classifier with 100% test accuracy, SPAR Bayesian inversion).
Automated source characterization tools covering P-polarity CNNs, shear-wave splitting, SKHASH/Bayesian focal mechanisms, high-rate GNSS PPP benchmarking, and Gisola CMT inversions (531 events).
Integration of non-traditional sensors (DAS, high-rate GNSS) and unified decision modules into European NFO Earthquake Early Warning test-beds.
设计并验证了五种新型NFO传感器系统：高频GNSS、EMFIT声发射传感器、Hiden HPR-20地球化学质谱仪、带系泊浮标的光纤海底地震仪以及ETHZ低成本地震仪原型。
开发了开源机器学习工作流（EQS-Denoiser、RECOVAR、校准PhaseNet、GaMMA），将地震目录扩展了2.8倍，并在科林斯裂谷地震危机中匹配了3566个事件。
将深度学习与概率谱反演应用于DAS光缆（PhaseNet-DAS、测试准确率达100%的ResNet-18时频图分类器、SPAR贝叶斯反演）。
构建了自动震源表征工具，涵盖初动极性CNN、横波分裂、SKHASH/贝叶斯震源机制、高频GNSS PPP基准测试及Gisola矩心矩张量反演（531个事件）。
将非传统传感器（DAS、高频GNSS）与统一决策模块集成到欧洲NFO地震预警测试平台中。
me: Multi-disciplinary hardware prototyping and shake-table/field validation (1-50 Hz PPP GNSS, 0.07-50 Hz EMFIT ferroelectric film, Fabry-Perot optical interferometry OBS, RoadRunner SOM PCB).

Deep learning for continuous 3C waveform denoising (U-Net EQS-Denoiser), unsupervised autoencoder cross-covariance detection (RECOVAR), and calibrated PhaseNet picking with Bayesian Gaussian Mixture association (GaMMA).
2D U-Net spatio-temporal picking (PhaseNet-DAS), ResNet-18 transfer learning on FK-denoised spectrograms, and SPAR Bayesian spectral inversion for DAS strain-rate records.

Automated earthquake source characterization via DiTingMotion CNN, Eigenvalue/Rotation-Correlation shear-wave splitting, SKHASH and Bayesian focal mechanism inversion, Gisola CMT inversion, and Hybrid Integral-Composite (HIC) finite-fault modeling.
多学科硬件原型设计与振动台/野外验证（1-50 Hz PPP GNSS、0.07-50 Hz EMFIT铁电薄膜、法布里-珀罗光学干涉OBS、RoadRunner SOM单板设计）。
用于连续三分量波形去噪的U-Net（EQS-Denoiser）、无监督自编码器互协方差检测（RECOVAR），以及结合贝叶斯高斯混合关联（GaMMA）的校准PhaseNet震相拾取。
针对DAS应变率记录的2D U-Net时空拾取（PhaseNet-DAS）、基于FK去噪时频图的ResNet-18迁移学习，以及SPAR贝叶斯谱反演。
通过DiTingMotion CNN、特征值/旋转相关横波分裂、SKHASH与贝叶斯震源机制反演、Gisola CMT反演以及混合积分复合（HIC）有限断层建模实现自动震源表征。
de: Timisoara comprehensive shake-table experiment benchmarking geodetic and low-cost GNSS receivers at 1-50 Hz using real strong-motion records (Greece, Italy, Poland, Romania) and synthetic waves.

Field validation of EMFIT acoustic emission sensor during the 2025 Mw 6.2 Marmara Sea earthquake, Hiden mass spectrometer at Naftia geochemical site, and optical OBS test site selection offshore Patras (30-35 m depth).
ML algorithm benchmarking on Swiss earthquake data, STEAD/INSTANCE datasets, and the Dec 2020 - Mar 2021 Corinth Rift (CRL-NFO) seismic crisis.
DAS algorithm testing on an 80 km fibre at Irpinia NFO (9.6 m spacing, 200 Hz) and generalization testing on Chile DAS data.
蒂米什瓦拉综合振动台实验，利用真实强震记录（希腊、意大利、波兰、罗马尼亚）和合成波在1-50 Hz下对大地测量型和低成本GNSS接收机进行基准测试。

sum: Traditional passive acoustic monitoring of marine ecosystems using hydrophones is spatially limited and logistically demanding. This study explores Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) for fish bioacoustics using a 505-m bespoke armored fiber-optic cable deployed for 7 days off Monaco, alongside a co-located hydrophone. Using spectrogram, frequency-distance, and octave-band analyses (63–1000 Hz), the authors successfully detect and localize acoustic calls from three Mediterranean fish species (Sciaena umbra, Epinephelus marginatus, and Ophidion rochei) plus an unidentified long tonal call over tens of meters. Sandy seabeds yield optimal coupling and signal clarity, whereas rocky substrates induce cable suspension and swell noise. An empirical transfer function between hydrophone sound pressure levels and DAS strain-rate levels demonstrates a stable response below 500 Hz (88.55–96.14 dB). This novel proof-of-concept shows that seafloor DAS can complement hydrophones by providing continuous, meter-scale spatial mapping of marine biophony and anthropogenic noise.

sum: This study investigates the origin of the lunar Dewar magnetic anomaly and its implications for the ancient lunar dynamo. By jointly inverting orbital gravity and magnetic observations, the authors identify a shallow, highly magnetized, high-density body beneath the Dewar swirl, consistent with buried mare basalt. The inversion results require a paleointensity exceeding 11 microtesla, suggesting that an active core dynamo existed approximately 4.2 billion years ago, constrained by superposed basin ejecta. Additionally, the study shows that the formation of the Dewar swirl requires horizontal magnetization and iron oxide enrichment. These findings establish a direct link between a specific lunar magnetic anomaly and its magmatic origin, providing crucial constraints on the Moon's early volcanic and magnetic history.
本研究联合反演轨道重力和磁力数据，探讨月球Dewar磁异常的成因。在Dewar旋涡下方发现了一个浅层、高磁化、高密度的埋藏月海玄武岩体。反演结果表明古磁场强度超11微特斯拉，证实约42亿年前存在活跃的月球发电机。研究还指出旋涡形成需水平磁化和氧化铁富集，为月球早期火山与磁场演化提供了关键约束。

sum: This data publication presents a comprehensive collection of video footage, marker files, and seismic/acoustic event files from the 2021 Geldingadalir eruption in Iceland, focusing on the critical events of July 2, 2021. During this period, the eruptive crater drained, triggering inner crater collapses and tephra-rich plumes. The dataset includes marker files detailing the timing of these plumes and collapses, a table of collapse durations and widths, and event files for the eight largest seismic and acoustic events. Additionally, it features two hours of merged webcam video footage and a video synchronizing volcanic activity with a seismic spectrogram. This dataset is highly valuable for studying volcanic processes, crater stability, and the multiparametric signatures of eruptive collapses.
该数据集收集了2021年冰岛火山喷发的视频、标记和事件文件，重点记录7月2日火山口排空引发的内部塌陷与羽流。数据包括塌陷与羽流的起止时间标记、塌陷尺寸表，以及8个最大地震和声学事件文件。此外，还包含2小时监控视频及火山活动与地震谱图同步视频。该多源数据集对研究火山塌陷动力学及声震耦合机制具有重要价值……

sum: This study re-evaluates the source characteristics, shaking distribution, and ground failure of the 1886 Charleston, South Carolina, earthquake—the largest historical event in the eastern United States. By analyzing historical societal, geological, and geophysical datasets, the author refutes previous claims that dynamic strain alone caused the extensive railway deformation observed during the event. Instead, the study demonstrates that dynamic strain-induced ground failure requires an intermediate liquefaction step to deform rails. This finding resolves inconsistencies in previous source and shaking interpretations and has significant implications for modern seismic hazard assessment, building codes, and the engineering design of linear infrastructure like railways.

sum: Natural hazard forecasting is inherently uncertain due to open-system complexity and incomplete knowledge. Drawing from the Italian RETURN multi-risk project, a multidisciplinary task force of scientists, communicators, and decision-makers addresses the lack of shared terminology and procedures for handling uncertainty across hazards (including earthquakes, floods, volcanoes, and marine systems). The authors introduce the concept of a 'complete forecast,' which explicitly separates aleatory variability (linked to an observable data-generating process via exchangeable sequences) from epistemic uncertainty (represented by an ensemble of forecast distributions, or Extended Experts' Distribution, EED). They illustrate this unified probabilistic framework using flood discharges, 50-year seismic peak ground acceleration at L'Aquila (MPS19), and marine biogeochemical simulations. Furthermore, the paper outlines a comprehensive evaluation flowchart distinguishing forecast consistency, calibration, and validation, and synthesizes insights from 32 risk-communication professionals to bridge the gap between probabilistic scientific outputs and Boolean decision-making.
受系统复杂性和认知局限影响，自然灾害预测存在固有不确定性。基于意大利RETURN多灾种项目，跨学科工作组致力于解决不同灾害（地震、洪水、火山、海洋等）在不确定性处理上缺乏统一术语和流程的问题。论文提出“完整预测”概念，利用统一概率框架将随机变异性（基于可交换序列的数据生成过程）与认知不确定性（由多模……

t: A unified probabilistic framework defines aleatory variability via exchangeable data-generating sequences and quantifies epistemic uncertainty across multiple models using an Extended Experts' Distribution (EED) over exceedance probabilities.
利用可交换数据生成序列定义随机变异性，并通过超越概率的扩展专家分布（EED）量化多模型认知不确定性。

Demonstrated on Kamp River annual peak flood discharges (1951–2021), L'Aquila 50-year seismic peak ground acceleration from 11 MPS19 models, marine biogeochemical ensembles, and 32 communication expert interviews.
采用奥地利Kamp河洪峰流量、意大利MPS19拉奎拉50年地震PGA、海洋生物地球化学集合及32份专家访谈。

Aggregating multi-model ensembles into a single mixture distribution loses epistemic dispersion; representing complete forecasts via Beta EEDs and Gamma design distributions preserves uncertainty for testing and high-percentile engineering design.
单一混合分布会丢失模型离散度；利用Beta扩展专家分布和Gamma设计分布可完整保留不确定性以供检验与设计。

Independent observations for extreme hazard intensities are rarely available, restricting empirical evaluation to weaker consistency tests rather than full calibration or validation, and requiring subjective expert judgment.
极端灾害强度的独立观测稀缺，往往只能进行较弱的一致性检验而非严格校准或验证。

Establishes a cross-disciplinary framework and standardized glossary within the Italian RETURN project that unifies complete probabilistic hazard forecasting, empirical validation protocols, and risk communication practices.
在RETURN项目下建立跨学科统一框架与标准术语，融合完整概率预测、验证协议与风险沟通。

kc: Establishes a standardized interdisciplinary glossary and hierarchy of uncertainties (aleatory vs. epistemic) across natural hazards.
Formalizes the 'complete forecast' concept using a unified probabilistic framework based on experimental concepts and Extended Experts' Distributions (EED).
Provides a logical evaluation framework distinguishing forecast consistency, calibration, validation, and relative skill depending on data independence.
Synthesizes risk communication challenges and best practices from interviews with 32 professionals, advocating the hazard-risk separation principle.
建立了跨自然灾害学科的标准化术语表和不确定性层级体系（随机变异性与认知不确定性）。
基于实验概念和扩展专家分布（EED）的统一概率框架，形式化定义了“完整预测”概念。
提出了根据数据独立性区分预测一致性、校准、验证和相对技能的逻辑评估框架。
基于32位专业人士的访谈总结了风险沟通挑战与最佳实践，倡导灾害评估与风险决策分离原则。
me: Unified probabilistic framework combining frequentist exchangeable sequences (De Finetti's theorem) and subjective expert distributions.
Multi-model ensemble aggregation via Extended Experts' Distribution (Beta distribution fitted to exceedance probabilities) and Gamma distribution for design hazard intensities.
Statistical forecast evaluation using Probability Integral Transform (PIT), ontological null hypothesis testing, and proper scoring rules.
Qualitative in-depth interviews with 32 risk communication professionals across Italian institutions.
结合频率学派可交换序列（De Finetti定理）与主观专家分布的统一概率框架。
通过扩展专家分布（拟合超越概率的Beta分布）和设计灾害强度的Gamma分布进行多模型集合表征。
利用概率积分变换（PIT）、本体论零假设检验和恰当评分规则进行统计预测评估。
对意大利各机构32位风险沟通专业人士进行定性深度访谈。
de: Mediterranean Sea biogeochemical reanalysis (1999-2019) phosphate concentration matchups and 5-model FABM phytoplankton ensemble simulations.
Yearly maximum peak flood discharges for the Kamp River at Zwettl, Austria (1951-2021) fitted with four extreme value distributions.
50-year horizontal peak ground acceleration (PGA) seismic hazard curves at L'Aquila, Italy from 11 models in the MPS19 national seismic hazard model.
Qualitative testimonies from 32 risk communication practitioners collected between December 2024 and September 2025.
地中海生物地球化学再分析（1999-2019）磷酸盐浓度匹配数据及5模型FABM浮游植物集合模拟。
奥地利Zwettl地区Kamp河年最大洪峰流量观测（1951-2021）及四种极值分布拟合。
意大利国家地震危险性模型（MPS19）中11个模型生成的拉奎拉地区50年水平峰值地面加速度（PGA）危险性曲线。
2024年12月至2025年9月期间收集的32位风险沟通从业者的定性访谈记录。
li: Observational data for extreme, societally relevant hazard intensities are typically scarce or not independent of model construction, preventing strict calibration or validation.
Validating complete forecasts under non-stationary conditions remains theoretically and practically challenging because empirical frequencies cannot be estimated at single time instants.
No single, universally accepted risk-communication strategy exists due to wide disparities in stakeholder probabilistic literacy and institutional roles.
针对极端灾害强度的观测数据通常十分稀缺且不独立于模型构建，限制了严格的预测校准或验证。
非平稳条件下的完整预测验证在理论和实践上仍具挑战性，因为无法在单一时间点估计经验频率。
由于利益相关者的概率素养和机构角色差异巨大，目前尚无单一、普遍适用的风险沟通策略。

tm.why: The paper develops a unified probabilistic uncertainty framework for natural hazard forecasting and explicitly demonstrates it on long-term seismic hazard analysis (50-year peak ground acceleration at L'Aquila, Italy from MPS19).

A core focus is the mathematical modeling, separation, and quantification of aleatory variability and epistemic uncertainty using multi-model ensembles, Bayesian updating, and extended experts' distributions.

ev.notes: Full 20-page PDF analyzed, including abstract, main sections 1-8, glossary, and all 7 figures.

sum: Extracting broadband multimode Scholte-wave dispersion from passive seabed Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) records is challenging due to uncontrolled ambient forcing and the trade-off between spatial localization and low-frequency wavenumber resolution. This study introduces a non-interferometric workflow combining 8-hour time-ensemble frequency-wavenumber (FK) stacking, data-driven multi-aperture analysis (1.02–8.20 km), and spatially consistent dispersion tracking using constant-wavenumber slices. Applied to a 65 km seabed telecommunication cable on the Texas Gulf Coast, direct processing preserves coherent Scholte-wave energy across 0.3–4.5 Hz, overcoming the ~2 Hz upper limit of correlation-based processing on the same dataset. Inverting 400 1D multimodal dispersion profiles along a 51 km segment yields a pseudo-2D shear-wave velocity model down to 2 km depth, revealing shallow softer incised-valley fills within stiffer Pleistocene deposits and localized velocity reversals at 100–250 m depth.
本文提出一种利用海底分布式声学传感（DAS）数据进行被动源宽频带Scholte波成像的非干涉工作流。针对德克萨斯湾沿岸65 km海底光缆记录的8小时环境噪声数据，方法结合了长时程频率-波数（FK）谱叠加、数据驱动的多孔径分析（1.02–8.20 km）以及基于等波数切片的空间一致性多模态频散追踪。直……

t: Non-interferometric 2D Fourier transform of 10-minute DAS segments stacked over 8 hours across multiple apertures (1.02–8.20 km), tracked via constant-wavenumber slices, and inverted using 1D multimodal surface-wave inversion.
对8小时10分钟段DAS记录做非干涉多孔径（1.02–8.20 km）FK叠加，利用等波数切片追踪频散并进行一维多模态反…

One day of passive DAS strain records (8 hours stacked in 10-minute windows, 10 Hz sampling) along a 65 km buried telecommunication cable (5,091 channels, 12.76 m spacing, 23.93 m gauge length) offshore Texas.
德克萨斯近海65 km埋置通信光缆（5091道，道距12.76 m，标距23.93 m）采集的8小时被动DAS应变数据。

Retrieved multimode Scholte-wave dispersion from 0.3 to 4.5 Hz and inverted 400 1D profiles along 51 km (127.6 m spacing) to image Vs down to 2 km depth, identifying shallow incised-valley fill and a 100–250 m low-velocity zone.
提取0.3–4.5 Hz多模态频散，沿51 km反演400个1D剖面至2 km深度，揭示浅部下切谷充填及100–250 …

The 4.5 Hz upper frequency limit (~50 m shortest wavelength) cannot independently resolve fine-scale structure in the uppermost meters, and oblique wave arrivals or strong lateral heterogeneity may bias 1D results.
4.5 Hz上限（最短波长50 m）无法分辨最浅几米精细结构，且斜入射与强横向变化会影响1D反演。

Combines direct uncorrelated wavefield FK stacking, scale-dependent multi-aperture selection, and constant-wavenumber slice tracking to double the usable high-frequency bandwidth (up to 4.5 Hz) over correlation-based seabed DAS processing.
结合未相关波场多孔径FK叠加与等波数切片追踪，相比互相关法将高频上限翻倍至4.5 Hz。

kc: Developed a non-interferometric multi-aperture FK stacking workflow that extends usable passive Scholte-wave bandwidth to 0.3–4.5 Hz compared to <2 Hz from cross-correlation.
Introduced constant-wavenumber slices from 3D (frequency, wavenumber, channel) spectral volumes for spatially consistent multimode dispersion tracking across laterally heterogeneous areas.
Constructed a 51 km regional pseudo-2D shear-wave velocity model from the near seafloor to 2 km depth on the Texas continental shelf using 400 1D inversions.
开发了非干涉多孔径FK叠加工作流，将被动Scholte波可用频带扩展至0.3–4.5 Hz（互相关方法仅低于2 Hz）。
引入三维（频率、波数、道）谱数据体的等波数切片，在横向非均质区域实现了空间一致的多模态频散追踪。
通过400个一维反演，在德克萨斯大陆架构建了长51 km、从近海底延伸至2 km深度的区域伪二维横波速度模型。
me: Direct 2D Fourier transform of 10-minute uncorrelated DAS strain records stacked over 8 hours without trace or spectral normalization.
Kronecker product factorization of temporal and spatial 1D Fourier transforms to efficiently compute overlapping multi-aperture FK spectra (1.02, 2.04, 4.08, and 8.20 km).
Constant-wavenumber slicing across FK-array centers to continuously track landward and seaward fundamental and overtone dispersion modes.
Gradient-based 1D multimodal Scholte-wave inversion using CPS with explicit water layer and logarithmic sediment layering.
对10分钟未相关DAS应变记录直接进行二维傅里叶变换，并在8小时内叠加，不进行单道或谱归一化。
利用时间和空间一维傅里叶变换的Kronecker积分解，高效计算重叠的多孔径FK谱（1.02、2.04、4.08和8.20 km）。
跨FK阵列中心提取等波数切片，连续追踪向陆和向海传播的基阶及高阶频散模态。
采用CPS中的基于梯度的一维多模态Scholte波反演，显式包含水层及对数增长的沉积层厚度。
de: One day of continuous passive DAS axial strain data recorded along a 65 km seabed telecommunication fiber-optic cable on the inner and middle Texas continental shelf.
DAS acquisition with 23.93 m gauge length, 12.76 m channel spacing (5,091 channels), buried ~1 m beneath the seabed in 10–36 m water depth, downsampled to 10 Hz.
在德克萨斯内陆架和中陆架沿65 km海底通信光缆记录的一天连续被动DAS轴向应变数据。
DAS采集标距23.93 m，道间距12.76 m（共5,091道），埋深约1 m，水深10–36 m，降采样至10 Hz。
li: Maximum usable frequency of ~4.5 Hz (minimum wavelength ~50 m) cannot independently resolve fine-scale structure within the uppermost several meters.
Direct passive FK analysis assumes inline propagation and may be biased by strongly oblique plane waves without explicit source-direction analysis.
Independent 1D inversions without joint lateral regularization may be affected by strong lateral heterogeneity, and resolution below 800 m is coarse.
最高可用频率约4.5 Hz（最短波长约50 m），无法独立分辨海底最浅几米内的精细结构。
直接被动FK分析未做显式震源方向分析，若存在强斜入射平面波可能会使视速度估计产生偏差。
未加横向正则化的独立一维反演在强横向非均质区可能受限，且800 m以下深度的垂向分辨率较粗糙。

tm.why: The paper processes passive wavefields recorded along a 65 km seabed distributed acoustic sensing (DAS) telecommunication fiber-optic cable.
Multimodal Scholte-wave dispersion spanning 0.3–4.5 Hz is inverted to build a 51-km pseudo-2D shear-wave velocity model.
The workflow exploits passive shallow-water ocean forcing via direct non-interferometric time-ensemble FK stacking of ambient noise records.

sum: This study maps the ~475 km surface rupture of the 2025 Mw 7.7 Mandalay earthquake along the Sagaing fault using high-resolution satellite optical imagery and subpixel correlation. The rupture was continuous and structurally simple. Notably, about 10% of the rupture traversed potentially saturated ground, as verified by Sentinel-2 Normalized Difference Water Index (NDWI) data. The authors analyze the correlation between ground saturation, surface rupture visibility, and strike-slip geomorphology. They conclude that transient near-surface hydrologic conditions, such as ground saturation, significantly affect the geomorphic and paleoseismic preservation of fault ruptures, as well as the performance of nearby infrastructure like dams. This highlights the importance of considering hydrologic factors in post-earthquake hazard assessments.
本研究利用高分辨率卫星光学图像和亚像素图像相关技术，绘制了2025年Mw 7.7曼德勒地震沿实皆断裂带约475公里的地表破裂。研究表明破裂带连续且结构简单。约10%的破裂穿过潜在饱和地表（经Sentinel-2 NDWI指数验证）。研究测试了地表饱和与破裂可见性及走滑地貌之间的相关性，指出瞬态近地表……

t: Mapping surface rupture using high-resolution satellite optical images guided by displacements from subpixel optical image correlation and Sentinel-2 NDWI.
利用高分辨率卫星光学图像，结合亚像素图像相关位移和Sentinel-2 NDWI指数进行地表破裂制图。
High-resolution satellite optical imagery and Sentinel-2 multispectral data covering the ~475 km rupture zone of the 2025 Mw 7.7 Mandalay earthquake.
覆盖2025年Mw 7.7曼德勒地震约475公里破裂带的高分辨率卫星光学图像和Sentinel-2多光谱数据。
The rupture was continuous and simple, with ~10% passing through saturated ground, showing that near-surface hydrology influences rupture preservation and infrastructure performance.
破裂带连续且简单，约10%穿过饱和地表，表明近地表水文影响破裂保存和基础设施性能。

Quantifying the spatial correlation between transient ground saturation and the geomorphic/paleoseismic preservation of a major strike-slip surface rupture.
定量分析了瞬态地表饱和与大型走滑地表破裂的地貌及古地震保存之间的空间相关性。

Demonstrated that transient near-surface hydrologic conditions (ground saturation) influence the geomorphic and paleoseismic preservation of fault ruptures.

Ground saturation observations are transient and dependent on the timing of satellite passes relative to the earthquake.

sum: Northern Pakistan hosts numerous fault-aligned hot springs without active volcanism, yet lacks direct heat-flow measurements. This study applies 1D steady-state, 1D transient, and 2D finite-element advective-conductive thermal models incorporating surface radiogenic heat production (RHP), temperature-dependent conductivity, and exhumation across the Nanga Parbat Massif (NPM), Kohistan arc, and Karakoram terrane. Steady-state models yield surface heat flows of 85–120 mW/m2 in the NPM, 50–85 mW/m2 in Kohistan, and 65–103 mW/m2 in Karakoram, demonstrating that surface RHP cannot be extrapolated to the lower crust without violating Moho temperature constraints. Transient and 2D models show that rapid exhumation (1–3 mm/yr) and rugged topography compress isotherms beneath deep valleys, raising surface heat flow to 120–180 mW/m2 and temperatures above 200 °C at ~3 km depth. This provides the first quantitative physical basis for widespread hydrothermal activity and identifies unconventional geothermal targets in the western Himalaya-Karakoram.
巴基斯坦北部无活动火山但发育大量温泉，且缺乏地表热流测量。本研究结合岩石物理与地表放射性生热率（RHP）数据，对南迦帕尔巴特地块（NPM）、科希斯坦弧和喀喇昆仑地体开展了一维稳态、一维瞬态及二维有限元平流-传导热模拟。稳态模型显示三地地表热流分别为85–120、50–85和65–103 mW/m2，……

t: Applies 1D steady-state finite-difference, 1D transient operator-splitting, and 2D COMSOL finite-element advective-conductive thermal models with temperature-dependent thermal conductivity, radiogenic heat production, and exhumation-driven solid translation.
应用一维稳态有限差分、一维瞬态算子分裂及二维COMSOL有限元平流-传导热模型，包含温度相关热导率与剥露。

Uses published in situ gamma-spectrometry radiogenic heat production and petrophysical rock properties (Anees et al., 2023, 2024), combined with seismic Moho/LAB depths and thermochronological exhumation rates (1–3 mm/yr).
采用已发表的原位伽马能谱生热率和岩石热物理参数，结合莫霍面/LAB深度及热年代学剥露速率（1–3 mm/yr）。
Steady-state surface heat flow is 85–120 mW/m2 in NPM, 50–85 mW/m2 in Kohistan, and 65–103 mW/m2 in Karakoram; 2D models with exhumation yield 120–180 mW/m2 and >200 °C at ~3 km depth in valleys.
NPM、科希斯坦和喀喇昆仑稳态热流分别为85–120、50–85和65–103 mW/m2；二维河谷处热流达120–18…
Models lack calibration against direct surface heat-flow or borehole temperature measurements and omit hydrothermal fluid circulation, fault permeability, and shear heating.
缺乏地表热流或深孔测温数据校准，且未模拟水热流体循环、断层渗透率及剪切生热。

First multi-dimensional conductive-advective thermal modeling study bracketing lithospheric geotherms, crustal differentiation indices, and topographic-exhumation geothermal anomalies across northern Pakistan's collisional terranes.
首次通过多维平流-传导热模拟约束了巴基斯坦北部碰撞地体的地温线、地壳分异指数及河谷地热异常。

kc: Brackets plausible lithospheric and upper-crustal thermal states for the Nanga Parbat Massif, Kohistan arc, and Karakoram using 1D steady-state, 1D transient, and 2D advective-conductive models.

Demonstrates that uniform downward extrapolation of surface radiogenic heat production yields unrealistically hot Moho temperatures, quantifying required crustal differentiation indices (DI of 3.0 in NPM and 2.0 in Karakoram).
Identifies deeply incised valleys in the Nanga Parbat Massif and Karakoram as high-favorability geothermal targets where topography and rapid exhumation compress >200 °C isotherms to ~3 km depth.
利用一维稳态、一维瞬态和二维平流-传导模型，约束了南迦帕尔巴特地块、科希斯坦弧和喀喇昆仑的岩石圈及上地壳热状态。
证明将地表放射性生热率均匀向下外推会导致莫霍面温度过高，并量化了地壳分异指数（NPM为3.0，喀喇昆仑为2.0）。
确定了南迦帕尔巴特和喀喇昆仑的深切河谷为高潜力地热目标区，地形效应和快速剥露使该处>200 °C等温线浅至约3 km深度。
me: 1D nonlinear steady-state conductive heat-transfer modeling using a conservative finite-difference half-station scheme with temperature-dependent lattice and radiative thermal conductivity.
1D transient advective-conductive thermal modeling over 10 Ma using operator splitting, fixed-grid material remapping for exhumation (1–3 mm/yr), and linearly implicit backward Euler time-stepping.
2D finite-element advective-conductive thermal modeling in COMSOL Multiphysics incorporating rugged topography (up to ~8 km elevation) and block-specific translational exhumation velocities.
Calculation of the crustal differentiation index (DI) from modeled surface and mantle heat flows to evaluate vertical stratification of heat-producing elements.
采用守恒有限差分半节点格式的一维非线性稳态热传导模型，包含温度相关的晶格和辐射热导率。
基于算子分裂、固定网格物质重映射（剥露速率1–3 mm/yr）和向后欧拉隐式时间步进的10 Ma一维瞬态平流-传导热模拟。
利用COMSOL Multiphysics进行二维有限元平流-传导热模拟，结合起伏地形（高达~8 km）和块体平移剥露速度。
基于模拟的地表和地幔热流计算地壳分异指数（DI），以评估生热元素的垂向分异程度。
de: In situ gamma-ray spectrometry surface radiogenic heat production (RHP) and laboratory petrophysical measurements (thermal conductivity, density, specific heat capacity) from northern Pakistan lithologies (Anees et al., 2023, 2024).
Literature-derived seismic constraints on Moho depth (60–70 km), lithosphere-asthenosphere boundary (LAB) depth (150–250 km), and zircon fission-track exhumation rates.
巴基斯坦北部岩性的原位伽马能谱地表放射性生热率（RHP）及实验室岩石物理测量数据（热导率、密度、比热容，引自Anees et al., 2023, 2024）。
文献中的莫霍面深度（60–70 km）、岩石圈-软流圈边界（LAB）深度（150–250 km）地震约束及锆石裂变径迹剥露速率数据。

Hydrothermal fluid circulation, fracture-network permeability, shear heating, and melt migration are excluded from the purely solid-state conductive-advective models.

sum: HighFEM-2 is a latent denoising-diffusion waveform model trained with rectified flow matching on a multi-modal diffusion transformer to synthesize three-component acceleration up to 50 Hz. By conditioning the model on low-frequency waveforms (below the source corner frequency) along with earthquake magnitude, hypocenter, station location, and VS30, it preserves deterministic source, path, and directivity effects while generating realistic regional high-frequency scattering. Trained on 195,138 Italian INSTANCE records (Mw 1.4–6.5), HighFEM-2 reproduces observed peak ground acceleration (PGA) and velocity (PGV) with minimal bias, matching observed envelopes and Fourier spectra. This approach offers a fast, regionally calibrated tool for generating broadband ground-motion time histories for seismic hazard and risk assessment.

sum: Recent seismic data from Mars suggest a molten silicate layer—a basal magma ocean (BMO)—above a smaller metallic core, as well as a possible solid inner core. Here, the authors couple a 2-D finite-volume mantle convection model (StagYY) with parameterized thermal evolution models for a convective BMO and the core over 4.5 Gyr. They systematically test mantle rheology, BMO heat-producing element (HPE) enrichment, and core liquidus temperatures. Results demonstrate that an HPE-enriched BMO retains deep interior heat, maintaining higher mantle temperatures and present-day plume activity, while suppressing core cooling and shortening early thermally driven dynamo lifetimes. Furthermore, forming a present-day solid inner core requires both weak BMO HPE enrichment and high core liquidus temperatures, which in turn restarts a present-day compositional dynamo—conflicting with Mars's lack of a global magnetic field today. This highlights a fundamental tension among Martian seismic, thermal, and magnetic constraints.
近期火星地震观测表明核幔边界上方可能存在基底岩浆洋（BMO）及固态内核。本研究将二维地幔对流数值模型（StagYY）与对流BMO和地核的参数化热演化模型耦合，模拟了火星45亿年的演化。研究表明，富集生热元素（HPE）的BMO会增强深部热量滞留，维持较高的地幔温度与现今地幔柱活动，但同时会抑制地核长期……

将二维有限体积地幔对流代码StagYY与对流BMO和金属核的一维参数化能量与熵平衡模型耦合。
41 numerical simulations (29 main + 12 sensitivity tests) on an 896 × 128 2-D spherical annulus grid over 4.5 Gyr, testing core size, rheology, HPE enrichment, and core liquidus.
在896×128二维球环网格上进行41组45亿年演化模拟，测试核大小、流变学、HPE富集度及液相线。
Increasing BMO HPE enrichment thins the lithosphere from ~270 to ~170 km, sustains plumes, stops the dynamo when F_BMO >= 3–5, and blocks inner-core growth when F_BMO >= 2.

Treats the mantle, convective BMO, and core as three thermally coupled systems to self-consistently compute CMB heat exchange, inner-core crystallization, and dynamo viability.
将地幔、对流BMO和地核作为三个热耦合系统，自洽计算核幔热交换、内核结晶和发电机演化。

Revealed a fundamental tension between maintaining a long-lived BMO, forming a ~600 km solid inner core, and explaining the absence of a present-day Martian global magnetic field.

证明了对流BMO中生热元素的富集可作为热缓冲层，促进现今地幔柱活动，同时抑制地核热流并缩短发电机寿命。

sum: This paper presents a radial-component predominant-mode (RCPM) inversion framework for Rayleigh waves, specifically tailored for Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) site characterization. Since DAS measures the in-line (radial) component of Rayleigh-wave motion, conventional vertical-component inversion methods can misinterpret modal behavior under complex stratigraphic conditions. The RCPM framework matches measured dominant radial dispersion trends with the theoretical mode exhibiting the maximum modal participation, eliminating the need for explicit modal indexing. Evaluated using three synthetic models and two field DAS datasets, the method successfully captures correct modal responses and yields reliable shear-wave velocity (Vs) profiles that agree well with independent borehole measurements.

sum: This dataset provides input files and output time series for 55 three-dimensional numerical simulations of earthquake cycles on planar faults. The simulations were conducted using the Hierarchical Boundary Element Method (HBI) code, systematically varying only the fault dip angle from 5° to 90° while keeping friction parameters and initial conditions constant. Each model spans approximately 10,000 years of fault slip history. The repository includes fault meshes, parameter files, and high-resolution time series of maximum and average fault slip rates. This dataset is highly valuable for studying the nonlinear dynamics of earthquake cycles and the influence of fault geometry on rupture behavior.
该数据集包含55个三维平面断层地震周期数值模拟的输入与输出。模拟采用HBI软件进行，系统地将断层倾角从5°变化到90°，保持摩擦参数和初始条件一致。每个模型覆盖约10,000年滑动历史。数据集包含断层网格、参数文件及滑动速率时间序列，对研究断层几何如何影响地震周期非线性动力学具有重要价值。

sum: Understanding shallow magma storage at active calderas requires sub-kilometer to kilometer-scale structural resolution. This study presents high-resolution 3-D Vp, Vs, and Vp/Vs models of the upper ~4 km beneath Kīlauea's summit from a 37-day hybrid experiment in 2023 combining 1,815 three-component nodal seismometers and 396 T-Rex vibroseis shot points. Automated picking via STA/LTA, RESTX, and PhaseNet yielded ~15 million arrivals, from which 799 representative earthquakes and 396 shots were jointly inverted on a 500 m horizontal grid using SIMUL2000. The models reveal two ~2-km-wide magma reservoirs at 1–3 km below sea level beneath Halema'uma'u and the south caldera, marked by reduced Vs, moderately reduced Vp, and locally elevated Vp/Vs. Laterally distinct at shallow levels, they merge at depth and align closely with geodetic deformation sources, demonstrating the power of large-N hybrid tomography for resolving reservoir-scale volcanic architecture.
本研究利用2023年在夏威夷基拉韦厄火山顶开展的37天主被动源联合地震实验数据，通过部署1,815个三分量节点地震仪和396个可控震源点，采用STA/LTA、RESTX和PhaseNet拾取了约1500万个P波和S波走时。选取799个代表性地震与主动源数据进行SIMUL2000联合反演，构建了水平网……

Validated 3-D velocity models via active-source relocation tests, reducing mean depth errors from 1,866 m (1-D model) to 200 m and horizontal offsets to within 100 m.

Comprehensive spatial resolution assessment via 3-D checkerboard tests, dataset-specific Vp inversions, restoration tests, and point-spread spike tests.

sum: This study utilizes magnesium (Mg) stable isotope compositions from Nicaragua, the South Sandwich Islands, and the central-eastern Aleutian arc, combined with a global compilation, to investigate volatile-rich processes at the slab-mantle interface. The authors observe heavy Mg isotopic signatures in mafic arc magmas that correlate with volatile enrichment indicators, particularly in subduction zones with steeply dipping slabs. Using Monte Carlo isotope mixing models, they demonstrate that up to 50% of the Mg budget in certain arc magma sources is derived from deep, water-saturated melting near the slab-mantle interface. This challenges the conventional view that arc magmas are solely derived from shallower, garnet-free mantle wedge regions, highlighting the geochemical and volumetric importance of the deep mantle wedge base in global volatile cycling and arc magmatism.
本研究利用多地弧岩浆的镁同位素数据及蒙特卡洛模拟，探讨了俯冲带深部挥发分循环。结果表明，基性弧岩浆的重镁同位素特征与挥发分富集相关，部分源区高达50%的镁来自板片-地幔界面附近的深部饱水熔融。该研究挑战了弧岩浆仅源于浅部地幔楔的传统认识，揭示了地幔楔底部在水分循环中的关键作用。

t: Monte Carlo isotope mixing models combined with stable Mg isotope geochemistry to quantify volatile-rich source contributions.
结合稳定镁同位素地球化学与蒙特卡洛同位素混合模拟，定量评估富挥发分源区的贡献。
Mg isotopic data from Nicaragua, South Sandwich Islands, and central-eastern Aleutian arc, integrated with a global arc magma compilation.
尼加拉瓜、南桑威奇群岛和阿留申群岛中东部的镁同位素数据，以及全球弧岩浆编译数据集。
Up to 50% of the Mg budget in some arc magma sources derives from deep, water-saturated melting near the slab-mantle interface.
部分弧岩浆源区中高达50%的镁预算来自板片-地幔界面附近的深部饱水熔融。
Geochemical modeling and isotopic tracing are indirect and depend on assumed end-member compositions and partition coefficients.

Challenges the view that arc magmas derive solely from shallower mantle wedge regions by proving significant deep, hydrous melting contributions.

Demonstrated a link between steep slab dip angles and the heaviest Mg isotopic compositions.

sum: This paper presents a self-adaptive fuzzy pitch (SFP) control method designed to suppress the structural vibration of large-scale wind turbines under combined wind and seismic loads. Utilizing tower-top fore-aft displacement and velocity as inputs, the fuzzy controller dynamically adjusts the pitch angle using an exponential self-adaptive proportional factor. Co-simulations using OpenFAST and Simulink demonstrate that the SFP method reduces peak tower-top displacement and acceleration by 25% and 31% on average compared to conventional PI control. Seismic fragility analysis indicates significant reductions in failure probabilities under strong ground motions (e.g., 43.05% reduction at 1.0 g PGA for yield displacement), demonstrating its potential to enhance wind turbine structural safety in seismically active regions.
本文提出一种自适应模糊变桨（SFP）控制方法，用于抑制大型风电机组在风震联合载荷下的振动。该方法以塔顶前后位移和速度为输入，通过自适应比例因子调整变桨角。仿真表明，相比传统PI控制，SFP使塔顶峰值位移和加速度平均降低25%和31%，并在强震下显著降低结构失效概率，提升了风电安全性。

t: A self-adaptive fuzzy pitch (SFP) control method using tower-top fore-aft displacement and velocity as inputs, with an exponential self-adaptive proportional factor to adjust the baseline pitch angle.
采用塔顶前后位移和速度作为输入，利用指数自适应比例因子调整基准变桨角的自适应模糊变桨控制方法。
Numerical co-simulations of a large-scale wind turbine under combined wind-seismic loading, utilizing various earthquake records scaled to peak ground accelerations up to 1.0 g.
在风震联合载荷下大型风机的数值联合仿真，采用缩放至1.0 g PGA的多种实际地震记录。
SFP control reduces peak tower-top fore-aft displacement and acceleration by 25% and 31% on average, and reduces failure probabilities at 1.0 g PGA by up to 43.05%.

The performance is demonstrated solely through numerical co-simulations without physical experimental validation or consideration of complex soil-structure interactions.

sum: This work presents Stein Mixture Variational Inference (SMVI) as an advanced tool for Bayesian geophysical inversion. Highly non-linear geophysical inverse problems often exhibit complex, multimodal posterior probability density functions that are challenging for standard variational methods and computationally expensive for Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC). By combining Stein variational gradient descent (SVGD) with mixture modeling, SMVI efficiently captures multiple modes and represents non-Gaussian uncertainties. This methodology provides a computationally efficient alternative for uncertainty quantification in complex geological settings.
本文提出了一种用于贝叶斯地球物理反演的斯坦混合变分推断（SMVI）方法。高度非线性的地球物理反演问题通常具有复杂的多峰后验概率密度函数，这对于标准变分方法极具挑战，而使用传统MCMC方法计算成本又过高。SMVI通过将斯坦变分梯度下降（SVGD）与混合模型相结合，能够高效捕获多个局部极值并表征非高斯不……

Synthetic geophysical inversion scenarios designed to evaluate the algorithm's capability in resolving multimodal parameter spaces.
旨在评估该算法在解析多峰参数空间中能力的合成地球物理反演场景。
SMVI successfully resolves multimodal posterior distributions and provides accurate uncertainty estimates with significantly fewer forward model evaluations than MCMC.

sum: This study presents nitrogen (N) isotope measurements of olivine-hosted fluid inclusions from 13 kimberlite pipes across eight cratons, spanning 14 ka to 558 Ma. The authors find that while near-zero δ15N values persist throughout the Phanerozoic, isotopically heavy N (+5.3 ± 0.5 ‰) only appears in kimberlites younger than 180 Ma. This heavy N signature correlates with K2O enrichment, indicating interaction with sediment-modified lithospheric mantle. Conversely, K-poor kimberlites preserve primordial deep mantle N signatures. The emergence of 15N-enriched signatures is linked to increased biomass burial following the Cambrian Explosion, which was subsequently subducted and metasomatized the subcontinental lithospheric mantle (SCLM). This provides a temporal link between biosphere evolution and the deep Earth N cycle.
本研究测定13个金伯利岩管橄榄石包裹体的氮同位素。结果显示，重氮同位素（+5.3‰）仅见于晚于180 Ma的金伯利岩，并与富钾相关，代表受俯冲沉积物改造的岩石圈地幔；贫钾样品保留原始深部地幔特征。这表明寒武纪大爆发后的生物富氮沉积物经俯冲交代了岩石圈地幔，揭示了生物圈与深部氮循环的演化联系。

t: Nitrogen and noble gas isotope analysis of olivine-hosted fluid inclusions from kimberlites to trace volatile sources.
对金伯利岩中橄榄石包裹体进行氮和惰性气体同位素分析以追踪挥发分来源。
Fluid inclusion samples from 13 kimberlite pipes across eight cratons, spanning ages from 14 ka to 558 Ma.
来自8个克拉通、年龄跨越14 ka至558 Ma的13个金伯利岩管的流体包裹体样品。
Heavy nitrogen (+5.3 ± 0.5 ‰) is restricted to kimberlites <180 Ma, correlating with K2O enrichment from sediment-modified lithospheric mantle.
重氮仅见于<180 Ma的金伯利岩，并与受沉积物改造的岩石圈地幔富钾特征相关。

First to identify a temporal onset of heavy nitrogen signatures in kimberlites, linking biosphere evolution to deep mantle metasomatism.
