sum: This study investigates the seasonal variation of earthquake source characteristics in the 2018–2020 Palghar swarm, western India. Using data from six local broadband stations, the authors relocate 8,377 earthquakes via NonLinLoc, revealing two steeply dipping N-S clusters within the top 10 km of the crust. Time-domain full moment tensor inversion and stress inversion for 33 ML >= 3.5 events, alongside spectral analysis of 27 events, show dominant normal faulting with ~42% non-double-couple (non-DC) components and low static stress drops (~2 MPa). Notably, source properties vary seasonally: during the post-monsoon peak rainfall load, faulting is strictly N-S and purely normal (rake ~-100°) with elevated non-DC components and lower stress drops, suggesting fluid-driven aseismic deformation. In summer, as water load dissipates, the regional India-Eurasia compressive stress reasserts influence, shifting mechanisms to NNE-SSW oblique-normal faulting (rake ~-65°). This seasonal stress interplay explains the swarm's unusual two-year longevity.
本研究探讨了印度西部帕尔加震群震源特性的季节性变化。利用6个宽频带台站数据，通过NonLinLoc重定位了8377次地震，揭示出两个南北向陡倾丛集。对33个ML>=3.5事件进行全矩张量与应力反演，并对27个事件进行频谱分析，结果显示以正断层为主，伴随约42%非双力偶成分和低应力降（~2 MPa）。……

t: Relocated earthquakes using NonLinLoc, performed time-domain regional waveform full moment tensor inversion (Herrmann, 2013) decomposed into DC/CLVD/ISO, inverted focal mechanisms for stress via STRESSINVERSE, and estimated spectral source parameters using SourceSpec.
采用NonLinLoc重定位，时域全矩张量反演并分解DC/CLVD/ISO，利用STRESSINVERSE反演应力场，及…

Continuous 100 sps broadband waveform recordings from six CSIR-NGRI seismic stations around Palghar between February 2019 and November 2020, yielding 8,377 well-located events and 33 ML >= 3.5 earthquakes.
2019年2月至2020年11月6个宽频带台站100 sps连续波形，含8377个精定位事件及33个ML>=3.5地震。

Earthquakes form two N-S steeply dipping clusters (<=10 km depth) with normal faulting, ~42% non-DC components, and median stress drop of 1.85 MPa, shifting from post-monsoon pure normal (rake -100°) to summer oblique-normal (rake -65°).
正断层为主，平均42%非双力偶成分，中位应力降1.85 MPa；雨季后呈纯正断层，夏季转为斜滑正断层。
The small number of ML >= 3.5 events prevents conclusive confirmation of self-similarity scaling breakdown and obscures a smooth seasonal transition in source properties.
较大震级样本量有限，难以对自相似标度律偏离下定论，也未能观测到季节间的平滑过渡。

Demonstrates seasonal modulation of swarm source mechanisms and stress regimes driven by the interplay between post-monsoon rainwater vertical loading and summer regional India-Eurasia plate convergence.
揭示了雨季后雨水垂直荷载与夏季印欧板块区域挤压应力交替主导的震源特性季节性调制机制。

kc: Relocated 8,377 swarm events with uncertainties <= 1.5 km, delineating two steeply dipping N-S fault planes separated by ~5 km in the upper 10 km.
Estimated full moment tensors for 33 ML >= 3.5 events, revealing dominant normal faulting and high average non-DC components (~42%: 24% CLVD, 18% ISO).
Computed source parameters for 27 events, finding low static stress drops (0.7–4.9 MPa, median 1.85 MPa) and a breakdown of self-similarity scaling.
Discovered seasonal modulation between post-monsoon pure normal faulting (vertical rainwater load) and summer oblique-normal faulting (regional compressive stress interplay).
重定位了8377次震群事件（误差<=1.5 km），勾勒出上地壳10 km内相距约5 km的两个南北向陡倾断层面。
反演了33个ML>=3.5事件的全矩张量，揭示出主导的正断层机制及高非双力偶成分（平均约42%：24% CLVD，18% ISO）。
计算了27个事件的震源参数，发现低静态应力降（0.7–4.9 MPa，中位数1.85 MPa）以及自相似标度律的偏离。
发现了震源特性的季节性调制：雨季后受雨水垂直荷载控制呈纯正断层，夏季受区域挤压应力影响转为斜滑正断层。
me: Nonlinear probabilistic earthquake relocation using NonLinLoc with Oct-tree importance sampling in an 80x80x40 km 3D grid.
Time-domain regional waveform full moment tensor inversion (0.03–0.3 Hz) decomposed into DC, CLVD, and ISO components.
Iterative joint stress tensor inversion (STRESSINVERSE) with 1,000 bootstrap realizations.
S-wave displacement spectral fitting (SourceSpec) using a Brune model corrected for site response and attenuation.
利用NonLinLoc程序及八叉树重要性采样算法在80x80x40 km三维网格中进行非线性概率地震重定位。
开展时域区域波形全矩张量反演（0.03–0.3 Hz），并将结果分解为DC、CLVD和ISO分量。
采用带1000次自助法（bootstrap）重采样的迭代联合应力张量反演（STRESSINVERSE）。
基于扣除场地响应和衰减效应的Brune模型，利用SourceSpec拟合S波位移谱以估算震源参数。
de: Continuous waveform data (100 sps) from 6 local broadband seismic stations deployed by CSIR-NGRI between February 2019 and November 2020.
Catalog of >10,000 recorded events (ML -0.1 to 4.6), filtered to 8,377 well-located events and 33 ML >= 3.5 events.
Daily rainfall data (2018–2020) from NASA Giovanni repository and synthetic combined stress inversion test using Sikkim Himalaya strike-slip focal mechanisms.
CSIR-NGRI部署的6个地方宽频带地震台站在2019年2月至2020年11月期间记录的100 sps连续波形数据。
包含超过10,000次记录事件（ML -0.1至4.6）的地震目录，筛选出8,377次精定位事件和33次ML>=3.5事件。
NASA Giovanni数据库的日降雨量数据（2018–2020年），以及结合锡金喜马拉雅走滑震源机制的合成联合应力反演实验。
li: Small sample size of moderate events (33 for MT/stress inversion, 27 for source spectra) prevents a conclusive statement on source scaling breakdown.
Expected smooth seasonal transition of source properties from dry season to post-monsoon is not clearly observed due to limited event counts and estimation uncertainties.
中等强度地震样本量较小（33个用于矩张量/应力反演，27个用于震源谱），限制了对震源标度律偏离的定论。
受限于事件数量及参数估计的不确定性，未能清晰观测到旱季向雨季后震源性质的平滑过渡。

tm.why: The paper performs full moment tensor inversion, stress inversion, and spectral source parameter estimation for 33 moderate earthquakes in the Palghar swarm.
The study investigates seasonal stress modulation, fluid-induced pore pressure, non-double-couple components, and inferred aseismic deformation.
Over 8,300 swarm earthquakes are relocated using NonLinLoc with uncertainties <= 1.5 km to delineate two N-S fault clusters.

ev.notes: Full preprint manuscript PDF (30 pages including figures and captions) used for all quantitative metrics, methods, and figure analyses.

sum: Conventional geomagnetic induction studies using ionospheric solar quiet (Sq) daily variations typically invert only dominant-term spherical harmonic transfer functions, neglecting up to 60% of the signal carried by non-dominant terms. This study introduces a 1-D mantle conductivity imaging framework that applies trans-dimensional Bayesian Markov chain Monte Carlo inversion to full-term global-to-local Sq transfer functions across six periods (4 to 24 hours). Synthetic tests on a two-layer model with a 410 km discontinuity show that full-term inversion reduces the L2 model norm error from 7.12 to 2.35 and doubles interface detection probability compared to dominant-term inversion. Applying the method to 25 years (1997–2021) of geomagnetic records from 14 inland Eurasian observatories reveals a lithosphere-asthenosphere boundary deepening from ~100 km in the east to ~200 km in the west, alongside a pronounced 410–660 km conductivity jump and elevated water content (~1.06 wt%) beneath eastern Eurasia linked to Western Pacific slab subduction.
针对传统电离层Sq日变反演仅利用主项传递函数而忽略非主项信息的局限，本文提出结合全项传递函数与跨维贝叶斯MCMC算法的1D地幔电导率成像方法。合成测试表明，全项反演显著降低模型误差并提高410 km间断面识别概率。利用欧亚大陆14个内陆地磁台站25年（1997-2021）数据反演发现，岩石圈-软流圈……

t: The authors combine a global-to-local spherical harmonic expansion of ionospheric Sq sources (incorporating both dominant and non-dominant transfer function terms across six harmonic periods) with a 1-D trans-dimensional Bayesian Markov chain Monte Carlo inversion.
结合电离层Sq源全球到局部球谐展开（含6个周期的主项与非主项传递函数）与一维跨维贝叶斯MCMC反演。

Twenty-five years (1997–2021) of hourly geomagnetic data from 135 global mid-latitude stations on quiet equinoctial days constrain the external Sq source, while vertical components at 14 inland Eurasian observatories yield local full-term transfer functions.
利用1997-2021年全球135个中纬度台站磁静日水平分量估算外源，并反演欧亚14个内陆台站垂直分量传递函数。

In synthetic tests, full-term inversion reduces the L2 model norm error from 7.12 to 2.35; across Eurasia, inferred LAB depths thicken from ~100 km (east) to ~200 km (west), and 464 km water content reaches 1.058 wt% at BMT.
合成测试模型L2误差从7.12降至2.35；欧亚LAB自东向西由100 km加深至200 km，东部BMT站含水量达1.…

The 1-D conductivity approximation neglects 3-D lateral variations and oceanic induction effects, and short-period (4 and 4.8 h) transfer functions lack higher-degree satellite and magnetospheric Dst source constraints.
一维近似忽略了三维电导率变化和海洋效应，且短周期传递函数缺乏高阶卫星数据与磁层Dst信号的联合约束。

First application of trans-dimensional Bayesian inversion to full-term (both dominant and non-dominant) geomagnetic diurnal variation transfer functions to image Eurasian upper-mantle and transition-zone conductivity discontinuities and water content.
首次将跨维贝叶斯反演应用于地磁日变全项传递函数，精细约束了欧亚大陆上地幔与转换带电导率间断面及含水量。

kc: Proposes a 1-D mantle electrical conductivity imaging method combining full-term global-to-local Sq transfer functions with trans-dimensional Bayesian inversion.
Demonstrates via synthetic testing that full-term transfer function inversion lowers L2 model error from 7.12 to 2.35 and improves 410 km interface detection over dominant-term inversion.
Determines 1-D conductivity profiles beneath 14 Eurasian observatories, identifying an east-to-west deepening of the lithosphere-asthenosphere boundary from ~100 km to ~200 km.

Quantifies mantle transition zone water content using Karato and Yoshino petrophysical parameterizations, revealing a wet eastern Eurasian mantle (~1.058 wt% at BMT) versus a dry western mantle (~0.0341 wt% at LVV).
提出了一种结合电离层Sq全项传递函数与跨维贝叶斯反演的一维地幔电导率成像方法。
通过合成测试证明，相比仅使用主项，全项传递函数反演将模型L2范数误差从7.12降至2.35，并提高了410 km间断面的识别概率。
获取了欧亚大陆14个地磁台站下方的一维电导率剖面，发现岩石圈-软流圈边界（LAB）自东向西从约100 km加深至约200 km。
结合Karato和Yoshino岩石物理实验参数量化了地幔含水量，揭示欧亚东部转换带富水（BMT站约1.058 wt%）而西部贫水（LVV站约0.0341 wt%）。
me: Global-to-local geomagnetic transfer function estimation using spherical harmonic expansion of ionospheric Sq sources across six harmonic periods (4, 4.8, 6, 8, 12, and 24 hours).
Joint inversion of dominant and non-dominant spherical harmonic transfer function terms (full-term dataset).
Trans-dimensional Bayesian Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) 1-D layered inversion with an adapted multivariate Gaussian prior for vertical smoothness.
Petrophysical conversion of inverted electrical conductivity to mantle water content using both Karato (2011) and Yoshino & Katsura (2013) laboratory laws.
利用电离层Sq源的球谐展开，在6个周期（4、4.8、6、8、12和24小时）估算全球到局部的地磁传递函数。
联合反演球谐传递函数的主项与非主项（全项数据集）。
采用带垂向平滑自适应多元高斯先验的跨维贝叶斯马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）一维分层反演。
利用Karato (2011) 和 Yoshino & Katsura (2013) 实验室导电律将反演电导率转换为地幔含水量。
de: Synthetic two-layer Earth model test (0.1 S/m over 1 S/m with an interface at 410 km depth) contaminated with 10% Gaussian noise on dominant terms and 12% on non-dominant terms.
25 years (1997–2021) of hourly mean geomagnetic observatory records from the World Data Centre for Geomagnetism (BGS).
Horizontal magnetic components from 135 mid-latitude observatories on quiet equinoctial days (aa < 7 nT) used to estimate external source spherical harmonic coefficients.
Vertical magnetic components at 14 inland Eurasian observatories (minimal ocean distortion effect) used to compute local full-term transfer functions.
双层地球合成模型测试（410 km界面上方0.1 S/m、下方1 S/m），主项和非主项分别添加10%和12%的高斯噪声。
来自世界地磁数据中心（BGS）1997至2021年共25年的地磁台站小时均值记录。
选取135个中纬度台站磁静分点日（aa < 7 nT）的水平磁场分量，用于计算外源球谐系数。
利用受海洋畸变影响较小的14个欧亚内陆台站垂直磁场分量计算局部全项传递函数。
li: 1-D conductivity parameterization beneath each observatory cannot fully account for 3-D lateral conductivity heterogeneities or oceanic induction effects.
Source field descriptions at short periods (4 and 4.8 hours) rely solely on ground-based ionospheric Sq signals without higher-degree satellite constraints or long-period Dst joint inversion.
Sq signals have limited sensitivity below 660 km depth, and laboratory petrophysical laws (Karato vs. Yoshino) yield notable quantitative discrepancies in absolute water content.
各台站下方的一维电导率模型近似无法完全消除三维横向电导率非均匀性及海洋感应效应带来的偏差。
4小时和4.8小时短周期的源场描述仅依赖地面电离层Sq信号，未结合更高阶卫星数据或与长周期Dst信号联合反演。
Sq信号对660 km以下深度灵敏度有限，且不同岩石物理实验定律（Karato与Yoshino）估算的绝对含水量存在显著定量差异。

tm.why: The paper images the 1-D mantle electrical conductivity structure beneath 14 Eurasian observatories, constraining the lithosphere-asthenosphere boundary and transition-zone water content related to Pacific slab subduction.
The authors employ a trans-dimensional Bayesian Markov chain Monte Carlo inversion algorithm to jointly estimate layer numbers, interface depths, conductivities, and posterior credibility intervals.
The study formulates and validates a geophysical inverse problem using full-term global-to-local geomagnetic transfer functions to reduce non-uniqueness compared to dominant-term-only inversions.

ev.notes: Full 26-page GJI manuscript PDF used, including all equations, 2 tables, and 12 figures.

sum: This study develops a spatially explicit Geographic Information Systems (GIS) and Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) Multi-Criteria Decision Analysis (MCDA) framework to identify optimal geothermal power plant sites in the Gulf of Suez, Egypt. Using bottom-hole temperature data from 52 hydrocarbon exploration wells corrected via Horner and Waples-Ramly methods, the authors map geothermal gradients across 1,000–4,000 m depths and regional heat flow. Nine thematic layers—geothermal gradient (25%), heat flow (20%), fault density (15%), geology (10%), seismicity (5%), power grid (8%), roads (7%), land use (5%), and slope (5%)—are combined. Linear regression confirms a mean geothermal gradient of 48.5 °C/km (R² = 0.9509) and heat flow up to 103 mW/m². The novelty lies in integrating thermal, geological, and infrastructural criteria to match specific sites with power plant technologies: Flash Steam (3,000–4,000 m, 140–210 °C) and Binary Cycle (2,000–3,000 m, 100–180 °C) at top candidate sites like Hammam Faraun and Ras Gharib.
本研究构建了结合地理信息系统（GIS）与层次分析法（AHP）的多准则决策分析（MCDA）框架，用于优选埃及苏伊士湾地热发电站站址。利用52口油气探井经校正的井底温度数据，计算了1000–4000米深度的地温梯度与大地热流，并融合断层密度、地质、地震活动、电网、道路、土地利用和坡度共9项指标。结果显示……

t: An Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP)-based Weighted Linear Combination (WLC) model in ArcMap 10.8 combines nine IDW-interpolated and reclassified thematic layers (45% thermal, 30% geological, 15% infrastructure, 10% topographic/environmental).
在ArcMap 10.8中结合IDW插值与AHP加权线性组合模型，融合9个重分类专题图层。

Subsurface bottom-hole temperature (BHT) measurements from 52 hydrocarbon exploration wells across the Gulf of Suez, corrected using both Horner and Waples and Ramly (2001) statistical methods, alongside GIS infrastructure and geological layers.
采用苏伊士湾52口油气探井经Horner和统计法校正的井底温度数据及多源GIS图层。

Linear regression shows a mean geothermal gradient of 48.5 °C/km (R² = 0.9509), with gradients of 1.94–4.45 °C/100m and heat flow up to 103 mW/m², identifying prime Flash Steam (3,000–4,000 m) and Binary Cycle (2,000–3,000 m) sites.
平均地温梯度48.5 °C/km（R²=0.9509），热流达103 mW/m²，优选出闪蒸与双工质电站站址。

Sparse well coverage on the western margin causes IDW interpolation uncertainty, AHP weights lack formal sensitivity analysis, and reservoir permeability, thickness, and fluid geochemistry are excluded.
西岸钻井稀疏带来插值误差，缺乏AHP敏感性分析及渗透率与地球化学数据。

First study in the Gulf of Suez to integrate thermal, geological, infrastructural, and environmental data into a spatially explicit MCDA framework that matches sites to specific power plant technologies.
首次在苏伊士湾耦合地热、地质与基础设施多准则空间模型并按深度匹配发电技术。

kc: Constructed a 9-layer geospatial suitability model using AHP-weighted overlay (45% thermal, 30% geological, 15% infrastructure, 10% topographic/environmental) for the Gulf of Suez.
Established a mean geothermal gradient of 48.5 °C/km (R = 0.975, R² = 0.9509) across 1,000–4,000 m depths from 52 corrected hydrocarbon borehole temperature records.

Classified specific coastal localities by suitable power generation technology: Hammam Faraun, Ras Sudr, Ras Gharib, and Ras Shukeir as very highly suitable for Binary Cycle (2,000–3,000 m) and Flash Steam (3,000–4,000 m).
基于AHP加权叠加（热力45%、地质30%、基础设施15%、地形与环境10%）构建了苏伊士湾9图层空间适宜性模型。
利用52口经校正的油气钻井温度记录，确立了1000–4000米深度范围内48.5 °C/km的平均地温梯度（R = 0.975, R² = 0.9509）。
按发电技术类型对沿海具体地点进行了分级：Hammam Faraun、Ras Sudr、Ras Gharib和Ras Shukeir非常适合双工质循环（2000–3000米）和闪蒸（3000–4000米）发电。
me: Bottom-hole temperature (BHT) correction using Horner and Waples & Ramly (2001) statistical methods, followed by 1D conductive geothermal gradient and heat flow calculation.
Inverse Distance Weighting (IDW) spatial interpolation in ArcMap 10.8 to generate continuous thermal and heat flow maps across 1,000–4,000 m depths.
Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) and Weighted Linear Combination (WLC) across nine thematic raster layers standardized onto a 1–9 suitability scale.
采用Horner法和Waples & Ramly (2001)统计法校正井底温度（BHT），进而计算一维传导地温梯度与大地热流。
在ArcMap 10.8中使用反距离加权（IDW）空间插值生成1000–4000米深度的连续温度场与热流分布图。
应用层次分析法（AHP）和加权线性组合（WLC）对标准化至1–9适宜度等级的9个专题栅格图层进行综合评估。
de: Subsurface temperature and depth logs from 52 hydrocarbon exploration wells across the Gulf of Suez compiled from Abdel Zaher et al. (2018).
USGS Earthquake Catalog (1960–early 2026) and Complete Bouguer Gravity Anomaly data from World Gravity Map (Bonvalot et al., 2012).
SRTM 30 m Digital Elevation Model (DEM), Landsat 8 imagery for land use, OpenStreetMap road networks, and Egyptian national electricity transmission grid datasets.
汇编自Abdel Zaher等（2018）的苏伊士湾52口油气探井的地下温度与深度测井数据。
USGS地震目录（1960年至2026年初）以及世界重力图（Bonvalot等，2012）的完全布格重力异常数据。
SRTM 30米数字高程模型（DEM）、用于土地利用分类的Landsat 8影像、OpenStreetMap道路网及埃及国家输电网数据集。
li: Uneven spatial distribution of the 52 wells (dense on the eastern margin, sparse on the western margin) introduces IDW interpolation uncertainty.
AHP weights rely on expert judgment without a formal weight-sensitivity perturbation analysis.
Lacks subsurface permeability, reservoir thickness, 3D thermal modeling, and fluid geochemical data.
52口钻井空间分布不均（东岸密集、西岸稀疏）导致IDW插值在西岸存在不确定性。
AHP权重依赖于专家主观判断，未进行系统的权重敏感性扰动分析。
缺乏地下渗透率、储层厚度、三维热模拟以及流体地球化学数据。

tm.why: The paper evaluates crustal geothermal gradients, terrestrial heat flow, fault density, and rift-related crustal thinning in the Gulf of Suez using 52 deep hydrocarbon borehole measurements.

ev.notes: Full 27-page PDF analyzed, including all 16 figures and 7 tables.

sum: This study integrates multibeam bathymetry, high-resolution multichannel seismic reflection data, and 3D structural modeling to reconstruct the offshore architecture of the Carboneras Fault Zone (CFZ) in the Alborán Sea. The authors map a deformation corridor exceeding 110 km in length, identifying five principal and seven subsidiary fault segments. By interpreting nine stratigraphic horizons from the Tortonian acoustic basement to the seafloor, they construct a 3D geological model. The CFZ is divided into northeastern, central, and southwestern sectors, with the central sector exhibiting the highest structural complexity (flower structures, pressure ridges, and sag ponds). This work refines the 3D geometry and segmentation of the CFZ, providing critical constraints for regional tectonics and seismic-hazard assessment.
本研究整合了多波束水深、高分辨率多道地震反射数据和三维构造建模，重新评估了阿尔沃兰海卡沃内拉斯断裂带（CFZ）的近海结构。研究表明，该断裂带形成了一个长度超过110公里的变形走廊，包含5个主断层段和7个次级断层段。通过解释从晚中新世（托尔顿阶）声学基底到海床的9个地层层位，构建了该断裂系统的三维地质……

t: Integration of multibeam bathymetry, high-resolution multichannel seismic reflection data, and 3D structural modeling to reconstruct fault geometry.
结合多波束水深、高分辨率多道地震反射数据和三维构造建模来重建断层几何结构。
Multibeam bathymetry and high-resolution multichannel seismic reflection profiles covering the offshore Carboneras Fault Zone in the Alborán Sea.
覆盖阿尔沃兰海近海卡沃内拉斯断裂带的多波束水深和高分辨率多道地震反射剖面。
Reconstructed a 110-km-long deformation corridor with 5 principal and 7 subsidiary segments, showing highest complexity in the central sector.
重建了110公里长的变形走廊，包含5个主断层段和7个次级段，中部区段构造最复杂。
The analysis is restricted to offshore data, lacking direct integration with onshore structural segments of the Carboneras Fault.
分析仅限于近海数据，缺乏与卡沃内拉斯断裂陆上构造段的直接整合。
Provides the first comprehensive 3D reconstruction and segmentation of the offshore CFZ, resolving along-strike structural variations.
首次对近海CFZ进行了全面的三维重建和分段，解决了沿走向的构造变化。

kc: Reconstructed a detailed 3D geological model of the offshore Carboneras Fault Zone (CFZ) using high-resolution seismic and bathymetric data.
Identified and characterized five principal and seven subsidiary fault segments along a 110 km deformation corridor.
Subdivided the CFZ into three distinct sectors (northeastern, central, southwestern) based on deformation style, uplift, and structural complexity.
利用高分辨率地震和水深数据，重建了卡沃内拉斯断裂带（CFZ）近海区域精细的三维地质模型。
在110公里长的变形走廊内识别并刻画了5个主断层段和7个次级断层段。
根据变形样式、抬升和构造复杂性，将CFZ细分为东北、中部和西南三个不同的区段。
me: High-resolution multichannel seismic reflection interpretation.
Multibeam bathymetry analysis for seafloor morphology.
Three-dimensional (3D) structural and geological modeling.
高分辨率多道地震反射数据解释。
用于海床地形分析的多波束测深技术。
三维构造与地质建模。
de: Multibeam bathymetry data of the Alborán Sea.
High-resolution multichannel seismic reflection profiles.
Interpretation of nine stratigraphic horizons from the Tortonian acoustic basement to the seafloor.
阿尔沃兰海的多波束水深数据。
高分辨率多道地震反射剖面。
对从托尔顿阶声学基底到海床的9个地层层位的解释。

Resolution of seismic data may limit the detection of very small-scale subsidiary faults.

sum: Following Kīlauea's massive 2018 flank eruption and summit caldera collapse, questions arose regarding whether magma supply would surge or storage pathways would reorganize. This study analyzes campaign microgravity measurements from March 2019 and April 2022 spanning the volcano's late-2020 eruptive reawakening. Raw gravity increases of up to hundreds of microgals near the summit caldera were corrected for vertical surface displacements using InSAR and GNSS data, and for the gravitational attraction of 108 × 10^6 m^3 of accumulated crater lava using 1-m digital elevation models. Bayesian inversion of the remaining residual gravity change reveals a subsurface mass increase of 6.9 × 10^10 kg at ~480 m depth beneath the 2018 collapse locus. Combining erupted lava, shallow summit storage, and East Rift Zone intrusion indicates that magma supply rates and reservoir geometry remained consistent with long-term pre-2018 averages, making an imminent transition to low-supply explosive volcanism unlikely.
针对2018年基拉韦厄火山大规模侧翼喷发与山顶破火山口坍塌后岩浆系统是否重构的问题，本文分析了2019年3月与2022年4月的流动微重力测量数据。研究结合InSAR和GNSS数据校正了地表垂直形变引起的自由空气重力效应，并利用1米分辨率数字高程模型（DEM）差分去除了坍塌坑内1.08亿立方米熔岩堆积……

t: The authors correct 2019–2022 campaign microgravity differences for InSAR-derived vertical free-air effects and 3D rectangular-prism gravitational attraction of erupted crater lava, then invert the residual signal using a Bayesian point-source model.
校正InSAR垂直形变自由空气效应并正演扣除火山口熔岩湖三维棱柱引力，再对剩余重力变化进行贝叶斯单点源反演。

Data comprise campaign microgravity surveys at 42 summit stations in March 2019 and April 2022 using Scintrex CG-5 gravimeters, alongside TerraSAR-X/COSMO-SkyMed InSAR, continuous GNSS, and 1-m lidar/photogrammetry DEMs.
2019年3月和2022年4月42个山顶测站的CG-5微重力数据，配合InSAR、连续GNSS和1米分辨率DEM。

After removing free-air effects and 108 × 10^6 m^3 of crater lava, Bayesian inversion yields a subsurface mass increase of 6.9 × 10^10 kg (25–30 × 10^6 m^3 magma) at 480 m depth beneath the 2018 collapse.
扣除1.08亿方熔岩引力后，反演得2018坍塌区下方480米深处质量增加6.9×10^10千克（约2500–3000万方…

Subsurface groundwater variations between 2019 and 2022 cannot be directly quantified or fully separated from magma accumulation, introducing an unquantifiable uncertainty into the residual gravity interpretation.
无法直接量化并分离地下水变化与岩浆聚集对重力增加的相对贡献，带来难以量化的不确定性。
Demonstrates via post-collapse microgravity across Kīlauea's reawakening that neither magma supply rate nor shallow reservoir geometry was significantly altered by the massive 2018 collapse.
首次通过跨越喷发复苏期的微重力测量证明2018年大坍塌未改变基拉韦厄岩浆供应率或浅部岩浆房几何结构。

kc: Documented 2019–2022 microgravity changes across 42 stations at Kīlauea's summit spanning its post-2018 eruptive reawakening.
Isolated subsurface mass change by removing InSAR-derived free-air effects and 3D rectangular-prism gravity forward models of 108 × 10^6 m^3 of crater lava.
Constrained a subsurface mass increase of 6.9 × 10^10 kg at 480 m depth, showing no post-2018 surge in magma supply or change in Halemaʻumaʻu reservoir geometry.
记录了2019–2022年基拉韦厄火山山顶42个测站的微重力变化，跨越了2018年坍塌后的喷发复苏期。
通过去除InSAR派生的自由空气效应以及1.08亿立方米火山口熔岩的三维矩形棱柱正演重力效应，分离出了地下质量变化信号。
约束了480米深处6.9×10^10千克的地下质量增加，证明2018年后岩浆供应未发生激增且Halemaʻumaʻu岩浆房几何形态未变。
me: Double-loop campaign microgravity surveys using two Scintrex CG-5 gravimeters corrected for solid Earth tides, tilt, temperature, drift, and ocean loading via gTOOLS.
Free-air gravity correction (-308.6 μGal/m) using vertical displacements combined from ascending and descending TerraSAR-X InSAR time series (MintPy) and continuous GNSS.

Forward gravitational modeling of accumulated crater lava discretized into >880,000 vertical 1-m^2 rectangular prisms (and verified with 10-m point sources) using 2019 lidar and 2022 photogrammetry DEMs.
Bayesian point-source inversion of lava-corrected residual gravity changes using the Geodetic Bayesian Inversion Software (GBIS).
使用两台Scintrex CG-5重力仪开展双环路流动微重力测量，并通过gTOOLS校正固体潮、倾斜、温度、零漂和海潮负荷。
结合升降轨TerraSAR-X InSAR时间序列（MintPy）与连续GNSS获取垂直位移，进行自由空气重力校正（-308.6 μGal/m）。
利用2019年激光雷达和2022年摄影测量DEM，将堆积熔岩离散为超过88万个1平方米垂直矩形棱柱（并用10米点源验证）进行重力正演。
利用大地测量贝叶斯反演软件（GBIS）对熔岩校正后的剩余重力变化进行单点源贝叶斯反演。
de: Campaign microgravity measurements at 42 summit stations in March 2019 and April 2022 relative to reference station P1.
TerraSAR-X (59 descending, 60 ascending images) and COSMO-SkyMed InSAR data plus continuous GNSS time series from the Hawaiian Volcanoes Supersite.
1-m resolution Digital Elevation Models from July 2019 airborne lidar and April 2022 uncrewed aircraft structure-from-motion photogrammetry.
2019年3月和2022年4月在基拉韦厄山顶42个测站相对于基准站P1采集的流动微重力数据。
来自夏威夷火山超级站点的TerraSAR-X（59景降轨、60景升轨）与COSMO-SkyMed InSAR数据及连续GNSS时间序列。
2019年7月机载激光雷达与2022年4月无人机运动恢复结构（SfM）摄影测量生成的1米分辨率数字高程模型（DEM）。
li: Instrument #579 malfunctioned during the 2022 survey on the downdropped block due to rough terrain hiking, requiring reliance on single-gravimeter differences with an assigned 20 μGal uncertainty.
Discrepancies of 0.05–0.06 m between InSAR and GNSS vertical displacements required assigning a uniform 0.05 m uncertainty (~15 μGal) to free-air corrections.
Relative contributions of groundwater fluctuations versus magma accumulation to the subsurface gravity increase cannot be directly untangled.
A single spherical point-source model simplifies the combination of 1–2 km deep reservoir storage, shallow dike intrusions, and void-filling beneath the caldera floor.
2022年在塌陷块体徒步测量时#579重力仪出现故障，迫使该区域仅依赖单台仪器差分并人为指定20 μGal的不确定度。
InSAR与GNSS垂直位移之间存在0.05–0.06米的差异，需要为自由空气校正指定0.05米（约15 μGal）的统一不确定度。
无法直接分离地下水波动与岩浆聚集对地下重力增加的相对贡献。
单球形点源模型简化了1–2公里深处岩浆房储集、浅部岩脉侵入以及破火山口底部裂隙填充的综合效应。

tm.why: The paper investigates magma supply, storage geometry, and eruptive reawakening at Kīlauea Volcano using microgravity, GNSS, InSAR, and DEM data.
The authors invert the lava-corrected residual gravity change using the Geodetic Bayesian Inversion Software (GBIS) to estimate point-source mass and depth with 95% credible intervals.

sum: Small earthquakes in tectonic fault zones are traditionally assumed to follow simple double-couple (DC) shear failure. Using continuous waveforms from a hyperdense (~1000 stations, ~1 km spacing) seismic network in western Tottori, Japan, the authors investigate ~4000 microearthquakes (aftershocks of the 2000 Mw 6.7 earthquake). They apply deep-learning phase picking (PhaseNet) and polarity classification (APPNet and DiTingMotion) to extract 227,685 high-confidence P-wave first-motion polarities, followed by Bayesian full moment tensor inversion (MTfit). Obtaining 1873 focal mechanisms and isolating 617 high-quality Rank-A solutions, they find that over 50% of events have >40% non-double-couple (NDC) components, dominated by positive isotropic (67%) and negative CLVD (61%) signatures. Kinematic modeling with tensile-shear and double-shear fault models shows NDC events cluster near co-seismic slip edges and low-Vp anomalies. This provides the first systematic evidence that NDC ruptures are widespread in tectonic strike-slip systems, driven by fluid-assisted cracking, rock damage, and structural complexity.
传统观点认为构造断层带的小震遵循纯剪切双力偶（DC）破裂。本研究利用日本鸟取西部超密集台阵（约1000个台站，间距约1公里）记录的约4000次微震波形，结合深度学习震相拾取（PhaseNet）与初动极性分类（APPNet和DiTingMotion）获取了227,685个高质量P波极性，并采用MTfi……

t: Deep learning models (PhaseNet, APPNet, DiTingMotion) pick P-waves and classify first-motion polarities; MTfit then performs Bayesian Monte Carlo full moment tensor inversion, followed by L-BFGS-B optimization of tensile-shear and double-shear models.
利用深度学习拾取P波并判定初动极性，通过MTfit进行贝叶斯全矩张量反演，并优化张裂-剪切与双剪切模型。

Continuous vertical-component waveforms (100 Hz) from a hyperdense network of ~1000 stations (~1 km spacing) in western Tottori, Japan (April 2017–April 2018), yielding 227,685 reliable P-wave polarities across 4033 microearthquakes (ML ≥ 0).
2017-2018年日本鸟取约1000个台站（间距1公里）记录的4033次微震波形，提取了227,685个可靠P波极性。
Out of 1873 inverted focal mechanisms (617 Rank-A), over 50% (±1%) have >40% NDC components, with 67% (±3%) exhibiting positive isotropic expansion and 61% (±3%) negative CLVD components.
获1873个震源机制（617个A级），超50%含>40%非双力偶分量，其中67%呈正各向同性，61%呈负CLVD。

Both tensile-shear and double-shear models can equally reproduce ~6% of events, precluding a unique distinction between fluid-driven and structurally controlled processes using polarity-only inversions.
仅靠P波极性反演，约6%的事件无法唯一区分张裂-剪切（流体驱动）与双剪切（结构控制）模型。
Provides the first systematic evidence from thousands of microearthquakes on a hyperdense array that non-double-couple ruptures are widespread and persistent in a tectonic strike-slip fault system.
基于超密集台阵数千次微震，首次系统证实构造走滑断层系中广泛且持续存在非双力偶破裂。

kc: Extracted 227,685 high-confidence P-wave first-motion polarities from ~4000 microearthquakes recorded on a ~1000-station array using PhaseNet, APPNet, and DiTingMotion.
Performed Bayesian full moment tensor inversions (MTfit) to obtain 1873 focal mechanisms and developed a four-tier quality ranking system based on Kullback-Leibler divergence and NDC circle geometry.

Demonstrated that over 50% of high-quality microearthquakes in the Tottori strike-slip fault system exhibit significant (>40%) non-double-couple components, with 67% showing positive isotropic expansion.
Evaluated competing tensile-shear and double-shear kinematic fault models, linking NDC seismicity to low-Vp fluid-rich zones, co-seismic slip peripheries, and off-fault rock damage.
利用PhaseNet、APPNet和DiTingMotion从约1000个台站记录的约4000次微震中提取了227,685个高置信度P波初动极性。
利用MTfit进行贝叶斯全矩张量反演获得1873个震源机制，并提出了基于KL散度和NDC圆几何特征的四级质量评估体系。
证明鸟取走滑断层系中超过50%的高质量微震具有显著（>40%）的非双力偶分量，其中67%表现为正各向同性体积膨胀。
评估了张裂-剪切与双剪切运动学断层模型，将NDC地震活动性与低P波速度富流体区、同震滑动边缘及断层外岩石损伤相联系。
me: Automated P-wave arrival picking with PhaseNet and SNR filtering (>10 dB over 2-s windows).
Dual-network P-wave first-motion polarity determination requiring consensus (>0.8 probability) between APPNet and DiTingMotion.
Bayesian Monte Carlo full moment tensor inversion (1,000,000 samples) using P-wave polarities in MTfit with 3D tomoDD takeoff angles.
Solution quality ranking using Kullback-Leibler divergence (DKL > 6) and a newly defined NDC circle around the null (N) axis.
L-BFGS-B optimization of five-parameter tensile-shear (Model 1) and double-shear (Model 2) kinematic source models against inverted radiation patterns.
使用PhaseNet自动拾取P波到时，并基于前后2秒窗口进行信噪比筛选（SNR > 10 dB）。
采用APPNet和DiTingMotion双神经网络判定P波初动极性，仅保留两模型结果一致且概率大于0.8的极性。
基于3D tomoDD离源角，利用MTfit对P波极性进行100万次采样的贝叶斯蒙特卡洛全矩张量反演。
结合Kullback-Leibler散度（DKL > 6）和围绕零轴（N轴）定义的NDC圆构建解的质量分级体系。
利用L-BFGS-B算法拟合反演辐射花样，优化五参数张裂-剪切模型（模型1）和双剪切模型（模型2）。
de: Continuous vertical-component waveform data (100 Hz sampling, 2.0 or 4.5 Hz sensors) from ~1000 stations (~1 km spacing) deployed in western Tottori between April 2017 and April 2018.
Catalog of 4033 microearthquakes (completeness magnitude ML ~0, focal depths mostly around 6 km) and 3D velocity perturbations (δVp) from Kato et al. (2021).
Synthetic recovery tests on 529 Rank-A station configurations (>50 stations) testing pure DC and prescribed NDC moment tensor reconstructions.
2017年4月至2018年4月在日本鸟取西部部署的约1000个垂直分量台站（间距约1公里，采样率100 Hz，固有频率2.0或4.5 Hz）的连续波形数据。
来自Kato et al. (2021)的4033个微震目录（完备震级约ML 0，震源深度主要在6公里左右）及三维速度扰动模型（δVp）。
基于529个A级事件台站分布（>50个台站）开展的纯DC与预设NDC合成矩张量恢复测试。
li: Inversions rely solely on vertical-component P-wave first-motion polarities without S-wave polarities, amplitude ratios, or full waveforms.
Synthetic tests show a mean recovery error of ~0.17 for pure DC sources due to polarity coverage uncertainties.
Kinematic ambiguity exists between the tensile-shear and double-shear models, with ~6% of events equally well explained by both models at a strict distance threshold of 0.02.
反演仅依赖单分量P波初动极性，未结合S波极性、振幅比或全波形信息。
合成测试显示，受极性覆盖不确定性影响，纯DC震源的平均恢复误差约为0.17。

tm.why: The study performs full moment tensor inversions of ~4000 microearthquakes to reveal widespread non-double-couple (tensile-shear and double-shear) rupture mechanisms.
The paper links non-double-couple earthquake mechanisms to fluid overpressure, rock damage, dilatancy, and geometrical fault complexity along the Tottori strike-slip fault system.
Deep learning models (PhaseNet, APPNet, and DiTingMotion) are systematically used to pick P-wave arrivals and determine 227,685 reliable first-motion polarities.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete 11-page PDF article including all main text sections, equations, and Figures 1–5.

sum: This study presents physics-based dynamic rupture and ground-motion simulations for the Jinqianghe–Maomaoshan (JQH–MMS) fault system in the Tianzhu seismic gap. To overcome poorly constrained initial stress conditions, the authors use geodetic estimates of interseismic locking and slip deficit rates from InSAR and GPS. The simulations show that a potential earthquake could generate peak ground motions exceeding intensity XI on the Chinese Seismic Intensity Scale. Comparing models with and without geodetic constraints reveals that locking-derived stress significantly influences rupture propagation and extent, providing a physically grounded framework for seismic hazard assessment.
本研究针对天祝空区金强河—毛毛山断裂带，开展了基于物理的动力破裂与地面运动模拟。研究利用InSAR和GPS大地测量观测的震间锁合分布及滑移亏损率约束初始应力。模拟表明，该断裂若发生地震，极震区烈度可超XI度。对比表明，锁合度约束的应力模型显著影响破裂传播与范围，为地震危险性评估提供了更具物理基础的框……

t: Constraining initial stress distributions in dynamic rupture simulations using geodetic estimates of interseismic locking and slip deficit rates from InSAR and GPS.
利用InSAR和GPS大地测量估算的震间锁合及滑移亏损率来约束动力破裂模拟中的初始应力分布。
Geodetic data (InSAR and GPS) and fault geometry of the Jinqianghe–Maomaoshan fault system in the Tianzhu seismic gap.
天祝地震空区内金强河—毛毛山断裂带的大地测量数据（InSAR和GPS）及断层几何。
Simulations show the fault can generate an earthquake with peak ground motions exceeding intensity XI, and locking-derived stress significantly affects rupture propagation.
模拟表明该断裂可产生烈度超XI度的地震，且基于锁合度的应力显著影响破裂传播。
The study's initial stress relies heavily on geodetic locking models, which have inherent resolution limits and simplified assumptions.
初始应力高度依赖于大地测量锁合模型，该模型具有固有的分辨率限制和简化假设。
Integrating geodetic interseismic locking and slip deficit rates directly into physics-based dynamic rupture and ground-motion simulations for a specific seismic gap.
将大地测量震间锁合与滑移亏损直接引入特定地震空区的物理动力破裂与地面运动模拟中。

kc: Developed/applied a framework to constrain initial fault stress in dynamic rupture simulations using geodetic (InSAR/GPS) interseismic locking.
Simulated potential earthquake scenarios on the Jinqianghe–Maomaoshan (JQH–MMS) fault, predicting ground motion intensity exceeding XI.
Demonstrated that geodetically constrained stress models significantly alter rupture propagation and extent compared to unconstrained models.
开发/应用了利用大地测量（InSAR/GPS）震间锁合度约束动力破裂模拟中初始断层应力的框架。
模拟了金强河—毛毛山断裂带的潜在地震情景，预测其产生的极震区烈度可超过XI度。
证实了与无约束模型相比，受大地测量约束的应力模型会显著改变破裂的传播过程和范围。
me: Geodetic inversion of InSAR and GPS data to estimate interseismic locking and slip deficit rates.
Physics-based dynamic rupture simulation constrained by geodetic stress.
Kinematic and dynamic ground-motion simulation.
利用InSAR和GPS数据进行大地测量反演，以估算震间锁合度和滑移亏损率。
受大地测量应力约束的基于物理的动力破裂模拟。
运动学与动力学强地面运动模拟。
de: Geodetic data (InSAR and GPS) from the Jinqianghe–Maomaoshan fault zone within the Tianzhu seismic gap.
Scenario simulations of dynamic rupture and ground motion with and without geodetic constraints.
来自天祝地震空区内金强河—毛毛山断裂带的大地测量数据（InSAR和GPS）。
包含和不包含大地测量约束的动力破裂与地面运动情景模拟。
li: The reliability of the simulations depends on the resolution and assumptions of the geodetic locking inversion.
Dynamic rupture parameters (e.g., friction properties) still contain uncertainties not fully resolved by geodesy.
模拟的可靠性取决于大地测量锁合度反演的分辨率和假设。
动力破裂参数（如摩擦属性）仍存在大地测量无法完全解决的不确定性。

tm.why: The paper performs physics-based dynamic rupture simulations of potential earthquakes.
The paper simulates ground motions to assess seismic hazard and risk in the Tianzhu seismic gap.
The initial stress conditions on the fault are constrained by geodetic interseismic locking and slip deficit rates.

sum: Classical Fourier spectral analysis is limited by the Rayleigh resolution scale, while parametric methods like AR and HTLS require accurate prior knowledge of harmonic counts (K) and frequency bands. This study introduces Super-Resolution Spectral Analysis (SRSA), which constructs a 2D pseudospectrum by evaluating the orthogonality between candidate-frequency Vandermonde steering vectors and multi-scale noise subspaces derived from Hankel matrix singular value decomposition (Hankel-SVD) across varying window lengths L. Theoretical bounds and synthetic experiments demonstrate that SRSA is robust to moderate perturbations in model order K and achieves up to an order-of-magnitude resolution improvement over Fourier benchmarks. Applied to 36 superconducting gravimeter records from the 2004 Sumatra-Andaman and 2011 Tohoku earthquakes, SRSA resolves complete singlet splitting for low-frequency spheroidal modes (0S2, 0S3, 0S4, 1S2, 2S1) and multiple singlets of core-sensitive modes (3S2, 2S3, 11S1, 10S2) even from single stations without relying on spatial array mode isolation.
针对傅里叶谱受限于瑞利分辨率及传统参数方法依赖模型阶数K先验信息的难题，本文提出超分辨率谱分析（SRSA）方法。该方法利用不同窗长L的Hankel矩阵奇异值分解提取多尺度噪声子空间，通过计算候选频率范德蒙德导向矢量与噪声子空间的正交性构建二维超分辨率伪谱。合成实验与36条超导重力仪（2004苏门答腊……

t: SRSA estimates multi-scale noise subspaces via Hankel-SVD across window lengths L and projects normalized candidate-frequency Vandermonde steering vectors onto them to build a 2D pseudospectrum.
通过不同窗长L的Hankel-SVD估计多尺度噪声子空间，并将候选频率范德蒙德导向矢量投影其上以构建二维超分辨率伪谱。
Three synthetic harmonic datasets and 36 superconducting gravimeter (SG) residual gravity records following the 2004 Sumatra-Andaman (17 records) and 2011 Tohoku (19 records) megathrust earthquakes.
三组合成谐波时间序列，以及2004苏门答腊（17条）和2011日本东北大震（19条）后的36条超导重力仪残差记录。
SRSA achieves ~10x resolution gain (resolving 0.005 cpy vs 0.0488 cpy Fourier main-lobe) in noise-free synthetics and resolves complete singlet splitting for 0S2, 2S1, 0S3, 0S4, and 1S2.
无噪合成实验中分辨率提升约一个量级（达0.005 cpy），并在实际重力数据中完整分辨出0S2至1S2等模态的分裂单线态…
SRSA is a pseudospectrum that does not yield physical amplitudes or damping directly, and its effective resolution remains SNR-dependent.
SRSA属于伪谱，无法直接给出物理振幅与阻尼，且有效分辨率仍受噪声水平限制。
Unlike conventional rotational-invariance methods using the signal subspace, SRSA exploits multi-scale noise subspaces to build a visual 2D super-resolution spectrum robust to model-order errors.
利用多尺度噪声子空间正交性而非信号子空间旋转不变性构建二维可视化谱，对模型阶数误差具有高鲁棒性。

kc: Proposes the Super-Resolution Spectral Analysis (SRSA) method constructing a 2D pseudospectrum over candidate frequency and Hankel window length L via noise-subspace orthogonality.
Establishes theoretical bounds via Gram matrix conditioning and Dirichlet coherence to explain SRSA's frequency resolution mechanism, window-length trade-offs, and robustness to model order K.

Resolves complete singlet splitting patterns for low-frequency modes (0S2, 2S1, 0S3, 0S4, 1S2) and multiple singlets of core-sensitive modes (3S2, 2S3, 11S1, 10S2) from superconducting gravimeter data.
提出了超分辨率谱分析（SRSA）方法，利用噪声子空间正交性构建关于候选频率与Hankel窗长L的二维伪谱。
基于Gram矩阵条件数与Dirichlet相干因子建立了理论界限，阐明了SRSA的高分辨率机制、窗长权衡及对模型阶数K的鲁棒性。
利用超导重力仪数据成功分辨出低频模态（0S2, 2S1, 0S3, 0S4, 1S2）的完整分裂单线态以及多个核敏感模态（3S2, 2S3, 11S1, 10S2）的单线态。
me: Multi-scale Hankel matrix embedding and singular value decomposition (Hankel-SVD) across varying window lengths L to extract orthogonal noise subspaces.
Projection of normalized candidate-frequency Vandermonde steering vectors onto multi-scale noise subspaces to form a 2D super-resolution pseudospectrum.
Multiplicative stacking of the 2D SR spectrum over stable window-length intervals to suppress incoherent background fluctuations and generate a 1D SR spectrum.
跨不同窗长L进行多尺度Hankel矩阵嵌入与奇异值分解（Hankel-SVD），以提取正交噪声子空间。
将归一化候选频率范德蒙德导向矢量投影至多尺度噪声子空间，构建二维超分辨率伪谱。
在稳定窗长区间上对二维SR谱进行乘性叠加，以压制非相干背景波动并生成一维SR谱。
de: Synthetic experiments: 4-component noisy complex exponential series for K-robustness; 41-year noise-free series with 28 clustered harmonics in 6 narrow bands; 100-realization Monte Carlo SNR-resolution tests.
36 superconducting gravimeter (SG) residual gravity records from the Global Geodynamics Project (GGP) following the 2004 Sumatra-Andaman (17 records) and 2011 Tohoku (19 records) earthquakes.
合成实验：用于K鲁棒性验证的4分量含噪复指数序列；含6个窄带28个密集谐波的41年无噪序列；100次实现的蒙特卡洛信噪比-分辨率联合测试。
来自全球地球动力学计划（GGP）在2004年苏门答腊-安达曼大震（17条）和2011年日本东北大震（19条）后的36条超导重力仪残差重力记录。
li: SRSA produces a pseudospectrum reflecting frequency-subspace coherence rather than physical amplitudes or spectral energies, requiring subsequent parametric fitting for amplitude, phase, and damping.
Effective frequency resolution remains dependent on the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) and requires balancing frequency aperture (L) against finite-sample support (QL) for densely spaced spectral lines.
SRSA生成的是反映频率-子空间相干性的伪谱，不代表真实物理振幅或谱能量，需后续参数拟合来获取振幅、相位和阻尼。
有效频率分辨率仍依赖于信噪比（SNR），且在处理密集谱线时需权衡频率孔径（L）与有限样本支持度（QL）。

tm.why: The paper detects and resolves the fine splitting of low-frequency spheroidal and core-sensitive Earth's free oscillation eigenmodes to constrain Earth's interior structure.
The paper develops a mathematical subspace-based spectral estimation framework (SRSA) using Hankel-SVD and Vandermonde matrix orthogonality for blind harmonic parameter retrieval.

ev.notes: Full 32-page GJI manuscript PDF including mathematical derivations, 3 synthetic experiments, SG data analysis from the 2004 Sumatra and 2011 Tohoku earthquakes, 8 figures, and 1 table.

sum: This study investigates the driving mechanism behind the rapid rifting of the Gulf of California oblique rift (GOCOR) ~6 to 8 million years ago. By utilizing three-dimensional geodynamic models, the authors demonstrate that the initiation of double subduction in the Western Pacific reorganized plate kinematics and transmitted significant extensional stresses (~5 to 15 MPa) across the Pacific plate. This stress transfer loaded both the GOCOR and the southern San Andreas fault. The findings suggest that far-field subduction reorganization can act as a primary driver for continental rifting within preconditioned lithosphere, offering a new perspective on global tectonic force transmission and rifting dynamics.
本研究探讨了约600万至800万年前加利福尼亚湾斜向裂谷（GOCOR）快速裂解的动力学机制。作者利用三维地球动力学数值模拟，表明西太平洋双俯冲的启动重组了板块运动学，并跨越太平洋板块传递了约5至15兆帕的显著拉张应力。这种应力传递加载到了GOCOR和圣安德烈斯断裂带南部。研究结果表明，远场俯冲重组可……

t: Three-dimensional geodynamic numerical modeling simulating plate kinematics, subduction dynamics, and stress transmission across the Pacific plate.
模拟板块运动学、俯冲动力学及跨太平洋板块应力传递的三维地球动力学数值模拟。
Synthetic geodynamic model configurations representing the Western Pacific subduction zones, Pacific plate, and the western North American plate boundary.
代表西太平洋俯冲带、太平洋板块和北美西部板块边界的合成地球动力学模型配置。
Western Pacific double subduction initiation transmits 5 to 15 MPa of extensional stress across the Pacific plate, loading the Gulf of California rift and southern San Andreas fault.
西太平洋双俯冲启动跨太平洋板块传递了5-15兆帕的拉张应力，加载了加利福尼亚湾裂谷。
Potential sensitivity of stress transmission to simplified mantle viscosity profiles and lithospheric rheology assumptions in the 3D models.
三维模型中应力传递对简化的地幔粘度剖面和岩石圈流变学假设的潜在敏感性。
Establishing a direct dynamical link between Western Pacific subduction reorganization and the rapid initiation of rifting in the Gulf of California.
在西太平洋俯冲重组与加利福尼亚湾快速裂谷启动之间建立了直接的动力学联系。

kc: Linked the rapid rifting of the Gulf of California oblique rift (GOCOR) to the initiation of Western Pacific double subduction.
Demonstrated via 3D geodynamic modeling that far-field subduction reorganization can transmit 5–15 MPa of extensional stress across the Pacific plate.
Provided a physical mechanism explaining how far-field tectonic forces can load local fault systems like the southern San Andreas fault.
将加利福尼亚湾斜向裂谷（GOCOR）的快速裂解与西太平洋双俯冲的启动联系起来。
通过三维地球动力学模拟证实，远场俯冲重组可跨越太平洋板块传递5-15兆帕的拉张应力。
提供了一种物理机制，解释了远场板块构造力如何加载到南部圣安德烈斯断裂等局部断裂系统。
me: Three-dimensional geodynamic numerical modeling of plate tectonics and stress transmission.
板块构造与应力传递的三维地球动力学数值模拟。
de: Synthetic geodynamic simulations modeling the Pacific plate, Western Pacific subduction zones, and the North American margin (GOCOR/San Andreas fault).
模拟太平洋板块、西太平洋俯冲带和北美边缘（GOCOR/圣安德烈斯断裂）的合成地球动力学数值模拟。
li: The simplified representation of lithospheric preconditioning and rheology in the 3D geodynamic models.
三维地球动力学模型中对岩石圈预处理和流变学的简化表示。

tm.why: The paper uses 3D geodynamic models to investigate the tectonic forces driving continental rifting and subduction dynamics.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the published abstract in Science and crossref metadata as no PDF was available.

sum: Models of injection-induced aseismic fault slip typically assume uniform in-situ stresses, predicting symmetric rupture growth. This paper relaxes this assumption by introducing linear depth variations of resolved shear and effective normal tractions on a 2D planar fault with constant friction under constant-overpressure fluid injection. Enforcing vanishing stress intensity factors at both tips yields two coupled propagation equations, which are solved semi-analytically and validated against coupled boundary-element/finite-element hydro-mechanical simulations. The stress gradient introduces a characteristic length scale Lc, breaking self-similarity. Rupture growth is governed by the fault-stress injection parameter T and the ratio of fluid diffusion length to Lc. While early growth is symmetric, up-dip propagation subsequently outpaces down-dip growth. In the marginally pressurized regime (T ~ 1), relative asymmetry grows as ~1.1*(4*alpha*t/Lc^2)^(1/2) with strong up-dip acceleration. In the critically stressed regime (T << 1), asymmetry grows as ~0.34*(4*alpha*t/(T^2*Lc^2))^(1/2) and remains moderate. Applied to the Rittershoffen geothermal stimulation, the model predicts...
以往注水诱发无震滑移模型常假设断层原位应力均匀，预测对称破裂。本文引入剪应力和有效正应力的线性深度梯度，研究二维平面应变恒定摩擦断层在恒定超压注水下的破裂扩展。通过令两端应力强度因子为零建立耦合方程，进行半解析求解并与边界元-有限元水力-力学耦合数值模拟对比。应力梯度引入特征尺度Lc并打破自相似性，……

t: The authors enforce vanishing mode-II stress intensity factors at both rupture tips to derive two coupled integral equations for up-dip and down-dip tip positions, validated against a coupled BEM-FEM elastoplastic solver.
利用两端II型应力强度因子为零推导裂尖耦合积分方程，并用BEM-FEM弹塑性耦合求解器验证。

Synthetic 2D numerical experiments spanning critically stressed (T = 0.1) to marginally pressurized (T = 0.9) regimes, plus field parameters from the 2013 Rittershoffen geothermal well GRT-1 stimulation.
涵盖T=0.1至0.9的二维合成数值实验，以及2013年Rittershoffen地热GRT-1井增产现场参数。

Relative rupture asymmetry grows as 1.1*(4*alpha*t/Lc^2)^(1/2) in the marginally pressurized regime and 0.336*(4*alpha*t/(T*Lc)^2)^(1/2) in the critically stressed regime, predicting an asymmetry of ~0.3 at Rittershoffen.
临界加压和临界应力下相对不对称性分别按1.1√t¯和0.336√tˆ增长，Rittershoffen不对称度约0.3。
The model is restricted to a single 2D slipping patch with constant friction, no dilatancy, smooth linear stress gradients, and constant overpressure injection.
局限于二维单滑移斑块、恒定摩擦、无扩容、平滑线性应力梯度及恒定超压注入。
Extends analytical and numerical models of fluid-driven aseismic fault slip from uniform in-situ stress to linear depth-dependent stress gradients, quantifying how self-similarity breaks.
将流体驱动无震滑移模型从均匀原位应力扩展至线性深度应力梯度，量化自相似性破缺机制。

kc: Formulated a 2D plane-strain model of fluid-driven frictional fault rupture incorporating linear depth gradients in resolved shear and effective normal stresses.
Derived two coupled semi-analytical tip propagation equations from vanishing stress intensity factors and identified two governing dimensionless parameters (T and S).
Established asymptotic scaling laws for relative rupture asymmetry in both marginally pressurized and critically stressed regimes, validated by coupled BEM-FEM numerical simulations.
Demonstrated practical applicability by evaluating stress-gradient length scales and rupture asymmetry for the 2013 Rittershoffen geothermal hydraulic stimulation.
建立了考虑分解剪应力和有效正应力随深度线性梯度的二维平面应变流体驱动摩擦断层破裂模型。
基于两端应力强度因子为零推导出两个耦合的半解析裂尖扩展方程，并确定了两个主导无量纲参数（T和S）。
建立了临界加压和临界应力两种状态下相对破裂不对称性的渐近标度律，并通过BEM-FEM耦合数值模拟进行了验证。
通过评估2013年Rittershoffen地热水利增产的应力梯度特征尺度和破裂不对称性，展示了模型的实际应用价值。
me: One-way coupled 1D pore-pressure diffusion along a permeable fault gouge under constant overpressure injection.
Linear elastic fracture mechanics (LEFM) weight-function approach enforcing vanishing mode-II stress intensity factors at up-dip and down-dip tips.
Numerical root-finding of coupled non-linear integral equations for tip amplification factors.

Fully coupled 2D hydro-mechanical numerical simulations combining a collocation boundary element method (elasticity) and finite element method (fluid flow) with an elastoplastic return-mapping scheme.
恒定超压注水下沿高渗断层泥的单向耦合一维孔隙压力扩散模型。
利用线弹性断裂力学（LEFM）权函数法，在逆倾向和顺倾向裂尖施加II型应力强度因子为零的扩展条件。
对裂尖放大因子的耦合非线性积分方程进行数值求根。
结合配点边界元法（弹性）和有限元法（流体流动）以及弹塑性返回映射算法的全耦合二维水力-力学数值模拟。
de: Numerical simulations comparing critically stressed (T = 0.1), intermediate (T = 0.5), and marginally pressurized (T = 0.9) fault regimes on an 800 m domain with 10,000 elements.
Field-scale case study using published microseismic catalog, stress profile, and downhole injection overpressure data from the 2013 GRT-1 well stimulation at Rittershoffen, France.
在包含10,000个单元的800米计算域上，对比临界应力（T = 0.1）、中间状态（T = 0.5）和临界加压（T = 0.9）断层机制的数值模拟实验。
利用法国Rittershoffen地热田2013年GRT-1井增产的已发表微震目录、应力剖面和井下注入超压数据进行的现场尺度案例研究。
li: Restricted to the evolution of a single primary slipping patch prior to the nucleation of a secondary patch at the yield boundary x = -Lc.
Assumes smooth linear stress gradients within a single layer, neglecting abrupt stress jumps across lithological boundaries.
Assumes constant friction and constant hydraulic properties, neglecting frictional weakening, shear-induced dilatancy, and permeability evolution.
Restricted to 2D plane-strain geometry and constant overpressure injection rather than 3D geometry and constant injection rate.
仅限于研究在屈服边界 x = -Lc 处萌生次级滑移斑块之前的单一主滑移斑块演化。
假设单一地层内为平滑线性应力梯度，忽略了跨岩性界面的应力突变。
假设摩擦系数和水力性质恒定，忽略了摩擦弱化、剪切扩容及渗透率演化。
局限于二维平面应变几何和恒定超压注入，而非三维几何与恒定注入率。

tm.why: The paper develops semi-analytical and numerical models of fluid-driven aseismic frictional fault slip under linear depth-dependent stress gradients.
The model addresses fluid injection into subsurface faults and is applied to hydraulic stimulation and microseismicity at the Rittershoffen geothermal reservoir.
The study derives fracture mechanics propagation conditions for up-dip and down-dip shear rupture tips using stress intensity factors and boundary integral equations.

ev.notes: Full 23-page PDF read and analyzed, including all mathematical derivations, tables, and 8 figures.

sum: This study analyzes foreshock activity associated with ML≥5 mainshocks in Taiwan from 2012 to 2022 using the nearest-neighbor clustering method. The authors find that only ~25% of Taiwanese mainshocks are preceded by foreshocks, which is lower than in California or Italy. Crucially, foreshock occurrence varies systematically with depth and focal mechanism: lower differential stress at shallower depths and on normal faults promotes higher foreshock rates. Additionally, the spatial extent of foreshocks correlates with both mainshock magnitude and the largest foreshock. These findings support a global trend where lower background seismicity rates correlate with higher foreshock percentages, highlighting differential stress and background seismicity as primary drivers of foreshock generation.
本研究利用最近邻聚类方法分析了2012至2022年间台湾地区ML≥5主震的前震活动。结果显示，台湾仅有约25%的主震伴随前震，明显低于加州和意大利。前震发生率随深度和断层机制系统性变化：浅部低差应力和正断层环境更易引发前震。此外，前震区空间范围与主震震级及最大前震震级相关。研究证实了背景地震率越低、……

t: Nearest-neighbor clustering method applied to identify and characterize foreshock-mainshock sequences from the Taiwan earthquake catalog.
应用最近邻聚类方法对台湾地震目录中的前震-主震序列进行识别和特征刻画。
Seismicity catalog of Taiwan from 2012 to 2022, focusing on mainshocks with ML >= 5.
2012至2022年间台湾地区的地震目录，重点关注ML >= 5的主震。
Only ~25% of mainshocks have foreshocks; shallow depths and normal faulting (lower differential stress) significantly increase foreshock percentages.
仅约25%的主震伴随前震；浅部和正断层（低差应力）显著增加了前震比例。
Results are sensitive to catalog completeness and the statistical thresholds of the nearest-neighbor clustering method.
结果对地震目录的完整性以及最近邻聚类方法的统计阈值较为敏感。
First systematic regional analysis in Taiwan linking foreshock occurrence directly to depth, focal mechanism, and background seismicity rates.
首次在台湾地区系统性地将前震发生率与深度、震源机制及背景地震率联系起来。

kc: Discovered that only ~25% of ML>=5 mainshocks in Taiwan are preceded by foreshocks, which is lower than in California and Italy.
Demonstrated that lower differential stress at shallow depths and normal faulting promote a higher percentage of foreshocks.
Validated the global trend that lower background seismicity rates correlate with higher foreshock percentages.
发现台湾地区仅有约25%的ML>=5主震伴随前震，显著低于加州和意大利。
证实了浅部低差应力和正断层机制会促进前震活动的发生。
验证了背景地震活动率越低、前震比例越高的全球性趋势。
me: Nearest-neighbor clustering method for high-resolution statistical identification of foreshock-mainshock sequences.
采用最近邻聚类方法对前震-主震序列进行高分辨率统计识别。
de: Seismicity catalog of Taiwan from 2012 to 2022, focusing on mainshocks with ML >= 5.
2012至2022年间台湾地区的地震目录，重点关注ML >= 5的主震。
li: Foreshock identification is highly dependent on catalog completeness and the specific clustering algorithm parameters.
前震的识别高度依赖于地震目录的完整性以及特定聚类算法的参数设置。

tm.why: The paper investigates foreshock activity, earthquake nucleation, and their relationship with fault stress states and focal mechanisms.
The study applies nearest-neighbor clustering to identify and characterize foreshock-mainshock sequences from seismicity catalogs.
It explores how differential stress and faulting styles (normal faulting) control foreshock occurrence.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the provided abstract and metadata since no PDF was available.

sum: This study investigates the source process of the 2025 Mw 6.6 Sanriku-Oki earthquake and its relationship with slow earthquake phenomena. Using a multi-time-window joint inversion of S-net ocean-bottom seismometer (OBS) accelerograms and ocean-bottom pressure gauge (OBPG) tsunami records, combined with radiation-corrected empirical Green's functions, the authors resolved a main slip region northeast of the epicenter with a maximum slip of 1.2 m and a low average stress drop of 1.4 MPa. The main slip area spatially overlaps with tectonic tremor activity that has gradually decelerated since 2016, alongside a pre-mainshock drop in the Gutenberg-Richter b-value to 0.5. The novelty lies in combining offshore seismic and tsunami records to precisely locate the offshore slip patch and proposing a conceptual model where slow slip in a fluid-rich, low-effective-normal-stress environment triggers both weakly velocity-weakening tremor patches and cascading rupture of strongly velocity-weakening seismic patches.
本研究利用S-net海底地震仪（OBS）和海底压力计（OBPG）数据，结合辐射校正经验格林函数进行多时间窗联合反演，估算了2025年Mw 6.6三陆冲地震的震源过程。结果显示主滑移区位于震中东北侧，最大滑移量1.2米，平均应力降较低（1.4 MPa）。该区域与2016年以来逐渐减弱的构造震颤活动空间……

t: Multi-time-window joint kinematic inversion of S-net OBS seismic waveforms (using radiation-corrected empirical Green's functions) and OBPG tsunami waveforms (using JAGURS), regularized via Akaike's Bayesian Information Criterion.
结合辐射校正经验格林函数与JAGURS海啸模拟，对S-net海底地震与压力数据进行ABIC正则化多时间窗联合反演。
S-net ocean-bottom accelerograms from 25 stations (0.08–0.8 Hz) and ocean-bottom pressure gauge tsunami waveforms from 26 stations (100–1,000 s), alongside JMA earthquake and tremor catalogs.
25个S-net海底加速度计记录（0.08–0.8 Hz）、26个海底压力计海啸记录（100–1000 s）及JMA地震…
The main slip region occurred northeast of the epicenter with a 1.2 m maximum slip, 1.1 × 10^19 Nm moment (Mw 6.6), 1.4 MPa average stress drop, and overlapped with decelerating tremor activity.
主滑移区位于震中东北侧，最大滑移1.2米（Mw 6.6），平均应力降1.4 MPa，且与震颤活动区空间重叠。
Onshore networks lack azimuthal coverage for this 150 km offshore event, and seismic-only inversions fail to constrain final static slip without tsunami pressure gauge records.
离岸150公里导致陆上台网方位角覆盖不佳，且仅靠地震波形无法准确约束最终静态滑移。
Jointly inverting S-net seismic and tsunami data resolves a northeast slip patch overlapping with tremors, explained by a new conceptual model of slow-fast interaction under low effective stress.
联合海底地震与海啸数据揭示主滑移区与震颤重叠，并提出低有效应力下慢-快滑移相互作用模型。

kc: Resolved the kinematic slip model of the 2025 Mw 6.6 Sanriku-Oki earthquake via joint inversion of S-net OBS and OBPG waveforms, finding a maximum slip of 1.2 m northeast of the epicenter.
Demonstrated spatial overlap between the coseismic main slip region and pre-existing tectonic tremor activity, alongside a precursory decrease in the b-value to 0.5.
Estimated a relatively low average shear stress drop of 1.4 MPa in the main slip region, attributing it to low confining pressure and elevated pore-fluid pressure.
Proposed a rate-and-state friction conceptual model explaining how slow slip events in a fluid-rich background trigger both tremor and fast cascading seismic ruptures.
通过联合反演S-net海底地震仪和压力计波形，解析了2025年Mw 6.6三陆冲地震的运动学滑移模型，发现震中东北侧最大滑移达1.2米。
证实了同震主滑移区与先存构造震颤活动的空间重叠，并观测到主震前b值降至0.5。
估算出主滑移区平均剪应力降较低（1.4 MPa），将其归因于浅部低围压和升高的孔隙流体压力。
提出了基于速率-状态摩擦定律的概念模型，解释富流体背景下慢滑移事件如何触发震颤及快速级联同震破裂。
me: Multi-time-window linear kinematic waveform joint inversion with non-negative constraints and ABIC-based smoothing.
Radiation-corrected empirical Green's function (EGF) method using an Mw 5.0 foreshock for seismic waveforms.
Tsunami Green's function modeling using JAGURS and the Okada dislocation model on the GEBCO 2025 bathymetry grid.
B-positive / moving-window Gutenberg-Richter b-value estimation and static shear stress drop calculation.
基于非负约束和ABIC平滑准则的多时间窗线性运动学波形联合反演。

The study investigates the spatial overlap and physical interaction mechanisms between coseismic fast rupture, tectonic tremors, and slow slip events under low effective normal stress.

sum: This study measures teleseismic P-wave attenuation along a 6000 km profile of the East African Rift System (EARS) to constrain mantle thermal and melt conditions. The authors find that attenuation anomalies are generally modest along most of the rift, with the prominent exception of the Main Ethiopian Rift (MER). Joint analysis of seismic velocity and attenuation beneath the MER and Afar Depression suggests the anomalies are best explained by a relatively thin, highly attenuating layer, likely caused by pre-melting relaxation or in situ partial melt. In contrast, rifting further south around the Tanzania craton and Lake Malawi occurs without strong attenuation, indicating distinct asthenospheric conditions. The work highlights significant lateral heterogeneity in mantle processes along this major continental rift.
本研究测量了沿东非裂谷带（EARS）约6000公里剖面的远震P波衰减，以约束地幔温度和熔融状态。结果表明，除埃塞俄比亚主裂谷（MER）存在显著强衰减外，沿线大部分地区的衰减异常较为温和。对MER和阿法尔洼地下方地震波速与衰减的联合分析表明，该异常最适合用一个相对较薄的高衰减层来解释，可能由预熔融松弛……

t: Teleseismic P-wave attenuation (t*) measurements and joint analysis with seismic velocity anomalies to constrain mantle temperature and melt.
远震P波衰减（t*）测量，并与地震波速异常进行联合分析，以约束地幔温度和熔融。
Teleseismic P-wave waveforms recorded along a ~6000 km profile from the Arabian Platform to the Kaapvaal craton.
沿阿拉伯地台至卡普瓦尔克拉通约6000公里剖面记录的远震P波波形数据。
Strong attenuation is localized beneath the Main Ethiopian Rift, whereas other parts of the East African Rift show modest attenuation.
强衰减局限于埃塞俄比亚主裂谷下方，而东非裂谷的其他部分表现出温和的衰减。
Direct trade-off between the thickness and quality factor (QP) of the attenuating layer due to path-integrated data.
由于数据为路径积分，衰减层的厚度与品质因子（QP）之间存在直接折衷。
First comprehensive profile of teleseismic P-wave attenuation across the entire East African Rift, revealing localized rather than widespread strong attenuation.
首次跨越整个东非裂谷测量远震P波衰减剖面，揭示了局域性而非广泛分布的强衰减特征。

kc: Measured teleseismic P-wave attenuation along a ~6000 km profile spanning the East African Rift System.
Identified exceptionally strong attenuation beneath the Main Ethiopian Rift (MER) and Afar Depression, contrasted with modest attenuation elsewhere.
Demonstrated that joint velocity and attenuation anomalies in the MER are best explained by a thin, highly attenuating layer (partial melt or pre-melting relaxation).
Revealed that rifting further south (e.g., Turkana Depression, Tanzania craton, Lake Malawi) occurs without strong attenuation, indicating different asthenospheric states.
测量了横跨东非裂谷带约6000公里剖面的远震P波衰减。
发现埃塞俄比亚主裂谷（MER）和阿法尔洼地下方存在异常强烈的衰减，而其他地区衰减较弱。
表明MER下方的波速与衰减联合异常最适合用一个高衰减的薄层（部分熔融或预熔融松弛）来解释。
揭示了更南方的裂谷作用（如图尔卡纳洼地、坦桑尼亚克拉通、马拉维湖）并未伴随强衰减，表明其软流圈状态不同。

Joint analysis of seismic velocity and attenuation anomalies to constrain temperature and melt effects.
利用远震P相的路径积分谱分析方法测量远震P波衰减（t*）。
联合分析地震波速与衰减异常，以约束温度和熔融效应。
de: Large dataset of teleseismic P-wave waveforms recorded along a ~6000 km profile stretching from the Arabian Platform to the Kaapvaal craton.
收集并分析了从阿拉伯地台延伸至卡普瓦尔克拉通的约6000公里剖面上记录的大量远震P波波形数据。

路径积分衰减测量存在衰减带厚度与品质因子（QP）之间的直接折衷。

sum: This study investigates the 3D seismogenic architecture and along-strike evolution of eastern Taiwan's Longitudinal Valley suture zone from arc-continent collision in the south to northward subduction. The authors reprocess waveform data from 1991 to 2024 across CWASN, BATS, and TSMIP networks using the RED-PAN machine-learning phase picker and relocate events within a 3D velocity model via NonLinLoc with source-specific station terms, reducing the magnitude of completeness (Mc90) from 2.1 to 1.6. Integrating relocated seismicity with 3D tomography reveals a three-fault retro-wedge system. Northward, the west-dipping Central Range Fault shallows and truncates the east-dipping Longitudinal Valley Fault (LVF). In the northern collision-subduction transition, the LVF deepens into a near-vertical slab boundary governed by elevated Vp/Vs arc-derived materials. Furthermore, an intra-suture left-lateral strike-slip fault is shown to be confined to the Central Range crust rather than forming the western slab boundary, and remnant forearc crust is identified in the south.
本研究探讨台湾东部纵谷缝合带从弧陆碰撞向俯冲过渡的三维发震构造演化。作者利用RED-PAN机器学习模型重新处理1991-2024年多台网波形，结合三维速度模型与NonLinLoc概率框架进行重定位，将完备震级从2.1降至1.6。综合地震目录与层析成像揭示：向北中央山脉断层倾角变缓并截切纵谷断层；在北……

t: The authors apply the RED-PAN multitask attention network for P/S picking, associate 2021–2024 continuous picks via 3D travel-time backprojection, and relocate all 1991–2024 events using NonLinLoc with Source-Specific Station Terms in a 3D velocity model.
应用RED-PAN拾取震相并结合三维反投影关联，利用NonLinLoc与三维速度模型和台站校正重定位1991-2024年…

Archived and continuous seismic waveforms from 1991 to 2024 recorded by CWASN, BATS, and dense TSMIP networks across eastern Taiwan, integrated with CMT focal mechanisms and a 3D seismic tomography model.
1991-2024年CWASN、BATS和TSMIP台网波形数据，结合CMT震源机制解与三维层析成像速度模型。

Catalog completeness Mc90 improves from 2.1 to 1.6. Northward, the west-dipping CRF shallows and truncates the LVF, while the LVF deepens into a ~50 km near-vertical slab boundary governed by high Vp/Vs arc materials.
完备震级Mc90从2.1降至1.6；揭示CRF向北变缓截切LVF，而LVF加深为受高Vp/Vs弧物质控制的近垂直板片边界…

Direct quantitative comparison of absolute location accuracy with the CWA catalog is hindered by fundamental differences in relocation algorithms, phase picking procedures, and changing operational velocity models.
因定位算法、震相拾取和业务速度模型不同，难以与CWA常规目录直接进行绝对定位精度的定量对比。

First spatially continuous, methodologically uniform 34-year seismological characterization across the full Taiwan suture zone, quantitatively linking Vp/Vs arc material distribution to fault geometry and disproving the strike-slip slab boundary hypothesis.
首次建立横跨整个台湾缝合带的34年统一高精度目录，定量证实弧源物质控制断层几何并否定走滑板片边界假说。

kc: Constructed a uniform, high-precision 34-year earthquake catalog (1991–2024) for eastern Taiwan using RED-PAN ML phase picking and NonLinLoc 3D probabilistic relocation, lowering Mc90 from 2.1 to 1.6.
Documented the continuous south-to-north geometric evolution and truncation relationship between the Central Range Fault (CRF) and Longitudinal Valley Fault (LVF).
Demonstrated quantitatively that arc-derived crustal materials (imaged as elevated Vp/Vs anomalies) mechanically govern the geometry and location of the LVF from collision to incipient subduction.

Refuted the hypothesis that the intra-suture left-lateral strike-slip fault represents the western boundary of the subducting Philippine Sea Plate slab, showing it is confined to the upper-middle crust.
Identified a high-velocity, low-Vp/Vs remnant forearc crustal block beneath the southernmost Coastal Range that diminishes northward via tectonic erosion.
利用RED-PAN机器学习拾取和NonLinLoc三维概率重定位，构建了台湾东部1991–2024年高精度的统一地震目录，将完备震级Mc90从2.1降至1.6。
揭示了中央山脉断层（CRF）与纵谷断层（LVF）由南向北连续的几何演化与截切关系。
定量证实了高Vp/Vs异常所表征的弧源地壳物质在碰撞向早期俯冲演化过程中控制了LVF的几何形态与位置。
否定缝合带内左旋走滑断层作为菲律宾海板块俯冲西界的假说，证明其仅局限于中央山脉中上地壳内。
识别出海岸山脉最南端下方高波速、低Vp/Vs的残留弧前地壳块体，且向北因构造侵蚀而消减。
me: Automated P- and S-wave arrival picking using the RED-PAN multitask attention neural network on archived event waveforms (1991–2020) and continuous waveforms (2021–2024).
Phase association on continuous data (2021–2024) via backprojection of continuous P- and S-wave phase-probability functions within a 3D velocity model.
Probabilistic global-search earthquake relocation using NonLinLoc (NLL) in a 3D velocity model of Taiwan combined with iterative Source-Specific Station Terms (SSST).
Joint structural interpretation integrating relocated hypocenters, Centroid Moment Tensor (CMT) solutions, and 3D seismic tomography (Vp, Vs, and Vp/Vs).
使用RED-PAN多任务注意力神经网络对归档事件波形（1991–2020年）和连续波形（2021–2024年）进行P波和S波自动拾取。
在三维速度模型中对连续P波和S波震相概率函数进行反投影，实现2021–2024年连续波形的震相关联。
结合台湾三维速度模型与震源特定台站校正项（SSST），利用NonLinLoc（NLL）全局搜索概率框架进行地震重定位。
综合重定位震源分布、矩心矩张量（CMT）解及三维地震层析成像（Vp、Vs和Vp/Vs）进行联合构造解释。

Continuous waveform records from dense Taiwan Strong Motion Instrumentation Program (TSMIP) stations incorporated for 2021–2024.
3D P- and S-wave velocity and Vp/Vs tomographic model of Taiwan from Lee et al. (2025).
Centroid Moment Tensor (CMT) solutions for major earthquake sequences and aftershocks from BATS and the Real-Time Moment Tensor Monitoring System (RMT).

tm.why: The study builds a 34-year uniform earthquake catalog (1991–2024) for eastern Taiwan by reprocessing seismic waveforms with an ML phase picker and probabilistic 3D relocation.
It integrates relocated seismicity with 3D seismic tomography to map the along-strike structural evolution of the Longitudinal Valley suture zone from arc-continent collision to subduction.
The workflow heavily relies on the RED-PAN multitask attention neural network for automated earthquake detection and P/S phase picking across multi-decade continuous and archived data.

sum: This study investigates the rainfall-induced Jixi landslide in Heilongjiang Province, China, which occurred in August 2023 following Typhoon Doksuri. By integrating aeromagnetic data, electrical resistivity tomography (ERT), multi-temporal satellite and UAV remote sensing, borehole data, and surface displacement monitoring, the authors characterize the landslide's subsurface structure and evolutionary mechanism. ERT inversions reveal a three-part electrical structure: a shallow high-resistivity landslide deposit, a low-resistivity slip zone (wet mudstone and fault fractures), and a deeper high-resistivity slip bed. Remote sensing and displacement monitoring show progressive quarrying and post-landslide retrogressive movement. The study proposes an evolutionary chain linking quarrying, rainfall infiltration, fault-controlled water conduction, slip zone softening, and retrogressive sliding. The novelty lies in the comprehensive, cross-scale integration of geophysical, remote sensing, and borehole methods to constrain both regional and shallow landslide structures.
本研究联合航磁、电法、遥感与钻孔监测，揭示了降雨诱发鸡西滑坡的地下结构与演化机制。ERT反演显示出浅部高阻堆积、中部低阻滑动带（富水断裂）及深部高阻滑床的三层结构。研究提出了采石扰动、降雨入渗、断裂导水、滑带软化到后退滑动的演化模式。其创新在于跨尺度联合地球物理与遥感，为滑坡防治提供多源约束。

t: 2D and quasi-3D Electrical Resistivity Tomography (ERT) calibrated by six boreholes was used to image the subsurface electrical structure of the landslide.
利用经六个钻孔校准的二维和准三维高密度电法（ERT）对滑坡地下电性结构进行成像。
Aeromagnetic data, ERT profiles, multi-temporal satellite/UAV remote sensing, borehole logs, and surface displacement monitoring data from the Jixi landslide.
采用鸡西滑坡的航磁数据、ERT剖面、多时相卫星/无人机遥感、钻孔柱状图及地表位移监测数据。
Revealed a three-part electrical structure (high-resistivity deposit, low-resistivity slip zone, high-resistivity slip bed) and documented ~20 m of cumulative southwestward displacement.
揭示了滑坡的三层电性结构，并记录了向西南方向约20米的累积位移。
Lacks pre-disaster subsurface geophysical imaging and quantitative mechanical modeling of the landslide's slope stability.
缺乏灾前地下地球物理成像以及对滑坡边坡稳定性的定量力学模拟。
Cross-scale integration of regional aeromagnetics, shallow ERT, multi-temporal remote sensing, and borehole data to establish a complete landslide evolutionary chain.
跨尺度整合区域航磁、浅部电法、多时相遥感和钻孔数据，建立了完整的滑坡演化链。

kc: Integrated multiple geophysical and remote sensing methods to characterize a rainfall-induced landslide.
Revealed a detailed three-part electrical structure of the landslide using 2D and quasi-3D ERT.
Proposed a comprehensive evolutionary chain for the Jixi landslide, linking human activity (quarrying) and natural triggers (typhoon rainfall).
整合了多种地球物理与遥感方法，对降雨诱发的滑坡进行了综合表征。
利用二维和准三维高密度电法（ERT）揭示了滑坡详细的三层电性结构。
提出了鸡西滑坡的完整演化链，将人类活动（采石）与自然诱因（台风降雨）联系起来。

Multi-temporal satellite and UAV remote sensing for surface displacement and geomorphology.
Borehole drilling and surface displacement monitoring for calibration and validation.

用于评估区域基底磁性的航空磁测。
