sum: This review synthesizes geological, glaciological, rock mechanical, and geophysical observations to resolve the paradox of how high fluid pressures both trigger and suppress slip instabilities across faults, landslides, and glaciers. The authors highlight two critical scales governing fluid-driven instabilities: the length scale of interconnected fluid overpressure and the relative timescales of deformation versus fluid transport. They propose three end-member rheological regimes: (1) Brittle-Localising (BL), where localized deformation and contained fluid flow sustain overpressure over sufficient length scales to nucleate and propagate dynamic instabilities; (2) Brittle-Delocalising (BD), where distributed deformation and rapid fluid diffusion into wall rocks stabilize slip; and (3) Transiently Brittle (TB), where elevated fluid pressures in dominantly viscous rock or ice induce transient brittle slip that is delocalized and rate-limited by dilatant hardening. This unified framework demonstrates that spatiotemporal fluid pressure heterogeneity, rather than pressure magnitude alone, dictates slip styles.
本文综述了地质、冰川、岩石力学和地球物理观测，探讨高流体压力如何触发或抑制断层、滑坡和冰川的滑动失稳。作者指出控制失稳的两个关键尺度：超压连通的长度尺度及变形与流体扩散的相对时间尺度，并提出三种端元流变体制：脆性局域化（BL）、脆性非局域化（BD）和瞬态脆性（TB）。研究表明，仅在BL体制下超压能维……

t: The authors review geological, glaciological, experimental, and geophysical data, and perform scaling analyses comparing fluid diffusion timescales (tf) and deformation timescales (td) alongside fracture mechanics and fault-valve stability models.
综述地质、冰川、实验和地球物理数据，并通过对比流体扩散与变形时间尺度进行理论尺度分析。

Synthesizes observations from exhumed fault rocks and drill cores, subglacial water-pressure records, laboratory triaxial rock deformation experiments, and seismological/geodetic observations of induced seismicity, slow slip, and megathrust earthquakes.
综合出露断层岩与岩芯、冰下水压记录、岩石变形实验以及诱发地震、慢滑移和大地震的观测数据。

Defines three regimes (BL, BD, TB): when tf < td, drained conditions allow instability if localized (BL) or stability if delocalized (BD); when tf > td (TB), dilatant hardening limits slip speed to fluid diffusion rates.
定义了BL、BD和TB三种体制：tf<td时视局域化程度决定失稳与否；tf>td时剪胀硬化限制滑动速度。

The preliminary quantitative scaling assumes internally homogeneous fault segments with constant fault zone thickness and diffusivity during slip, neglecting complex 3D spatiotemporal evolution and thermal-chemical coupling.
初步定量计算假设断层段内部均匀且厚度与扩散率恒定，未直接模拟三维时空演化。

Introduces a unified three-regime framework across rocks and glaciers that links contrasting fluid-driven slip behaviors to spatial overpressure connectivity and the competition between deformation and diffusion timescales.
提出跨岩石和冰川的统一三体制框架，将滑动样式与超压空间连通性及速率竞争联系起来。

kc: Proposes three end-member regimes—Brittle-Localising (BL), Brittle-Delocalising (BD), and Transiently Brittle (TB)—to classify fluid-driven slip styles across faults, landslides, and glaciers.
Synthesizes field observations of exhumed fault rocks, borehole cores, laboratory rock deformation experiments, and geophysical observations of earthquakes and slow slip.
Provides preliminary quantitative bounds on fluid pressure regimes using timescales of deformation and fluid diffusion, dilatant hardening criteria, and fault-valve stability length scales.
提出了脆性局域化（BL）、脆性非局域化（BD）和瞬态脆性（TB）三种端元体制，以统一分类断层、滑坡和冰川中的流体驱动滑动样式。
综合了出露断层岩的野外考察、钻孔岩芯、实验室岩石变形实验以及地震和慢滑移的地球物理观测证据。
利用变形与流体扩散时间尺度、剪胀硬化准则及断层阀稳定性长度尺度，给出了流体压力体制的初步定量边界。
me: Multidisciplinary literature review integrating structural geology, glaciology, laboratory rock physics, and seismological/geodetic observations.
Theoretical scaling analysis comparing fluid diffusion timescales (tf) and deformation timescales (td) across varying fault thicknesses and permeabilities.
Analytical evaluation of dilatant hardening stress intensity factors and linear stability length scales for fault-valve instabilities.
跨学科文献综述，整合了构造地质学、冰川学、实验室岩石物理学以及地震学/大地测量学观测。
理论尺度分析，对比不同断层厚度和渗透率下的流体扩散时间尺度（tf）与变形时间尺度（td）。
针对剪胀硬化应力强度因子及断层阀失稳的线性稳定性长度尺度进行解析评估。
de: Field and drill-core observations from active and exhumed faults (e.g., Hikurangi IODP Exp. 375, Nankai Trough, SAFOD, Nobeoka thrust, Makimine mélange, Alps).
Subglacial borehole water pressure and basal sliding velocity records from glaciers (e.g., Findelengletscher, Variegated Glacier).
Laboratory triaxial and biaxial rock/gouge deformation experiments testing effective stress, dilatant hardening, and localization (e.g., granite, Berea sandstone, serpentinite, quartz/calcite gouge).
来自活动和出露断层的野外及钻孔岩芯观测（如Hikurangi IODP 375航次、南海海槽、SAFOD、延冈逆冲断层、牧峰混杂岩、阿尔卑斯山）。
冰川（如Findelengletscher冰川、Variegated冰川）的冰下钻孔水压和底部滑动速度记录。
测试有效应力、剪胀硬化和局域化的实验室三轴及双轴岩石/断层泥变形实验（如花岗岩、Berea砂岩、蛇纹岩、石英/方解石断层泥）。
li: Quantitative calculations rely on simplified rules-of-thumb assuming internally homogeneous fault segments and constant fault thickness and diffusivity during slip.
Direct in-situ monitoring data from glaciers, landslides, and underground laboratories are inherently limited to surface and shallow upper-crustal environments.
Strain rates and fluid diffusion rates for natural fault rocks carry large uncertainties spanning multiple orders of magnitude.
定量计算依赖于简化的经验法则，假设断层段内部均匀且滑动期间断层厚度和扩散率恒定。
来自冰川、滑坡和地下实验室的直接原位监测数据本质上局限于地表和浅部上地壳环境。
天然断层岩的应变率和流体扩散率具有跨越多个数量级的巨大不确定性。

tm.why: The paper extensively reviews how fluid overpressure, dilatant hardening, and rheological regimes govern frictional instabilities, slow slip events, tremor, and regular earthquakes along tectonic faults.
The authors apply their fluid-pressure and frictional instability framework directly to basal sliding in glaciers, glacier surges, and landslide instabilities.
Section 4.1 explicitly analyzes fluid injection-induced earthquakes and how fluid overpressure triggers both seismic and aseismic slip in anthropogenic settings.

ev.notes: Full Journal Pre-proof PDF (147 pages, double-spaced manuscript with 11 figures) was read and analyzed in detail.

sum: Safe CO2 geological storage requires managing both when pre-existing faults yield and how yielding spreads. This study develops a 2D quasi-static coupled hydromechanical model in COMSOL representing immiscible CO2-brine flow and Mohr-Coulomb elastoplasticity with linear strain-softening across an offset normal fault based on the western Ordos Basin. Over a 30-day period, simulations compare constant- and variable-rate histories, hanging-wall/footwall/concurrent well placements, and well-fault distances (400-800 m). Pointwise Coulomb Failure Function (CFF) defines yield onset, while failure-area ratio and maximum shear plastic strain track domain-scale localization. Results show a hierarchy of controls: injection rate governs pressure buildup and onset timing; rate history reorganizes transient stress paths and localization; and well placement and distance redistribute yielding across the fault. Local CFF and domain-scale metrics are complementary rather than interchangeable, motivating joint optimization of injection schedules and well layouts for early risk screening.
安全的CO2地质封存需兼顾断层屈服时间与扩展范围。本研究基于鄂尔多斯盆地西部地质背景，在COMSOL中建立二维准静态水力力学耦合模型，结合CO2-盐水两相流与含线性应变软化的莫尔-库仑弹塑性正断层。通过30天模拟，对比了恒定与变速率注入历史、上盘/下盘/双井同时注入配置及井-断层距离（400-800……

t: 2D plane-strain coupled hydromechanical finite-element modeling in COMSOL combining immiscible CO2-brine Darcy flow, Biot poroelasticity, and a Mohr-Coulomb elastoplastic fault zone with linear strain-softening.
在COMSOL中进行二维平面应变水力力学耦合建模，结合CO2-盐水两相流、孔隙弹性与莫尔-库仑应变软化断层。
A 3000 m x 1000 m 2D profile with a 60-degree dipping, 80 m offset normal fault derived from the western Ordos Basin, tested across 30-day injection rate, schedule, placement, and distance scenarios.
基于鄂尔多斯盆地西部的3000m×1000m含60°倾角正断层剖面，开展30天注入速率、波形、井位和井距测试。

Increasing constant rate from 0.02 to 0.04 kg/s/m shifted MP-6 yield onset from 13.87 d to 6.8 d and increased failure-area ratio from 0.15 to 0.18; periodic intermittent injection yielded largest area ratio (0.18) among variable schedules.
注入率从0.02增至0.04 kg/s/m使MP-6屈服从13.87天提前至6.8天，破坏面积比从0.15增至0.18。
2D plane-strain quasi-static model omits 3D effects, dynamic rupture, and thermal-chemical processes; unregularized strain-softening lacks mechanical mesh convergence.
二维准静态模型忽略三维效应、动态破裂与热化过程；非正则化软化本构缺乏力学网格收敛验证。
Jointly compares temporal injection-rate histories and spatial well configurations within one two-phase hydromechanical model using both pointwise CFF onset and domain-scale localization metrics.
在同一两相水力力学模型中联合对比时间注入历史与空间井位配置，结合局部CFF与全局局部化指标。

kc: Jointly evaluated temporal injection-rate histories and spatial well configurations within a unified 2D two-phase CO2-brine hydromechanical fault model.
Demonstrated that pointwise CFF onset, fault-zone failure-area ratio, and maximum plastic shear strain represent distinct, non-interchangeable dimensions of fault response.
Established a hierarchy of operational controls showing injection rate governs onset timing, rate history alters localization patterns, and well placement/distance redistributes yielding.
在统一的二维CO2-盐水两相水力力学断层模型中，联合评估了时间注入速率历史与空间井位配置。
证明了局部CFF屈服起始、断层带破坏面积比和最大塑性剪切应变代表了断层响应的不同且不可互换的维度。
建立了运行控制的层级关系：注入速率控制起始时间，速率历史改变局部化模式，井位与距离重新分配屈服范围。
me: Two-dimensional plane-strain coupled hydromechanical modeling in COMSOL Multiphysics 6.3.
Immiscible two-phase Darcy flow and van Genuchten capillary/relative-permeability relations coupled with Biot poroelasticity.
Finite-thickness (2 m) Mohr-Coulomb elastoplastic fault zone with linear plastic-strain frictional weakening (friction coefficient dropping from 0.6 to 0.2).
利用COMSOL Multiphysics 6.3进行二维平面应变水力力学耦合建模。
将非混相两相达西流和van Genuchten毛细管压力/相对渗透率关系与Biot孔隙弹性力学耦合。
采用2 m有限厚度的莫尔-库仑弹塑性断层带，结合线性塑性应变摩擦弱化本构关系（摩擦系数从0.6降至0.2）。
de: 2D conceptual cross-section (3000 m x 1000 m) with a 60-degree dipping normal fault (80 m offset) derived from the Triassic Yanchang Formation in the western Ordos Basin.

Parametric 30-day scenario matrix testing 3 constant rates (0.02-0.04 kg/s/m), 4 variable waveforms (intermittent, triangular, ascending/descending sawtooth), 3 placements (hanging wall, footwall, concurrent), and 3 distances (400, 600, 800 m).
Hydraulic mesh/timestep verification and early-time multiphase flow benchmarking against the Liang (2010) synthetic waterflood case.
基于鄂尔多斯盆地西部三叠系延长组构建的3000 m × 1000 m二维概念剖面，包含倾角60°、断距80 m的正断层。
为期30天的参数化情景矩阵测试：3种恒定速率（0.02-0.04 kg/s/m）、4种变速率波形（间歇、三角波、上升/下降锯齿波）、3种井位（上盘、下盘、双井同时）及3种井距（400、600、800 m）。
水力网格与时间步长稳定性验证，以及与Liang (2010) 合成注水算例的早期多相流基准对比。
li: 2D plane-strain idealization omits along-strike fluid flow, fault-end effects, and 3D stress redistribution.
Strain-softening law is unregularized and lacks mechanical mesh convergence testing, restricting plastic strain and failure-area ratio to within-mesh comparative indicators.
Quasi-static continuum formulation with a 30-day window excludes dynamic rupture, seismic/aseismic slip distinction, thermal transport, and geochemical reactions.
二维平面应变理想化忽略了沿走向的流体流动、断层端部效应和三维应力重分布。
应变软化本构未正则化且缺乏力学网格收敛性测试，使塑性应变和破坏面积比仅限于网格内相对比较指标。
30天时间窗口的准静态连续介质公式不包含动态破裂、地震/无震滑动区分、热传输和地球化学反应。

tm.why: The paper evaluates fault reactivation and yielding proxies during CO2 geological storage using coupled hydromechanical simulations of fluid injection.
The study models quasi-static fault yielding, Coulomb failure function attainment, frictional strain-weakening, and plastic strain localization along an offset normal fault.

ev.notes: Full 25-page PDF text and figures analyzed, including governing equations, COMSOL numerical setup, Table 1, and Figures 1-11.

sum: Classical full waveform inversion (FWI) suffers from cycle skipping when low frequencies or accurate starting models are unavailable. Deep-learning-matching FWI (DLM-FWI) uses a convolutional neural network (CNN) inside the inversion loop as a kinematic preconditioner, but standard automatic differentiation (AD) across time-stepping wave equations creates a severe GPU memory bottleneck. This paper introduces a memory-efficient hybrid workflow interfacing Julia's Flux deep-learning framework with the JUDI/Devito finite-difference solver. By decoupling the CNN's AD graph from the PDE solver and applying the chain rule strictly in the receiver-data domain, memory requirements drop from O(Nt × Ngrid) to O(Nt × Ntraces). Validated on the Marmousi2 model under severe source-wavelet mismatch (55° phase rotation, 20 ms shift) and 0 dB noise, and applied to the Mobil AVO Viking Graben Line 12 marine dataset, the method suppresses cycle-skipped artifacts, flattens common image gathers, and improves structural continuity.
传统全波形反演（FWI）在初始模型不准时易陷入周期跳跃。深度学习匹配FWI（DLM-FWI）利用卷积神经网络（CNN）进行动态相位匹配，但常规自动微分（AD）需存储完整时空波场，导致显存瓶颈。本文提出融合Julia语言Flux与JUDI/Devito有限差分求解器的混合计算框架，将CNN的AD计算图……

t: A hybrid alternating optimization workflow interfaces Flux with JUDI/Devito, training a residual CNN matching filter in the receiver domain and computing data-space AD adjoint sources before evaluating physical gradients via the adjoint-state method.
将Flux与JUDI/Devito耦合进行交替优化，在数据域训练残差CNN并计算AD伴随源，再由伴随状态法更新速度。

Evaluated on the 2D Marmousi2 synthetic model (81 shots, 851 receivers, 5 Hz Ricker with 55° phase rotation, 20 ms shift, and 0 dB noise) and the North Sea Mobil AVO Viking Graben Line 12 marine dataset.
采用含55°相移、20 ms时移和0 dB噪声的Marmousi2模型及北海维京地堑12号线海上实测数据。

Under source mismatch and 0 dB noise on Marmousi2, DLM-FWI reduces velocity RMSE from 414.88 m/s to 337.31 m/s while adding only 0.55 GiB GPU memory; on Viking Graben data, it eliminates shallow velocity oscillations and flattens CIGs.
Marmousi2噪声测试中速度RMSE从414.88降至337.31 m/s，显存仅增0.55 GiB；实测数据消除了…
DLM-FWI increases runtime by 2.44x due to extra wavefield solves, lacks a formal guarantee that transformed data obey the wave equation, and can be slower than direct PDE-AD on small models.
额外波场求解使总耗时增加2.44倍，且在小模型上不如直接PDE自动微分高效。
Decouples deep-learning automatic differentiation from the PDE wavefield solver by splitting the chain rule at the receiver data domain, reducing memory scaling from O(Nt × Ngrid) to O(Nt × Ntraces).
在接收器数据域截断链式法则以解耦网络AD与波场求解，将显存需求从网格级降至地震道级。

kc: Developed a memory-efficient hybrid DLM-FWI framework interfacing Flux (deep learning) with JUDI/Devito (finite-difference wavefield modeling) in Julia.
Reduced GPU memory scaling from O(Nt × Ngrid) to O(Nt × Ntraces) by restricting automatic differentiation to the receiver-data domain, adding only ~0.5 GiB peak GPU memory over classical FWI.
Demonstrated strong resilience to severe source-wavelet mismatch (55° phase rotation, 20 ms shift, ringing) and 0 dB random noise on the Marmousi2 benchmark.
Successfully scaled DLM-FWI to the Mobil AVO Viking Graben Line 12 marine field dataset up to 18 Hz, eliminating shallow cycle-skipped velocity oscillations and flattening Common Image Gathers.
开发了在Julia中融合Flux深度学习库与JUDI/Devito有限差分波场模拟器的高效内存混合DLM-FWI框架。
通过将自动微分限制在接收器数据域，将GPU显存需求从O(Nt × Ngrid)降至O(Nt × Ntraces)，相比传统FWI峰值显存仅增加约0.5 GiB。
在Marmousi2基准模型上验证了该方法对严重震源子波失配（55°相位旋转、20 ms时移及振铃）和0 dB随机噪声的强鲁棒性。
成功将DLM-FWI扩展至Mobil维京地堑12号线海上实测数据（最高18 Hz），消除了浅层周期跳跃速度振荡并拉平了共成像点道集。
me: 8-layer residual CNN architecture with 3×3 kernels, parallel input-projection branches, Leaky ReLU activations, and zero-initialized final layers to ensure an exact initial identity mapping.
Alternating optimization performing 2 inner-loop Adam epochs (learning rate 10^-3) per outer L-BFGS physical model update, carrying weights over between outer iterations.
Data-domain AD pullback in Flux to compute the preconditioned adjoint source, followed by matrix-free adjoint-state gradient computation in JUDI/Devito.
Hierarchical multiscale frequency continuation (1-5 Hz, 1-10 Hz, 1-18 Hz) combined with prestack Kirchhoff depth migration for image-domain validation.
采用含3×3卷积核、并行输入投影分支、Leaky ReLU激活函数及零初始化末层的8层残差CNN架构，确保初始映射为严格恒等映射。
采用交替优化策略，在每次外部L-BFGS物理模型更新中执行2个内部Adam训练周期（学习率10^-3），并在外部迭代间保留网络权重。
在Flux中执行数据域AD反向传播以计算预条件伴随源，随后交由JUDI/Devito通过无矩阵伴随状态法计算空间速度梯度。
结合分层多尺度频率延拓策略（1-5 Hz、1-10 Hz、1-18 Hz）与叠前克希霍夫深度偏移进行成像域验证。
de: Marmousi2 synthetic benchmark (81 sources at 212 m spacing, 851 receivers at 20 m spacing, 5 Hz Ricker wavelet, 5 s duration) tested under clean, source-mismatched, and 0 dB noisy conditions.
Sensitivity benchmark on inner CNN training epochs (1, 2, 4, 8, and 16 epochs) and GPU memory scaling up to 4 million grid cells against naive full-tape AD and Deepwave.

Mobil AVO Viking Graben Line 12 marine field dataset from the North Sea (decimated to 75 m shot spacing, 120-channel streamer at 25 m spacing, 3 km max offset, 4 s record length, validated against Well 4 and Well 5 sonic logs).
Marmousi2合成基准测试（81个震源间距212 m，851个接收器间距20 m，5 Hz雷克子波，记录时长5 s），测试了无噪、子波失配及0 dB噪声条件。
内部CNN训练周期数（1、2、4、8和16个周期）敏感性测试，以及高达400万网格单元的GPU显存扩展性对比测试（对比朴素全计算图AD与Deepwave）。
北海Mobil AVO维京地堑12号线海上实测数据集（震源间距抽稀至75 m，120道拖缆道间距25 m，最大偏移距3 km，记录截断至4 s，并与4号和5号井声波测井对比验证）。
li: Increases total runtime by a factor of ~2.44 compared to classical FWI due to extra forward/adjoint wave-equation solves during alternating optimization and line search.
Does not provide a formal mathematical guarantee that CNN-transformed waveforms satisfy the acoustic wave equation, relying on architectural constraints to avoid hallucinated events.
Currently restricted to 2D constant-density acoustic approximation; 3D geometries, multi-parameter elastic FWI, and anisotropic media remain untested.
由于交替优化和线搜索需要额外的正演与伴随波动方程求解，总运行时间相比传统FWI增加了约2.44倍。
无法从数学上严格保证CNN变换后的波形满足声波方程，仅依赖网络结构约束来降低产生物理不一致同相轴的风险。
目前仅限于二维常密度声波近似，尚未在三维观测系统、多参数弹性FWI及各向异性介质中进行测试。

tm.why: The paper develops a scalable deep-learning-matching full waveform inversion (DLM-FWI) workflow to mitigate cycle skipping in field-scale seismic inversion.
A convolutional neural network (CNN) implemented in Flux is trained inside the FWI loop as a dynamic phase-matching preconditioner.
The study resolves GPU memory bottlenecks in automatic differentiation by decoupling the neural network AD graph from the JUDI/Devito finite-difference wave-equation solver.

ev.notes: Full 40-page manuscript PDF evaluated, including all mathematical derivations, Flux/JUDI implementation details, 3 tables, and 17 figures.

sum: This study investigates tsunami generation from the 2020 Mw 7.0 Samos normal-faulting earthquake by comparing four modeling frameworks: instantaneous Okada sourcing with 2D non-linear shallow-water equations (SWE), time-dependent one-way linked SWE using 3D kinematic and spontaneous dynamic rupture models, and 3D fully coupled elastic-acoustic-gravity simulations in SeisSol. The dynamic rupture models are informed by kinematic shear stress changes and validated against near-field strong-motion records. In water deeper than 100 m, one-way linked and fully coupled time-dependent models agree within 0.10 m for extreme crest and trough metrics from 50 to 360 s. At 6 minutes, all models produce a leading drawdown near -0.5 m, but the instantaneous Okada source underestimates the tsunami crest (0.35 m vs. 0.5–0.6 m). Furthermore, 3D full coupling uniquely resolves the early near-source seismo-acoustic wavefield, including dispersive oceanic Rayleigh waves, acoustic modes, and Scholte-like interface waves.
本研究对比了2020年Mw 7.0萨摩斯正断层地震海啸生成的四种建模方法：基于静态Okada位移的二维非线性浅水方程（SWE）、单向链接三维运动学与动力学破裂的时变SWE，以及SeisSol三维全耦合震源-海啸模拟。动力学模型结合了近场强地面运动验证。在水深大于100米处，50至360秒内单向链接与……

t: Compares 2D non-linear shallow-water tsunami simulations (GeoClaw) driven by static Okada or one-way linked time-dependent seafloor displacements against 3D fully coupled elastic-acoustic-gravity dynamic rupture simulations (SeisSol) using ADER-DG.
对比基于静态Okada或单向链接时变位移的二维非线性浅水模拟（GeoClaw）与基于ADER-DG的三维全耦合震源-海啸…

Uses the kinematic finite-fault slip model of Plicka et al. (2022), GEBCO 15 arc-second bathymetry, 1D crustal velocity model of Novotný et al. (2001), seven coastal strong-motion stations, and seven Aegean tide gauges.
采用Plicka等（2022）有限断层模型、GEBCO 15角秒水深、一维速度模型、7个沿海强震台及7个爱琴海验潮站记录…
From 50–360 s in water >100 m, one-way linked and fully coupled models agree within 0.10 m on extreme crests/troughs, whereas static Okada sourcing underestimates 6-min crests (0.35 m vs. 0.5–0.6 m).
50–360秒内水深>100米处单向链接与全耦合极值差<0.1米；静态Okada源低估6分钟波峰（0.35米对比0.5–…

3D fully coupled simulations cannot model coastal inundation, run-up, or long-term propagation due to linearized gravity boundary conditions and high computational cost of discretizing the water layer.
三维全耦合模拟采用线性化自由表面重力边界且计算昂贵，无法模拟海岸淹没、爬高及长时程海啸传播。

First application of 3D fully coupled dynamic rupture and tsunami simulation to a predominantly normal-faulting earthquake, systematically benchmarking static, kinematic, and dynamic tsunami sourcing.
首次将三维全耦合动力学破裂-海啸模拟应用于正断层地震，系统量化静态、运动学与动力学海啸源差异。

kc: Developed 3D kinematic and spontaneous dynamic rupture models for the 2020 Mw 7.0 Samos normal-faulting earthquake validated against near-source strong ground motion.
Demonstrated that one-way linked SWE and 3D fully coupled time-dependent models agree within 0.10 m on tsunami extrema after 50 s in water deeper than 100 m.
Showed that instantaneous Okada sourcing underestimates peak tsunami crests by about a third (0.35 m vs. 0.5–0.6 m at 6 min) compared to time-dependent sources.
Resolved complex near-source seismo-acoustic wavefields in 3D fully coupled simulations, identifying dispersive oceanic Rayleigh waves, acoustic modes, and Scholte waves.
构建了2020年萨摩斯Mw 7.0正断层地震的三维运动学与自发动力学破裂模型，并通过近源强震记录进行了验证。
证明在水深超过100米区域，50秒后单向链接浅水模型与三维全耦合时变模型的海啸极值差异在0.10米以内。
揭示瞬时Okada静态震源相比时变震源会将海啸峰值波峰低估约三分之一（6分钟时为0.35米对比0.5–0.6米）。
在三维全耦合模拟中解析了复杂的早期近源震声波场，识别出频散海洋瑞利波、海洋声波模态及Scholte界面波。
me: 3D kinematic and spontaneous dynamic rupture modeling with linear slip-weakening friction using the ADER-DG software SeisSol.
3D fully coupled elastic-acoustic-gravity wave simulations capturing simultaneous earthquake rupture, seismo-acoustic waves, and tsunami generation.
2D depth-averaged non-linear shallow-water equation (SWE) tsunami modeling with adaptive mesh refinement in GeoClaw (both static Okada and one-way linked time-dependent forcing).
Spatial Butterworth low-pass filtering (2 km cut-off) and frequency-wavenumber (f-k) spectrum decomposition to separate gravity, acoustic, and seismic surface/interface modes.
利用基于ADER-DG方法的SeisSol软件开展三维运动学及线性滑移弱化自发动力学破裂模拟。
开展三维全耦合弹性-声学-重力波模拟，同步求解地震破裂、震声波传播与海啸生成。

GEBCO 15 arc-second gridded bathymetry and topography data for mesh construction across the Aegean Sea.

使用GEBCO 15角秒网格化水深与地形数据构建爱琴海区域计算网格。
使用希腊和土耳其7个近源沿海强震台的观测峰值地面速度记录（PGV和RotD50）进行模型验证。

Simplified planar single-fault geometry, 1D layered velocity structure, and pure dip-slip initial traction omit fault segmentation, 3D basin effects, and strike-slip components.

sum: This study investigates the global distribution and persistence of subduction-derived mantle hydration over the past 410 Myr. Combining a mantle-reference-frame plate reconstruction with a thermodynamic model of slab water flux, the authors calculate site-specific hydration ages and durations beneath present-day mid-ocean ridges and compare them against H₂O/Ce ratios in 1,344 mid-ocean ridge basalt (MORB) glass samples from 1,048 sites. Estimated hydration ages are ~120 Ma in the Arctic, ~320 Ma in the northern Mid-Atlantic Ridge (NMAR), ~220 Ma in the mid-latitude MAR, and ~380 Ma in the southern MAR, while most Pacific ridges lack modeled hydration. Globally, MORB from mantle hydrated within the past 400 Myr exhibits significantly higher median H₂O/Ce than unhydrated mantle (249 versus 200), independent of hydration age, duration, or plume influence. This demonstrates that hydrous subduction signatures in the upper mantle can survive convective stirring for up to 400 Myr.
本研究结合地幔参考系板块重建与俯冲板片水通量模型，计算了过去4.1亿年间全球洋中脊下方的地幔水化年龄与持续时间，并与1048个站点的1344个洋中脊玄武岩（MORB）玻璃样品的H₂O/Ce比值进行对比。结果显示，北极、北大西洋、中纬度和南大西洋洋中脊的水化年龄分别约为120、320、220和380……

t: Tracks subducted water in sediments, crust, and mantle from 410 Ma in a mantle reference frame using pyGPlates, smoothing trench delivery with a 300 km Gaussian filter to compute hydration ages.
利用pyGPlates在地幔参考系中追踪410 Ma以来的俯冲水，通过300 km高斯平滑计算水化年龄。
Modeled hydration ages and durations are compared against a curated global dataset of 1,344 unique MORB glass H₂O/Ce samples across 1,048 distinct sites grouped into 136 300-km along-ridge clusters.
将模拟水化年龄与全球1048个站点（136个300 km聚类）的1344个MORB玻璃H₂O/Ce样品进行对比。
MORB from mantle hydrated within the past 400 Myr has significantly higher median H₂O/Ce than unhydrated sites globally (249 ± 15 vs. 200 ± 6; p = 0.003), with regional ages from 120 to 380 Ma.
过去4亿年内水化地幔的MORB具有更高的H₂O/Ce中位数（249±15对比200±6，p=0.003）。
The kinematic workflow omits mantle flow, convective mixing, dilution, and melt extraction, and cannot track storage depths or particle transport paths.
运动学模型忽略了地幔流动、对流混合稀释和熔融抽取过程。
Links global MORB H₂O/Ce anomalies directly to reconstructed Paleozoic–Mesozoic slab dehydration episodes, proving subduction volatile imprints survive in the upper mantle for up to 400 Myr.
直接关联MORB水异常与古俯冲脱水事件，证明地幔俯冲挥发分印记可留存达4亿年。

kc: Reconstructed global cumulative subducted water delivery in a mantle reference frame over the past 410 Myr across multiple absolute plate motion frames.
Compiled and deduplicated a global dataset of 1,344 MORB glass H₂O/Ce measurements across 1,048 distinct sites (136 along-ridge clusters).
Demonstrated that MORB overlying mantle hydrated within 400 Myr has significantly higher median H₂O/Ce (249 vs. 200) regardless of hydration age or duration.
Resolved two distinct subduction sources for the North Atlantic hydration anomaly on opposite sides of Laurentia (~320 Ma north of 50°N and ~220 Ma Farallon slab between 20°N and 35°N).
在多个绝对板块运动参考系下重建了过去4.1亿年全球地幔参考系中的累积俯冲水输入。
汇编并去重了涵盖1048个站点（136个沿脊聚类）的1344个全球MORB玻璃H₂O/Ce测量数据集。
证明了过去4亿年内水化的地幔源区MORB具有显著更高的H₂O/Ce中位数（249对比200），且与水化年龄或持续时间无关。
解析了北大西洋水化异常在劳伦大陆两侧的两个不同俯冲源（50°N以北约320 Ma的古老俯冲与20°N–35°N之间约220 Ma的法拉隆板块俯冲）。
me: Kinematic plate reconstruction tracking subducting segments from 410 to 0 Ma using a pyGPlates workflow in a mantle reference frame.
Accumulation of slab water from sediments, altered oceanic crust, and serpentinized mantle onto a 0.2° grid with a 300 km isotropic Gaussian smoothing filter.
Sensitivity testing across three absolute plate motion reference frames (optimized mean-net-rotation, no-net-rotation, and maximum-net-rotation) and shallow vs. deep devolatilization splits.
Non-parametric statistical comparison (Mann-Whitney U tests and rank regressions) on 300 km along-ridge clusters with and without plume-influenced segments.
利用pyGPlates工作流在地幔参考系中追踪410至0 Ma俯冲板块片段的运动学板块重建。
将沉积物、蚀变洋壳和蛇纹石化地幔中的板片水通过300 km各向同性高斯平滑滤波累积到0.2°网格上。
在三个绝对板块运动参考系（优化平均净旋转、无净旋转和最大净旋转）以及浅部与深部脱水拆分下进行敏感性测试。
对包含和排除地幔柱影响片段的300 km沿脊聚类进行非参数统计比较（Mann-Whitney U检验和秩回归）。
de: Global plate reconstruction model of Zahirovic et al. (2022) from 410 Ma to present coupled with Mather et al. (2026) slab volatile budgets.
Curated global compilation of 1,344 unique MORB glass H₂O/Ce analyses from 1,048 sites merged from five major literature and newly curated sources.
结合Mather等（2026）板片挥发分预算的Zahirovic等（2022）410 Ma至今全球板块重建模型。
融合五个主要文献及新整理数据源的1048个站点1344个独立MORB玻璃H₂O/Ce分析全球汇编数据集。
li: The kinematic model omits mantle flow, convective stirring, dilution by mixing, lithospheric capture, and melt extraction at ridges.
Isotropic 300 km Gaussian smoothing places water symmetrically on both subducting and overriding sides of the trench.
The reconstruction begins at 410 Ma and cannot distinguish never-hydrated mantle from mantle hydrated prior to 410 Ma.
运动学模型忽略了地幔流动、对流搅拌、混合稀释、岩石圈捕获以及洋中脊熔融抽取过程。

sum: This paper presents FaultNet, a deep learning framework designed to reconstruct complex 3D fault geometries from earthquake hypocenter catalogs. Treating hypocenters as 3D point clouds, FaultNet utilizes PointNet++ for denoising, feature learning, and semantic segmentation. Trained on synthetic earthquake catalogs, the model learns feature embeddings to identify individual fault clusters and reconstruct continuous 3D fault surfaces. The authors successfully apply FaultNet to three distinct real-world datasets: induced seismicity, a mainshock-aftershock sequence, and volcanic seismicity. Across these settings, FaultNet accurately resolves intersecting and segmented faults, matching independent geological and seismological observations. This work demonstrates that deep learning can effectively automate the extraction of complex fault systems from seismicity catalogs.
本文提出FaultNet深度学习框架，利用PointNet++将地震震源目录作为三维点云进行语义分割，以重建复杂的三维断层几何。该方法在合成地震目录上训练，能自动去噪并识别断层簇。应用于诱发地震、主震-余震及火山地震等实际数据，成功解析了相交和分段断层，与地质观测高度一致，实现了从震源分布中高效自动……

t: FaultNet formulates fault extraction from earthquake hypocenters as a 3D semantic segmentation problem, using PointNet++ to hierarchically process point coordinates, learn feature embeddings, and identify individual fault clusters.
FaultNet将地震震源的断层提取表述为三维语义分割问题，利用PointNet++分层处理点坐标并学习特征嵌入。
The model is trained on synthetic earthquake catalogs and evaluated on three real-world catalogs representing induced seismicity, mainshock-aftershock sequences, and volcanic seismicity.
该模型在合成地震目录上进行训练，并在代表诱发地震、主震-余震序列和火山地震的三个实际目录上进行评估。

FaultNet successfully resolves coherent, intersecting, and segmented 3D fault structures across diverse settings, yielding reconstructions consistent with independent geological and seismological observations.
FaultNet在多种背景下成功解析了连贯、相交和分段的三维断层结构，重建结果与独立的地质和地震观测一致。
The method's performance is inherently limited by the resolution and location errors of the input earthquake hypocenter catalogs.
该方法的性能本质上受限于输入地震震源目录的分辨率和定位误差。
First application of PointNet++ 3D semantic segmentation to automatically extract and reconstruct complex 3D fault geometries directly from earthquake hypocenter point clouds.

sum: This study investigates the dynamic evolution of in-dip double subduction systems (IDDS) using scaled laboratory experiments and thermomechanical simulations. The authors demonstrate how initial geometric inequalities amplify into asymmetric configurations depending on the inter-trench separation (λ). For large separations (λ ≥ 2500 km), the slabs behave symmetrically and independently. However, as λ decreases below 1500 km, strong inter-slab interactions and altered mantle flow patterns beneath the overriding plate drive highly asymmetric slab dynamics. The model's findings are successfully applied to real-world examples, including the Manila-Philippine, Vanuatu and Vitiaz-Tonga, and Central America-Antilles systems, providing a comprehensive framework for understanding complex multi-slab subduction zones.
本研究利用比例物理模拟和热动力学数值模拟，探讨了同向双俯冲系统（IDDS）的动力学演化机制。研究表明，初始几何不均匀性的放大导致了非对称俯冲形态的发育，这主要取决于海沟间距（λ）。当λ不小于2500千米时，双板块表现为几乎无相互作用的对称动力学特征；而当λ小于1500千米时，强烈的板块间相互作用和上……

t: Scaled laboratory experiments combined with thermomechanical numerical simulations to model the dynamic evolution of double subduction systems.
结合比例物理模拟与热动力学数值模拟，对双俯冲系统的动力学演化进行建模。
Synthetic data from dynamic simulations and physical laboratory models, compared with tectonic observations from active double subduction zones.
来自动力学模拟和物理实验模型的合成数据，并与活跃双俯冲带的构造观测进行对比。
Inter-trench separation (λ) controls asymmetry; λ ≥ 2500 km leads to symmetric, non-interacting slabs, while λ < 1500 km causes strong asymmetry.
海沟间距控制非对称性：间距不小于2500千米时板块对称且无干扰，小于1500千米时导致强非对称性。
Simplified model setups may omit complex 3D plate geometries, oblique subduction angles, and detailed mineral phase transitions.
简化的模型设置可能忽略了复杂的三维板块几何、斜向俯冲角度及详细的矿物相变。
First dynamic study demonstrating how incipient geometric inequalities spontaneously amplify into asymmetric double subduction configurations as a function of trench separation.
首次通过动力学研究证明了初始几何不均匀性如何随海沟间距变化自发放大为非对称双俯冲形态。

sum: This paper presents the initial seismic characterization results of the Euregio Meuse-Rhine candidate site for the Einstein Telescope (ET), a next-generation gravitational wave detector. Utilizing a newly deployed network of four borehole stations and co-located surface sensors, the authors analyze seven months of continuous data from 2026. They introduce 'SiteChar', a Python-based data processing framework designed to separate the ambient noise floor from anthropogenic transients, such as those from nearby railway infrastructure. The study provides a catalog and classification of these transients, analyzing their propagation to depth. This work is crucial for predicting Newtonian noise and guiding future mitigation strategies to ensure the low-frequency sensitivity of the Einstein Telescope.
本文展示了爱因斯坦望远镜（ET）候选遗址的首次井下台网地震背景噪声表征结果。研究利用2026年前7个月由4个井下台站及地表共置传感器组成的新型台网数据，开发了名为SiteChar的Python数据处理框架，实现了环境噪声底噪与人为瞬态信号（如铁路交通）的分离与分类。研究重点分析了这些瞬态信号向深部的……

sum: This study investigates the lithospheric-scale tectonic deformation of Mars to define its strength profile. By conducting systematic parameter testing on mechanical and rheological models of the Martian lithosphere, the authors constrain the planet's crustal and upper mantle strength. The modeling helps resolve how the Martian lithosphere responds to tectonic loading, providing critical insights into Mars' thermal state, crustal thickness, and long-term geodynamic evolution.

sum: This study utilizes a novel reverse experimental approach ('forced multiple saturation') to reconstruct the compositional evolution of a primitive Cape Verde basanitic magma within a mantle plume from 3 to 7 GPa (1380–1420°C). By equilibrating the melt with a garnet-lherzolite assemblage under realistic CO2 and H2O conditions, the authors show that melts transition from olivine melilititic at shallow depths (3–4 GPa) to kimberlitic at greater depths (6–7 GPa). The presence of H2O and alkalis lowers the transition temperature, allowing redox melting to generate kimberlitic melts under adiabatic conditions. As these melts ascend via porous flow, they become increasingly silica-saturated, explaining the origin of highly Si-undersaturated ocean island magmas.
本研究采用反向实验方法，重构了佛得角原始碧玄岩岩浆在3-7 GPa地幔柱中的成分演化。在真实CO2和H2O条件下，熔体在浅部（3-4 GPa）为橄榄黄长岩质，深部（6-7 GPa）演化为金伯利岩质。H2O和碱金属降低了转变温度，使氧化还原熔融在绝热条件下产生金伯利质熔体，解释了洋岛高度硅不饱和岩浆的……

sum: This study numerically investigates seismic site effects near a strong lateral discontinuity using a canonical semi-infinite sedimentary layer model. The authors simulate particle velocity, rotational motion rate, and axial strain rate for vertically incident SH, SV, and P waves, employing a novel time-frequency transfer function characterization. The results reveal that while translational particle velocity peaks at variable distances from the boundary (the basin-edge effect), rotational motion and axial strain exhibit sharp, localized peaks directly at the lateral discontinuity, particularly for SV and P waves. These findings highlight the critical role of rotational and strain components in localized earthquake damage along sharp geological boundaries, offering valuable insights for seismic hazard assessment and engineering seismology.
本研究利用半无限沉积层模型，数值模拟了强侧向不连续面附近的场地效应。通过模拟SH、SV和P波入射下的速度、旋转率和轴向应变率，并引入新型时频传递函数，发现旋转和轴向应变在不连续面处表现出急剧的局部峰值（尤其是SV和P波）。该成果揭示了旋转与应变在陡峭边界局部震害中的关键作用，对防震减灾具有重要意义。

t: Numerical simulation of vertically incident SH, SV, and P waves in a semi-infinite sedimentary layer, analyzed using novel time-frequency transfer functions.

sum: This study utilizes high-resolution receiver function imaging from the Eifel Large-N seismic experiment to investigate the lithospheric structure beneath the Quaternary Eifel volcanic fields in Central Europe. The results reveal that the Moho is locally uplifted by ~5 km (to ~28 km depth) beneath the East and West Eifel volcanic fields, and the Paleozoic basement is ~1 km shallower beneath the East Eifel. Furthermore, the lithosphere thins from ~70 km beneath the West Eifel to ~45 km beneath the East Eifel. This synchronized uplift of crustal and lithospheric discontinuities coincides with deep low-frequency earthquakes, CO2 degassing, and regional uplift, providing strong evidence for asthenospheric upwelling and transient fluid/magma migration associated with active intraplate volcanism.

sum: This book chapter introduces a mathematical framework for wave scattering by heterogeneities, detailing two distinct imaging paradigms: diffraction imaging and holography. Diffraction imaging computationally reconstructs internal structures from scattered wave measurements. In contrast, holography utilizes the complete wavefield—integrating both amplitude and phase—to physically reconstruct three-dimensional objects. This preserves shape and depth information, offering a more comprehensive representation of wave-object interactions than intensity-only methods. The work serves as a theoretical foundation for advanced wave-based imaging techniques.

sum: This publication by Andreas Fichtner addresses the persistent challenge of parameter tuning (such as step size and proposal covariance) in Monte Carlo and Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) simulations. It proposes an 'autotuning' framework designed to dynamically adjust these parameters during the inversion process. This methodology aims to significantly improve convergence rates and sampling efficiency, making high-dimensional Bayesian uncertainty quantification more accessible and less reliant on manual trial-and-error tuning in geophysical inverse problems.
本文针对蒙特卡洛及马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）模拟中参数调优（如步长或提议协方差）的挑战，提出了一种“自动调优”框架。该方法在反演过程中动态调整这些参数，从而提高了高维地球物理逆问题中的收敛速度和采样效率，使贝叶斯不确定性定量评估更加高效，减少了对手动试错调优的依赖。

t: An autotuning framework for Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) that dynamically adjusts proposal distributions and step sizes during sampling.

sum: The paper introduces NAP-Wave, a novel neural network architecture and training strategy designed to solve highly oscillatory, high-frequency Helmholtz wave propagation problems. To overcome spectral bias and optimization challenges, NAP-Wave expands the scattered wavefield using an adaptive neural plane-wave basis modulated by trainable plane-wave carriers. It utilizes a physics-informed loss based on the Lippmann-Schwinger integral equation, avoiding spatial differentiation. A decoupled optimization strategy is employed where Adam updates the basis parameters and a least-squares solver computes the linear coefficients. Additionally, an adaptive-depth progressive training scheme is used. Tested on exact-solution and highly heterogeneous geophysical benchmarks, NAP-Wave achieves relative L2 errors of 1% to 10%, significantly outperforming standard PINNs in both accuracy and convergence speed.

sum: The authors present RevealLO, a global-scale full-waveform inversion (FWI) model that updates its predecessor REVEAL. By expanding the inversion time window from 1 hour to 3.5 hours, RevealLO incorporates minor-arc (R1, G1) and major-arc (R2, G2) surface waves, alongside late-arriving multi-orbit body waves. This significantly improves azimuthal coverage beneath ocean basins and the southern hemisphere. Using the spectral-element solver Salvus, 3-D viscoelastic wavefields are simulated on cubed-sphere meshes. The velocity structure is updated across period bands from 100-200 s to 60-200 s using time-frequency phase misfits and a mini-batch stochastic trust-region L-BFGS algorithm. RevealLO improves azimuthal sampling and mitigates trade-offs between unmodeled anisotropy and isotropic structure in the upper and mid mantle.

利用Salvus进行三维波场模拟的全球全波形反演，采用时频相位误差和随机L-BFGS优化。

sum: This study utilizes field- and lidar-based geomorphic analysis of offset fluvial terrace risers to constrain the late-Holocene slip rate and slip-per-event of the Kekerengu fault, a major upper-plate splay of the Hikurangi megathrust in New Zealand. The authors document exceptionally fast late-Holocene slip rates of ~33–35 mm/yr, which exceed the late-Pleistocene rate of 20–26 mm/yr. By comparing these offsets with paleoseismic data, they show that the fault consistently experiences large coseismic displacements of ≥10 m per event, similar to the 2016 Mw 7.8 Kaikōura earthquake. These large displacements relative to the fault's length suggest a listric geometry soling into the megathrust, accommodating almost all deep plate motion. The slip rate discrepancy indicates temporal clustering or slip rate variations on upper-plate faults.
本研究利用野外和激光雷达（Lidar）数据对新西兰Kekerengu断裂（希库朗伊俯冲带上盘分支断裂）错断的河流阶地进行分析，约束了其晚全新世滑动速率及单次地震位移。结果显示，该断裂晚全新世滑动速率高达约33-35毫米/年，显著快于晚更新世的20-26毫米/年。结合古地震数据，研究表明该断裂在过去多……

sum: This study evaluates the global capability of open geodetic data (GNSS and Sentinel-1 InSAR) to detect magma accumulation beneath 1,100 subaerial Holocene volcanoes. By modeling the minimum detectable Mogi volume change at 5 km depth, the author finds that open GNSS cannot detect a 10^7 m³ volume change at 64% of highly populated, historically active volcanoes. Even when incorporating Sentinel-1 data, 53 volcanoes remain undetectable during their worst coherent seasons. The study highlights that open geodetic station distribution is often driven by population density rather than volcanic hazard, and emphasizes how national data policies (e.g., Japan's open data) significantly influence monitoring capabilities.

sum: This study demonstrates the feasibility of shared-use geophysical sensing on long, onshore, traffic-carrying telecommunication optical fibers. Utilizing a 114 km commercial roadside fiber optic cable in Ireland, the authors successfully recorded five out of six teleseismic events over a 12-day period, including the Mw 7.7 Myanmar earthquake. Additionally, they extracted interchannel cross-correlations of oceanic microseisms, monitored vehicular traffic, and detected broadband seismic signals associated with localized rainfall. The novelty lies in performing continuous, multi-scale environmental and seismological monitoring on active, long-distance terrestrial telecom infrastructure without disrupting communication traffic, paving the way for a global, cost-effective geosensor network.
本研究首次展示了在长距离、承载通信流量的陆地商业光纤上进行共享地球物理传感的可行性。利用爱尔兰114公里的商业路侧光纤，研究人员在12天内成功检测到6个远震中的5个（包括Mw 7.7缅甸地震），提取了海洋微震的通道间互相关信号，并监测了车辆交通和局部降雨引起的宽频地震信号。该研究的创新点在于，在不干……

Interchannel cross-correlation of ambient noise (oceanic microseisms).
Broadband seismic signal analysis for environmental (rainfall) and anthropogenic (traffic) sources.
在活跃的电信光纤电缆上进行分布式声学传感（DAS）。
环境噪声（海洋微震）的通道间互相关处理。
针对环境（降雨）和人为（交通）震源的宽频地震信号分析。
de: 12 days of continuous DAS recording along a 114 km commercial roadside fiber optic cable in Ireland.
Seismic waveforms of five teleseismic events, including the March 28, 2025 Mw 7.7 Myanmar earthquake.
Ambient noise data capturing oceanic microseisms, vehicular traffic, and localized rainfall.
在爱尔兰114公里商业路侧光纤上进行的为期12天的连续DAS记录。
五个远震事件的地震波形，包括2025年3月28日Mw 7.7缅甸地震。
捕获海洋微震、车辆交通和局部降雨的环境噪声数据。
li: The study is based on a relatively short observation period of 12 days.
Signal-to-noise ratio beneath 1 Hz on terrestrial fibers can be challenging due to high cultural noise.
研究基于较短的观测周期（12天）。
由于较强的人类活动噪声，陆地光纤在1 Hz以下的信噪比可能面临挑战。

tm.why: The paper focuses on using long, onshore, traffic-carrying telecom optical fibers for distributed acoustic sensing (DAS).
The study extracts interchannel cross-correlations of oceanic microseisms from the fiber data.
The paper demonstrates environmental sensing of localized rainfall and vehicular traffic using the fiber network.
